Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 IF vis = 'FALSE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 Set_Item_Property('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'STD_NORMAL_FUNCTION');
 Execute_Function('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := FALSE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_GRP_ID NUMBER;
 V_ROLE_ID NUMBER;
 V_CHK_EXP_EMP NUMBER;
v_cnt NUMBER ;
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 CHECK_NONE_GROUP_MGR(:DCLTN_ISN);
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND RMV_DT IS NULL
 AND INSPTR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;


--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = DCLTN.DU_BRKR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR') THEN
--&&& END
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND BRKR_PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND LIC_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR
 AND LIC_TYPE = :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE
 AND (
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE IN (3, 4, 5, 6) AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 OR
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE IN (1 , 2) AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1 , 2)
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN

 V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD := NULL;
 END;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (DCLTN.DU_INSP, DCLTN.DU_IMM) THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM')) THEN
--&&& END
 BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_ID
 INTO V_GRP_ID
 FROM INSPTR_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في تعريف مجموعات المعاين - يجب تعريف المعاين في مجموعات المعاينة ','ERROR');
 END;

--str.dispalert('H001','error');--

 IF AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT(V_GRP_ID) THEN
 BEGIN
--str.dispalert('H002','error');--
 SELECT DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE
 AND (
 ((INSPTR_ID IN (:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,'PSNGR_INSPCT' )
 AND GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD<>5) OR (DCLTN_STA_CD=5)
 OR ( v_cnt > 0))
 )
 ;
--str.dispalert('H003','error');--
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD := NULL;
 END;
 ELSE

 BEGIN

--str.dispalert('H004','error');--
 SELECT DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE
 AND (
 (((INSPTR_ID IN (:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,'PSNGR_INSPCT' )) OR (INSPTR_ID IS NULL) OR ( v_cnt > 0))
 AND ((GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID) OR (GROUP_ID IS NULL)) AND DCLTN_STA_CD<>5) OR (DCLTN_STA_CD=5)

 )
 ;
--str.dispalert('H005','error');--
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD := NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = DCLTN.DU_EXP THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP') THEN
--&&& END
 BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_ID
 INTO V_GRP_ID
 FROM INSPTR_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;

 EXCEPTION
/*
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في تعريف مجموعات المعاين - يجب تعريف المعاين في مجموعات المعاينة ','ERROR');
*/
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES UR
 WHERE UR.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND UR.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UR.UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND UR.ROLE_ID = 'DCLN_R38';
 IF (V_ROLE_ID > 0) THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT GROUP_ID
 INTO V_GRP_ID
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في تعريف مجموعات المعاين - يجب تعريف المعاين في مجموعات المعاينة ','ERROR');
 END IF;
 END;

 END;
--str.dispalert('m000','error');--

 IF AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT(V_GRP_ID) THEN
 BEGIN
--str.dispalert('m001','error');--
 V_CHK_EXP_EMP := CHK_EXP_EMP_TYPE;
--str.dispalert('m002','error');--
 SELECT DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 AND ( (INSPTR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID AND GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID AND DCLTN_STA_CD <>4 )
 OR
 (DCLTN_STA_CD=4 AND GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID)
 OR
 (V_CHK_EXP_EMP >= 1 AND GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID)
 )
 ;
--str.dispalert('m003','error');--
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD := NULL;
 END;
 ELSE
--str.dispalert ('m004', 'error');--
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 AND ((GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID) OR (GROUP_ID IS NULL))
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD := NULL;
 END;

 END IF;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
--str.dispalert ('m005', 'error');--
 SELECT DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND (
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE IN (3, 4, 5, 6) AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 OR
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE IN (1 , 2) AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1 , 2)
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD := NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

--str.dispalert ('m006 V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD ==> '||V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD, 'error');--

 IF V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE:=V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_ISN;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;

 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان جمركي يخصك بهذا الرقم المبدئي','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

DECLARE
 V_PORT_CD VARCHAR2(3);
 V_DCLTN_TYPE VARCHAR2(2);
 V_DCLTN_NBR VARCHAR2(10);
 V_MI VARCHAR2(2);
 V_MM VARCHAR2(2);
 V_YY VARCHAR2(2);
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_GRP_ID NUMBER;
 V_CHK_EXP_EMP NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 IF :U_IN_BAR_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_PORT_CD := SUBSTR(:U_IN_BAR_CODE, 1, 3);
 V_DCLTN_TYPE := SUBSTR(:U_IN_BAR_CODE, 4, 2);
 V_DCLTN_NBR := SUBSTR(:U_IN_BAR_CODE, 6, 10);
 V_MI := SUBSTR(:U_IN_BAR_CODE, 16, 2);
 V_MM := SUBSTR(:U_IN_BAR_CODE, 18, 2);
 V_YY := SUBSTR(:U_IN_BAR_CODE, 20, 2);

 V_DCLTN_DT := TO_DATE('14'||V_YY||'-'||V_MM||'-'||V_MI, 'YYYY-MM-MI');
 :U_IN_BAR_CODE := NULL;

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_TYPE_CD', ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := V_DCLTN_TYPE;
 END IF;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = DCLTN.DU_BRKR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR') THEN
--&&& END
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = V_DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_DT = V_DCLTN_DT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE
 AND BRKR_PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND LIC_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR
 AND LIC_TYPE = :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE
 ;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (DCLTN.DU_INSP, DCLTN.DU_IMM, DCLTN.DU_EXP) THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP')) THEN
--&&& END
 BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_ID
 INTO V_GRP_ID
 FROM INSPTR_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في تعريف مجموعات المعاين - يجب تعريف المعاين في مجموعات المعاينة ','ERROR');
 END;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID <> DCLTN.DU_EXP THEN
 IF (AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT(V_GRP_ID)) AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP') THEN
--&&& END
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = V_DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_DT = V_DCLTN_DT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE
 AND
 (
 (INSPTR_ID IN (:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,'PSNGR_INSPCT' )
 AND GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD <>5 ) OR DCLTN_STA_CD=5
 )
 ;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID <> DCLTN.DU_EXP THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP') THEN
--&&& END
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = V_DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_DT = V_DCLTN_DT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE
 AND
 ((
 ((INSPTR_ID IN (:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,'PSNGR_INSPCT' )) OR (INSPTR_ID IS NULL))
 AND
 ((GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID) OR (GROUP_ID IS NULL))
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD<>5 )
 OR (DCLTN_STA_CD=5)
 )
 ;
 ELSIF (AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT(V_GRP_ID)) AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP') THEN
 V_CHK_EXP_EMP := CHK_EXP_EMP_TYPE;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = V_DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_DT = V_DCLTN_DT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE
 AND
 (
 (INSPTR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID AND GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID AND DCLTN_STA_CD <>4 )
 OR
 (DCLTN_STA_CD=4 AND GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID)
 OR
 (V_CHK_EXP_EMP >= 1 AND GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID)
 )
 ;

 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = V_DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_DT = V_DCLTN_DT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE
 AND ((GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID) OR (GROUP_ID IS NULL))
 ;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = V_DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_DT = V_DCLTN_DT
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD= :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE
 ;
 END IF;

 IF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD := :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR := V_DCLTN_NBR;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_DT := V_DCLTN_DT;

 :GLOBAL.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان جمركي يخصك بهذا الرقم لنفس النوع','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 NEXT_ITEM;
END;

DECLARE
 V_RET NUMBER;
BEGIN

--DEVELOPED BY BILAL
-- FOR DUTY_REFUND
IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 4 THEN
 IF (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR') )
 OR (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP')AND NVL(:DCLTN_STOP,0) =1 ) THEN

 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_12',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_true);
 IF :DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('RETURN_DCLTN_NBR', TRUE);
 ELSE
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('RETURN_DCLTN_NBR', FALSE);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_12',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
ELSE
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_12',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);

END IF;

------

IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE) = 1 THEN
 IF :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM = :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM THEN
/*
 IF (NOT AIR_GRP_MANUAL) AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 4 AND :PARAMETER.P_PRIVATE_VT IS NULL THEN
 :GROUP_ID := :DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_NAME

 IF GET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS', CURRENT_RECORD),'DECLARATIONS',STATUS) NOT IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN

 :PARAMETER.P_NO_LOCK := 1;
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب إعادة تحديد مجموعة البيان قبل الحفظ','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 */

--- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM @ 31/12/2005
--- NEW CODE FOR ASSIGN GROUP FOR DCLTN
 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_LOV = 0 THEN
 :GROUP_ANAME := NULL;
 :GROUP_ID := NULL;
 V_RET := ASSIGN_GROUP;
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('GROUP_ID', TRUE);

 IF (:GROUP_ID IS NULL) THEN
 IF GET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS', CURRENT_RECORD),'DECLARATIONS',STATUS) NOT IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_NO_LOCK := 1;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_LOV := 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN

 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التعامل مع هذا النوع من البيان الجمركي','ERROR');

 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE) = 1 THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التعامل مع هذا النوع من البيان الجمركي','ERROR');

 END IF;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 1 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_CMPTR')) THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 ELSE
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PRX') THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التعامل مع هذا النوع من البيان الجمركي','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX') THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_CMPTR')) THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 ELSE
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PRX') THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التعامل مع هذا النوع من البيان الجمركي','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التعامل مع هذا النوع من البيان الجمركي','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;


 IF :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM = :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM THEN
 :GROUP_ANAME := NULL;
 :GROUP_ID := NULL;

 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('GROUP_ID', TRUE);
 SYNCHRONIZE;

 IF GET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS', CURRENT_RECORD),'DECLARATIONS',STATUS) NOT IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_NO_LOCK := 1;
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب إعادة تحديد مجموعة البيان قبل الحفظ','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_EX'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PRX')) THEN

 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR', FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR' , REQUIRED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR2', ENABLED , PROPERTY_FALSE);

 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('AGENT_NBR', TRUE);

 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = 15 THEN

 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR', TRUE);

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR2', ENABLED , PROPERTY_TRUE);

 IF GET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS', CURRENT_RECORD),'DECLARATIONS',STATUS) NOT IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_NO_LOCK := 1;
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تحديد بيانات الشركة المنتجة قبل التخزين','INFORMATION');
 END IF;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX') THEN

 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('OIL_ORDER_NBR',TRUE, 'E');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('OIL_ORDER_NBR',REQUIRED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DECLARATIONS.DHL_OWNER := NULL;
 :DECLARATIONS.DHLO_NAME := NULL;


 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DHL_OWNER',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DHL_OWNER2',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DHLO_NAME',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DHL_BL',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSE

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DHL_BL',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 SELECT TYPE_NAME
 INTO :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME
 FROM DCLTN_TYPES
 WHERE TYPE_ID = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;


 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE) = 1 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM') THEN
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_INSP');
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DCLTN_STA_CD;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_FILL');
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DCLTN_STA_CD;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP') THEN
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_REV');
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DCLTN_STA_CD;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_INIT');
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DCLTN_STA_CD;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;

END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_STMT_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_DLCTN_ISN NUMBER;
 CURSOR BRKR_DCLTN_LAND_CURSOR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT DLM.PORT_CD, DLM.DCLTN_ISN, D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM LAND_BILLS LB, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM, DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE LB.BILL_NBR = :BILL_NBR
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = LB.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = LB.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND D.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_ISN
 AND D.BRKR_PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND D.LIC_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR
 AND D.LIC_TYPE = :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE
 ;

 CURSOR EMP_DCLTN_LAND_CURSOR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT DLM.PORT_CD, DLM.DCLTN_ISN, D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM LAND_BILLS LB, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM, DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE LB.BILL_NBR = :BILL_NBR
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = LB.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = LB.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND D.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_ISN
 ;


 CURSOR INSP_DCLTN_LAND_CURSOR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT DLM.PORT_CD, DLM.DCLTN_ISN, D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM LAND_BILLS LB, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM, DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE LB.BILL_NBR = :BILL_NBR
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = LB.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = LB.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND D.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_ISN
 AND D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE
 ;
BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_LND AND :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM = :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM AND :BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND') AND :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM = :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM AND :BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
--IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = DCLTN.DU_BRKR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR') THEN
--&&& END
 FOR I IN BRKR_DCLTN_LAND_CURSOR LOOP
 V_STMT_COUNT := V_STMT_COUNT + 1;

 V_PORT_CD := I.PORT_CD;
 V_DLCTN_ISN := I.DCLTN_ISN;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := I.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_STMT_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان مربوط علي هذه البوليصة','ERROR');
 ELSIF V_STMT_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := V_DLCTN_ISN;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 ELSE
 CALL_LAND_BILL_DCLTNS;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (DCLTN.DU_IMM, DCLTN.DU_INSP) THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP')) THEN
--&&& END
 FOR I IN INSP_DCLTN_LAND_CURSOR LOOP
 V_STMT_COUNT := V_STMT_COUNT + 1;

 V_PORT_CD := I.PORT_CD;
 V_DLCTN_ISN := I.DCLTN_ISN;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := I.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_STMT_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان مربوط علي هذه البوليصة','ERROR');
 ELSIF V_STMT_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := V_DLCTN_ISN;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 ELSE
 CALL_LAND_BILL_DCLTNS;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 FOR I IN EMP_DCLTN_LAND_CURSOR LOOP
 V_STMT_COUNT := V_STMT_COUNT + 1;

 V_PORT_CD := I.PORT_CD;
 V_DLCTN_ISN := I.DCLTN_ISN;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := I.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_STMT_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان مربوط علي هذه البوليصة','ERROR');
 ELSIF V_STMT_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := V_DLCTN_ISN;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 ELSE
 CALL_LAND_BILL_DCLTNS;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

DECLARE
 V_STMT_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_DLCTN_ISN NUMBER;
 CURSOR BRKR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT ADO.PORT_CD, ADO.STMT_ISN, D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS ADO, DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE ADO.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND ADO.BILL_NBR = :BILL_NBR
 AND ADO.CARR_PREFIX = :CARR_PREFIX
 AND D.PORT_CD = ADO.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = ADO.STMT_ISN
 AND D.BRKR_PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND D.LIC_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR
 AND D.LIC_TYPE = :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE
 AND D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2)
 AND ADO.STMT_ISN IS NOT NULL
 ;


 CURSOR BRKR_EXPR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT B.PORT_CD, B.STMT_ISN, D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM BILLS B, DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE B.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND B.BILL_NBR = :BILL_NBR
 AND B.CARR_PREFIX = :CARR_PREFIX
 AND D.PORT_CD = B.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = B.STMT_ISN
 AND D.BRKR_PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND D.LIC_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR
 AND D.LIC_TYPE = :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE
 AND D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 AND B.STMT_ISN IS NOT NULL
 ;


 CURSOR INSPT_STMT_DATA_CURSOR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT ADO.PORT_CD, ADO.STMT_ISN, D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS ADO, DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE ADO.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND ADO.BILL_NBR = :BILL_NBR
 AND ADO.CARR_PREFIX = :CARR_PREFIX
 AND D.PORT_CD = ADO.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = ADO.STMT_ISN
 AND D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE
 AND ADO.STMT_ISN IS NOT NULL
 ;

 CURSOR STMT_DATA_CURSOR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT ADO.PORT_CD, ADO.STMT_ISN, D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS ADO, DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE ADO.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND ADO.BILL_NBR = :BILL_NBR
 AND ADO.CARR_PREFIX = :CARR_PREFIX
 AND D.PORT_CD = ADO.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = ADO.STMT_ISN
 AND D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2)
 AND ADO.STMT_ISN IS NOT NULL
 ;


 CURSOR EXPR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT B.PORT_CD, B.STMT_ISN, D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM BILLS B, DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE B.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND B.BILL_NBR = :BILL_NBR
 AND B.CARR_PREFIX = :CARR_PREFIX
 AND D.PORT_CD = B.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = B.STMT_ISN
 AND D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 AND B.STMT_ISN IS NOT NULL
 ;


 STMT_DATA_REC STMT_DATA_CURSOR%ROWTYPE;

BEGIN
IF :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM = :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM AND :BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :CARR_PREFIX IS NOT NULL THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = DCLTN.DU_BRKR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR') THEN
--&&& END
 OPEN BRKR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR;

 FETCH BRKR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR INTO STMT_DATA_REC;

 WHILE BRKR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR%FOUND LOOP
 V_STMT_COUNT := V_STMT_COUNT + 1;

 V_PORT_CD := STMT_DATA_REC.PORT_CD;
 V_DLCTN_ISN := STMT_DATA_REC.STMT_ISN;

 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := STMT_DATA_REC.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;

 FETCH BRKR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR INTO STMT_DATA_REC;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_STMT_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان مربوط علي هذه البوليصة','ERROR');
 ELSIF V_STMT_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := V_DLCTN_ISN;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 ELSE
 CALL_LOV_BILL_DCLTNS;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (DCLTN.DU_IMM, DCLTN.DU_INSP) THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP')) THEN
--&&& END

 OPEN INSPT_STMT_DATA_CURSOR;

 FETCH INSPT_STMT_DATA_CURSOR INTO STMT_DATA_REC;

 WHILE INSPT_STMT_DATA_CURSOR%FOUND LOOP
 V_STMT_COUNT := V_STMT_COUNT + 1;

 V_PORT_CD := STMT_DATA_REC.PORT_CD;
 V_DLCTN_ISN := STMT_DATA_REC.STMT_ISN;

 FETCH INSPT_STMT_DATA_CURSOR INTO STMT_DATA_REC;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_STMT_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان مربوط علي هذه البوليصة','ERROR');
 ELSIF V_STMT_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := V_DLCTN_ISN;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 ELSE
 CALL_LOV_BILL_DCLTNS(:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 OPEN STMT_DATA_CURSOR;

 FETCH STMT_DATA_CURSOR INTO STMT_DATA_REC;

 WHILE STMT_DATA_CURSOR%FOUND LOOP
 V_STMT_COUNT := V_STMT_COUNT + 1;

 V_PORT_CD := STMT_DATA_REC.PORT_CD;
 V_DLCTN_ISN := STMT_DATA_REC.STMT_ISN;

 FETCH STMT_DATA_CURSOR INTO STMT_DATA_REC;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_STMT_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان مربوط علي هذه البوليصة','ERROR');
 ELSIF V_STMT_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := V_DLCTN_ISN;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 ELSE
 CALL_LOV_BILL_DCLTNS;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 ELSE
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = DCLTN.DU_BRKR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR') THEN
--&&& END
 OPEN BRKR_EXPR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR;

 FETCH BRKR_EXPR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR INTO STMT_DATA_REC;

 WHILE BRKR_EXPR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR%FOUND LOOP
 V_STMT_COUNT := V_STMT_COUNT + 1;

 V_PORT_CD := STMT_DATA_REC.PORT_CD;
 V_DLCTN_ISN := STMT_DATA_REC.STMT_ISN;

 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := STMT_DATA_REC.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;

 FETCH BRKR_EXPR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR INTO STMT_DATA_REC;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_STMT_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان مربوط علي هذه البوليصة','ERROR');
 ELSIF V_STMT_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := V_DLCTN_ISN;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 ELSE
 CALL_LOV_EXPR_BILL_DCLTNS;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
 ELSE

 OPEN EXPR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR;

 FETCH EXPR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR INTO STMT_DATA_REC;

 WHILE EXPR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR%FOUND LOOP
 V_STMT_COUNT := V_STMT_COUNT + 1;

 V_PORT_CD := STMT_DATA_REC.PORT_CD;
 V_DLCTN_ISN := STMT_DATA_REC.STMT_ISN;

 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := STMT_DATA_REC.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;

 FETCH EXPR_STMT_DATA_CURSOR INTO STMT_DATA_REC;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_STMT_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان مربوط علي هذه البوليصة','ERROR');
 ELSIF V_STMT_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := V_DLCTN_ISN;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 ELSE
 CALL_LOV_EXPR_BILL_DCLTNS;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* Formatted on 2015/08/26 12:41 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
DECLARE
 v_count NUMBER;
 v_grp_id NUMBER;
 v_role_id NUMBER;
 v_du_exp_ins NUMBER;
 v_chk_exp_emp NUMBER;
 v_cnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 v_du_exp_ins := 0;

 IF :dcltn_isn IS NULL AND :dcltn_nbr IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND rmv_dt IS NULL
 AND insptr_id = :parameter.p_user_id;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = DCLTN.DU_BRKR THEN
 IF :parameter.p_task_id = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_BRKR')
 THEN
--&&& END
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_nbr = :dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_type_cd = :parameter.p_dcltn_type
 AND brkr_port_cd = :parameter.p_brkr_port_cd
 AND lic_nbr = :parameter.p_brkr_nbr
 AND lic_type = :parameter.p_lic_type;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (DCLTN.DU_INSP, DCLTN.DU_IMM, DCLTN.DU_EXP) THEN
 ELSIF :parameter.p_task_id IN
 (consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),
 consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_IMM'),
 consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_EXP')
 )
 THEN
 BEGIN
 --str.dispalert('m001','error'); --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT grp_id
 INTO v_grp_id
 FROM insptr_grps
 WHERE port_cd = :parameter.p_curr_port_cd
 AND ((user_id = :parameter.p_user_id))
 AND rec_status = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 BEGIN
 --str.dispalert('m002','error'); --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF :parameter.p_task_id =
 consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_EXP')
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_role_id
 FROM sc_user_roles ur
 WHERE ur.user_id = :parameter.p_user_id
 AND ur.port_cd = :parameter.p_curr_port_cd
 AND ur.ur_active = 1
 AND ur.role_id = 'DCLN_R38';

 IF (v_role_id > 0)
 THEN
 BEGIN
 --str.dispalert('m003','error'); --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_nbr = :dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_type_cd = :parameter.p_dcltn_type;

 v_du_exp_ins := 1;
 END;
 ELSE
 str.dispalert
 ('خطأ في تعريف مجموعات المعاين - يجب تعريف المعاين في مجموعات المعاينة ',
 'ERROR'
 );
 END IF;
 ELSE
 str.dispalert
 ('خطأ في تعريف مجموعات المعاين - يجب تعريف المعاين في مجموعات المعاينة ',
 'ERROR'
 );
 END IF;
 END;
 END;

 IF (auto_assign_act (v_grp_id))
 AND :parameter.p_task_id <> consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_EXP')
 THEN
 --str.dispalert('m004','error'); --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_nbr = :dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_type_cd = :parameter.p_dcltn_type
 AND ( ( ( insptr_id IN (:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,'PSNGR_INSPCT' )
 OR ( 0 < (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND rmv_dt IS NULL
 AND insptr_id = :parameter.p_user_id)
 )
 )
 AND GROUP_ID = v_grp_id
 AND dcltn_sta_cd <> 5
 )
 OR (dcltn_sta_cd = 5)
 );
 ELSIF :parameter.p_task_id <> consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_EXP')
 THEN
 --str.dispalert('m005','error'); --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_nbr = :dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_type_cd = :parameter.p_dcltn_type
 AND ( ( ( (insptr_id IN (:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,'PSNGR_INSPCT' ))
 OR (insptr_id IS NULL)
 OR ( 0 < (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND rmv_dt IS NULL
 AND insptr_id = :parameter.p_user_id)
 )
 )
 AND ((GROUP_ID = v_grp_id) OR (GROUP_ID IS NULL))
 AND dcltn_sta_cd <> 5
 )
 OR (dcltn_sta_cd = 5)
 );
 ELSIF (auto_assign_act (v_grp_id))
 AND :parameter.p_task_id =
 consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_EXP')
 THEN
 --str.dispalert('m006','error'); --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 v_chk_exp_emp := chk_exp_emp_type;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_nbr = :dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_type_cd = :parameter.p_dcltn_type
 AND ( ( insptr_id = :parameter.p_user_id
 AND GROUP_ID = v_grp_id
 AND dcltn_sta_cd <> 4
 )
 OR (dcltn_sta_cd = 4 AND GROUP_ID = v_grp_id)
 OR (v_chk_exp_emp >= 1 AND GROUP_ID = v_grp_id)
 );
 ELSE
 IF v_du_exp_ins = 0
 THEN
 --str.dispalert('m007','error'); --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_nbr = :dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_type_cd = :parameter.p_dcltn_type
 AND ((GROUP_ID = v_grp_id) OR (GROUP_ID IS NULL));
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 --str.dispalert('m008','error'); --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_nbr = :dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_type_cd = :parameter.p_dcltn_type;
 END IF;

 IF v_count = 1
 THEN
 DECLARE
 v_dcltn_isn NUMBER ;
 BEGIN
 SELECT MAX(dcltn_isn)
 INTO v_dcltn_isn
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_nbr = :dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_type_cd = :parameter.p_dcltn_type;
 --str.dispalert('v_dcltn_isn ==> '||v_dcltn_isn,'error'); --
 CHECK_NONE_GROUP_MGR(v_dcltn_isn);
 copy (v_dcltn_isn,'dcltn_isn');

 :GLOBAL.dcltn_nbr := :dcltn_nbr;
 :GLOBAL.dcltn_port_cd := :port_cd;
 :GLOBAL.dcltn_type_cd := :dcltn_type_cd;
 :GLOBAL.exec_query_now := 1;

 END ;

 ELSIF v_count > 1
 THEN
 disp_dcltn_lov;
 ELSE
 --str.dispalert('m009','error'); --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 str.dispalert ('لا يوجد بيان جمركي يخصك بهذا الرقم لنفس النوع',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_STA_CD IS NOT NULL THEN

 END IF;
 END;

DECLARE

 V_ERR_NUMBER NUMBER;

 --IF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE) = 0 THEN
 --SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('IMPR_NBR',REQUIRED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --END IF;

 IF :AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR IS NULL THEN

 :IMPR_NAME := :AGNT_NAME;

 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NBR;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT *
 INTO AGNT_REC
 FROM AGNTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND ATHRZTN_SEQ_NBR = :AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR;

 IF AGNT_REC.IMPR_NBR_AGENT_ID <> :AGENT_NBR THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.

--&&& END
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 180, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 190, 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.

--&&& END

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.

--&&& END

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

 -- CHECK_IMPR_BUS_ID(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,AGNT_REC.IMPR_NBR,'I');

 :IMPR_NBR := AGNT_REC.IMPR_NBR;
 BEGIN

 FROM IMPORTERS

 AND IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NBR;

 :IMPR_NAME := NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD = DCLTN.DT_IR AND :LIC_NBR IS NULL AND :LIC_TYPE IS NULL AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE <> DCLTN.PT_PO THEN

DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_OLD_CTRY_CD NUMBER;

 V_RET NUMBER ;
 V_OUT_MSG VARCHAR2(100);
 V_COUNTRY NUMBER;


BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) THEN
IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNTRY
 FROM SD_FR_PORT_CONNS
 WHERE SD_PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND FR_CTRY_CD = :FINAL_CTRY_CD
 ;

 IF V_COUNTRY > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يصح أن تكون دولة المقصد هي نفس الدولة الواردة منها البضاعة ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

--IF :FINAL_CTRY_CD IS NOT NULL AND :FINAL_CTRY_CD <> DCLTN.KSA THEN
 IF :FINAL_CTRY_CD IS NOT NULL AND :FINAL_CTRY_CD <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA') THEN
--&&& END
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CTRY_GROUP_DETAILS
 WHERE CTRY_CD = :FINAL_CTRY_CD
 AND CTRY_GRP_STAT = 1
 AND CTRY_GRP_NBR = 1
 ;

 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لابد أن تكون دولة الوصول النهائي تابعة لدول مجلس التعاون','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF :DECLARATIONS.BRKR_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL AND :DECLARATIONS.LIC_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND :DECLARATIONS.LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF NOT TRNST.VALID_TRNST_BRKR(:DECLARATIONS.BRKR_PORT_CD, :DECLARATIONS.LIC_TYPE, :DECLARATIONS.LIC_NBR) THEN
 IF TRNST.VALID_TRNST_BRKR(:DECLARATIONS.BRKR_PORT_CD, :DECLARATIONS.LIC_TYPE, :DECLARATIONS.LIC_NBR, :PORT_CD) = 0 THEN
--&&& END
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ - مخلص العبور يجب أن يكون مخلص ترانزيت','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM = :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM THEN
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_8',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT_PORT_CD',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT_PORT_CD',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT_PORT_CD2',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT_PORT_CD',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT_PORT_CD',REQUIRED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :EXIT_PORT_CD := :EXIT_PORT_CD;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT_PORT_CD',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF :EXIT_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL AND :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM = :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM THEN
 :EXIT_PORT_CD := NULL;
 :EXIT_PORT_NAME := NULL;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT_PORT_CD',REQUIRED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT_PORT_CD',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT_PORT_CD2',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_8',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;

ELSE
 V_RET := TARIFF.CHECK_ALL_TRF_ITEM_INST_EXP (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN ,1 ,:DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD,
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD,V_OUT_MSG);
 IF V_RET <> 0 THEN
 STR.DispAlert(' يوجد بنود محظورة من الدولة المختارة موجودة ' || V_OUT_MSG ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER :=0 ;
C_INVST_COMP NUMBER:=0 ;
r_count NUMBER:=0 ;
v_old_impr NUMBER ;
BEGIN
-- IMPORTER ON FORM IS INVEST COMPANY
SELECT COUNT (*) INTO V_COUNT
FROM IMPORTERS
WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
AND IMPR_NBR=:IMPR_NBR
AND IMPR_TYPE_CD=19 ;
-- HE HAS RECORD IN TABLE DCLTN_INVST
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO C_INVST_COMP
FROM DCLTN_INVST
WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN
;
BEGIN
--THE OLD ONE IN STATS_DCLTNS IS NOT INVEST COMPANY
SELECT IMPR_NBR
INTO v_old_impr
FROM DECLARATIONS
WHERE port_cd=:PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN ;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO r_count
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE
 PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR =v_old_impr
 AND IMPR_TYPE_CD<>19 ;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
END;
-- IMPORTER HAS RECORD IN INVST_COMP TABLE
IF C_INVST_COMP >0 THEN
 -- ON FORM IMPORTER IS INVEST COMPANY

 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن تعديل المستورد لانه شركة استثمارية','ERROR');-- MESSAGE
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE ; -- STOP
 END IF;
 -- the old importer is not invest company
ELSIF V_COUNT >0 AND r_count>0 then
 -- THE STATS_DCLTN IS NUMBERED
 IF :DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 if :dcltn_TYPE_CD in (1,2) then
begin
 -- INSERT RECORD INTO DCLTN_INVST
 INSERT INTO DCLTN_INVST(port_cd,dcltn_isn,DCLTN_DT,DCLTN_NBR,dcltn_type_cd,impr_nbr,dcn_status)
 VALUES(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_DT,:DCLTN_NBR,1,:IMPR_NBR,0) ; -- 1 MEANS DECLARATIONS 2 MEANS STATS
exception
 when others then
 null;
end;

 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
END;

DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'ATHR_PARAM';
 RET NUMBER;
 COUNT1 NUMBER;
BEGIN

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;


 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة إختيار تفويض المخلص');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER,10);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PORT_CD);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_MNFCT_NO.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :MNFCT_NBR := :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR ;
 :MNFCT_NAME := :GLOBAL.ARBC_IMPR_NAME;
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

END;

DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'USER_PARAM';
 RET NUMBER;
 COUNT1 NUMBER;
BEGIN

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;


 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'المعاينيين الجمركيين');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 6);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_GROUP_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :GROUP_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PORT_CD);


 IF :SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_REC_STATUS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 END IF;


CALL_FORM('LOV_INSPECTORS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 :INSPTR_ID := :GLOBAL.USER_ID ;
 :INS_ANAME := :GLOBAL.USR_ANAME;
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF :INSPTR_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT U.USR_ANAME
 INTO :INS_ANAME
 FROM SC_USERS U, INSPTR_GRPS IG
 WHERE IG.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND IG.GRP_ID = :GROUP_ID
 AND IG.USER_ID = :INSPTR_ID
 AND U.PORT_CD = IG.PORT_CD
 AND U.USER_ID = IG.USER_ID
 ;

EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;
END IF;
END;

 BEGIN
 CGFK$CHK_DECLARATIONS_DCLTN_DH(
 :DECLARATIONS.DHLO_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :DECLARATIONS.DHLO_NAME. */

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000) := NULL;
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
/*IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) THEN
 IF :FINAL_CTRY_CD IS NOT NULL AND :FINAL_CTRY_CD <> DCLTN.KSA THEN*/
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 IF :FINAL_CTRY_CD IS NOT NULL AND :FINAL_CTRY_CD <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA') THEN
--&&& END
 IF :FINAL_CTRY_CD = 113 AND :EXIT_PORT_CD NOT IN (35, 44) THEN
 V_MSG := 'المفروض أن يكون جمرك الخروج هو الخفجي أو الرقعي كي يتناسب مع بلد المقصد النهائي وهي الكويت';
 END IF;
 IF :FINAL_CTRY_CD = 116 AND :EXIT_PORT_CD <> 83 THEN
 V_MSG := 'المفروض أن يكون جمرك الخروج هو الجسر كي يتناسب مع بلد المقصد النهائي وهي البحرين';
 END IF;
 IF :FINAL_CTRY_CD = 117 AND :EXIT_PORT_CD <> 41 THEN
 V_MSG := 'المفروض أن يكون جمرك الخروج هو سلوى كي يتناسب مع بلد المقصد النهائي وهي قطر';
 END IF;
 IF :FINAL_CTRY_CD = 119 AND :EXIT_PORT_CD <> 31 THEN
 V_MSG := 'المفروض أن يكون جمرك الخروج هو البطحاء كي يتناسب مع بلد المقصد النهائي وهي عمان';
 END IF;
 IF :FINAL_CTRY_CD = 120 AND :EXIT_PORT_CD <> 31 THEN
 V_MSG := 'المفروض أن يكون جمرك الخروج هو البطحاء كي يتناسب مع بلد المقصد النهائي وهي الإمارات';
 END IF;
 IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_MSG := V_MSG || ' - هل تريد الاستمرار؟';
 RET := STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'USR_CONFIRM_B');
 IF RET = alert_button2 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :EXIT_PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يصح ان يكون الجمرك الحالي هو جمرك الخروج','ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_PORT_CD VARCHAR2(3);
 V_DCLTN_TYPE VARCHAR2(2);
 V_DCLTN_NBR VARCHAR2(6);
 V_MI VARCHAR2(2);
 V_MM VARCHAR2(2);
 V_YY VARCHAR2(2);
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_GRP_ID NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :U_EXIT_BAR_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_PORT_CD := SUBSTR(:U_EXIT_BAR_CODE, 1, 3);
 V_DCLTN_TYPE := SUBSTR(:U_EXIT_BAR_CODE, 4, 2);
 V_DCLTN_NBR := SUBSTR(:U_EXIT_BAR_CODE, 6, 6);

 V_MI := SUBSTR(:U_EXIT_BAR_CODE, 12, 2);
 V_MM := SUBSTR(:U_EXIT_BAR_CODE, 14, 2);
 V_YY := SUBSTR(:U_EXIT_BAR_CODE, 16, 2);

 V_DCLTN_DT := TO_DATE('14'||V_YY||'-'||V_MM||'-'||V_MI, 'YYYY-MM-MI');

 :U_EXIT_BAR_CODE := NULL;

 IF V_DCLTN_TYPE <> 14 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('نوع بيان الخروج لابد أن يكون عبور خروج','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 :EXIT_PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD;
 SELECT DECODE(V_DCLTN_TYPE, 11, 2, 12, 2, 13, 2, 14, 2, 15, 2, 16, 2, 1) INTO :EXIT_DCLTN_TYPE FROM DUAL;
 :EXIT_DOC_NBR := V_DCLTN_NBR;
 :EXIT_DOC_DATE := V_DCLTN_DT;

 BEGIN
 IF (name_in('DECLARATIONS.EXIT_PORT_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$CHK_DECLARATIONS_DCLTN_EX(
 :DECLARATIONS.EXIT_PORT_NAME
 ,:DECLARATIONS.EXIT_PORT_CD );
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
 END;
 COMMIT;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_DCLTN';
V_DATE DATE;
 RET NUMBER;
V_DEFF_DYS NUMBER;
 BEGIN

 IF :RETURN_DCLTN_NBR IS NULL THEN
 :RETURN_DCLTN_DT := NULL;
 :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN := NULL;
 ELSE
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_TYPE_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :RETURN_DCLTN_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_STA_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, 9);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_TASK_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'البيانات الجمركية الموجوه لنفس الرقم من نفس النوع');


 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 :RETURN_DCLTN_DT:= :GLOBAL.DCLTN_DT ;
 :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN :=:GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 ELSE
 :RETURN_DCLTN_NBR := NULL;
 :RETURN_DCLTN_DT:= NULL ;
 END IF;


 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;

/* CGDV$VALIDATE_OVF */
/* Validate this item against the REF_CODES table */
DECLARE
 curr_value VARCHAR2(2) := :DECLARATIONS.RSK_MNG;
BEGIN
 IF (name_in('DECLARATIONS.RSK_MNG') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 CGDV$REF_CODES.SOFT_VAL(P_VALUE=>curr_value, P_DOMAIN=>'RSK_MNG');
 IF (curr_value != nvl(:DECLARATIONS.RSK_MNG, 'CG$NULL') )
 THEN
 :DECLARATIONS.RSK_MNG := curr_value;
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 message('Error: Invalid value for RSK_MNG');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TYPE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نـــوع الـــبــــيـــان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TERMN_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نـــوع الـــبــــيـــان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جهة الأوضاع الخاصه', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_MNFCT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقــــم الـمـنــتــج' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INSPECTOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمــــز الجمــــــرك,رقم الـمسـتــــــورد' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_GROUP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'مـجموعة الـمعاينة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'Frgn Imp Exp Seq' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_EXIT_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_DHLOWN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في مالك بوليصة البريد السريع الدولي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BRKRAUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'تـفــويـض المخلص' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الرخصة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AG_AUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'تـفويض المسـتورد' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AGNT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب اختيار المشغل الأقتصادى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD <> 98 THEN
DECLARE
v_msg_out VARCHAR2(500);
BEGIN
v_msg_out:=lib_usr.prtl_nebras_services.get_dcltn_termination (:port_cd,:DCLTN_ISN,:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,:PARAMETER.P_user_ID);
IF v_msg_out IS NOT NULL THEN
STR.DISPALERT(v_msg_out,'ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;

GET_NOTIFICATION;
END IF;


 :RECIEVE_AUTO:=:GLOBAL.RECIEVE_AUTO;
 BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 SELECT DISTINCT PORT_CNTRCTR_CD INTO :PORT_CNTRCTR_CD
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders
 WHERE port_cd = :DECLARATIONS.port_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;
ELSE
 SELECT DISTINCT PORT_CNTRCTR_CD INTO :PORT_CNTRCTR_CD
 FROM VSSL_BLS
 WHERE port_cd = :DECLARATIONS.port_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;
END IF;
 IF :PORT_CNTRCTR_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT PORT_CNTRCTR_ANAME INTO :PORT_CNTRCTR_ANAME
 FROM PORT_CONTRACTORS
 WHERE PORT_CNTRCTR_CD = :PORT_CNTRCTR_CD;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
IF :FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
SELECT FRGN_IMP_EXP_NBR INTO :FRGN_IMP_EXP_NBR FROM FRGN_IMP_EXP
WHERE FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ = :FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ;
END IF;
DECLARE
V_DEPT_ID NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT DECODE(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,30,32,17,6,24,7,10,8,29,9,25,21,26,22,27,23,28,24,23,26,0) INTO V_DEPT_ID FROM dual;
IF (:SPCL_DEPT_ACTN IS NOT NULL AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD=CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_SPE') AND :SPCL_DEPT_ID=V_DEPT_ID) OR :SPCL_DEPT_ACTN IS NOT NULL AND
(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN
(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF'))
) AND
(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD IN
(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF'))
) THEN
SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SPCL_DEPT_ACTN',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
ELSE
SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SPCL_DEPT_ACTN',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
END IF;
END;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


BEGIN
 IF NOT (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_STA_CD = 6) AND NOT (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :DCLTN_STA_CD = 8) THEN
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DCLTN_STA_CD;
 ELSE
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (DCLTN.DU_INST, DCLTN.DU_CMPTR, DCLTN.DU_MGR) THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INST'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_CMPTR'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_MGR')) THEN
--&&& END
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DCLTN_STA_CD;

 ---START BY HOSAM TO UPDATE RELATED TABLE BRKIMP & WIVERS UPON M.ABD ELMONEEM

 DECLARE
 V_DATE DATE;
 BEGIN

 IF :PARAMETER.P_SUP_BRKR = 1 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_AUTH_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE BRKIMPS
 SET ATHRZTN_USG_NBR = ATHRZTN_USG_NBR - 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND ATHRZTN_SEQ_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_AUTH_NBR
 ;
 :PARAMETER.P_AUTH_NBR := NULL;
 IF :DECLARATIONS.BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 UPDATE BRKIMPS
 SET ATHRZTN_USG_NBR = NVL(ATHRZTN_USG_NBR, 0) + 1,
 ATHRZTN_LAST_USG_DT = V_DATE
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND ATHRZTN_SEQ_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR
 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 UPDATE WAIVERS
 SET BRK_PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,
 BRK_LIC_TYPE = :DECLARATIONS.LIC_TYPE,
 BRK_LIC_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.LIC_NBR
 WHERE WVR_PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;
 END IF;

 DB_JOURNAL.JOURNALING_OFF;
 :PARAMETER.P_SUP_BRKR :=0;
 :PARAMETER.P_AUTH_NBR := NULL;
 END;

DECLARE
 v_ivr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_send NUMBER;
 v_sadad_send NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :declarations.u_sadad_send IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 v_sadad_send := :declarations.u_sadad_send;
 :declarations.u_sadad_send := NULL;

 SELECT ivr_nbr
 INTO v_ivr_nbr
 FROM coll_orders
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND coll_ordr_nbr = :declarations.dcltn_nbr
 AND coll_ordr_dt = :declarations.dcltn_dt
 AND coll_ordr_ctgry = :declarations.dcltn_type_cd;

 IF v_sadad_send = 1
 THEN
 v_send := sadad4port.send_bill (v_ivr_nbr);
 ELSIF v_sadad_send = 2
 THEN
 v_send := sadad4port.send_bill (v_ivr_nbr, 1);
 END IF;

 IF v_send <= 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('لا يمكن إرسال الفاتورة إلى سداد - لا يمكن التخزين',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;


DECLARE
 V_GRP_ID NUMBER;
 v_count number;
BEGIN
IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0) = 1 THEN
IF :DCLTN_STA_CD <> 7 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
FROM DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS
WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
AND USER_ID_DEPT IS NOT NULL;
IF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
UPDATE DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS SET USER_ID_DEPT = NULL
WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
AND USER_ID_DEPT IS NOT NULL;
END IF;
END IF;
 IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = 36 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_ID INTO V_GRP_ID FROM DCLTN_RECEIVED
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_GRP_ID,0) <> :GROUP_ID THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_RECEIVED SET GRP_ID = :GROUP_ID
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;

IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP')) AND :DCLTN_STA_CD=15 THEN

v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(500);

 (importers.port_cd = :port_cd)

 SELECT COUNT(*)

 FROM
 importers,
 black_list_impr_risk

 WHERE (
 (importers.port_cd = :port_cd)
 AND (importers.impr_nbr = :IMPR_NBR)



 AND (importers.bus_id = black_list_impr_risk.bus_id)


 AND black_list_impr_risk.STATUS = 0 -- ACTIVE


 ) ;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;

 END;

 IF v_chk > 0
 THEN

 -- the importer of the declarations is in blacklist
 ELSE

 -- the importer of the declarations not in blacklist

 v_ret_new := 1;
 -- the importer of the declarations is in blacklist

 -- the importer of the declarations not in blacklist

--&&& END

 DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE AND
 ((
 (INSPTR_ID IN (:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID , ''PSNGR_INSPCT'' ) OR ( '

 DCLTN_STA_CD<>5) OR DCLTN_STA_CD =5 )'
 );

 DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE AND
 ((
 (INSPTR_ID IN (:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID , ''PSNGR_INSPCT'' ) OR INSPTR_ID IS NULL OR ( '
 || v_cnt

 || v_grp_id

 )'

 );

 IF auto_assign_act (v_grp_id)

 default_where,
 '
 DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3, 4, 5, 6) AND
 ((INSPTR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID AND '
 || chk_exp_emp_type
 || '= 0 AND
 GROUP_ID = '

 || ' AND
 DCLTN_STA_CD<>4) OR (DCLTN_STA_CD = 4 AND GROUP_ID = '

 || ') OR ('

 || ') )'
 );

 (GROUP_ID = '
 || v_grp_id

 );

 ELSE

 ('DECLARATIONS',
 default_where,
 '
 (
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE IN (3, 4, 5, 6) AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 OR
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE IN (1 , 2) AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1 , 2)

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('GROUP_ID', update_allowed, property_false);

PACKAGE BODY KEY_CONTROL IS
PROCEDURE FOUND_KEY IS
BEGIN

:GLOBAL.V_INSERT :=1;
:GLOBAL.V_UPDATE :=1;
:GLOBAL.V_DELETE :=1;

DECLARE
 FLAG1 NUMBER := 0;
 V_UPDATE NUMBER := 0;
 V_DELETE NUMBER := 0;
 V_INSERT NUMBER := 0;

 CURSOR C_FK(VROLE VARCHAR2) IS

 SELECT RL_SYS_UPDATE,RL_SYS_INSERT,RL_SYS_DELETE
 FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID = VROLE
 AND SYS_TYPE IN (5,6);

 CURSOR C_ROLES IS
 SELECT DISTINCT ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES SCUR
 WHERE USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID =:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID =SCUR.ROLE_ID)
 UNION
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES SCGR,SC_USER_GROUPS SCUG
 WHERE SCUG.GROUP_ID = SCGR.GROUP_ID
 AND SCUG.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND SCUG.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND GR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID =:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID =SCGR.ROLE_ID)
 MINUS
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UER.UER_ACTIVE =1;
 vc varchar2(2000) ;
 vrol_password varchar2(200) ;
 V_ROLE VARCHAR2(2000);

BEGIN
 FOR J in c_roles LOOP
 FOR I IN C_FK(J.ROLE_ID)LOOP
 FLAG1 :=1;
 IF I.RL_SYS_INSERT =1 THEN V_INSERT := 1 ; END IF;
 IF I.RL_SYS_DELETE =1 THEN V_DELETE := 1 ; END IF;
 IF I.RL_SYS_UPDATE =1 THEN V_UPDATE := 1 ; END IF;

 END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF FLAG1 =1 THEN
 IF V_INSERT = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_INSERT :=0;
 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_UPDATE = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_UPDATE :=0;
 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_DELETE =0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_DELETE :=0;
 END IF;

 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
END;
 FK_DISPLAY;
END;



 PROCEDURE FK_DISPLAY IS
 BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.V_INSERT = 0 AND :GLOBAL.V_UPDATE = 0 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR.SAVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 IF :GLOBAL.V_DELETE = 0 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR.REMOVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE KEY_CONTROL IS
 PROCEDURE FOUND_KEY ;
 PROCEDURE FK_DISPLAY ;
END;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);

 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF V_REP_PRNT_FLG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('مسار ملف التقرير غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('ملف التقرير غير معرف داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END PRINT_REPORT;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;


 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD <> 98 THEN
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;
 END IF ;
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_USER_ID VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
V_ROLE_ID VARCHAR2(30);
BEGIN
BEGIN
 SELECT UR.ROLE_ID INTO V_ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES UR
 WHERE UR.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND UR.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UR.UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND UR.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 UNION
 SELECT GR.ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES GR, SC_USER_GROUPS UG
 WHERE UG.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UG.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND GR.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 AND GR.GROUP_ID = UG.GROUP_ID
 AND GR.GR_ACTIVE = 1
 MINUS
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UER.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 AND UER.UER_ACTIVE =1
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN(FALSE);
END;
 IF V_ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL' THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG IS

 Timer_Expired varchar2(30);
 Tim timer;
 dummy varchar2(32);

begin
 Timer_Expired := Get_Application_Property(TIMER_NAME);
 if Timer_Expired = 'TURN' then
 dummy := To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS));
 if dummy <= 5.5 then
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS, 5.5);
 Delete_Timer('TURN');
 else
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS,
 To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS))-0.006);
 end if;

 :global.timer := 1;
 elsif Timer_Expired = 'RETURN' then
 if To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS)) >= 8.5 then
--Stop this timer
 Delete_Timer('RETURN');
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS, 8.5);
 else
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS,
 To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS))+0.006);
 end if;
 :global.timer := 2;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$QRY_DECLARATIONS_DCLTN_TY */
PROCEDURE CGFK$QRY_DECLARATIONS_DCLTN_TY(
 P_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME. */
 ,P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
/* Query foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT DCLTN_TYPE.TYPE_NAME
 FROM DCLTN_TYPES DCLTN_TYPE
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE.TYPE_ID = P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$CHK_DECLARATIONS_DCLTN_TY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$CHK_DECLARATIONS_DCLTN_TY */
PROCEDURE CGFK$CHK_DECLARATIONS_DCLTN_TY(
 P_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME. */
 ,P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
/* Validate foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT DCLTN_TYPE.TYPE_NAME
 FROM DCLTN_TYPES DCLTN_TYPE
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE.TYPE_ID = P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND (:PARAMETER.P_Dcltn_Type IN (1 , 2) AND DCLTN_TYPE.TYPE_ID IN (1, 2))
 OR
 (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = 15 AND :PARAMETER.P_Dcltn_Type IN (3 , 4, 5, 6) AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_Type = 1 AND DCLTN_TYPE.TYPE_ID IN (3, 4, 5, 6))
 OR
 (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID <> 15 AND :PARAMETER.P_Dcltn_Type IN (3 , 4, 5, 6) AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_Type = 1 AND DCLTN_TYPE.TYPE_ID IN (3, 4, 5))
 OR
 (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = 15 AND :PARAMETER.P_Dcltn_Type IN (3 , 4, 5, 6) AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_Type <> 1 AND DCLTN_TYPE.TYPE_ID IN (3, 4, 6))
 OR
 (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID <> 15 AND :PARAMETER.P_Dcltn_Type IN (3 , 4, 5, 6) AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_Type <> 1 AND DCLTN_TYPE.TYPE_ID IN (3, 4));
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

 AND L_IG.GRP_ID = P_GROUP_ID
 AND L_USR.PORT_CD (+) = L_IG.PORT_CD
 AND L_USR.USER_ID (+) = L_IG.USER_ID;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_INS_ANAME;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

 , P_AGNT_ACTIVITY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;
