ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('تم إضافة هذا المعاين لنفس المجموعة من قبل، فقط يمكنك إعادة تفعيله', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'USR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ,رمز المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'Grp Id,رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CTRY_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الدولة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BKM_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BKM_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رقم السجل المدني لايمكن أن يتكرر لمخلص آخر', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DHLO_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'AG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', '' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BI_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'USR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ,رمز المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VALID_DATE_NUMBER') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملية ترقيم البيان الجمركي - يجب وجود رقم وتاريخ في نفس الوقت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: XRAY_CHK_EXPORT_DCLN2
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--XRAY_CHK_EXPORT_DCLN
--DESCRIPTION : XRAY_CHK_DCLN FOR EXPORT DCLTN
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARAF
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 10/09/2006
-------------------------------------------------------------------

FUNCTION XRAY_CHK_EXPORT_DCLN2(V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS


 CURSOR DCLTN_CNTR_INSP IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2) AND
 (VSCNIN.PORT_CD, VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE, VSCNIN.MFST_NBR, VSCNIN.MFST_DT, VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ,VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT VCI.PORT_CD, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.CNTNR_SEQ , VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 FROM VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI,
 VSSL_BLs vb,
 vssl_cntnrs vc ,
 VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VCI
 WHERE vbi.PORT_CD = vb.PORT_CD
 AND vbi.MFST_NBR = vb.MFST_NBR
 AND vbi.MFST_TYPE = vb.MFST_TYPE
 AND vbi.MFST_DT = vb.MFST_DT

 AND VBI.BL_SEQ = VB.BL_SEQ
 AND vbi.CNTNR_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 AND vbi.PORT_CD = vc.PORT_CD
 AND vbi.MFST_TYPE = vc.MFST_TYPE
 AND vbi.MFST_NBR = vc.MFST_NBR
 AND vbi.MFST_DT = vc.MFST_DT
 AND vbi.CNTNR_SEQ = vc.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VC.PORT_CD = VCI.PORT_CD
 AND VC.MFST_TYPE = VCI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VC.MFST_NBR = VCI.MFST_NBR
 AND VC.MFST_DT = VCI.MFST_DT
 AND VC.CNTNR_SEQ = VCI.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND vb.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL
 AND vb.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND vb.dcltn_isn = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_CD = 2 -- معاينة يدوية--
 AND VCI.INSPCT_RESULT_CD <> 1
 --GROUP BY VCI.CNTNR_SEQ, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.PORT_CD --
 );



 V_CNTNR_MARK VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_RET BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 V_RET :=TRUE;
 V_CNTNR_MARK :=NULL;
 FOR REC IN DCLTN_CNTR_INSP LOOP
 -- BY SHERIFT @KAS
 IF REC.CNTNR_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND DCLTN_CNTR_INSP%FOUND THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2)
 AND VSCNIN.PORT_CD = REC.PORT_CD
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE = REC.MFST_TYPE
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_NBR = REC.MFST_NBR
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_DT = REC.MFST_DT
 AND VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ = REC.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_CD =4
 AND VSCNIN.INSPCT_RESULT_CD IN (1,3)
 ;
 IF V_COUNT=0 THEN
 V_RET :=FALSE;
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK IS NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 ELSE
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10) || GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF NOT V_RET THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := 'حاويات تتطلب تأكيد نتيجة فحصها يدويا' || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK;
 END IF;
 RETURN V_CNTNR_MARK;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: XRAY_CHK_EXPORT_DCLN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--XRAY_CHK_EXPORT_DCLN
--DESCRIPTION : XRAY_CHK_DCLN FOR EXPORT DCLTN
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARAF
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 10/09/2006
-------------------------------------------------------------------

FUNCTION XRAY_CHK_EXPORT_DCLN(V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS

 CURSOR DCLTN_CNTR_INSP IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2) AND
 (VSCNIN.PORT_CD, VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE, VSCNIN.MFST_NBR, VSCNIN.MFST_DT, VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ,VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT VCI.PORT_CD, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.CNTNR_SEQ
 , MAX (VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ)
 FROM VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI,
 VSSL_BLs vb,
 vssl_cntnrs vc ,
 VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VCI
 WHERE vbi.PORT_CD = vb.PORT_CD
 AND vbi.MFST_NBR = vb.MFST_NBR
 AND vbi.MFST_TYPE = vb.MFST_TYPE
 AND vbi.MFST_DT = vb.MFST_DT
 AND VBI.BL_SEQ = VB.BL_SEQ
 AND vbi.CNTNR_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 AND vbi.PORT_CD = vc.PORT_CD
 AND vbi.MFST_TYPE = vc.MFST_TYPE
 AND vbi.MFST_NBR = vc.MFST_NBR
 AND vbi.MFST_DT = vc.MFST_DT
 AND vbi.CNTNR_SEQ = vc.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VC.PORT_CD = VCI.PORT_CD
 AND VC.MFST_TYPE = VCI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VC.MFST_NBR = VCI.MFST_NBR
 AND VC.MFST_DT = VCI.MFST_DT
 AND VC.CNTNR_SEQ = VCI.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND vb.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL
 AND vb.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND vb.dcltn_isn = V_DCLTN_ISN
 GROUP BY VCI.CNTNR_SEQ, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.PORT_CD
 );

 V_CNTNR_MARK VARCHAR2(4000);
 V_CNTNR_MARK2 VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_CNTNR_MARK3 VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_CNT_MRK VARCHAR2(20);
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP BOOLEAN;
 V_TST_REC BOOLEAN;
V_RET VARCHAR(100);
BEGIN
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := TRUE;
 V_CNTNR_MARK := NULL;

 FOR REC IN DCLTN_CNTR_INSP LOOP
 V_TST_REC := TRUE;
 -- BY SHERIFT UPON A.HASAN --
 IF REC.INSPCT_ACTN_CD IN (1,2,3,4) THEN
 IF NOT (REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 1 OR REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 3) THEN -- حالة أن نتيجة الفحص سليمة يمكن فسحها أو سليمة سحب عينات --
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := FALSE ;
 V_TST_REC := FALSE;
 IF REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 0 OR REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 4 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 IF REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 2 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE -- REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 5 --
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- حالة دخول الحاوية فقط و لم تفحص بعد--
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := FALSE ;
 V_TST_REC := FALSE;
 END IF;
 IF NOT V_TST_REC THEN
 V_CNT_MRK :=GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK IS NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNT_MRK;
 ELSE
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10)|| V_CNT_MRK;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- TO CHK CONFIRM OR NOT BY SHERIFT 09/10/2005 --
 IF XRAY_CHK_CNTNR_CNFRM(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ )=0 THEN
 V_CNT_MRK :=GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK3 IS NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK3 := V_CNT_MRK;
 ELSE
 V_CNTNR_MARK3 := V_CNTNR_MARK3 || CHR(10)|| V_CNT_MRK;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- --
 END LOOP;
 V_CNTNR_MARK2 := XRAY_CHK_EXPORT_DCLN2(V_DCLTN_ISN );
 IF NOT V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := 'حاويات لا تزال في مرحلة الفحص بالإشعة ' || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK;
 END IF;
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK3 IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK3 := 'حاويات تحتاج الى تأكيد نتيجة فحص ' || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK3;
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK3;
 END IF;
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK2 IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK2;
 END IF;

 IF V_CNTNR_MARK IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := CHR(1000) || V_CNTNR_MARK;
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_CNTNR_MARK, 'INFORMATION', 1, 'قائمة الحاويات التي لا تزال في الفحص بالإشعة',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 12);

 END IF;
 RETURN V_CNTNR_MARK;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: XRAY_CHK_CNTNR_CNFRM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION XRAY_CHK_CNTNR_CNFRM(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER,V_MFST_NBR NUMBER,V_MFST_DT DATE,V_CNTNR_SEQ NUMBER)
 RETURN INTEGER IS
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD1 NUMBER;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD2 NUMBER;
 I NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER:=0;
 V_XRAY_CNFRM_USR_EXIST VARCHAR2(50);

 CURSOR vci_crsr1 IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_PORT_CD, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1;

 CURSOR vci_crsr2 IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_PORT_CD, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND INSPCT_ACTN_CD=3
 ORDER BY INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ;
BEGIN

 IF :GLOBAL.XRAY_CNFRM_USR_EXIST ='Y' THEN
 FOR REC IN vci_crsr1 LOOP
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD1 := REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD;
 END LOOP;
 I :=0;
 FOR REC2 IN vci_crsr2 LOOP
 I := I+1;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD2 := REC2.INSPCT_RESULT_CD;
 IF V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD1 = V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD2 AND I=1 THEN
 RET :=1;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF RET = 0 AND I>1 THEN
 RET :=1;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET :=1;
 END IF;
 RETURN RET;
END;

PROCEDURE VHCLS_ARRVL IS

 V_DUMMY NUMBER;

 no_query_only,
 pl_id);


 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPT_DCTN_ITEMS_PRC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPT_DCTN_ITEMS_PRC IS
 CURSOR V_ITEMS IS
 SELECT *
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

V_RET_VAL VARCHAR2(20);
V_RETURN_VALUE NUMBER;
V_DTL_SEQ NUMBER;
V_SETTING NUMBER:= NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CHK_PRICING_TARIFF', 21), 0);
V_ACT_SETT NUMBER:= NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting ('DM_379', 21), 0);
BEGIN
 IF V_ACT_SETT = 0 THEN RETURN; END IF;
 FOR I IN V_ITEMS LOOP
 -- الجمرك غير مفعل
 IF V_SETTING = 0 THEN
 V_RET_VAL:=PRICING_DB.IS_PRICING_TARIFF_CD(I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD);
 IF V_RET_VAL IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS
 SET PRICING_APPRV = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN AND PRICING_APPRV IN (2,3);
 END IF;

 -- الجمرك مفعل
 ELSIF V_SETTING = 1 THEN
 V_RETURN_VALUE:=PRICING_DB.IS_PRICING_TARIFF_CD_NEW(I.PORT_CD, I.ITEM_ISN, V_DTL_SEQ);
 IF V_RETURN_VALUE = 1 THEN PRICING_DB.PRICING_TARIFF_CD_ACTION(I.PORT_CD, I.ITEM_ISN, V_DTL_SEQ); END IF;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_STATS_4_EXP_CNTRS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPDATE_STATS_4_EXP_CNTRS(V_DLCLTN_ISN NUMBER) IS
 CURSOR CR IS SELECT vssl_cntnrs.PORT_CD, vssl_cntnrs.MFST_TYPE, vssl_cntnrs.MFST_NBR, vssl_cntnrs.MFST_DT, vssl_cntnrs.CNTNR_SEQ
 FROM vssl_cntnrs, vssl_bl_items vbi, vssl_bls vbs
 WHERE ( (vssl_cntnrs.port_cd = vbi.port_cd)
 AND (vssl_cntnrs.mfst_type = vbi.mfst_type)
 AND (vssl_cntnrs.mfst_nbr = vbi.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vssl_cntnrs.mfst_dt = vbi.mfst_dt)
 AND (vssl_cntnrs.cntnr_seq = vbi.cntnr_seq)
 AND (vbs.port_cd = vbi.port_cd)
 AND (vbs.mfst_type = vbi.mfst_type)
 AND (vbs.mfst_nbr = vbi.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vbs.mfst_dt = vbi.mfst_dt)
 AND (vbs.bl_seq = vbi.bl_seq)
 AND (vbs.DCLTN_ISN = V_DLCLTN_ISN)
 AND (NVL(vssl_cntnrs.CNTNR_STA_CD,0)<>1 )
 )
 ;

BEGIN
 FOR I IN CR LOOP
 UPDATE VSSL_CNTNRS
 SET CNTNR_STA_CD = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = I.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = I.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = I.MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = I.CNTNR_SEQ
 ;
 -- DM-364B Mohamed Shehata 15-12-2018
 -- call the cntnr_movment procedure to insert a record in cntnrs_movments table
 IF NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting('CNTNR_MOVMENT_DM364',18),0) = 1 THEN
 DECLARE
 p_message_code NUMBER;
 p_message_desc VARCHAR2(200);
 v_cntnr_mrk VARCHAR2(25);
 v_cntnr_type_cd NUMBER(2);
 BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT cntnr_mrk,cntnr_type_cd
 INTO v_cntnr_mrk,v_cntnr_type_cd
 FROM vssl_cntnrs
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = I.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = I.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = I.MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = I.CNTNR_SEQ
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 --
 sea_shpmt.cntnr_movment(i.port_cd,v_cntnr_mrk,v_cntnr_type_cd,4,11,p_message_code,p_message_desc);
 forms_ddl('commit');
 END;
 END IF;
 ------- end DM-364B -----------
 END LOOP;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_PORT_CONTRACTOR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_port_contractor IS
V_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD VARCHAR2(20);
v_DSCHRG_AREA_CD VARCHAR2(20);
ret NUMBER;
PL_ID PARAMLIST;
BEGIN
 PL_ID := GET_PARAMETER_LIST('LOV_PORT_CONTRACTORS');
 IF ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN
 PL_ID := CREATE_PARAMETER_LIST('LOV_PORT_CONTRACTORS');
 IF ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('Error creating parameter list LOV_PORT_CONTRACTORS','SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_TITLE ', TEXT_PARAMETER,'قائمة متعهد التفريغ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_WIDTH ', TEXT_PARAMETER,7.5);
 -- ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_CURR_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PORT_CD);


 CALL_FORM('LOV_PORT_DSC_AREA.FMX',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,NO_QUERY_ONLY,PL_ID);

 IF :GLOBAL.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم تغيير شركة المناولة - هل ترغب في إستكمال ؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 :PORT_CNTRCTR_CD := :GLOBAL.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD;
 :PORT_CNTRCTR_ANAME := :GLOBAL.PORT_CNTRCTR_ANAME;
 :DSCHRG_AREA_CD := :GLOBAL.DSCHRG_AREA_CD;
 BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 SELECT DISTINCT PORT_CNTRCTR_CD,DSCHRG_AREA_CD INTO V_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD,v_DSCHRG_AREA_CD
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders
 WHERE port_cd = :DECLARATIONS.port_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;
ELSE
 SELECT DISTINCT PORT_CNTRCTR_CD INTO V_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD
 FROM VSSL_BLS
 WHERE port_cd = :DECLARATIONS.port_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN V_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD:='0';
 END;
IF V_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD <> :PORT_CNTRCTR_CD OR v_DSCHRG_AREA_CD <> :DSCHRG_AREA_CD THEN
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 UPDATE sea_dlvy_orders SET PORT_CNTRCTR_CD = :PORT_CNTRCTR_CD,DSCHRG_AREA_CD = :DSCHRG_AREA_CD
 WHERE port_cd = :DECLARATIONS.port_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;
ELSE
 UPDATE VSSL_BLS SET PORT_CNTRCTR_CD = :PORT_CNTRCTR_CD
 WHERE port_cd = :DECLARATIONS.port_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;
END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
STR.DISPALERT('يوجد خطأ','INFORMATION');
TERMINATE_FUN;
END;
 STR.DISPALERT('تم تغيير شركة المناولة','INFORMATION');
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
END IF;
 END IF;
END;

 END IF;
 DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST(PL_ID);
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('Parameter list '||'LOV_PORT_CONTRACTORS'||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_DEPT_WORK_FLAG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_dept_work_flag IS
v_count NUMBER;
V_24HOURS NUMBER :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0);
v_filler1 VARCHAR2(20);
V_MSG VARCHAR2(200);
v_dcltn_sta_cd NUMBER;
V_EXIST NUMBER;
v_track_seq NUMBER;
v_status NUMBER;
ret NUMBER;
v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(500);
BEGIN
IF V_24HOURS = 1 THEN
SELECT filler1 INTO v_filler1 FROM TASKS
 WHERE TASK_ID =NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0);
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND work_flag = 0;
IF v_count = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
 FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn AND work_flag = 0
 AND TO_CHAR(DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID) = v_filler1
 AND USER_ID_RECEIVER = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 IF v_count = 1 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS := 3;
 :dcltn_sta_cd:=:U_DCLTN_STATUS;
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;
 IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('CLEAR_RECP_USER',21),0) = 1 THEN
 FORMs_ddl('UPDATE DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS SET USER_ID_RECEIVER = NULL WHERE port_cd = '||:port_cd||' AND dcltn_stats_isn= '||:dcltn_isn );
 FORMs_ddl('COMMIT');
 END IF;
 COMMIT;
 FORMS_DDL('UPDATE declarations SET DCLTN_STA_CD = 3 WHERE port_cd = '||:port_cd||' AND dcltn_isn= '||:dcltn_isn );
 FORMs_ddl('DELETE FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV WHERE port_cd = '||:port_cd||' AND dcltn_isn= '||:dcltn_isn );

 -- SELECT dcltn_sta_cd INTO v_dcltn_sta_cd
 -- FROM declarations
 -- WHERE port_cd = :port_cd AND dcltn_isn=:dcltn_isn;
 -- IF v_dcltn_sta_cd = 3 THEN
 -- DELETE FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 -- WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 -- AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn AND work_flag = 0
 -- AND TO_CHAR(DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID) = v_filler1
 -- AND USER_ID_RECEIVER = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;

 FORMs_ddl('COMMIT');
 LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,TO_NUMBER(v_filler1),36,5,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret :=
 activity_db.add_activity (21,
 20,
 2,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN||'!'||v_filler1,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 standard.commit;
 V_MSG:='تم التحويل لقسم الاستقبال';
 -- END IF;
 END IF;
ELSIF v_count > 1 THEN
 DELETE FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn AND work_flag = 0
 AND TO_CHAR(DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID) = v_filler1
 AND USER_ID_RECEIVER = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,TO_NUMBER(v_filler1),NULL,5,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret :=
 activity_db.add_activity (21,
 20,
 2,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN||'!'||v_filler1,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 standard.commit;
 V_MSG:='تم الانتهاء من المعامله';
END IF;
STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG,'INFORMATION');
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXIST FROM
(SELECT PORT_CD,dcltn_isn,INSERT_DT,USER_ID_RECEIVER,'BEFORE_RCV' V_TYPE
 FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE work_flag = 0 AND TO_CHAR(DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID) = v_filler1
 AND (USER_ID_RECEIVER = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID OR USER_ID_RECEIVER IS NULL)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT D1.PORT_CD,D1.dcltn_isn,TRANS_HIST,RECIVER_USER,'AFTER_RCV' V_TYPE
 FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES D1,DECLARATIONS D2
 WHERE TO_CHAR(SPCL_DEPT_ID_TO) = v_filler1
 AND D1.DCLTN_ISN IN (SELECT DCLTN_STATS_ISN FROM DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS)
 AND D1.DCLTN_ISN = D2.DCLTN_ISN
 AND trans_hist IN (
 SELECT MAX (t1.trans_hist)
 FROM dcltn_spcl_dept_transes t1
 WHERE t1.dcltn_isn = d1.dcltn_isn)
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD=7
 AND (RECIVER_USER = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID OR RECIVER_USER IS NULL));
IF V_EXIST = 0 THEN
 :global.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :PORT_CD;
 :global.DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_ISN;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 :GLOBAL.REFRESH_DCLTN := 1;
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM:='DCLTN_NBR';
ELSE
display_new_dcltn_queue;
END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPDATE_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANS IS
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;

 p_rqst_nmr NUMBER;
 p_rqst_dt DATE;
 V_24HOURS NUMBER:=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0);
 V_FUN_RET NUMBER;
BEGIN

 IF CHECK_DCLTN_IS_RECIVE(V_PORT_CD,V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ) = 1 THEN

 SET RECIVER_USER = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,TRANS_HIST_TO = SYSDATE

 ELSIF CHECK_DCLTN_IS_RECIVE(V_PORT_CD,V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ) = -1 THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: TRANS_SPCL_DEPT_UPDATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE TRANS_SPCL_DEPT_UPDATE IS
V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ NUMBER;
V_SPCL_DEPT_ID NUMBER;
V_SND_REC_STA NUMBER;
 V_SND_RCV_ACT NUMBER;
 v_prtl_exist NUMBER;
 V_24HOURS NUMBER :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0);

BEGIN





 IF :GLOBAL.SEC_SND_RCV_EXIST = 1 AND
 GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SPCL_DEPT_ID',DATABASE_VALUE) <>:SPCL_DEPT_ID
 AND :GLOBAL.SPCL_DEPT_ID_CHANGE=1 THEN


 SELECT MAX(SPCL_DEPT_SEQ) INTO V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES
 WHERE PORT_CD=:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN;

 SELECT SND_REC_STA INTO V_SND_REC_STA
 FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_REFS
 WHERE SPCL_DEPT_ID = :SPCL_DEPT_ID ;
 SELECT INSTR(NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('SND_RCV_ACT',21),0),'|'||:SPCL_DEPT_ID||'|')
 INTO V_SND_RCV_ACT
 FROM DUAL;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_prtl_exist
 FROM dcltn_prtl_docs
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd AND dcltn_stats_isn = :dcltn_isn;
 IF V_SND_RCV_ACT > 0 AND V_24HOURS = 1 AND v_prtl_exist = 1 THEN
 V_SND_REC_STA :=1;
 END IF;

 IF V_SND_REC_STA = 1 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES SET
 -- SPCL_DEPT_ID =:SPCL_DEPT_ID
 SPCL_DEPT_ID_TO =:SPCL_DEPT_ID
 ,SENDER_USER =:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 ,RECIVER_USER =NULL
 ,TRANS_HIST_TO =NULL
 WHERE PORT_CD =:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND
 SPCL_DEPT_SEQ =V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ ;
 ELSE


 UPDATE DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES SET
 -- SPCL_DEPT_ID =:SPCL_DEPT_ID
 SPCL_DEPT_ID_TO =:SPCL_DEPT_ID
 ,SENDER_USER =:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 ,RECIVER_USER =:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 ,TRANS_HIST_TO =SYSDATE
 WHERE PORT_CD =:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND
 SPCL_DEPT_SEQ =V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ ;

 END IF;



 END IF;

:GLOBAL.SPCL_DEPT_ID_CHANGE:=0;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TRANSFER_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE TRANSFER_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT(P_TRANSFER_TYPE NUMBER,MAX_KEY_RET OUT NUMBER ) IS
 V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_SPCL_DEPT_ID NUMBER;
 V_SND_REC_STA NUMBER;
 MESSAGE NUMBER := 0 ;
 V_SND_RCV_ACT NUMBER;
 v_prtl_exist NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;
 v_track_seq NUMBER;
 v_status NUMBER;
 v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(500);
 v_actvy_type NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_STA_CD NUMBER;
 V_24HOURS NUMBER :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0);
BEGIN

 IF :GLOBAL.SEC_SND_RCV_EXIST = 1 THEN

 SELECT SND_REC_STA INTO V_SND_REC_STA
 FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_REFS
 WHERE SPCL_DEPT_ID = :SPCL_DEPT_ID ;
 SELECT INSTR(NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('SND_RCV_ACT',21),0),'|'||:SPCL_DEPT_ID||'|')
 INTO V_SND_RCV_ACT
 FROM DUAL;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_prtl_exist
 FROM dcltn_prtl_docs
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd AND dcltn_stats_isn = :dcltn_isn;
 IF V_SND_RCV_ACT > 0 AND V_24HOURS = 1 AND v_prtl_exist = 1 THEN
 V_SND_REC_STA :=1;
 END IF;
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD = 3 THEN
 V_SPCL_DEPT_ID := 95 ;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_STA_CD = 15 THEN
 V_SPCL_DEPT_ID := 96 ;
 END IF;

 FOR CO IN 1..3 LOOP

 ret := activity_db.add_activity (21,
 1,
 28,

 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );

IF V_SND_REC_STA = 1 THEN
 FORMS_DDL('
INSERT INTO DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES D(D.PORT_CD, D.SPCL_DEPT_SEQ, D.TRANS_HIST,

 D.SENDER_USER, D.RECIVER_USER, D.TRANS_HIST_TO) VALUES
 ('||:PORT_CD||','||V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ||',SYSDATE,'||V_SPCL_DEPT_ID||','||:DCLTN_ISN||','||:SPCL_DEPT_ID
 ||','''||:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID||''',NULL,NULL)');
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 FORMS_DDL(' INSERT INTO DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES D(D.PORT_CD, D.SPCL_DEPT_SEQ, D.TRANS_HIST,
 D.SPCL_DEPT_ID, D.DCLTN_ISN, D.SPCL_DEPT_ID_TO,
 D.SENDER_USER, D.RECIVER_USER, D.TRANS_HIST_TO) VALUES
 ('||:PORT_CD||','||V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ||',SYSDATE,'||V_SPCL_DEPT_ID||','||:DCLTN_ISN||','||:SPCL_DEPT_ID
 ||','''||:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID||''','''||:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID||''',SYSDATE)');
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- من الأوضاع الخاصة الى رئيس المجموعة او المعاين
 if V_SPCL_DEPT_ID = 96 then
 v_actvy_type:=14;
 V_DCLTN_STA_CD:=15;
 else
 v_actvy_type:=64;
 V_DCLTN_STA_CD:=3;
 end if;
LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,:SPCL_DEPT_ID,V_SPCL_DEPT_ID,12,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret := activity_db.add_activity (21,
 1,
 v_actvy_type,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN

 END IF;
IF V_SND_REC_STA = 1 THEN
 FORMS_DDL('INSERT INTO DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES D(D.PORT_CD, D.SPCL_DEPT_SEQ, D.TRANS_HIST,
 D.SPCL_DEPT_ID, D.DCLTN_ISN, D.SPCL_DEPT_ID_TO,
 D.SENDER_USER, D.RECIVER_USER, D.TRANS_HIST_TO) VALUES
 ('||:PORT_CD||','||V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ||',SYSDATE,'||:SPCL_DEPT_ID||','||:DCLTN_ISN||','||V_SPCL_DEPT_ID
 ||','''||:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID||''',NULL,NULL)');
 FORMS_DDL('UPDATE declarations SET SPCL_DEPT_ID=NULL,DCLTN_STA_CD = '||V_DCLTN_STA_CD||' WHERE port_cd = '||:port_cd||' AND dcltn_isn= '||:dcltn_isn );
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 FORMS_DDL('INSERT INTO DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES D(D.PORT_CD, D.SPCL_DEPT_SEQ, D.TRANS_HIST,
 D.SPCL_DEPT_ID, D.DCLTN_ISN, D.SPCL_DEPT_ID_TO,
 D.SENDER_USER, D.RECIVER_USER, D.TRANS_HIST_TO) VALUES
 ('||:PORT_CD||','||V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ||',SYSDATE,'||:SPCL_DEPT_ID||','||:DCLTN_ISN||','||V_SPCL_DEPT_ID
 ||','''||:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID||''','''||:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID||''',SYSDATE)');
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE:=1;
 END;
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 END LOOP;

 IF MESSAGE =1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يرجى المحاولة مرة اخرى','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SUP_UPD_IMPR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SUP_UPD_IMPR IS
 lnOldAuth NUMBER ;
 ldCurHijDate DATE;
 lnPrtTy NUMBER ;
BEGIN


 -- UPDATE WAIVER
 UPDATE WAIVERS SET IMPR_NBR = :impr_NBR
 WHERE WVR_PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;

 UPDATE SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SET IMPR_NBR = :impr_NBR
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;


 -- UPDATE COLL ORDERS
 IF :DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE COLL_ORDERS SET PAYER = (SELECT ARBC_IMPR_NAME FROM IMPORTERS WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND IMPORTERS.IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NBR)
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD ;
 END IF;

 -- UPDATE SEA DLVY. ORDERS
 SELECT PORT_TYPE INTO lnPrtTy FROM SD_PORTS WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD ;
 IF lnPrtTy = 1 THEN
 UPDATE SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SET IMPR_NBR = DECODE(NVL(IMPR_NBR,0),0,IMPR_NBR,:AGENT_NBR)
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: STRG_INSURANCE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE STRG_INSURANCE(V_STATUS BOOLEAN) IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_AMT NUMBER;
 V_SRCE_PORT_AMT NUMBER;
 V_OLD_ACCT_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_NEW_ACCT_SEQ NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF V_STATUS = TRUE THEN
 V_OLD_ACCT_SEQ := 11;
 V_NEW_ACCT_SEQ := 22;
 ELSE
 V_OLD_ACCT_SEQ := 22;
 V_NEW_ACCT_SEQ := 11;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(NVL(AMT,0)), SUM(NVL(SRCE_PORT_AMT, 0))
 INTO V_AMT, V_SRCE_PORT_AMT
 FROM COLL_ORDER_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND ACCT_SEQ = V_OLD_ACCT_SEQ
 ;

 V_AMT := NVL(V_AMT, 0);
 V_SRCE_PORT_AMT := NVL(V_SRCE_PORT_AMT, 0);

 IF V_AMT > 0 OR V_SRCE_PORT_AMT > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM COLL_ORDER_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND ACCT_SEQ = V_NEW_ACCT_SEQ
 ;

 DELETE COLL_ORDER_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND ACCT_SEQ = V_OLD_ACCT_SEQ
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 UPDATE COLL_ORDER_DTLS
 SET AMT = AMT + V_AMT, SRCE_PORT_AMT = SRCE_PORT_AMT + V_SRCE_PORT_AMT
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND ACCT_SEQ = V_NEW_ACCT_SEQ
 ;
 ELSE
 INSERT INTO COLL_ORDER_DTLS(PORT_CD, COLL_ORDR_NBR, COLL_ORDR_DT, COLL_ORDR_CTGRY, ACCT_SEQ, AMT, SRCE_PORT_AMT)
 VALUES (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD, :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR, :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT, :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD, V_NEW_ACCT_SEQ, V_AMT, V_SRCE_PORT_AMT )
 ;
 END IF;

 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(NVL(AMT, 0)), SUM(NVL(SRCE_PORT_AMT, 0))
 INTO V_AMT, V_SRCE_PORT_AMT
 FROM DCLTN_ADDNL_FEES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ACCT_SEQ = V_OLD_ACCT_SEQ
 ;

 V_AMT := NVL(V_AMT, 0);
 V_SRCE_PORT_AMT := NVL(V_SRCE_PORT_AMT, 0);

 IF V_AMT > 0 OR V_SRCE_PORT_AMT > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DCLTN_ADDNL_FEES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ACCT_SEQ = V_NEW_ACCT_SEQ
 ;

 DELETE DCLTN_ADDNL_FEES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ACCT_SEQ = V_OLD_ACCT_SEQ
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_ADDNL_FEES
 SET AMT = AMT + V_AMT, SRCE_PORT_AMT = SRCE_PORT_AMT + V_SRCE_PORT_AMT
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ACCT_SEQ = V_NEW_ACCT_SEQ
 ;
 ELSE
 INSERT INTO DCLTN_ADDNL_FEES(PORT_CD, DCLTN_ISN, ACCT_SEQ, AMT, SRCE_PORT_AMT)
 VALUES (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD, :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN, V_NEW_ACCT_SEQ, V_AMT, V_SRCE_PORT_AMT )
 ;
 END IF;

 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: START_SUPPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE START_SUPPORT IS
MESSAGE_LEVEL NUMBER := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 DCLTN_STATUS NUMBER;
 ACTV_RET BOOLEAN;
 PKEY VARCHAR2(200);
 ALERT_MESSAGE VARCHAR2(1000);
 ALERT_RET NUMBER;
 PL_ID PARAMLIST;

BEGIN
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 25;
 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;
 PL_ID := GET_PARAMETER_LIST('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 IF ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN
 PL_ID := CREATE_PARAMETER_LIST('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 IF ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('Error creating parameter list SUPPORT_ENTRY','SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_X_POS',TEXT_PARAMETER,1.5);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_Y_POS',TEXT_PARAMETER,2);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_MODE',TEXT_PARAMETER,0);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 CALL_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY.FMX',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,NO_QUERY_ONLY,PL_ID);
 DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST(PL_ID);
 IF :GLOBAL.LETTER_NBR IS NULL THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ALERT_MESSAGE := 'لقد أدخلت بيانات المساندة الفنية التالية' || CHR(10) || CHR(13);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'جمرك الخطاب: ' || :GLOBAL.PORT_NAME || CHR(10) || CHR(13);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'جهة الخطاب: ' || :GLOBAL.SUPP_TITLE_NAME || CHR(10) || CHR(13);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'رقم الخطاب: ' || :GLOBAL.LETTER_NBR || CHR(10) || CHR(13);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'تاريخ الخطاب: ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(:GLOBAL.LETTER_DT),'MI-MM-RRRR') || CHR(10) || CHR(13);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'هل ترغب في إجراء المساندة الفنية وفق هذه البيانات؟';
 ALERT_RET := STR.DISPALERT(ALERT_MESSAGE,'USR_CONFIRM');
 IF ALERT_RET <> ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('Parameter list '||'SUPPORT_ENTRY'||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 DB_JOURNAL.JOURNALING_ON(:GLOBAL.PORT_CD,:GLOBAL.SUPP_TITLE_CD,:GLOBAL.LETTER_NBR,:GLOBAL.LETTER_DT);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SPC_DEPT_RCV_TRANS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2017/03/01 12:30 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
PROCEDURE spc_dept_rcv_trans (v_name_NOT_RISK VARCHAR2, v_oper VARCHAR2)
IS
 v_insert_count_RISK NUMBER;

 v_name VARCHAR2(200);
 v_word VARCHAR2 (200);
 v_begin NUMBER;
 v_end NUMBER;
 namelength NUMBER;
 v_pos NUMBER;
 v_track_seq NUMBER;
 v_status NUMBER;
 ret NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(500);
 CURSOR S IS SELECT spcl_dept_id FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RISKS
 WHERE PORT_CD =:PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND WORK_FLAG = 0 AND INSTR(v_name,'!'||spcl_dept_id||'!') = 0
 AND SUBSTR(v_name,0,INSTR(v_name,'!'))<>spcl_dept_id||'!';
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) THEN
 RETURN ;
END IF;
 v_name :=v_name_NOT_RISK;

 IF v_oper = 'I' THEN

 FOR REC IN S LOOP
 v_name:=v_name||REC.spcl_dept_id||'!';
 END LOOP;
 END IF;

 v_begin := 1;
 v_end := 1;


 namelength := LENGTH (v_name);

 WHILE (v_begin <= namelength)
 LOOP
 v_pos := INSTR (v_name, '!', v_begin);

 IF v_pos <= 0
 THEN
 v_end := namelength + 1;
 ELSE
 v_end := v_pos;
 END IF;

 v_word := SUBSTR (v_name, v_begin, v_end - v_begin);

 IF v_oper = 'I'
 THEN
 INSERT INTO dcltn_spc_dept_rcv
 (port_cd, dsdr_seq, dsdr_spcl_dept_id,
 dcltn_isn, user_id_sender, work_flag, insert_dt,
 allowed_hours
 )
 VALUES (:port_cd, dsdr_seq.NEXTVAL, TO_NUMBER (v_word),
 :dcltn_isn, :parameter.p_user_id, 0, SYSDATE,
 6
 );

 IF TO_NUMBER (v_word) = 2 THEN
 /*
 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS
 SET PRICING_APPRV = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN AND PRICING_APPRV IN (2,3);
 */
 UPT_DCTN_ITEMS_PRC;
 END IF;


 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO v_insert_count_RISK FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RISKS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :dcltn_isn
 AND spcl_dept_id= TO_NUMBER (v_word);

 IF v_insert_count_RISK > 0 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RISKS SET WORK_FLAG = 1
 WHERE spcl_dept_id=TO_NUMBER (v_word) AND DCLTN_ISN = :dcltn_isn
 AND PORT_CD = :PORT_CD;

 ret :=
 activity_db.add_activity (21,
 21,
 2,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN||'!'||TO_NUMBER (v_word),
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_msg_txt
 );



 END IF;


LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,36,TO_NUMBER (v_word),4,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret :=
 activity_db.add_activity (21,
 20,
 1,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN||'!'||TO_NUMBER (v_word),
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSIF v_oper = 'D'
 THEN
 --IF TO_NUMBER (v_word) = 2 THEN
 --UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS
 --SET PRICING_APPRV = 2
 --WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 --AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN AND PRICING_APPRV IN (1);
 --END IF;

 DELETE FROM dcltn_spc_dept_rcv
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND dsdr_spcl_dept_id = TO_NUMBER (v_word)
 AND user_id_receiver IS NULL;
 SELECT COUNT (*)INTO V_CNT FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF V_CNT = 0 THEN
 LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,TO_NUMBER(v_word),36,5,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ELSE
 LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,TO_NUMBER(v_word),NULL,5,v_track_seq,v_status);
 END IF;
 ret :=
 activity_db.add_activity (21,
 20,
 2,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN||'!'||TO_NUMBER (v_word),
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 v_begin := v_end + 1;
 END LOOP;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SHOW_DEPT_RCV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SHOW_DEPT_RCV IS
V_DEPT_EXIST NUMBER;
V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
V_MSG_end VARCHAR2(500);
V_COUNT NUMBER;
V_24HOURS NUMBER :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0);
V_RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF V_24HOURS = 1 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
FROM TASKS
WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) AND FILLER1 IS NOT NULL;
IF V_COUNT > 0 OR
 NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) IN (36,CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')) THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_DEPT_EXIST
FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS
WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 21
 AND SUBJ_CODE = 20
 AND ACTVY_TYPE = 1
 AND ACTVY_SUB_ID LIKE :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN||'!%';
IF V_DEPT_EXIST > 0 THEN
DECLARE
CURSOR S_start IS
SELECT DISTINCT D2.DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME
FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS,DECLARATIONS D1,DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_REFS D2
WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 21
 AND SUBJ_CODE = 20
 AND ACTVY_TYPE = 1
 AND ACTVY_SUB_ID LIKE D1.PORT_CD||'!'||D1.DCLTN_ISN||'!%'
 AND D2.SPCL_DEPT_ID = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(ACTVY_SUB_ID,INSTR(ACTVY_SUB_ID,'!',4)+1))
 AND D1.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND D1.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;
CURSOR S_end IS
SELECT DISTINCT D2.DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME
FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS,DECLARATIONS D1,DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_REFS D2
WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 21
 AND SUBJ_CODE = 20
 AND ACTVY_TYPE = 2
 AND ACTVY_DATE IN (SELECT MAX(a1.ACTVY_DATE) FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS a1
 WHERE a1.SYSOBJ_ID = 21
 AND a1.SUBJ_CODE = 20
 AND a1.ACTVY_SUB_ID = ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.ACTVY_SUB_ID)
 AND ACTVY_SUB_ID LIKE D1.PORT_CD||'!'||D1.DCLTN_ISN||'!%'
 AND D2.SPCL_DEPT_ID = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(ACTVY_SUB_ID,INSTR(ACTVY_SUB_ID,'!',4)+1))
 AND D1.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND D1.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;

BEGIN
FOR REC IN S_start LOOP
V_MSG :=V_MSG||','||REC.DEPT_NAME;
END LOOP;
V_MSG := CHR(1000)||' البيان حول من موظف الاستقبال الي '||SUBSTR(V_MSG,2);
FOR REC IN S_end LOOP
V_MSG_end :=V_MSG_end||','||REC.DEPT_NAME;
END LOOP;
IF V_COUNT > 0 OR NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) IN (36) AND V_MSG_end IS NOT NULL THEN
V_MSG := V_MSG||CHR(10)||'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------'
 ||CHR(10)||' تم انهاء الاجراءات من '||SUBSTR(V_MSG_end,2);
END IF;
 v_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR', 1, 'معلومات الاقسام المختصة الخاصة بالمعاملة',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1150, 'r0g0b75', 4);
END;
END IF;
END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SHOW_DCLTN_EXPLAIN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE show_dcltn_explain(V_DISPLAY_MODE NUMBER) IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'TMPLT_MOD_CALL';
 RET NUMBER;
 V_FROM_DEPT NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM TASKS
 WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) AND FILLER1 IS NOT NULL
 ;

 IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = 36 THEN
 V_FROM_DEPT:=36;
 ELSIF v_count > 0 THEN
 SELECT FILLER1 INTO V_FROM_DEPT
 FROM TASKS
 WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0);
 ELSIF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) IN
(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM'),
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP')) AND CHK_EXP_EMP_TYPE=0 THEN
 V_FROM_DEPT:=95;
 ELSIF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')
 OR (NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP')
 AND CHK_EXP_EMP_TYPE <> 0 ) THEN
 V_FROM_DEPT:=96;
 END IF;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_SPCL_DEPT_ID_FROM', TEXT_PARAMETER,V_FROM_DEPT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DISP_ONLY', TEXT_PARAMETER,V_DISPLAY_MODE);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SHOW_DCLTN_EXP_ACTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE show_dcltn_exp_action(v_daction_id NUMBER) IS
CURSOR s IS SELECT DISTINCT dept_name
 FROM CUSTOMS.DCLTN_EXPLAIN_ACTION D1, CUSTOMS.DCLTN_EXPLAIN D2,DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_REFS d3
 WHERE D1.PORT_CD = D2.PORT_CD
 AND D1.EXPLAIN_SEQ = D2.EXPLAIN_SEQ
 AND d2.SPCL_DEPT_ID_FROM = d3.SPCL_DEPT_ID
 AND D2.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DACTION_ID = v_daction_id;
v_msg VARCHAR2(900);
v_info VARCHAR2(900);
ret NUMBER;
v_REJECT_STAGE NUMBER;
BEGIN
FOR rec IN s LOOP
v_msg:=','||rec.dept_name||v_msg;
END LOOP;
v_msg:=SUBSTR(v_msg,2);
IF v_daction_id = 3 THEN
v_info:=' تم الطلب من الاقسام التالية اختيار حاوية للفحص اليدوي ';
ELSIF v_daction_id = 1 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_REJECT_STAGE
 FROM CUSTOMS.DCLTN_EXPLAIN_ACTION D1, CUSTOMS.DCLTN_EXPLAIN D2
 WHERE D1.PORT_CD = D2.PORT_CD
 AND D1.EXPLAIN_SEQ = D2.EXPLAIN_SEQ
 AND D2.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DACTION_ID = 1
 AND DONE_FLAG IS NULL;
IF v_REJECT_STAGE > 0 THEN
v_info:=' تم الطلب من الاقسام التالية رفض المعاملة ';
ELSE
v_info:=' تم الطلب من الاقسام التالية رفض المعاملة و قام المخلص بإعادة الارشفة يجب إعادتها لهم للمراجعة ';
END IF;
END IF;
v_info:=V_INFO||v_msg||' لا يمكن الاستمرار ';

RET := STR.DispALERT(v_info,'ERROR');
terminate_fun;
END;

V_DGT_SEQ NUMBER;

BEGIN

 ---تقفيل الشحن البحري والجاف والجوي---

 THEN
 UPDATE VSSL_BLS

 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD

 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE =
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.PT_DRY')

 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE =
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 THEN
 UPDATE BILLS
 SET BILL_STATUS = 4
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND BILL_STATUS IN (2, 3);
 END IF;


 SELECT NVL (MAX (DGT.DGT_SEQ) + 1, 1)
 INTO V_DGT_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE DGT.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

 CLRNC_DT,
 CLRD_QTY,

 CLRNC_NOTE,

 VHCL_TRANS_DATE,
 GATE_NBR,
 SHIFT_ID)
 VALUES (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN,
 V_DGT_SEQ,
 CURR_DATE,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 1,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL);
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY (21,
 1,
 58,
 :PORT_CD || '!' || :DCLTN_ISN)
 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_BAL_ADJUST_BY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2020/02/19 12:37 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
PROCEDURE set_bal_adjust_by
IS
 v_othr_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_cl_nbr NUMBER;
 v_cl_dt DATE;
 v_cl_type NUMBER;
 v_cl_val NUMBER;
 v_dcltn_dt DATE;
 v_dcltn_nbr NUMBER;
 v_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_dcltn_isn NUMBER;
 v_bal_adjust_by VARCHAR2 (500);
BEGIN
 v_port_cd := :declarations.port_cd;
 v_dcltn_isn := :declarations.dcltn_isn;

 SELECT EXIT_PORT_CD, dcltn_dt, dcltn_nbr
 INTO v_othr_port_cd, v_dcltn_dt, v_dcltn_nbr
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn;

 v_bal_adjust_by :=
 'dcltn2210!'
 || v_dcltn_nbr
 || '!'
 || TO_CHAR (v_dcltn_dt, 'mi-mm-yyyy')
 || '!'
 || v_othr_port_cd
 || '!'
 || v_cl_val;

 UPDATE customs.credit_letters
 SET bal_adjust_by = v_bal_adjust_by
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.brkr_port_cd
 AND cr_letr_nbr = :declarations.cl_nbr
 AND cr_letr_dt = :declarations.cl_dt
 AND cr_letr_type = :declarations.cl_type;

 IF NOT activity.add_activity (21,
 1,
 195,
 :declarations.port_cd
 || '!'
 || :declarations.dcltn_isn
 )
 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
END;

PROCEDURE RUN_FUN(FN IN VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST) IS

 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 CURSOR c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 IS SELECT VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 FROM sc_port_setting
 WHERE sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 5
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 FOR i IN c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 LOOP
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 END LOOP;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RJCT_BLKLST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RJCT_BLKLST IS

 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG_LVL NUMBER;
 v_rsk_mng NUMBER;
PROCEDURE updt_rsk(p_val NUMBER) IS
BEGIN
 FORMS_DDL('UPDATE declarations SET rsk_mng= '|| p_val ||' WHERE port_cd = '||:port_cd||' AND dcltn_isn= '||:dcltn_isn );
 FORMs_ddl(' COMMIT');
END updt_rsk ;
BEGIN

SELECT rsk_mng
INTO v_rsk_mng
FROM declarations
WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn ;

 -- IF :RSK_MNG IN (1,2,11,12,22,21,32,23) THEN--

 -- RET := STR.DispALERT(' سوف يتم رفض الفحص هل ترغب فى الاستمرار ؟ ','CONFIRM'); ----





 RET :=FLASH_CLR_ALERT (
 ' الإرسالية ضمن المسار الاحمر ويوجد ملاحظات عليها : ويجب استكمال اجراءات التدقيق , هل تريد الاستمرار؟',
 'CONFIRM',
 1,
 'رسالة تأكيد',
 5.5,
 1.8,
 2.5,
 0.5,
 1300,
 'r255g255b255',
 'r255g0b0',
 1

 ) ;



 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN


 V_MSG_LVL:=:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;--

 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 25;--

 intrface.make_block_full_operation('DECLARATIONS',TRUE,TRUE,TRUE);

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RSK_MNG',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RSK_MNG',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RSK_MNG',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);


 if v_RSK_MNG in (1,2) then
 :RSK_MNG:= 3 ;
 updt_rsk(3) ;
 elsif v_RSK_MNG in (11,12,22,32,23,21) then
 :RSK_MNG:= 33 ;
 updt_rsk(33) ;
 ELSIF v_RSK_MNG IN (10,20) THEN
 :RSK_MNG:= 30 ;
 updt_rsk(30) ;
 END IF;

 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=V_MSG_LVL;

 END IF ;

 -- END IF ; --
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.dispalert('حدث خطأ فى وظيفة الرفض للمسار الاحمر يرجى الاتصال بقسم الحاسب الالى','error');-- TO BE CHANGED LATER
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETURN_REFUND_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RETURN_REFUND_DCLTN IS
 V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_COUNT_USED NUMBER;
 V_DATE DATE;
 V_DEFF_DYS NUMBER;
 V_IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER:=GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN',DATABASE_VALUE);

BEGIN


IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN',DATABASE_VALUE) IS NOT NULL AND :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN IS NULL
 AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR') THEN

 UPDATE DCLTN_DUTY_REFUND
 SET EXPORT_DCLTN_ISN = NULL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DELETE_DATE IS NULL
 AND EXPORT_DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN := NULL;

ELSIF (( GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN',DATABASE_VALUE) IS NULL AND :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL)
 OR (GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN',DATABASE_VALUE) != :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN AND :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL ))
 AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR') THEN

 SELECT IMPR_NBR INTO V_IMPR_NBR
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN =:IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 IF V_IMPR_NBR != :AGENT_NBR THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('مستورد بيان الاستيراد مختلف عن مصدر هذا البيان','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DCLTN_DUTY_REFUND
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DELETE_DATE IS NULL
 ;
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT_USED
 FROM DCLTN_DUTY_REFUND
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN
 AND EXPORT_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL
 AND DELETE_DATE IS NULL
 ;

 SELECT COLL_DT INTO V_DATE
 FROM COLL_ORDERS CO,DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE CO.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD
 AND CO.COLL_ORDR_NBR = D.DCLTN_NBR
 AND CO.COLL_ORDR_DT = D.DCLTN_DT
 AND CO.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN =:IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 V_DEFF_DYS := HIJDATE_DB.TO_GREG(:DCLTN_DT)- HIJDATE_DB.TO_GREG(V_DATE) ;

 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن استعادة رسوم بيان الاستيراد المدخل لأنه تم تسديد رسومه قبل اكثر من سنة ميلادية ..والمفترض ان لا تزيد المدة عن سنة ميلادية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF V_COUNT_USED >0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تمت اعادة رسوم بيان الإستيراد المدخل سابقا.. ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF V_DEFF_DYS > 365.25 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن استعادة رسوم هذا البيان لأنه تم تحصيل رسومه قبل اكثر من سنة ميلادية ..والمفترض ان لا تزيد المدة عن سنة ميلادية','ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 IF V_IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL AND V_IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN != :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN AND :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_DUTY_REFUND
 SET EXPORT_DCLTN_ISN = NULL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DELETE_DATE IS NULL
 AND EXPORT_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL
 ;
 END IF;

 UPDATE DCLTN_DUTY_REFUND
 SET EXPORT_DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :IMPORT_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DELETE_DATE IS NULL
 AND EXPORT_DCLTN_ISN IS NULL
 ;
END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('رقم او تاريخ بيان الاستيراد غير صحيح','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RET_HANDING_BILLS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- MODIFYIED BY KAMEL@4145 IN 20/04/2008 OT ACHIEVE NEW BUSINESSES REQUIRED FOR BOOKED ITEMS
PROCEDURE RET_HANDING_BILLS IS
 TODAY DATE ;
 V_RET_HANDING_NBR NUMBER ;
 V_RET_BILL_NBR VARCHAR2(2000);
 RET NUMBER;

 CURSOR C1 IS SELECT RET_BILL_NBR
 FROM RET_REPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD,0) <> 99 AND NVL(STAGE_CD,0) <> 97
 AND NVL(STATUS,0) <> 1;
BEGIN

 TODAY := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم إصدار محضر تسليم لمحاضر حجز البيان - هل ترغب في إستكمال إصدار؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 SELECT NVL(MAX (RET_HANDING_NBR),0) + 1 INTO V_RET_HANDING_NBR
 FROM RET_HANDINGS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD;

 RET := STR.DispALERT('هل ترغب بالأيداع بالساحة الجمركية أم بالمستودع فى حالة الموافقة سيتم الأيداع لكل محاضر الحجز بالمستودع .. فى حالة عدم الموافقة سيتم الأيداع لكل محاضر الحجز بالساحة ؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button2 THEN

 INSERT INTO RET_HANDINGS(PORT_CD,RET_HANDING_NBR,RET_HANDING_DT,HAND_ATHORTY_CD,STATUS,LAST_HANDING_DT)
 VALUES (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,V_RET_HANDING_NBR,TODAY,4,2,TODAY) ;

 UPDATE RET_REPS
 SET RET_HANDING_NBR = V_RET_HANDING_NBR , RET_FLAG = 1 , STORG_NBR = NULL , STORE_TYPE = 3 , STAGE_CD = 3
 ,STORG_LOC_CD ='الساحة'--LOCATION
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD,0) = 2 -- <> 99 CHANGED TO 3 FOR GIVE AVI. TO RET DEP. TO BACK IT AGAIN TO INSP. (13/04/2009)
 AND NVL(STATUS,0) = 0 ; -- <> 1;


 UPDATE RET_ITEMS
 SET STAGE_CD = 3
 WHERE (PORT_CD, RET_BILL_NBR) IN
 (SELECT PORT_CD, RET_BILL_NBR
 FROM RET_REPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD AND
 DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 )
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD,0) = 2 -- <> 99 CHANGED TO 3 FOR GIVE AVI. TO RET DEP. TO BACK IT AGAIN TO INSP. (13/04/2009)
 AND NVL(STATUS,0) = 0 ; -- <> 1;

 ELSIF Ret = alert_button1 THEN

 INSERT INTO RET_HANDINGS(PORT_CD,RET_HANDING_NBR,RET_HANDING_DT,HAND_ATHORTY_CD,STATUS,LAST_HANDING_DT)
 VALUES (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,V_RET_HANDING_NBR,TODAY,4,1,TODAY) ;

 UPDATE RET_REPS
 SET RET_HANDING_NBR = V_RET_HANDING_NBR , RET_FLAG = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD,0) = 2 -- <> 99
 AND NVL(STATUS,0) = 0 ; -- <> 1;
 END IF;


 FOR I IN C1 LOOP
 INSERT INTO RET_HANDING_BILLS(PORT_CD,RET_HANDING_NBR,RET_BILL_NBR,RET_FLAG)
 VALUES (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,V_RET_HANDING_NBR,I.RET_BILL_NBR,0) ;

 IF V_RET_BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_RET_BILL_NBR :=V_RET_BILL_NBR||','||I.RET_BILL_NBR;
 ELSE
 V_RET_BILL_NBR :=I.RET_BILL_NBR;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 STR.DISPALERT('تم إنشاء محضر تسليم رقم ' ||V_RET_HANDING_NBR||' بتاريخ ' ||TO_CHAR(TODAY,'MI-MM-YYYY')|| CHR(13) || CHR(10) ||
 'ملحوظة هامة : سيتم الأن طباعة محضر تسليم البيان و محاضر الحجز الخاصة بالبيان','INFORMATION');

 PRINT_RET_BILL(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,V_RET_BILL_NBR);
 Win_Api_Utility.Sleep(8000);
 PRINT_RET_HANDING_NBR (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,V_RET_HANDING_NBR);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RE_PRINT_HANDING_REPORTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- MODIFYIED BY KAMEL@4145 IN 20/04/2008 OT ACHIEVE NEW BUSINESSES REQUIRED FOR BOOKED ITEMS
PROCEDURE RE_PRINT_HANDING_REPORTS IS
 TO_DAY DATE ;
 V_RET_HANDING_NBR NUMBER ;
 V_RET_BILL_NBR VARCHAR2(2000);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_STATUS NUMBER;
 V_LAST_HANDING_SER NUMBER;

 CURSOR C1 IS SELECT RET_BILL_NBR
 FROM RET_REPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD,0) <> 99
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD,0) <> 97
 AND NVL(STATUS,0) <> 1;

BEGIN

 FOR I IN C1 LOOP

 IF V_RET_BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_RET_BILL_NBR :=V_RET_BILL_NBR||','||I.RET_BILL_NBR;
 ELSE
 V_RET_BILL_NBR :=I.RET_BILL_NBR;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 BEGIN

 SELECT ret_handings.ret_handing_nbr,ret_handings.STATUS,ret_handings.LAST_HANDING_SER INTO V_RET_HANDING_NBR,V_STATUS,V_LAST_HANDING_SER
 FROM declarations, ret_reps, ret_handing_bills, ret_handings
 WHERE ( (declarations.port_cd = ret_reps.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = ret_reps.dcltn_isn)
 AND (ret_reps.port_cd = ret_handing_bills.port_cd)
 AND (ret_reps.ret_bill_nbr = ret_handing_bills.ret_bill_nbr)
 AND (ret_handings.port_cd = ret_handing_bills.port_cd)
 AND (ret_handings.ret_handing_nbr = ret_handing_bills.ret_handing_nbr
 )
 AND ((NVL(ret_reps.STAGE_CD,0) <> 99) AND NVL(ret_reps.STAGE_CD,0) <> 97 )
 AND ((NVL(ret_reps.STATUS,0) <> 1))
 AND ((declarations.port_cd = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD))
 AND ((declarations.dcltn_isn = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN))
 AND ((ret_handings.status IN(1,2,3,9)))
 );

 IF V_STATUS IN(3,9) THEN
 TO_DAY:=HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
 UPDATE ret_handings SET STATUS=1 ,LAST_HANDING_SER=V_LAST_HANDING_SER+1,LAST_HANDING_DT=TO_DAY
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD AND RET_HANDING_NBR=V_RET_HANDING_NBR;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END IF;


 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يوجد أكثر من محضر تسليم فعال - خطأ بالبيانات','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد محضر تسليم فعال - خطأ بالبيانات','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ بالبيانات','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END;

 PRINT_RET_BILL(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,V_RET_BILL_NBR);
 Win_Api_Utility.Sleep(8000);
 PRINT_RET_HANDING_NBR (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,V_RET_HANDING_NBR);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: REPRINT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE REPRINT IS
 V_MAX_PRINT NUMBER;
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'TMPLT_MOD_CALL';
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN

 V_MAX_PRINT :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('MAX_DCLTN_PRINT_CNT',21),0);
 IF NVL(:PRINT_CNT,0) >= V_MAX_PRINT THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,215 , 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم إعادة طباعة المعامله - هل ترغب في إستكمال الطباعة؟','CONFIRM');

 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 END IF;

 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN

 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 11, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --3/09/2008 :PRINT_CNT := NVL(:PRINT_CNT,0) + 1;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REPRINT_RSN_CD',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REPRINT_RSN_CD',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REPRINT_RSN_CD',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REPRINT_RSN_CD',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REPRINT_RSN_CD',REQUIRED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REPRINT_RSN_CD',ITEM_IS_VALID,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 GO_ITEM('REPRINT_RSN_CD');
 IF :NEED_PRINT = 1 THEN
 :DECLARATIONS.REPRINT_RSN_CD := 4;
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب التخزين ليتم عملية الطباعة','INFORMATION');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REPRINT_RSN_CD',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSE
 :DECLARATIONS.REPRINT_RSN_CD := NULL;
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DECLARATIONS.REPRINT_RSN_CD';
 END IF;

 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX') THEN
 PRINT_PETROLEUM_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD, :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_DCLTN_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_PORT_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_DCLTN_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_REPRINT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PRIVATE_AIR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_PRIVATE_VT);

-- IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND :FINAL_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN
-- V_DCLTN_COPIES := COPIES_COUNT;
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'COPIES', TEXT_PARAMETER, V_DCLTN_COPIES);
-- END IF;

-- IF CHK_DIFF_CLR THEN
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_IMPR_DIFF_CLRNC', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
-- END IF;
-- ACTUAL_CD := DCLTN.ENCRYPT_NUM(:DCLTN_ISN, :PRINT_CNT);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_PRNT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, ACTUAL_CD);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NNOTEXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: REJECT_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE reject_dcltn IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'CALL_RJCTION_NOTE';
 RET NUMBER;
 COUNT1 NUMBER;
 V_RJCTION_NOTE VARCHAR2(500);
 V_RJCTION_CD NUMBER ;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(500);
 v_track_seq NUMBER;
 v_status NUMBER;
 v_from NUMBER;
 v_count NUMBER;
 P_TRANS_TYPE NUMBER;
V_NOTE VARCHAR2(500);
X NUMBER;

ProgramUnit.Name: REASSIGN_INSPTR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE REASSIGN_INSPTR IS
 H_DATE DATE;
 V_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL NUMBER ;

 OLD_ASSIGN BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 INSPTR_CHANGED BOOLEAN := TRUE;

 CURSOR INSPTR_DCLTNS_RECS IS
 (
 SELECT PORT_CD, ASSIGN_ISN, WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL, GRP_ID, INSPTR_ID
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND END_DATE IS NULL
 AND RMV_DT IS NULL
 );

BEGIN
 H_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;

 FOR I IN INSPTR_DCLTNS_RECS LOOP
 OLD_ASSIGN := TRUE;

 IF :INSPTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND :INSPTR_ID = I.INSPTR_ID AND :DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID = I.GRP_ID THEN
 INSPTR_CHANGED := FALSE;
 END IF;

 UPDATE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 SET RMV_DT = H_DATE,
 RMV_RSN = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_RMV_RSN,1)
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND ASSIGN_ISN = I.ASSIGN_ISN
 ;
 :PARAMETER.P_RMV_RSN:=NULL;
 UPDATE INSPTR_GRPS
 SET RMVD_DCLTN_COUNT = RMVD_DCLTN_COUNT + 1,
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL = WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL - I.WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = I.GRP_ID
 AND USER_ID = I.INSPTR_ID
 ;
 END LOOP;


 IF :INSPTR_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF (OLD_ASSIGN AND INSPTR_CHANGED)
 OR
 (NOT OLD_ASSIGN)
 THEN
 V_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL := GET_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL;

 INSERT INTO INSPTR_DCLTNS(PORT_CD, ASSIGN_ISN, DCLTN_ISN, GRP_ID, INSPTR_ID, ASSGIN_DT, END_DATE, RMV_DT, RMV_RSN, REQ_DT, WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL,RE_GRP_ID, RE_INSPTR_ID,ASS_GREG_DT)
 VALUES (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD, AUTO_ASSGN_ISN.NEXTVAL, :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN, :DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID, :INSPTR_ID, H_DATE, NULL, NULL, NULL, H_DATE, V_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL, NULL, NULL,SYSDATE)
 ;

 UPDATE INSPTR_GRPS
 SET ACT_DCLTN_COUNT = ACT_DCLTN_COUNT + 1,
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL= WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL + V_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = :DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID
 AND USER_ID = :INSPTR_ID
 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE PRINT_PETROLEUM_DCLTN(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) IS
 V_FILE_NAME CONSTANT VARCHAR2(20) := 'DCLN3150';
 V_SYSOBJ_ID NUMBER;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_DCLN3150';
 V_PRINT_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYSOBJ_ID, SYS_OS_LOCATION
 INTO V_SYSOBJ_ID, V_CALLED_FORM
 FROM SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS
 WHERE SYS_OS_FILE_NAME = V_FILE_NAME
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في تعريف تقرير البيان البترولي على النظام', 'ERROR');
 RETURN;
 END;

 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;

 V_PRINT_CD := DCLTN.ENCRYPT_NUM(:DCLTN_ISN, :PRINT_CNT);
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(V_SYSOBJ_ID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'PARAMFORM' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,V_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_ISN',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_DCLTN_ISN);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_PRINT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,V_PRINT_CD);
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
END;

 IF FAST_TRACK THEN

 ACTUAL_CD := DCLTN.ENCRYPT_NUM(:DCLTN_ISN, :PRINT_CNT);

 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);

 ELSE

ProgramUnit.Name: PREVENT_GRP_PRESIDENT_ACTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE prevent_grp_president_action IS
 --NIB1-4404 to fix issue in JIRA -- CR-9582
 /*
 حسب الاجتماع مع التشغيل
 التعديل كالاتي
 منع التعامل مع البيانات من نوع فسح مباشر من خلال شاشة بيان وارد رئيس مجموعة
 لذلك سيتم ايقاف كل الوظائف في الشاشة حتي لا يتعامل معها رئيس المجموعة
 */
 v_recs number;
BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = 4 then -- رئيس مجموعة بيان وارد
 select count(*)

 where port_cd = :port_cd
 and GRP_ID = :group_id
 and grp_type = 2
 ;
 ----
 if v_recs = 1 then
 str.dispalert('ليس لديك صلاحية التعامل مع هذا البيان .. حيث أن البيان فسح مباشر','ERROR');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 terminate_fun;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POST_HOURS24
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE post_hours24 IS
V_PRTL_AFF NUMBER;
BEGIN

IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0) = 1 THEN
IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')
 OR (NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP')
 AND CHK_EXP_EMP_TYPE <> 0 ) THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_PRTL_AFF FROM DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND dcltn_stats_isn = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND USER_ID_AFF IS NULL;
 IF V_PRTL_AFF = 1 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS SET USER_ID_AFF = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND dcltn_stats_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND USER_ID_AFF IS NULL;
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 END IF;
END IF;
DECLARE
 V_COUNT_EXIST NUMBER;
 V_USER_ID_RECEIVER VARCHAR2(30);
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_exist_in_dept NUMBER;
 V_CHIEF NUMBER;
 V_EXIT_TRANS NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
FROM TASKS
WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) AND FILLER1 IS NOT NULL
;

IF :SPCL_DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
IF :RECIEVE_AUTO = 0 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXIT_TRANS
FROM declarations,DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS
WHERE dcltn_isn = DCLTN_STATS_ISN
AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
AND USER_ID_DEPT IS NULL
AND TO_CHAR(SPCL_DEPT_ID) IN (SELECT filler1 FROM TASKS
 WHERE TASK_ID =NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) );
IF V_EXIT_TRANS = 1 THEN
UPDATE DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS SET USER_ID_DEPT = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
WHERE dcltn_stats_isn = :dcltn_isn
AND USER_ID_DEPT IS NULL;
STANDARD.COMMIT;
END IF;
END IF;
ELSE
 IF :RECIEVE_AUTO = 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID = (SELECT FILLER1 FROM TASKS
 WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) )
 AND USER_ID_RECEIVER IS NULL
 ;
 IF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV SET USER_ID_RECEIVER = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID = (SELECT FILLER1 FROM TASKS
 WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) )
 AND USER_ID_RECEIVER IS NULL
 ;
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;
END IF;
DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER;
RET NUMBER;
V_DCLTN_EXPLAIN NUMBER;

pl_id ParamList;
pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'TMPLT_MOD_CALL';
V_FROM_DEPT NUMBER;

BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
FROM TASKS
WHERE (TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) AND FILLER1 IS NOT NULL)
 OR NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) IN (36,CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF'));
IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_DCLTN_EXPLAIN
FROM DCLTN_EXPLAIN
WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN;
IF V_DCLTN_EXPLAIN > 0 AND :GLOBAL.DONTSHOW = 0 THEN
RET:=STR.DISPALERT('يوجد شروحات علي البيان هل تريد الاستعراض','CONFIRM');
IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
--SHOW_DCLTN_EXPLAIN(0);
BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM TASKS
 WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) AND FILLER1 IS NOT NULL
 ;

 IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = 36 THEN
 V_FROM_DEPT:=36;
 ELSIF v_count > 0 THEN
 SELECT FILLER1 INTO V_FROM_DEPT
 FROM TASKS
 WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0);
 ELSIF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP') THEN
 V_FROM_DEPT:=95;
 ELSIF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') THEN
 V_FROM_DEPT:=96;
 END IF;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_SPCL_DEPT_ID_FROM', TEXT_PARAMETER,V_FROM_DEPT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD);
 IF V_FROM_DEPT IS NOT NULL THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DISP_ONLY', TEXT_PARAMETER,0);
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DISP_ONLY', TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
 END IF;

 RUN_Fun('CD_03560',pl_id);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOT EXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
END;

END IF;
END IF;
END IF;
END;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PALESTINE_CREATE_EXEMPTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PALESTINE_CREATE_EXEMPTION(V$INV_ISN NUMBER) IS
V$THERE_IS_EXEMPTION BOOLEAN:=FALSE;
V$EXEMPTION_ISN NUMBER;

 V_MSG VARCHAR2(3500):=NULL;
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN

IF CHK_VALID_DECREE(V$EXEMPTION_ISN)=TRUE THEN



FOR CUR IN (SELECT ROWNUM||'- الصنف'||'('||ITEM_SEQ ||')' MSG FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN
 AND INV_ISN=V$INV_ISN
 AND CTRY_CD=165
 AND EXMTN_TYPE IS NULL AND DUTY_TYPE=1) LOOP


 IF LENGTH (V_MSG || CUR.MSG)<3000 THEN
 V_MSG := V_MSG || CUR.MSG||CHR(10);
 END IF;

END LOOP;




 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS SET
 EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 ,EXMTN_DECREE_ISN = V$EXEMPTION_ISN
 ,EXMTN_TYPE = 4
 ,EXMTD_CIF = CIF_COST
 ,EXMTD_DUTY = ORGNL_DUTY
 WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN
 AND INV_ISN=V$INV_ISN
 AND CTRY_CD=165
 AND EXMTN_TYPE IS NULL AND DUTY_TYPE=1;
 V_MSG:='هناك اصناف تم اعفائها وهي:-'||CHR(10)||V_MSG;
RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR', 1, 'الاصناف التي تم اعفائها اعفاء فلسطيني',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1150, 'r0g0b75', 12);
END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PALESTINE_CHECK_EXCEMPTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION PALESTINE_CHECK_EXCEMPTION(V$srce_nbr NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
V$THERE_IS_EXEMPTION BOOLEAN:=FALSE;
V$SRCE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
V$EXEMPTION_ISN NUMBER;
RESULT NUMBER;
BEGIN




BEGIN
SELECT src.srce_name INTO V$SRCE_NAME
 FROM srce_cmpys src
 WHERE src.srce_nbr = V$srce_nbr
 AND SRC.port_cd=:PORT_CD ;

EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN V$THERE_IS_EXEMPTION;
END;



 DECLARE
 CURSOR NAME_EXP IS SELECT EXPR_ARB_NAME FROM PALESTINE_EXPORTER WHERE STATUS=1;

 BEGIN
 FOR LOOP$NAME_EXP IN NAME_EXP LOOP
 RESULT:= STR_DB.NAMESMATCH( LOOP$NAME_EXP.EXPR_ARB_NAME, V$SRCE_NAME, 1, 0);
 IF RESULT=0 THEN
 V$THERE_IS_EXEMPTION:=TRUE;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END;


RETURN V$THERE_IS_EXEMPTION;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PALESTINE_ALARM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PALESTINE_ALARM IS
V$EXEMPTION_ISN NUMBER;
V$BUTTON NUMBER:=0;
CURSOR CUR_INVITEM IS SELECT DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN,DCLTN_INVOICES.SRCE_NBR
 FROM DCLTN_INVOICES
 WHERE DCLTN_INVOICES.PORT_CD=:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD AND
 DCLTN_INVOICES.DCLTN_ISN=:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND EXISTS
 (SELECT 1 FROM
 DCLTN_ITEMS WHERE
 DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD =:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN =:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN=DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN
 AND EXMTN_TYPE IS NULL
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD =165 AND DUTY_TYPE=1);

V$FOUNDITEM NUMBER;
BEGIN

IF DCLTN.DCLTN_PAYED(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN) =0 THEN

 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') THEN
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF') THEN

 FOR CUR_FOUND IN CUR_INVITEM LOOP
 /*1*/ IF PALESTINE_CHECK_EXCEMPTION(CUR_FOUND.SRCE_NBR) =TRUE THEN

 /*1.1*/ IF V$BUTTON != ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 V$BUTTON:= STR.DISPALERT('هناك اصناف بلد المنشأ لها فلسطين ,هل تريد أنشاء اعفاء فلسطيني لها؟','CONFIRM');
 END IF;


 /*1.2*/ IF V$BUTTON=ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 IF CHK_VALID_DECREE(V$EXEMPTION_ISN)=TRUE THEN
 PALESTINE_CREATE_EXEMPTION(CUR_FOUND.INV_ISN);
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXIT;
 END IF;

 /*1*/ END IF;
 END LOOP;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;


END IF;

END;
