ProgramUnit.Name: MNFST_OWNER_ALERT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\
 --/\------------ --------nihad khalil fagem ------ ----------------------/\
 --/\---------------------------------- 22/10/2007---------------------------------------------/\
 --/\------- for show flash alert contain user mnfst have history ---------------/\
 --/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\



PROCEDURE MNFST_OWNER_ALERT IS



BEGIN
-------------------------------------MAIN CHECK SEA AND DECLARATION TYPE----------------------
---/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\
IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE=1 AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN




-------------------------------------CHECK USER TYPE TO DISPLAY FLASH ALERT------------------
---/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\


DECLARE

 CHECK_USER BOOLEAN:=FALSE;
 BEGIN


 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -------------------------------------------FIRST CHECK------------------------------------------
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD = 3 AND (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN ( CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_INSP') ,
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.DSI_AFF' ) ,
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.DSI_INST') ))
 THEN
 CHECK_USER:=TRUE;
 END IF;
 -------------------------------------------SECOND CHECK------------------------------------
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD = 15 AND (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN ( CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP') ,
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.DU_IMM' ) ,
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.DU_AFF' ) ))
 THEN
 CHECK_USER:=TRUE;
 END IF;
 -------------------------------------------THIRD CHECK------------------------------------
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD = 7
 THEN
 CHECK_USER:=TRUE;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 IF CHECK_USER = TRUE THEN
 ---------------------------------------------declare for show alert
 DECLARE
 CURSOR OWNER_NAME IS
 ---------------------------------------ATTRIBUTES---------------------------------
 SELECT DISTINCT
 bl_owner_hist.OWNER_NAME AS NAME ,
 bl_owner_hist.mfst_type ||TO_CHAR(bl_owner_hist.bl_seq) || TO_CHAR( bl_owner_hist.mfst_nbr)|| TO_CHAR( sea_dlvy_items.mfst_dt)
 AS pk_mfst,sea_dlvy_items.mfst_type AS mfst_type,bl_owner_hist.mfst_nbr AS
 mfst_nbr,bl_owner_hist.bl_seq AS bl_seq,sea_dlvy_items.mfst_dt AS mfst_dt,
 sea_dlvy_items.port_cd AS port_cd


 FROM bl_owner_hist, sea_dlvy_orders, sea_dlvy_items
 WHERE( (sea_dlvy_orders.port_cd = sea_dlvy_items.port_cd)
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.shpg_agnt_nbr = sea_dlvy_items.shpg_agnt_nbr)
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.do_nbr = sea_dlvy_items.do_nbr)
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.do_iss_dt = sea_dlvy_items.do_iss_dt)
 AND (sea_dlvy_items.mfst_port_cd = bl_owner_hist.port_cd)
 AND (sea_dlvy_items.mfst_type = bl_owner_hist.mfst_type)
 AND (sea_dlvy_items.mfst_nbr = bl_owner_hist.mfst_nbr)
 AND (sea_dlvy_items.mfst_dt = bl_owner_hist.mfst_dt)
 AND (sea_dlvy_items.bl_seq = bl_owner_hist.bl_seq)
 )
 ----------------------------PARAMETER ------------------------
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.PORT_CD =:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.DCLTN_ISN =:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN ;
 ---------------------------------------------------------------
 ----------------------------VARIABLE---------------------------
 V_TXT_DTL VARCHAR2(6000) := NULL;
 V_TXT_DTL_ALL VARCHAR2(6000) := NULL;
 V_TXT_HEDR VARCHAR2(200);
 V_FLASH_ALERT VARCHAR2(200);
 COUNTER NUMBER:=0;
 old_value VARCHAR2(1000):=' ';
 mfst_type_name VARCHAR2(100);
 found BOOLEAN:=FALSE;

 BEGIN


 V_TXT_HEDR := 'ملاك بوالص البيان :';

 FOR I IN OWNER_NAME LOOP


 IF i.pk_mfst != old_value THEN
 COUNTER:=0;
 BEGIN
 SELECT RV_MEANING INTO MFST_TYPE_NAME FROM CG_REF_CODES WHERE
 RV_DOMAIN='MFST_TYPES' AND RV_LOW_VALUE = I.MFST_TYPE;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 MFST_TYPE_NAME:=NULL;
 END;

 V_TXT_DTL := '- - - - - - - - - - - - - -'|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 V_TXT_DTL :=V_TXT_DTL|| 'رقم المنافيست : '||i.mfst_nbr||' '||'نوعة : '||MFST_TYPE_NAME||' '||' مسلسل البوليصة : '||i.bl_seq||' تاريخة: '||TO_CHAR(i.mfst_dt,'mi-mm-yyyy')|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 V_TXT_DTL_ALL :=V_TXT_DTL_ALL || V_TXT_DTL;

 END IF;

 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;

 V_TXT_DTL := COUNTER ||'-'|| I.NAME || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 V_TXT_DTL_ALL :=V_TXT_DTL_ALL || V_TXT_DTL;


 IF (LENGTH(V_TXT_DTL_ALL) > 5950) THEN
 V_TXT_DTL_ALL := V_TXT_DTL_ALL ||'.....' || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 old_value :=i.pk_mfst;
 found:=TRUE;
 END LOOP;


 IF found= TRUE THEN
 V_FLASH_ALERT := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(CHR(1000)||V_TXT_HEDR || CHR(10) ||CHR(13)||V_TXT_DTL_ALL,'INFORMATION',2, 'رسالة توضيحية',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1400, 'r100g0b0',30);
 END IF;
 END;
---------------------------------------------declare for show alert
 END IF;




 END;
 -------------------------------------CHECK USER TYPE TO DISPLAY FLASH ALERT------------------
 ---/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\
 END IF;
 ---/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\
 -------------------------------------MAIN CHECK SEA AND DECLARATION TYPE----------------------



END;

ProgramUnit.Name: MESSAGES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE MESSAGES IS
V_DATE DATE;
V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(400);
V_KEY VARCHAR2(100);
V_ITEM_SEQ VARCHAR2(400) := NULL;
V_TXT_DTL VARCHAR2(6000) := NULL;
V_TXT_DTL_ALL VARCHAR2(6000) := NULL;
V_TXT_HEDR VARCHAR2(200);
V_FLASH_ALERT VARCHAR2(200);
V_BUS_ID VARCHAR2(20);
COUNTER NUMBER:=0;
V_COUNT NUMBER;
V_RESULT NUMBER;
V_IMPD_STMT_NBR NUMBER;
DUMMY NUMBER;
ITEM_CNT NUMBER :=0 ;
V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
V_COUNT_WAIVER NUMBER;
FOUND BOOLEAN:=FALSE;


 CURSOR C_IMP_ACT (P_KEY VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS WHERE ACTVY_SUB_ID = P_KEY ) DEC_ACT_1
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 21 AND SUBJ_CODE = 1 AND ( ACTVY_TYPE = 14 OR ACTVY_TYPE = 61) ORDER BY ACTVY_ISN DESC;

 CURSOR ITEM_TEMP_CUR IS
 SELECT ITEM_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND TEMP_ITEM = 2
 ;

 CURSOR ITEM_TEMP_CUR2 IS
 SELECT ITEM_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS,GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE GROUP_ITEMS.GRP_CODE = 80
 AND GROUP_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE = DCLTN_ITEMS.BRKR_TARIFF_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL(DCLTN_ITEMS.TEMP_ITEM,0) <> 2;


BEGIN

V_TXT_HEDR := 'رســــائل البيان :';
V_TXT_DTL := '- - - - - - - - - - - - - -'|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);

IF :DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN

 IF
 (
 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') -- موظف رئيس مجموعة
 )
 AND
 (
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF') -- معروض على رئيس المجموعة
 ) THEN


 IF (DCLTN.CHK_IMPR(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN,1,V_MSG_TXT) = 1) THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT,'INFORMATION');
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=COUNTER ||'-'||V_MSG_TXT|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 END IF;


 IF CHK_FUTURE_IMPR_DIFF_SUSPN(V_DATE) THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('يوجد فروقات علي المستورد يجب تسديدها قبل تاريخ : '||TO_CHAR(V_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI'),'INFORMATION');
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=COUNTER ||'-'||'يوجد فروقات علي المستورد يجب تسديدها قبل تاريخ : '||TO_CHAR(V_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI')|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DCLTN_MSG_TOS DMT, DCLTN_MSGS DM
 WHERE DMT.PORT_CD = DM.PORT_CD
 AND DMT.MSG_SEQ = DM.MSG_SEQ
 AND DMT.MSG_STA = 1
 AND DMT.TO_TSK_ID = :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID
 AND DM.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DM.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DM.MSG_ABOUT = :PARAMETER.P_LEVEL
 ;
 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('لديك رسائل جديدة علي هذا البيان','INFORMATION');
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=COUNTER ||'-'||'لديك رسائل جديدة علي هذا البيان'|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (

 SELECT 1 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS OUTER
 WHERE PORT_CD= :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN
 AND EXISTS
 (
 SELECT HRMNZD_CODE FROM TARIFF_ITEM_RISTRICTIONS INNER WHERE
 SUBSTR(INNER.HRMNZD_CODE,1,8) = SUBSTR(OUTER.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,1,8)
 )

 );

 IF DUMMY>0 THEN
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=V_TXT_DTL||COUNTER ||'-'||'يوجد قائمة اجراءات الفسح للبند'|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;

-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO ITEM_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD =:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN =:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND IDEN_CERT_NBR IS NOT NULL
 ;

 IF ITEM_CNT > 0 THEN
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=V_TXT_DTL||COUNTER ||'-'||'يوجد شهادات مطابقه'|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;


-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 BEGIN
 SELECT BUS_ID,BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_BUS_ID,V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN ;
 END;

 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT_WAIVER FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM
 wvr_items_globals wvr,sd_ports sd WHERE
 sd.port_cd = wvr.WVR_PORT_CD AND
 item_type_cd = 7 AND ISSUED_DT >=
 --TO_DATE( '02/01/1430 12:01:00 ق.ظ.', 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') AND BUS_ID=V_BUS_ID
 TO_DATE( '02/01/1430', 'MM/MI/YYYY') AND BUS_ID=V_BUS_ID
 AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD =V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD

 UNION SELECT 1
 FROM
 wvr_items_globals wvr,sd_ports sd WHERE
 sd.port_cd = wvr.WVR_PORT_CD AND
 item_type_cd != 7 AND (ITEM_STATUS=0 OR ITEM_STATUS IS NULL) AND ITEM_CLRNC_DT IS NULL AND BUS_ID=V_BUS_ID AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD =V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 )
 ;

 IF V_COUNT_WAIVER > 0 THEN
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=V_TXT_DTL||COUNTER ||'-'||'يوجد تعهدات على المستورد'|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;


 END IF;
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP')) THEN -- رئيس مجموعة 4
 V_RESULT := PRICING_DB.IF_DCLTN_CAN_ADD_TO_PRC(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN) ;
 IF V_RESULT >0 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PREV_DCLTN_ISN <> :DCLTN_ISN THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(22,190,'INFORMATION');
 FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;


-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL) AND
 (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')) AND --- رئيس مجموعة
 (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF')) AND --- معروض على رئيس المجموعة
 ( (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS')) OR (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')) )THEN
 V_KEY := :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD || '!' || :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN ;

 FOR REC IN C_IMP_ACT(V_KEY)
 LOOP
 IF :GLOBAL.CHK_DCLN_ISN_CHANG_IMP != :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN THEN
 IF REC.ACTVY_TYPE = 61 THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('هذا البيان معروض على رئيس المجموعة لإنتهاء معاينته و لطلب تحويله للتحصيل','INFORMATION');
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=COUNTER ||'-'||'هذا البيان معروض على رئيس المجموعة لإنتهاء معاينته و لطلب تحويله للتحصيل'|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 :GLOBAL.CHK_DCLN_ISN_CHANG_IMP := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN ;
 END IF;
 END IF ;
 EXIT;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;

-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 IF ( (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AUD'))) AND
 (:DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL) AND
 ( (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS')) OR (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')) )
 )THEN

 SELECT NVL(IMPD_STMT_NBR,0)
 INTO V_IMPD_STMT_NBR
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD =:PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR =:IMPR_NBR
 ;

 IF V_IMPD_STMT_NBR =1 THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('هذه أول معاملة جمركية لهذا المستورد','INFORMATION');
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=COUNTER ||'-'||'هذه أول معاملة جمركية لهذا المستورد'|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') THEN
 FOR I IN ITEM_TEMP_CUR LOOP
 IF V_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_ITEM_SEQ := V_ITEM_SEQ||', '||I.ITEM_SEQ;
 ELSE
 V_ITEM_SEQ := I.ITEM_SEQ;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF V_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT(' توجد أصناف مربوطة على البيان ذات إدخال مؤقت متكرر أرقامها كما يلي : '||V_ITEM_SEQ ,'INFORMATION');
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=COUNTER ||'-'||' توجد أصناف مربوطة على البيان ذات إدخال مؤقت متكرر '|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;

 V_ITEM_SEQ := NULL;
 FOR J IN ITEM_TEMP_CUR2 LOOP
 IF V_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_ITEM_SEQ := V_ITEM_SEQ||', '||J.ITEM_SEQ;
 ELSE
 V_ITEM_SEQ := J.ITEM_SEQ;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF V_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT(' توجد أصناف مربوطة على البيان ضمن مجموعة بنود تعريفة الإدخال المؤقت المتكرر ولم يتم تحديدها كأصناف ذات إدخال مؤقت متكرر أرقامها كما يلي : '||V_ITEM_SEQ ,'INFORMATION');
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=COUNTER ||'-'||' توجد أصناف مربوطة على البيان ضمن مجموعة بنود تعريفة الإدخال المؤقت المتكرر ولم يتم تحديدها كأصناف ذات إدخال مؤقت متكرر '|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END;
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF (:DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL) AND
 (
 (
 (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_CMPTR')))
 )
 )
 THEN


 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM RET_REPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND STAGE_CD <> 99 AND STAGE_CD <> 97
 AND STATUS = 0
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 -- STR.DISPALERT('هذا البيان مربوط على محضر حجز، يمكن استعراضها من خلال وظيفة استعراض محاضر الحجز على البيان','INFORMATION');
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=COUNTER ||'-'||' هذا البيان مربوط على محضر حجز، يمكن استعراضها من خلال وظيفة استعراض محاضر الحجز على البيان '|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF (:DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL) AND
 (
 (
 (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_CMPTR')))
 )
 )
 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CASE_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND TABLE_FLAG = 1
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('هذا البيان توجد عليه قضايا جمركية، ، يمكن استعراضها من خلال وظيفة استعراض القضايا الجمركية على البيان','INFORMATION');
 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;
 V_TXT_DTL :=COUNTER ||'-'||' هذا البيان توجد عليه قضايا جمركية، ، يمكن استعراضها من خلال وظيفة استعراض القضايا الجمركية على البيان '|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 IF found= TRUE THEN
 V_FLASH_ALERT := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(CHR(1000)||V_TXT_HEDR || CHR(10) ||CHR(13)||V_TXT_DTL,'INFORMATION',2, 'رسالة توضيحية',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1400, 'r100g0b0',30);
 END IF;

END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOV_WAIVER_DISP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE lov_waiver_disp IS
V_COUNT NUMBER;
V_BUS_ID VARCHAR2(20);
V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'ATHR_PARAM';
RET NUMBER;
BEGIN


IF (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL) THEN
 IF
 (

 (
 (
 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP')
 OR
 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM')
 )
 AND
 (
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_INSP')
 )
 )
 OR
 (

 (
 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')
 )
 AND
 (
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF')
 OR
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_INSP')
 )
 )

 OR
 (

 (
 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = 36
 )
 AND
 (
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF')
 )
 )

 )
 AND
 (
 (
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS')
 )
 OR
 (
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')
 )
 )

 THEN

 BEGIN
 SELECT BUS_ID,BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_BUS_ID,V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN ;
 END;
SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
SELECT 1
FROM
 wvr_items_globals wvr,sd_ports sd WHERE
 sd.port_cd = wvr.WVR_PORT_CD AND
 item_type_cd = 7 AND ISSUED_DT >=
--TO_DATE( '02/01/1430 12:01:00 ق.ظ.', 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') AND BUS_ID=V_BUS_ID
 TO_DATE( '02/01/1430', 'MM/MI/YYYY') AND BUS_ID=V_BUS_ID
 AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD =V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD

 UNION SELECT 1
FROM
 wvr_items_globals wvr,sd_ports sd WHERE
 sd.port_cd = wvr.WVR_PORT_CD AND
 item_type_cd != 7 AND (ITEM_STATUS='0' OR ITEM_STATUS IS NULL) AND ITEM_CLRNC_DT IS NULL AND BUS_ID=V_BUS_ID AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD =V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 ) ;





IF V_COUNT >=1 THEN
:GLOBAL.FOUND := 'TRUE';

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'جميع التعهدات على هذا المستورد ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 8);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_bus_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, V_BUS_ID);
Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD);
/*
CALL_FORM('LOV_WVR_DCLTN_GLOBA.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
*/

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

END IF;

END IF;
END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOV_ALL_ITMS_RSTRCT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE LOV_ALL_ITMS_RSTRCT IS

DUMMY NUMBER;
BEGIN


SELECT COUNT(1) INTO DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (

SELECT 1 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS OUTER
WHERE PORT_CD= :PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN
AND EXISTS
(
SELECT HRMNZD_CODE FROM TARIFF_ITEM_RISTRICTIONS INNER WHERE
SUBSTR(INNER.HRMNZD_CODE,1,8) = SUBSTR(OUTER.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,1,8)
)

);


IF DUMMY>0 THEN
:GLOBAL.FOUND := 'TRUE';
DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;

 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة إجراءات الفسح للبند');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'TRF_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, NULL);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PORT_CD );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_ISN);
/*
 CALL_FORM('LOV_ALL_ITMS_RSTRCTS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
*/
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END ;


END IF;

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: JAPAN_CHK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE japan_chk IS

-- japaaan maih 09-05-2011
RET NUMBER;
v_messege VARCHAR2(200);
v_jap_status NUMBER ;

BEGIN

 BEGIN
 SELECT var_value INTO v_jap_status
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
 WHERE var_name = 'JAP_CHEK_STATUS' ;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;

IF v_jap_status = 1 THEN -- 1 means it is enabled

 IF :parameter.p_task_id= CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') THEN

 IF
 ( (
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF') -- معروض على لاشئون الجمركية --
 )
 AND

 (
 (
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS') -- بيان أستيراد --
 )
 OR
 (
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR') -- بيان تصفية --

 )
 ) ) THEN


 v_messege:=dcltn.Jap_check(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN,1) ; -- the ctry code is japan


 IF v_messege IS NOT NULL THEN

 v_messege :='هل تم تحويل البضاعة إلى الإداراة المختصة بالمنفذ و التى تختص بالفحص الأشعاعى للبضائع الواردة أم لم يتم ؟' ||CHR(13)||v_messege ;
 --RET := STR.DispALERT(v_messege ,'information'); --

 RET := STR.DispALERT(v_messege,'USR_CONFIRM_B');

 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 --RET := STR.DispALERT('','INFORMATION'); --
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 106, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 ELSE
 --RET := STR.DispALERT('','INFORMATION'); --
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 END IF;

END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_VALIDATE_AGENT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE IS_VALIDATE_AGENT (V_AGENT_NBR NUMBER) IS
 V_HQ_NBR NUMBER;
 V_EXPR_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_IMPR_SUSP_DATE_CHK DATE ;
 V_PrtCd NUMBER ;
 V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(200) ;
 V_CUR_DATE DATE ;
 V_ERR_NUMBER NUMBER;
BEGIN

-- --> 24/07/2014 AHMED A-MONIM consume service from Yesser Producion الربط مع وزارة التجارة والصناعة - السجلات التجارية - يســــــــر
CHK_IMPR_CR(:PORT_CD, V_AGENT_NBR);

 IF NVL(:U_DCLTN_STATUS,0) IN (9,13) THEN
 V_IMPR_SUSP_DATE_CHK := :DCLTN_DT ;
 ELSE
 V_IMPR_SUSP_DATE_CHK := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date ;
 END IF;

 IF IMPR.IMPR_SUSPENDED(:PORT_CD, V_AGENT_NBR,V_IMPR_SUSP_DATE_CHK) = 1 THEN -- by MAIH 25-05-2011
-- IF IS_IMPR_SUSPENDED(:PORT_CD, V_AGENT_NBR,V_IMPR_SUSP_DATE_CHK) = TRUE THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = TRUE THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
--&&& END
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 250, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 260, 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 -- CHECK_IMPR_BUS_ID(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,V_AGENT_NBR,'A',V_IMPR_SUSP_DATE_CHK);

 V_ERR_NUMBER := IMPR.CHECK_IMPR_BUS_ID(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,V_AGENT_NBR,'A',:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD,V_IMPR_SUSP_DATE_CHK);
 IF (V_ERR_NUMBER NOT IN (0,105,115,125)) THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, V_ERR_NUMBER, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

----- NEW CODE FOR CHEACK WAIVERS
 BEGIN
 V_CUR_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 SELECT waivers.wvr_port_cd INTO V_PrtCd FROM waivers waivers, wvr_items wvr
 WHERE ( (waivers.wvr_port_cd = wvr.wvr_port_cd)
 AND (waivers.wvr_seq_nbr = wvr.wvr_seq_nbr)
 AND (waivers.issued_dt = wvr.issued_dt)
 AND (waivers.impr_nbr = V_AGENT_NBR)
 AND (wvr.item_clrnc_dt IS NULL)
 AND (
 ( (wvr.item_type_cd IN (7))AND (wvr.item_end_dt < V_CUR_DATE) )
 OR
 ( (wvr.item_type_cd IN (1,2))AND(wvr.item_end_dt < V_CUR_DATE) AND (TO_CHAR(wvr.issued_dt,'RRRR-MM-MI') > '1427-02-26') )
 )
 AND ROWNUM =1
 );
 IF (V_PrtCd) IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 910, 'ERROR');
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التعديل ,المستورد الجديد رقم'|| ' ' || V_AGENT_NBR || ' ' || 'يوجد تعهدات فواتير أو تعهدات شهادة منشأ غير مسددة وغير مفسوحة ومنتهية' , 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
-----

 :AGENT_NBR := V_AGENT_NBR;
 BEGIN
 SELECT ARBC_IMPR_NAME, HQ_IMPR_NBR
 INTO :AGNT_NAME, V_HQ_NBR
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :AGENT_NBR;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :AGNT_NAME := NULL;
 END;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = TRUE THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
--&&& END
 :AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR := NULL;
 :IMPR_NBR := :AGENT_NBR;
 :IMPR_NAME := :AGNT_NAME;
 :HQ_IMPR_NBR := V_HQ_NBR;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_IMPR_SUSPENDED
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION IS_Impr_Suspended (v$port_cd IN NUMBER, v$importer_num IN NUMBER, V_HDATE IN DATE) RETURN NUMBER IS

 Impr_Row IMPR_SUSPNS%ROWTYPE;
 TYPE ImprCrType IS REF CURSOR RETURN IMPR_SUSPNS%ROWTYPE;
 Impr_Cr ImprCrType;

 hq_Impr_Row IMPR_CNTRL_SUSPNS%ROWTYPE;
 TYPE hq_ImprCrType IS REF CURSOR RETURN IMPR_CNTRL_SUSPNS%ROWTYPE;
 hq_Impr_Cr hq_ImprCrType;

 V_HQ_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;

BEGIN
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



 BEGIN



 OPEN Impr_Cr FOR SELECT
 *
 FROM IMPR_SUSPNS
 WHERE (IMPR_SUSPNS.Impr_Nbr = v$importer_num AND IMPR_SUSPNS.PORT_CD = v$PORT_CD)
 /*
 WHERE ((IMPR_SUSPNS.Impr_Nbr = v$importer_num AND IMPR_SUSPNS.PORT_CD = v$PORT_CD)
 OR (IMPR_SUSPNS.FILLER1 = v$importer_num AND IMPR_SUSPNS.PORT_CD = 99))
 */
 AND TO_CHAR(IMPR_SUSPNS.SUSPN_STRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-MI') <= TO_CHAR(V_HDATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI')
 AND TO_CHAR(IMPR_SUSPNS.SUSPN_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-MI') >= TO_CHAR(V_HDATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI')
 AND IMPR_SUSPNS.SUSPN_RLSE_DT IS NULL ;






 FETCH Impr_Cr INTO Impr_Row;
 IF Impr_Cr%found THEN
 CLOSE Impr_Cr;
 RETURN (1);

 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END ;

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 BEGIN

 OPEN hq_Impr_Cr FOR
 SELECT IMPR_CNTRL_SUSPNS.*
 FROM IMPR_CNTRL_SUSPNS,importers
 WHERE importers.Impr_Nbr = v$importer_num
 AND IMPR_CNTRL_SUSPNS.HQ_IMPR_NBR=importers.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 AND TO_CHAR(IMPR_CNTRL_SUSPNS.SUSPN_STRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-MI') <= TO_CHAR(V_HDATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI')
 AND TO_CHAR(IMPR_CNTRL_SUSPNS.SUSPN_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-MI') >= TO_CHAR(V_HDATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI')
 AND IMPR_CNTRL_SUSPNS.SUSPN_RLSE_DT IS NULL ;


 FETCH hq_Impr_Cr INTO hq_Impr_Row;

 IF hq_Impr_Cr%found THEN

 CLOSE hq_Impr_Cr;
 RETURN (1);

 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;


 CLOSE Impr_Cr;
 CLOSE hq_Impr_Cr;

 RETURN (0);

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

END IS_Impr_Suspended;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_IMPOERTER_HAS_DUTY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE IS_IMPOERTER_HAS_DUTY IS

--====================================================================================================
CURSOR HQ_IMPORTER_DUTY_CUR(P_HQ_IMPORTER_NBR NUMBER) IS
SELECT BLK_PORT_CD, DIFFERENCE_ISN,DIFF_DUTY_AMOUNT,BLK_START_DT,BLK_DEPLOY_DT
FROM IMPR_DUTY_DIFF_BLKS
WHERE HQ_IMPR_NBR = P_HQ_IMPORTER_NBR AND BLK_RLS_DT IS NULL;
--========================================== ==========================================================
V_MSG VARCHAR2(4000) :='';
V_PORT_NAME VARCHAR2(200) :='';
V_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR2(20) :='';
RET NUMBER ;
V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER := 0 ;
V_HQ_IMPR_NBR NUMBER := 0 ;
V_COUNT NUMBER :=0;
V_IMPR_NAME VARCHAR2(200) :='';

BEGIN


 V_IMPR_NBR := :DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR;
 V_IMPR_NAME := :DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NAME;

 IF V_IMPR_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT HQ_IMPR_NBR INTO V_HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE IMPORTERS.IMPR_NBR = V_IMPR_NBR
 AND IMPORTERS.PORT_CD =:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD;


 FOR REC_DUTY IN HQ_IMPORTER_DUTY_CUR(V_HQ_IMPR_NBR) LOOP


 IF V_COUNT =0 THEN
 V_MSG := 'المستورد : '||V_IMPR_NBR||' '||'الأسم : '||V_IMPR_NAME||CHR(10)||CHR(13) ;
 V_MSG :=V_MSG ||'عليه الفروقات التالية و يجب تسديدها : '||CHR(10)||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||CHR(13);
 V_MSG :=V_MSG ||RPAD('أسم الجمرك',40)||RPAD('مسلسل الفرق',20)||RPAD('مبلغ الفرق',20)||RPAD('تاريخ تسجيل الايقاف',30)||RPAD('تاريخ تعميم الايقاف',30)||CHR(10)||CHR(13) ;
 V_MSG :=V_MSG ||'================================================================='||CHR(10)||CHR(13) ;
 V_COUNT:= V_COUNT+1;
 END IF;
 BEGIN
 SELECT PORT_NAME INTO V_PORT_NAME FROM SD_PORTS
 WHERE PORT_CD= REC_DUTY.BLK_PORT_CD;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 V_MSG :=V_MSG ||RPAD(V_PORT_NAME,40)||RPAD(REC_DUTY.DIFFERENCE_ISN,20)||RPAD(REC_DUTY.DIFF_DUTY_AMOUNT,20)||RPAD(TO_CHAR(REC_DUTY.BLK_START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'),30)||RPAD(TO_CHAR(REC_DUTY.BLK_DEPLOY_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'),30)||CHR(10)||CHR(13) ;
 END LOOP;
 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN
 RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR', 1, 'هناك فروقات رسوم جمركية',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1150, 'r0g0b75', 12);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_BOUND_ZONES (P_PORT_CD NUMBER ,P_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER ,P_DCLTN_DT DATE ) RETURN NUMBER IS /* A.ABDELHADI DM384 15-02-2021 لمعرفة هل البيان يخص مناطق الايداع ام لا 1- نعم \ 0 - لا */
 V_CNT NUMBER ;

 CURSOR cVSLL IS
 SELECT VB.PORT_CD , VB.MFST_DT , VB.MFST_NBR , VB.MFST_TYPE , VB.BL_SEQ
 FROM VSSL_BLS VB
 WHERE VB.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND VB.DCLTN_ISN = P_DCLTN_ISN;
BEGIN


 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DECLARATIONS DE , VSSL_BLS VB , VSSL_MFSTS VM
 WHERE DE.PORT_CD = VB.PORT_CD
 AND DE.DCLTN_ISN = VB.DCLTN_ISN
 AND VB.PORT_CD = VM.PORT_CD
 AND VB.MFST_TYPE = VM.MFST_TYPE
 AND VB.MFST_NBR = VM.MFST_NBR
 AND VB.MFST_DT = VM.MFST_DT
 AND VM.MFST_TYPE = 6
 AND DE.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DE.DCLTN_ISN = P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DE.DCLTN_DT = P_DCLTN_DT ;

 IF V_CNT >0 THEN
 V_CNT := 1 ;
 ELSE
 V_CNT := 0 ;
 END IF;

 /* IF V_CNT = 0 THEN
 FOR I IN cVSLL LOOP

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM BOUND_DIRECTION_REQ BD
 WHERE BD.PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND BD.MFST_DT = I.MFST_DT
 AND BD.MFST_NBR = I.MFST_NBR
 AND BD.MFST_TYPE = I.MFST_TYPE
 AND BD.BL_SEQ = I.BL_SEQ ;

 END LOOP;

 IF V_CNT >0 THEN
 V_CNT := 1 ;
 ELSE
 V_CNT := 0 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;*/

 RETURN V_CNT;
END;

 --CR-5913

ProgramUnit.Name: INSP_CHECKS_BEFORE_TRANS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE INSP_CHECKS_BEFORE_TRANS(V_DEPT_ID NUMBER) IS
 V_SEND_LAB NUMBER := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('IDEN_CER_STAGE', 21),0);
 V_SET_DATE DATE := TO_DATE(NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('IDEN_CER_STAGE_DATE', 21),'1450-01-01'),'YYYY-MM-MI');
 V_MSG_OUT VARCHAR2(200);
 v_SND_RCV_STA NUMBER;
 V_24HOURS NUMBER :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0);
 V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD NUMBER :=0; --wakeel dm_580 ini
 V_PORT_TYPE NUMBER := TO_NUMBER(NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('PORT_TYPE', 999), 0)) ; -- WAKEEL DM_580 ini
 V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN NUMBER := TO_NUMBER(NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN', 21), 0));
BEGIN
 IF V_24HOURS = 1 THEN
 IF V_DEPT_ID NOT IN (25,20) THEN
 IF Call_Can_Item_Confirm_Pass('INSP') = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 check_cert_approved;
 --
 IF LIB_USR.dcltn_services.check_manual_cntnrs(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN,V_MSG_OUT)=0 THEN
 str.dispalert(V_MSG_OUT,'error');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 --
 IF V_DEPT_ID <> 20 THEN
 IF V_SEND_LAB = 1 AND :DCLTN_DT >= V_SET_DATE THEN
 IF CHECK_IDEN_CERT_OK(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN) = 1 THEN
 str.dispalert ('يجب انشاء طلبات تحليل عينات او استثناء الاصناف لا يمكن الاستمرار','error');
 terminate_fun;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_SND_RCV_STA
 FROM DCLTN_INSPTN_POSES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND SND_RCV_STA IN (1,3)
 ;
 IF v_SND_RCV_STA > 0 THEN
 BEGIN --wakeel dm_580 ini
 SELECT INSPECT_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD
 FROM DCLTN_INSPCT_TRANS DIT
 WHERE DIT.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DIT.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN ;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL ;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 SELECT INSPECT_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD
 FROM DCLTN_INSPCT_TRANS DIT
 WHERE DIT.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DIT.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND ROWNUM = 1 ;
 END ; --wakeel dm_580 ini
 IF NOT (V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD =1 AND v_port_type IN (3,4) AND V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN >0) THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_INSPTN_POSES
 SET SND_RCV_STA = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND SND_RCV_STA IN (2)
 ;
 standard.commit;
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تسجيل مواقع الحاويات و ارسالها','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF ; --wakeel dm_580 ini
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_MANUAL_XRAY_INST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE insert_manual_xray_inst(P_PORT_CD NUMBER,P_dcltn_isn NUMBER,P_MFST_TYPE NUMBER,P_MFST_nbr NUMBER,P_MFST_dt DATE,P_CNTNR_SEQ NUMBER) IS
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_CD NUMBER;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_TIME DATE;
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_DATE DATE;
 actv_type NUMBER;
 actv_ret BOOLEAN;
 PKEY VARCHAR2(200);
 V_AUTO_SELECT_FLAG NUMBER;
 v_count_exist NUMBER;

BEGIN
 SELECT SYSDATE INTO V_INSPCT_ACTN_TIME FROM DUAL;

 V_INSPCT_ACTN_DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD =P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE =P_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR =P_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT =P_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ =P_CNTNR_SEQ
 ;


 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count_exist
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD =P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE =P_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR =P_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT =P_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ =P_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND ( (INSPCT_ACTN_CD = 5 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 8) OR (INSPCT_ACTN_CD = 1 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 2) )

 ;



 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_CD :=5;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD :=8;

 SELECT NVL(MAX(INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ)+1,1)
 INTO V_INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS CI
 WHERE PORT_CD =P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE =P_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR =P_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT =P_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ =P_CNTNR_SEQ
 ;

 V_AUTO_SELECT_FLAG :=3;

 INSERT INTO VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS ( PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ,
 INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_STA_CD,
 INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME,USER_PORT_CD, USER_ID,AUTO_SELECT_FLAG )
 VALUES (P_PORT_CD,p_MFST_TYPE,P_MFST_NBR,P_MFST_DT,P_CNTNR_SEQ,V_INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 ,V_INSPCT_ACTN_CD,V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD/*2*/,1,
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_DATE,V_INSPCT_ACTN_TIME,P_PORT_CD,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,V_AUTO_SELECT_FLAG)
 ;

 actv_type:=36; -- اختيارفحص يدوى بعد فحص مباشر

 PKEY := P_PORT_CD || '!' ||P_MFST_TYPE || '!' ||P_MFST_NBR || '!' ||P_MFST_DT || '!' ||P_CNTNR_SEQ;
 actv_ret := activity.ADD_ACTIVITY(18, 5,actv_type, PKEY);
 IF actv_ret = FALSE THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ عند دخول النشاط','ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 if v_count_exist = 0 then
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD =P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE =P_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR =P_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT =P_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ =P_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND NOT ( (
 INSPCT_ACTN_CD=5
 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=9
 )

 OR
 (
 INSPCT_ACTN_CD=0
 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=0
 )
 OR
 (
 INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1
 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=4
 )

 )
 ;

 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD =P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE =P_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR =P_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT =P_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ =P_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND INSPCT_ACTN_CD = 5
 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 9
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 UPDATE VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS SET INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 8,AUTO_SELECT_FLAG = 3
 WHERE PORT_CD =P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE =P_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR =P_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT =P_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ =P_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND INSPCT_ACTN_CD = 5
 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 9
 ;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD =P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE =P_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR =P_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT =P_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ =P_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND INSPCT_ACTN_CD = 1
 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 1
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_CD :=1;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD :=2;

 SELECT NVL(MAX(INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ)+1,1)
 INTO V_INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS CI
 WHERE PORT_CD =P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE =P_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR =P_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT =P_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ =P_CNTNR_SEQ
 ;

 V_AUTO_SELECT_FLAG :=3;

 INSERT INTO VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS ( PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ,
 INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_STA_CD,
 INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME,USER_PORT_CD, USER_ID,AUTO_SELECT_FLAG )
 VALUES (P_PORT_CD,P_MFST_TYPE,P_MFST_NBR,P_MFST_DT,p_CNTNR_SEQ,V_INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 ,V_INSPCT_ACTN_CD,V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD/*2*/,1,
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_DATE,V_INSPCT_ACTN_TIME,P_PORT_CD,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,V_AUTO_SELECT_FLAG)
 ;

 actv_type:=32; -- اختيارفحص يدوى بعد فحص مباشر

 PKEY := P_PORT_CD || '!' ||P_MFST_TYPE || '!' ||P_MFST_NBR || '!' ||P_MFST_DT || '!' ||P_CNTNR_SEQ;
 actv_ret := activity.ADD_ACTIVITY(18, 5,actv_type, PKEY);
 IF actv_ret = FALSE THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ عند دخول النشاط','ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 STANDARD.COMMIT;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_MANUAL_AFTER_DXRAY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE insert_manual_after_dxray IS
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_CD NUMBER;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_TIME DATE;
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_DATE DATE;
 actv_type NUMBER;
 actv_ret BOOLEAN;
 PKEY VARCHAR2(200);
 V_AUTO_SELECT_FLAG NUMBER;

 V_MFST_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_MFST_NBR NUMBER;
 V_MFST_DT DATE;
 V_CNTNR_SEQ NUMBER;


BEGIN


 SELECT SYSDATE INTO V_INSPCT_ACTN_TIME FROM DUAL;

 V_INSPCT_ACTN_DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;


 SELECT DISTINCT VSSL_Cntnrs.PORT_CD,VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_TYPE,VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_NBR,VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_DT,VSSL_Cntnrs.CNTNR_SEQ INTO V_MFST_PORT_CD,V_MFST_TYPE,V_MFST_NBR,V_MFST_DT,V_CNTNR_SEQ
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders ,sea_dlvy_items , vssl_bl_items , VSSL_CNTNRS,VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE sea_dlvy_orders.port_cd = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.PORT_CD = sea_dlvy_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = sea_dlvy_ITEMS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.DO_NBR = sea_dlvy_ITEMS.DO_NBR
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.DO_ISS_DT = sea_dlvy_ITEMS.DO_ISS_DT
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_PORT_CD = VSSL_bl_items.PORT_CD
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_bl_items.MFST_TYPE
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_NBR = VSSL_bl_items.MFST_NBR
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_DT = VSSL_bl_items.MFST_DT
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.BL_SEQ = VSSL_bl_items.BL_SEQ
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ = VSSL_bl_items.ITEM_SEQ
 AND VSSL_bl_items.PORT_CD = VSSL_Cntnrs.PORT_CD
 AND VSSL_bl_items.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_TYPE
 AND VSSL_bl_items.MFST_NBR = VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_NBR
 AND VSSL_bl_items.MFST_DT = VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_DT
 AND VSSL_bl_items.CNTNR_SEQ = VSSL_Cntnrs.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.PORT_CD = VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.PORT_CD
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_TYPE
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_NBR = VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_NBR
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_DT = VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_DT
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.CNTNR_SEQ = VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.CNTNR_SEQ
 ;


 SELECT NVL(MAX(INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ)+1,1)
 INTO V_INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS CI
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_MFST_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ
 ;



 V_INSPCT_ACTN_CD :=1;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD :=2;
 V_AUTO_SELECT_FLAG :=2;


 INSERT INTO VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS ( PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ,
 INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_STA_CD,
 INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME,USER_PORT_CD, USER_ID,AUTO_SELECT_FLAG )
 VALUES (V_MFST_PORT_CD,1,V_MFST_NBR,V_MFST_DT,V_CNTNR_SEQ,V_INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 ,V_INSPCT_ACTN_CD,V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD/*2*/,1,
 V_INSPCT_ACTN_DATE,V_INSPCT_ACTN_TIME,V_MFST_PORT_CD,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,V_AUTO_SELECT_FLAG);

 actv_type:=32; -- اختيارفحص يدوى بعد فحص مباشر

 PKEY := V_MFST_PORT_CD || '!' ||V_MFST_TYPE || '!' ||V_MFST_NBR || '!' ||V_MFST_DT || '!' ||V_CNTNR_SEQ;
 actv_ret := activity.ADD_ACTIVITY(18, 5,actv_type, PKEY);
 IF actv_ret = FALSE THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ عند دخول النشاط','ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 STANDARD.COMMIT;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^*/
 /********************************************/
 /************ MAIH 16-05-2011 ***************/
 /********************************************/
 /*^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^*/
-------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE IMP_IN_BLKLST IS
 X NUMBER;
 V_RSLT NUMBER;
 V_RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG_LVL NUMBER;
 v_dcltn_sta_cd NUMBER ;
 v_rsk_mng NUMBER;
 V_CLR_RET VARCHAR (100);
 V_EXPRESS_POST VARCHAR(1) := '0';
 V_MSG VARCHAR(300);
 v_new_rsk NUMBER (8) := 0;

BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_new_rsk
 FROM sc_port_setting
 WHERE var_name = 'NEW_RSK_MNG' AND var_value = 1;

 V_RSLT := dcltn.black_list_impr_chk(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN);

 IF (V_RSLT IN (1, 11)) OR (V_RSLT IN (10) AND v_new_rsk > 0)
 OR (
 :RSK_MNG > 0
 AND
 (
 :RSK_MNG < 10 AND v_new_rsk <= 0
 OR
 :RSK_MNG >= 10 AND v_new_rsk > 0
 )
 ) THEN

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 BEGIN
 SELECT dcltn_sta_cd,rsk_mng INTO v_dcltn_sta_cd ,v_rsk_mng
 FROM declarations
 WHERE
 port_cd=:port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn=:dcltn_isn ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------------------ شركات النقل السريع ----------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 BEGIN
 SELECT EXPRESS_POST INTO V_EXPRESS_POST
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE
 port_cd=:port_cd
 AND IMPR_NBR=:IMPR_NBR;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;


 IF V_EXPRESS_POST ='1' THEN
 V_MSG := 'تنبية هام - الإرسالية مسجلة بإسم إحدى شركات النقل السريع ومن المحتمل وبشكل كبير أن تكون ليست المستورد الفعلي , يجب عليك التأكد بنسبة 100 % من عدم وجود مخالفات ' ;
 ELSE
 V_MSG :='بلاغ خطورة - يجب التدقيق على الوارد 100% والتأكد من عدم وجود مخالفات او تجاوزات ';
 END IF;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ProgramUnit.Name: HANDLE_CHNG_FASAH_TO_MANUAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE handle_chng_fasah_to_manual IS
 --CR-5913
 v_setting NUMBER;
 v_port_type NUMBER;
 v_port_cntrctr_cd VARCHAR2(3);
 v_grp_id NUMBER(3);
 v_old_group_id NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :declarations.dcltn_isn IS NULL THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 v_setting := NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting('ALOW_TRNSFER_EXP_ICC',21),0);
 IF v_setting = 1 THEN
 v_port_type := hours24.get_port_type(:declarations.port_cd);
 BEGIN
 SELECT group_id
 INTO v_old_group_id
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN;
 END;
 -------
 IF v_port_type IN (1,2) THEN -- بحري وجاف--
 BEGIN
 SELECT DISTINCT port_cntrctr_cd
 INTO v_port_cntrctr_cd
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders
 WHERE dcltn_isn IN (SELECT dcltn_isn FROM declarations WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2))
 AND port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT port_cntrctr_cd
 FROM vssl_bls
 WHERE dcltn_isn IN (SELECT dcltn_isn FROM declarations WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6))
 AND port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 -----
 BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_ID
 INTO v_grp_id
 FROM DCLTN_CONTRACTOR_GRP
 WHERE port_cntrctr_cd = v_port_cntrctr_cd
 AND port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ELSIF v_port_type IN (3,4) THEN -- بري وجوي
 v_grp_id := NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting('DRCT_CLR_GRP_DCLTN',21),0);
 END IF;
 IF v_grp_id = v_old_group_id THEN -- مجموعة البيان قبل التعديل فسح مباشر
 null;
 else -- مجموعة البيان الأصلية يدوي
 if :declarations.group_id = v_grp_id then -- تم تحويل من معاينة يدوي إلى فسح مباشر
 str.dispalert('لا يمكن تحويل البيان من معاينة يدوية إلى فسح مباشر','ERROR');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GOTS_FILL_TBLS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GOTS_FILL_TBLS(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
 CURSOR CUR_ITEMS IS SELECT ITEM_DESC
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 ;

CURSOR CUR_BOX IS SELECT TRAN_SEQ,TRANS_DATE_H,BOX_NBR,DRIVER_MOBILE,GOTS_CTGRY
 FROM
 (
 SELECT VB.TRAN_SEQ,VB.TRANS_DATE_H,VB.BOX_NBR,VB.DRIVER_MOBILE,VB.GOTS_CTGRY
 FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM,vhcl_boxes VB
 WHERE DLM.DCLTN_ISN = V_dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = V_port_cd
 AND DLMT.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND DLMT.PORT_CD = VB.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.TRAN_SEQ = VB.TRAN_SEQ
 AND DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H = VB.TRANS_DATE_H
 UNION
 SELECT VB.TRAN_SEQ,VB.TRANS_DATE_H,VB.BOX_NBR,VB.DRIVER_MOBILE,VB.GOTS_CTGRY
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT,vhcl_boxes VB
 WHERE DGT.dcltn_isn = V_dcltn_isn
 AND dgt.port_Cd = V_port_cd
 AND DGT.PORT_CD = VB.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR = VB.TRAN_SEQ
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE = VB.TRANS_DATE_H
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE IS NOT NULL
 AND DGT.DGT_TYPE <> 7
 )
 ;

 G_DT DATE;
 V_DCLTN_NBR NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_ITEM_DESC VARCHAR2(200);
 V_ITEM_DESC_ALL VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_BOX_NBR VARCHAR2(10);
 V_TRANSACTION_GDT DATE;
 V_SEQ_NBR NUMBER;
 V_PLATE_NO VARCHAR2(30);
 V_PLATE_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_DRIVER_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE DATE ;
 V_PSPRT_NO VARCHAR2(20);
 V_DRIVER_NAME VARCHAR2(60);
 V_LENGTH_ITEM NUMBER :=0 ;
 V_LENGTH_ALL_ITEM NUMBER :=0 ;
 V_LENGTH_DESC NUMBER :=0 ;
 V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR NUMBER;
 V_LOCKS_CNT NUMBER;
 V_EXTS_CNT NUMBER;

 V_MFR_CD NUMBER;
 V_MFR_DATE NUMBER;
 V_MODEL_CD NUMBER;
 V_COLOR_CD NUMBER;
 V_SECOND_CD_COLOR NUMBER;
 V_VHCL_CTGRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_VHCL_CHASSIS_NO VARCHAR2(29);
 V_VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD NUMBER;
 V_PLATE_CITY_CD NUMBER;
 V_PLATE_COLOR_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
 G_DT := SYSDATE;
 SELECT DCLTN_TYPE_CD,DCLTN_NBR,DCLTN_DT,EXIT_PORT_CD
 INTO V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD,V_DCLTN_NBR,V_DCLTN_DT,V_EXIT_PORT_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 FOR CUR1 IN CUR_ITEMS LOOP
 V_ITEM_DESC := CUR1.ITEM_DESC ;
 IF V_ITEM_DESC_ALL IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_ITEM_DESC := '-' || V_ITEM_DESC;
 END IF;
 V_LENGTH_ITEM := LENGTH(V_ITEM_DESC);
 V_LENGTH_ALL_ITEM := V_LENGTH_ALL_ITEM + V_LENGTH_ITEM;

 IF V_LENGTH_ALL_ITEM < 2000 THEN
 V_ITEM_DESC_ALL := V_ITEM_DESC_ALL || V_ITEM_DESC;
 ELSE
 V_LENGTH_DESC := 2000 - LENGTH(V_ITEM_DESC_ALL);
 IF V_LENGTH_DESC >= 3 THEN
 V_ITEM_DESC_ALL := V_ITEM_DESC_ALL || '...';
 ELSE
 V_ITEM_DESC_ALL := V_ITEM_DESC_ALL;
 END IF;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 FOR CUR2 IN CUR_BOX LOOP
 BEGIN
 SELECT BOX_NBR,TRANSACTION_GDT,CHNG_SEQ_NBR+1,EXTS_CNT
 INTO V_BOX_NBR,V_TRANSACTION_GDT,V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR,V_EXTS_CNT
 FROM GOTS_TRANS_BOXES
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND TRANS_SEQ = CUR2.TRAN_SEQ
 AND TRANS_DATE = CUR2.TRANS_DATE_H
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_BOX_NBR := NULL;
 V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR := 0;
 END;

 IF V_BOX_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT NVL(MAX(EX_SEQ_NBR),0)+1
 INTO V_SEQ_NBR
 FROM GOTS_TRANS_BOXES_EXT
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = V_BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = V_TRANSACTION_GDT
 ;

 INSERT INTO GOTS_TRANS_BOXES_EXT(PORT_CD,BOX_NBR,TRANSACTION_GDT,EX_SEQ_NBR,TRNST_TYPE,
 TRNST_NBR,TRNST_DT,EXIT_PORT_CD,SHPMNT_DESC,CHNG_SEQ_NBR)
 VALUES(V_PORT_CD,V_BOX_NBR,V_TRANSACTION_GDT,V_SEQ_NBR,V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD,
 V_DCLTN_NBR,V_DCLTN_DT,V_EXIT_PORT_CD,V_ITEM_DESC_ALL,V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR);
 UPDATE GOTS_TRANS_BOXES_EXT
 SET CHNG_SEQ_NBR = V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = V_BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = V_TRANSACTION_GDT
 ;

 UPDATE GOTS_TRANS_LOCKS
 SET CHNG_SEQ_NBR = V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = V_BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = V_TRANSACTION_GDT
 ;

 UPDATE GOTS_TRANS_BOXES
 SET CHNG_SEQ_NBR = V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR,EXTS_CNT = V_EXTS_CNT+1
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = V_BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = V_TRANSACTION_GDT
 ;

 ELSE
 SELECT VT.PLATE_NO,VT.PLATE_CTRY_CD,VT.PLATE_CITY_CD,VT.VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD,VT.COLOR_CD,VT.VHCL_CTGRY_CD,VT.VHCL_CHASSIS_NO,VT.DRIVER_CTRY_CD,VT.PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE,VT.PSPRT_NO,VD.DRIVER_NAME
 INTO V_PLATE_NO,V_PLATE_CTRY_CD,V_PLATE_CITY_CD,V_VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD,V_PLATE_COLOR_CD,V_VHCL_CTGRY_CD,V_VHCL_CHASSIS_NO,V_DRIVER_CTRY_CD,V_PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE,V_PSPRT_NO,V_DRIVER_NAME
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VT, VHCL_DRIVERS VD
 WHERE VT.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND VT.TRANS_DATE_H = CUR2.TRANS_DATE_H
 AND VT.TRAN_SEQ = CUR2.TRAN_SEQ
 AND VD.CTRY_CD (+) = VT.DRIVER_CTRY_CD
 AND VD.PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE (+) = VT.PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE
 AND VD.PSPRT_NO (+) = VT.PSPRT_NO
 AND VD.DOC_TYPE (+) = VT.DOC_TYPE
 ;
 V_DRIVER_CTRY_CD := NVL(V_DRIVER_CTRY_CD, 0);
 V_PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE := NVL(V_PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE, SYSDATE);
 V_PSPRT_NO := NVL(V_PSPRT_NO, '-');
 V_DRIVER_NAME := NVL(V_DRIVER_NAME, '-');


 SELECT MFR_CD,MFR_DATE,MODEL_CD,COLOR_CD,SECOND_CD_COLOR INTO V_MFR_CD,V_MFR_DATE,V_MODEL_CD,V_COLOR_CD,V_SECOND_CD_COLOR
 FROM VEHICLS
 WHERE VHCL_CHASSIS_NO = V_VHCL_CHASSIS_NO
 ;

 INSERT INTO GOTS_TRANS_BOXES(PORT_CD,BOX_NBR,TRANSACTION_GDT,TRNST_TYPE,TRNST_NBR,TRNST_DT,TRANS_SEQ,
 TRANS_DATE,EXIT_PORT_CD,GOTS_CTGRY,PLATE_NO,PLATE_CTRY_CD,PLATE_CITY_CD,PLATE_COLOR_CD,CTGRY_GRP_CD,PLATE_CTGRY_CD,MFR_CD,MFR_DATE,MODEL_CD,COLOR_CD,SECOND_CD_COLOR,DRIVER_NAME,
 DRIVER_CTRY_CD,PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE,PSPRT_NO,DRIVER_MOBILE,SHPMNT_DESC,
 GOOID,GOTS_DATE_E,GOTS_DATE_X,CLERANCE_DT,CHNG_SEQ_NBR,EXTS_CNT)
 VALUES(V_PORT_CD,CUR2.BOX_NBR,G_DT,V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD,V_DCLTN_NBR,V_DCLTN_DT,CUR2.TRAN_SEQ,
 CUR2.TRANS_DATE_H,V_EXIT_PORT_CD,CUR2.GOTS_CTGRY,V_PLATE_NO,V_PLATE_CTRY_CD,V_PLATE_CITY_CD,V_PLATE_COLOR_CD,V_VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD,V_VHCL_CTGRY_CD,V_MFR_CD,V_MFR_DATE,V_MODEL_CD,V_COLOR_CD,V_SECOND_CD_COLOR,V_DRIVER_NAME,
 V_DRIVER_CTRY_CD,V_PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE,V_PSPRT_NO,CUR2.DRIVER_MOBILE ,V_ITEM_DESC_ALL,
 NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL,V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR,0);

 INSERT INTO GOTS_TRANS_LOCKS(PORT_CD, BOX_NBR, TRANSACTION_GDT, LOCK_NBR, LOCK_LOC_CD, EXIT_PORT_CD,
 GOOID, GOTS_DATE_E, GOTS_DATE_X, CHNG_SEQ_NBR)
 SELECT V_PORT_CD, CUR2.BOX_NBR, G_DT, LOCK_NBR, LOCK_LOC_CD, V_EXIT_PORT_CD,
 NULL, NULL, NULL, V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR
 FROM VHCL_LOCKS
 WHERE TRANS_DATE_H = CUR2.TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = CUR2.TRAN_SEQ
 AND PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 ;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_LOCKS_CNT
 FROM GOTS_TRANS_LOCKS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = CUR2.BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = G_DT
 ;

 UPDATE GOTS_TRANS_BOXES
 SET LOCKS_CNT = V_LOCKS_CNT
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = CUR2.BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = G_DT
 ;

 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN (1);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN (0);
END GOTS_FILL_TBLS;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
 V_LEVEL NUMBER := 1;
BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (DCLTN.PT_SEA, DCLTN.PT_DRY) THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
--&&& END
 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BI.CNTNR_SEQ)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO, SEA_DLVY_ITEMS DI, VSSL_BL_ITEMS BI
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND SDO.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD
 AND DI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR
 AND DI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT
 AND BI.PORT_CD = DI.MFST_PORT_CD
 AND BI.MFST_TYPE = DI.MFST_TYPE
 AND BI.MFST_NBR = DI.MFST_NBR
 AND BI.MFST_DT = DI.MFST_DT
 AND BI.BL_SEQ = DI.BL_SEQ
 AND BI.ITEM_SEQ = DI.ITEM_SEQ
 AND BI.CNTNR_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 ;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_LND THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND') THEN
 V_COUNT := 0;
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_AIR THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
--&&& END
 V_COUNT := 0;
 END IF;


 IF V_COUNT >= 1 AND V_COUNT <= 3 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 2;
 ELSIF V_COUNT > 3 AND V_COUNT <= 7 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 3;
 ELSIF V_COUNT > 7 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 4;
 END IF;

 RETURN (V_LEVEL);
END;

FUNCTION GET_US_FORCE RETURN NUMBER IS

V_RET_US_EXCEPTION NUMBER;
BEGIN

 ---------------------AHMED MOMEN 20-08-2021 -------------DM-259--------------

 IF NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('US_FORCES_DISPATCH', 21), 0) = 1
 THEN
 V_RET_US_EXCEPTION := DCLTN.CHECK_US_FORCES_IMPR (1,
 :PORT_CD,
 :AGENT_NBR,
 :FINAL_CTRY_CD,
 :DCLTN_DT,
 :DCLTN_TYPE_CD);

 IF V_RET_US_EXCEPTION = 1
 THEN
 RETURN 1 ;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0;

 END IF;
ELSE
RETURN 0;


 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN 0;
 STR.DISPALERT('حدث خطأ فى بيانات الارسالية للقوات الامريكية '||SQLERRM ,'ERROR');
 END;

 -------------------

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_TABALE_COUNT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_TABALE_COUNT RETURN NUMBER IS
V_TABALE_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_TABALE_COUNT
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT VT.PORT_CD, VT.PLATE_NO, VT.TRAN_SEQ, VT.TRANS_DATE_H, VT.VHCL_TRAN_TYPE
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VT,
 DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT,
 DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLM.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = DLMT.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND DLMT.PORT_CD = VT.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.TRAN_SEQ = VT.TRAN_SEQ
 AND DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H = VT.TRANS_DATE_H
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT VT.PORT_CD, VT.PLATE_NO, VT.TRAN_SEQ, VT.TRANS_DATE_H, VT.VHCL_TRAN_TYPE
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT,
 VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VT
 WHERE DGT.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DGT.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT.PORT_CD = VT.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE = VT.TRANS_DATE_H
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR = VT.TRAN_SEQ
 AND DGT.DGT_TYPE = 4)
 WHERE Duty.Get_Vhcl_Dcltn_Count(PORT_CD, TRAN_SEQ, TRANS_DATE_H) = 1;

 RETURN V_TABALE_COUNT;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN 0;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PAY_AMOUNT_CD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_pay_amount_cd (p_port_cd NUMBER, p_dcltn_isn NUMBER)
 RETURN NUMBER
IS
 v_err_msg VARCHAR2 (100);
 v_curr_exchg NUMBER;
 v_total_exps NUMBER;
 v_inv_curcy_cd NUMBER;
 v_total NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 FOR cur IN (SELECT total_exps, inv_curcy_cd
 FROM dcltn_invoices_cd
 WHERE port_cd = p_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn)
 LOOP
 v_curr_exchg :=
 revenue.get_currency_rate (cur.inv_curcy_cd,
 hijdate_db.cur_hij_date);
 v_curr_exchg := NVL (v_curr_exchg, 1);
 v_total := v_total + (v_curr_exchg * cur.total_exps);
 END LOOP;

 RETURN NVL (v_total, 0);
END;

FUNCTION GET_INS_AMT RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_AMT NUMBER;
 V_SRC_PORT_AMT NUMBER;
 V_TOT_AMT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(COD.AMT), SUM(COD.SRCE_PORT_AMT)
 INTO V_AMT, V_SRC_PORT_AMT
 FROM COLL_ORDER_DTLS COD, ACCT_ITEM_DTLS AID
 WHERE COD.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COD.ACCT_SEQ = AID.ACCT_SEQ
 AND AID.AID_TYPE = 2 -- مؤمن
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;

 V_TOT_AMT := NVL(V_AMT, 0) + NVL(V_SRC_PORT_AMT, 0);

 RETURN(V_TOT_AMT);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN(0);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GEN_65_DIGITS_MAKASA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GEN_65_DIGITS_MAKASA IS
 V_EXIST NUMBER;
 V_DUE_NBR VARCHAR2(200);
 V_EXIST_DUE VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CHECK NUMBER ; -- CR-7466
BEGIN
 -- i check if the Cr-7466 active and there is data in DCLTN_ITEMS_MQSA_DTLS tables
 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO V_CHECK FROM DCLTN_ITEMS_MQSA_DTLS WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
AND dcltn_ISN=:dcltn_ISN;

IF V_CHECK >0 THEN
V_DUE_NBR:= LIB_USR.MAKASA.generate_dcltn_due (:PORT_CD,:dcltn_ISN); --Cr-7466
ELSE
V_DUE_NBR:=STATS.generate_dcltn_due(:PORT_CD,:dcltn_ISN);
END IF ;

IF V_DUE_NBR <> '0' THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXIST FROM dcltn_GCC_DUES
WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
AND dcltn_ISN=:dcltn_ISN;
IF V_EXIST = 0 THEN
INSERT INTO dcltn_GCC_DUES S(S.PORT_CD, S.dcltn_ISN,S.DUE_NBR,S.GEN_DATE, S.STATUS)
VALUES(:PORT_CD,:dcltn_ISN,V_DUE_NBR,SYSDATE,1);
ELSE
SELECT DUE_NBR INTO V_EXIST_DUE FROM dcltn_GCC_DUES
WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
AND dcltn_ISN=:dcltn_ISN;
 IF V_EXIST_DUE <> V_DUE_NBR THEN
 UPDATE dcltn_GCC_DUES SET DUE_NBR = V_DUE_NBR
 WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD AND dcltn_ISN=:dcltn_ISN;
 END IF;
END IF;
STANDARD.COMMIT;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FLASH_SFDA_MEWA_RESULT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE FLASH_SFDA_MEWA_RESULT(V_PORT_CD NUMBER ,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER ) IS
 CURSOR DI_CURSOR IS
 SELECT sr.lab_cd ,sr.rqst_nmr ,sr.rqst_dt ,si.SMPL_NBR,di.ITEM_DESC, FINAL_TARIFF_CD ,SMPL_RESULTS.RESULT_NAME
 ,si.SMPL_REMARKS
 FROM smpl_requests sr, smpl_items si ,DCLTN_ITEMS DI

 ,SMPL_RESULTS


 WHERE
 sr.rqst_port_cd = V_PORT_CD
 AND sr.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND rqst_status_cd <> 9
 AND sr.lab_cd IN (5, 15, 80) -- dm_892 -- Mohamed Shehata
 AND si.rqst_port_cd = sr.rqst_port_cd
 AND si.rqst_nmr = sr.rqst_nmr
 AND si.rqst_dt = sr.rqst_dt
 AND NVL (si.SMPL_STATUS, 0) NOT IN (9)
 AND si.RESULT_CD=SMPL_RESULTS.RESULT_CD(+)
 AND DI.PORT_CD = si.rqst_port_cd
 AND DI.ITEM_ISN = si.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN
 ORDER BY sr.rqst_nmr ,sr.rqst_dt ,si.SMPL_NBR



;

 V_AGRMNT_EXIST NUMBER;


--- GROUP 204 COULD NOT BE EXCEPTED
 V_RETURN1 NUMBER;


 V_RET1 VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;
 V_MSG1 VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;
 v_lab_cd NUMBER;

BEGIN

 v_lab_cd :=0;

 V_RET1 := ' ' || CHR(10) ;







 FOR DI IN DI_CURSOR LOOP



 V_RETURN1 :=1;

 IF v_lab_cd <> DI.lab_cd THEN
 v_lab_cd := DI.lab_cd ;

 IF v_lab_cd = 15 THEN

 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || ' الجهة : هيئة الغذاء والدواء ';
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || ' رقم الطلب : ' || DI.rqst_nmr || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);

 ELSIF v_lab_cd = 5 THEN

 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || 'الجهة : وزارة الزراعة' ;
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || ' رقم الطلب : ' || DI.rqst_nmr || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 elsif v_lab_cd = 80 THEN -- dm_892 mohamed shehata
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || 'الجهة : وزارة التجارة' ;
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || ' رقم الطلب : ' || DI.rqst_nmr || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 END IF;


 END IF;


 --- لا يوجد شهادة مطابقة
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || ' مسلسل :' || DI.SMPL_NBR || ' ' || ' البند ' || ' ' || DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD || ' ' || DI.ITEM_DESC || CHR(10) ;
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || 'النتيجة ' || ' ' || DI.RESULT_NAME || ' ' || DI.SMPL_REMARKS;


 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);


 IF (LENGTH(V_RET1) > 3900) THEN
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 ||'.....' || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 EXIT;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;
 IF V_RETURN1 =1 THEN
 V_MSG1 := CHR(1000) || V_RET1;
 V_RET1 := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG1, 'INFORMATION', 1, 'يوجد طلب تحليل تم ارساله الى جهة خارجية',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 12);

 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FLASH_CLR_ALERT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION FLASH_CLR_ALERT (
 V_MESS_TXT IN VARCHAR2,
 V_ALERT_TYPE IN VARCHAR2 := 'WARNING',
 V_ALERT_BUT_DEF IN NUMBER := 2,
 V_W_TITLE IN VARCHAR2 := 'رسالة تحذيرية',
 V_W_WIDTH IN NUMBER := 5.5,
 V_W_X_POS IN NUMBER := 1.8,
 V_W_Y_POS IN NUMBER := 2.5,
 V_MESS_X_POS IN NUMBER := 0.5,
 V_FONT_SIZE IN NUMBER := 1300,
 V_FG_COLOR IN VARCHAR2 := 'r255g255b0',
 V_BG_COLOR IN VARCHAR2 := 'r255g0b0',
 V_ROW_COUNT IN NUMBER := 1 ,
 V_BLNKING IN VARCHAR2 := 0

 )RETURN VARCHAR IS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'PLATE_NO_PARAM';
 RET NUMBER;
 COUNT1 NUMBER;
 ALERT_TYPE VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 --ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ALERT_TYPE := UPPER(V_ALERT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_W_TITLE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_W_WIDTH);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_W_X_POS);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_W_Y_POS);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_MESS_TXT' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MESS_TXT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_MESS_X_POS' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MESS_X_POS);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_FONT_SIZE' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_FONT_SIZE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_FG_COLOR' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_FG_COLOR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BG_COLOR' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_BG_COLOR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_ROW_COUNT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_ALERT_BUT_DEF' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_ALERT_BUT_DEF);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_ALERT_TYPE' , TEXT_PARAMETER,ALERT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BLNKING' , TEXT_PARAMETER,V_BLNKING);


 CALL_FORM('Cic_clr_MESS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 -- ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;


 IF NAME_IN(':GLOBAL.OK') = 1 THEN
 ERASE('GLOBAL.OK');
 RETURN ALERT_BUTTON1;
 ELSE
 ERASE('GLOBAL.OK');
 RETURN ALERT_BUTTON2;
 END IF;

END ;

V_MSG:=V_MSG||CHR(10)||CHR(13);
END IF;
V_MSG:=V_MSG||' - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -'||CHR(10)||CHR(13);
END LOOP;



 IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL AND V_SHOW =TRUE THEN
 V_MSG := CHR(1000) || V_MSG;
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'INFORMATION', 1, 'أصناف البيان المرتبطة باصناف محاضر الحجز والمتروكات والمبيعات من المستودع',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1150, 'r0g0b75', 12);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FINALIZE_RECEIVE_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE FINALIZE_RECEIVE_DCLTN IS
p_out_result NUMBER;
p_out_msg VARCHAR2(500);
ret NUMBER;
V_EXIST NUMBER;
BEGIN

LIB_USR.hours24_services.FINALIZE_RECEIVE_DCLTN (:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,:parameter.p_user_id,:parameter.p_WS_ID,p_out_result,p_out_msg);

IF p_out_result = 0 THEN
STR.DispALERT(p_out_msg,'error');
terminate_fun;
ELSE
LIB_USR.hours24_services.check_before_FINALIZE(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,p_out_result,p_out_msg);
IF p_out_result = 0 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT(p_out_msg,'CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
END IF;
 FORMs_ddl('COMMIT');
 STR.DispALERT('تمت عملية الإنهاء بنجاح','INFORMATION');

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXIST
 FROM dcltn_prtl_docs d1, declarations d3
 WHERE (user_id_receiver = :parameter.p_user_id OR user_id_receiver IS NULL)
 AND finalize_dt IS NOT NULL
 AND d1.port_cd = d3.port_cd
 AND dcltn_stats_isn = d3.dcltn_isn
 AND ( (dcltn_sta_cd = 2 AND :parameter.p_dcltn_type = 3)
 OR (dcltn_sta_cd = 3 AND :parameter.p_dcltn_type = 1))
 AND RECP_FLAG IS NULL
 AND NOT EXISTS
 (SELECT *
 FROM smpl_requests sr, smpl_items si
 WHERE sr.rqst_port_cd = d3.port_cd
 AND sr.dcltn_isn = d3.dcltn_isn
 AND rqst_status_cd <> 9
 AND sr.lab_cd IN (5, 15)
 AND si.rqst_port_cd = sr.rqst_port_cd
 AND si.rqst_nmr = sr.rqst_nmr
 AND si.rqst_dt = sr.rqst_dt
 AND NVL (si.SMPL_STATUS, 0) NOT IN (9)
 AND NVL (si.RESULT_CD, 0) = 0);

 IF V_EXIST = 0 or :RECIEVE_AUTO = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.DONTSHOW := 1;
 :global.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :PORT_CD;
 :global.DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_ISN;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 :GLOBAL.REFRESH_DCLTN := 1;
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM:='DCLTN_NBR';
 ELSE
 display_new_dcltn_queue;
 END IF;
END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FILL_REJ_DCLTNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE fill_rej_dcltns (
 p_port_cd NUMBER,
 p_dcltn_isn NUMBER
)
IS
 v_port_type NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT port_type
 INTO v_port_type
 FROM sd_ports
 WHERE port_cd = p_port_cd;

 INSERT INTO dcltn_rejected_items
 (port_cd, item_isn, dcltn_nbr, dcltn_dt, final_tariff_cd,
 final_tariff_dt, inv_qty, gross_wt, item_desc, ctry_cd,
 hq_impr_nbr, inv_nbr,
 inv_date, srce_nbr)
 (SELECT dcltn_items.port_cd, dcltn_items.item_isn,
 declarations.dcltn_nbr, declarations.dcltn_dt,
 dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd, dcltn_items.final_tariff_dt,
 dcltn_items.inv_qty, dcltn_items.gross_wt,
 dcltn_items.item_desc, dcltn_items.ctry_cd,
 importers.hq_impr_nbr, dcltn_invoices.inv_nbr,
 dcltn_invoices.inv_date, dcltn_invoices.srce_nbr
 FROM declarations, dcltn_invoices, dcltn_items, importers
 WHERE ( (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_invoices.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_invoices.dcltn_isn)
 AND (importers.port_cd = declarations.port_cd)
 AND (importers.impr_nbr = declarations.impr_nbr)
 AND (dcltn_invoices.port_cd = dcltn_items.port_cd)
 AND (dcltn_invoices.inv_isn = dcltn_items.inv_isn)
 AND dcltn_items.duty_type = 8
 AND declarations.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND declarations.port_cd = p_port_cd
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn
 ));

 IF v_port_type IN (1, 2)
 THEN /* sea or dry*/
 INSERT INTO dcltn_rej_items_vssl
 (port_cd, item_isn, vssl_seq, mfst_type, mfst_nbr, mfst_dt,
 bl_seq, bl_nbr, cntnr_mrk)
 (SELECT dcltn_items.port_cd, dcltn_items.item_isn, ROWNUM vssl_seq,
 vssl_bls.mfst_type, vssl_bls.mfst_nbr, vssl_bls.mfst_dt,
 vssl_bls.bl_seq, vssl_bls.bl_nbr, vssl_cntnrs.cntnr_mrk
 FROM customs.declarations,
 customs.dcltn_items,
 customs.sea_dlvy_items,
 customs.sea_dlvy_orders,
 customs.vssl_bl_items,
 customs.vssl_cntnrs,
 customs.vssl_bls
 WHERE ( (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_items.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_items.dcltn_isn)
 AND (declarations.port_cd = sea_dlvy_orders.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = sea_dlvy_orders.dcltn_isn)
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.port_cd = sea_dlvy_items.port_cd)
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.shpg_agnt_nbr =
 sea_dlvy_items.shpg_agnt_nbr
 )
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.do_nbr = sea_dlvy_items.do_nbr)
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.do_iss_dt = sea_dlvy_items.do_iss_dt)
 AND (vssl_bl_items.port_cd = sea_dlvy_items.mfst_port_cd)
 AND (vssl_bl_items.mfst_type = sea_dlvy_items.mfst_type)
 AND (vssl_bl_items.mfst_nbr = sea_dlvy_items.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vssl_bl_items.mfst_dt = sea_dlvy_items.mfst_dt)
 AND (vssl_bl_items.bl_seq = sea_dlvy_items.bl_seq)
 AND (vssl_bl_items.item_seq = sea_dlvy_items.item_seq)
 AND (vssl_cntnrs.port_cd = vssl_bl_items.port_cd)
 AND (vssl_cntnrs.mfst_type = vssl_bl_items.mfst_type)
 AND (vssl_cntnrs.mfst_nbr = vssl_bl_items.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vssl_cntnrs.mfst_dt = vssl_bl_items.mfst_dt)
 AND (vssl_cntnrs.cntnr_seq = vssl_bl_items.cntnr_seq)
 AND (vssl_bls.port_cd = vssl_bl_items.port_cd)
 AND (vssl_bls.mfst_type = vssl_bl_items.mfst_type)
 AND (vssl_bls.mfst_nbr = vssl_bl_items.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vssl_bls.mfst_dt = vssl_bl_items.mfst_dt)
 AND (vssl_bls.bl_seq = vssl_bl_items.bl_seq)
 AND dcltn_items.duty_type = 8
 AND declarations.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND declarations.port_cd = p_port_cd
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn
 ));
 ELSIF v_port_type IN (3)
 THEN /*land*/
 INSERT INTO dcltn_rej_items_land
 (port_cd, item_isn, land_seq, DRV_DOC_TYPE, DRV_psprt_no,
 DRV_psprt_issue_date, DRV_ctry_cd, DRV_name, plate_no,
 frgn_man_no, frgn_man_date, man_type)
 (SELECT dcltn_items.port_cd, dcltn_items.item_isn, ROWNUM land_seq,
 vhcl_drivers.doc_type, vhcl_drivers.psprt_no,
 vhcl_drivers.psprt_issue_date, vhcl_drivers.ctry_cd,
 vhcl_drivers.driver_name, vhcl_transactions.plate_no,
 dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.frgn_man_no,
 dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.frgn_man_date,
 dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.man_type
 FROM customs.declarations,
 customs.dcltn_items,
 customs.dcltn_land_mnfsts,
 customs.dcltn_land_mnfst_trans,
 customs.vhcl_transactions,
 customs.vhcl_drivers
 WHERE ( (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_items.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_items.dcltn_isn)
 AND (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_land_mnfsts.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_land_mnfsts.dcltn_isn)
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfsts.port_cd =
 dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.port_cd
 )
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfsts.dcltn_mnfst_isn =
 dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.dcltn_mnfst_isn
 )
 AND (declarations.port_cd = vhcl_transactions.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = vhcl_transactions.dcltn_isn)
 AND (vhcl_drivers.ctry_cd = vhcl_transactions.driver_ctry_cd
 )
 AND (vhcl_drivers.psprt_issue_date =
 vhcl_transactions.psprt_issue_date
 )
 AND (vhcl_drivers.psprt_no = vhcl_transactions.psprt_no)
 AND (vhcl_drivers.doc_type = vhcl_transactions.doc_type)
 AND dcltn_items.duty_type = 8
 AND declarations.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND declarations.port_cd = p_port_cd
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn
 ));
 ELSIF v_port_type IN (4)
 THEN /*air*/
 INSERT INTO dcltn_rej_items_air
 (port_cd, item_isn, air_seq, carr_prefix, bill_nbr,
 bill_dt)
 (SELECT dcltn_items.port_cd, dcltn_items.item_isn, ROWNUM air_seq,
 bills.carr_prefix, bills.bill_nbr, bills.bill_dt
 FROM customs.declarations,
 customs.dcltn_items,
 customs.air_dlvy_orders,
 customs.bills
 WHERE ( (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_items.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_items.dcltn_isn)
 AND (declarations.port_cd = air_dlvy_orders.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = air_dlvy_orders.stmt_isn)
 AND (bills.port_cd = air_dlvy_orders.port_cd)
 AND (bills.carr_prefix = air_dlvy_orders.carr_prefix)
 AND (bills.bill_nbr = air_dlvy_orders.bill_nbr)
 AND (bills.bill_dt = air_dlvy_orders.bill_dt)
 AND dcltn_items.duty_type = 8
 AND declarations.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND declarations.port_cd = p_port_cd
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn
 ));
 END IF;

 FORMS_DDL ('commit');
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FAST_TRACK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION FAST_TRACK RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_BUS_ID VARCHAR2(20);
 V_BUS_ID_BRNCH VARCHAR2(20);
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_count NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('FAST_TRACK',21),0) = 1 THEN

 BEGIN
 SELECT IMPR_TYPE_CD, BUS_ID_TYPE_CD , BUS_ID, BUS_ID_BRNCH
 INTO V_IMPR_TYPE_CD, V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD , V_BUS_ID, V_BUS_ID_BRNCH
 FROM importers
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND impr_nbr = :AGENT_NBR
 ;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN FALSE;

 END;

 IF V_BUS_ID_BRNCH IS NOT NULL THEN

 SELECT COUNT (1) INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM IMPR_FAST_TRACK
 WHERE IMPR_TYPE_CD = V_IMPR_TYPE_CD
 AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 AND bus_id = v_bus_id
 AND BUS_ID_BRNCH = V_BUS_ID_BRNCH
 )
 ;
 ELSE

 SELECT COUNT (1) INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM IMPR_FAST_TRACK
 WHERE IMPR_TYPE_CD = V_IMPR_TYPE_CD
 AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 AND bus_id = v_bus_id
 )
 ;



 END IF;

 IF NVL(v_count,0) > 0 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
END IF;

RETURN FALSE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUNS(CD VARCHAR2) IS
 v_setting VARCHAR2 (200) := '0';
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'TMPLT_MOD_CALL';
 RET NUMBER;
 V_CALC_DT DATE;
 V_PAYER VARCHAR2(1000);
 V_CRT_STRG BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_REVENUE_CHNGD NUMBER := 0;
 V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
 V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
 V_RET BOOLEAN;
 ACTUAL_CD NUMBER;
 V_INS_AMT NUMBER;
 V_DEF_AMT NUMBER;
 V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR2(50);
 V_OLD_INSP_GROUP NUMBER;
 V_CHK_FEES_RECALC NUMBER;
 V_MGR_ID VARCHAR2(200);
 V_DEPUTY_MGR_ID VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CL_VAL NUMBER;
 v_filler1 VARCHAR2(20);
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_GULF_DUTY NUMBER := 0;
 V_DCLTN_COPIES NUMBER := 1;
 V_RCV_NOTE_PRNT NUMBER := 1;
 V_EXIST NUMBER;
 V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW_CHAR VARCHAR(10);
 V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW INTEGER:=0;
 V_Hij_Date_Diff_In_Days INTEGER;
 V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_NOTE VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_RET_WVR NUMBER;
 V_MSG_OUT VARCHAR2(500);
 V_INSP_RET BOOLEAN;
 V_XRAY_CHECK NUMBER;
 V_BL_PARTS_APPLIED BOOLEAN;
 V_INSP_REP NUMBER;
 V_ACTIVITY_SPCL_DEPT_ID NUMBER;
 V_CHK_XRAY_LAND NUMBER; -- BY HATEM 2/12/2006
 V_MAX_PRINT NUMBER;
 V_CHECK_ITEMS NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_DCN_STATUS NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_RET1 NUMBER ;
 V_TODAY DATE;
 ----ALAA ---- 24-03-2009 ---------
 V_T2_RESULT NUMBER ;
 O_T2_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 O_T2_DATE DATE ;
 O_T2_SEQ NUMBER;
 O_LIST_DATE DATE ;
 O_LIST_SEQ NUMBER ;
 O_ERR_MSG_T2 VARCHAR2(100) ;
 V_Form_T2_FULLPATH VARCHAR2(300) ;
 V_OTHER_MGS VARCHAR2(100) ;
 -----------------------------------
 V_MILK_BAN NUMBER;
 V_NEED_PRINT_TEST NUMBER;
 V_FRGN_IMP_ACTV NUMBER := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('FRGN_IMP_ACTV', 21);
 V_SEND_LAB NUMBER := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('IDEN_CER_STAGE', 21),0);
 V_SET_DATE DATE := TO_DATE(NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('IDEN_CER_STAGE_DATE', 21),'1450-01-01'),'YYYY-MM-MI');
 V_HQ_NBR NUMBER;
 V_COUNT_DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS NUMBER;
 MSG_LVL1 VARCHAR2(5);
 v_frgn_doc NUMBER;
 V_SEND_INI NUMBER;
 V_TOTAL_XRAY NUMBER;
 -----------AHMED MOMEN -----29-06-2020-----------
 V_filler1_RISK VARCHAR2(100);
 V_COUNT_RISK NUMBER;
 V_CNT_INFO_RASEL NUMBER;
 V_CNT_RASEL NUMBER;
 --------***********------------
v_PEGA_ENABLE_EXP_ICC NUMBER := NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('ALOW_TRNSFER_EXP_ICC', 21), 0);--CR-5913
V_DCLTN_STA_CD NUMBER(2); -- CR-5913
v_archv VARCHAR2 (100);
v_USER_ID_RECEIVER VARCHAR2 (200);
v_track_seq NUMBER ;
v_status NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 IF gnrl.get_customs_setting(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'PRESIDENT_NO_ACTIONS',21) = 1 THEN
 prevent_grp_president_action;--NIB1-4404 to fix issue in JIRA -- 06-05-2026 -- CR-9582
 END IF;
 --
 BEGIN
 IF :AGENT_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT HQ_IMPR_NBR
 INTO V_HQ_NBR
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :AGENT_NBR
 ;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 --
 V_CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_PAYER := DCLTN.GET_DCLTN_PAYER_NAME(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);
 V_PAYER := NVL(V_PAYER, :AGNT_NAME);
 --
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_setting
 FROM sc_port_setting
 WHERE var_name = 'INVOICE_PAYMENT_MTHD'
 AND var_value = '1'
 ;
 IF CD = 'CD_04150' THEN -- By Mohamed Al-Sheerif 09/11/2020 DM-769
 CALL_LOV_CONFIRM_LESS_COST;
 ELSIF CD = 'AUCTION_INV_NBR' THEN --CRQ21024 A.ABDELHADI
 CALL_AUCTION_DETAILS;
 ELSIF CD = 'CD_04520' THEN
 CALL_DIFF_REASON;
 ELSIF CD = 'CD_04230' AND NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('DM_787',21),0) = 1 THEN -- By Mohamed Al-Sheerif 27/12/2020 DM-787
 EXEC_FUN_CD_04230;
 ELSIF CD = 'CD_04390' AND NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('DM_156',21),0) = 1 THEN -- By Mohamed Al-Sheerif 13/09/2021 DM-156
 CALL_LOV_CONFIRM_ISBN;
 ELSIF CD = 'CD_04280' THEN -- الاسـتعلام عن البيان الجمركي برقم الاستحقاق
 LOV_DUE_NBR;
 END IF;
 --
 IF CD IN ('CD_00010', 'CD_01100') THEN
 IF CD = 'CD_00010' THEN
 /* DEVELOPED BY :KAMEL EL SAYED KAMEL@4145
 DATE :06/05/2007
 MODIFICATION :TO PREVENT USER FROM CALLING FORM OF INVOICE AND ITEMS IN CASE OF THE DECLARATION PAYED
 */
 IF DCLTN.DCLTN_PAYED(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)= 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن استدعاء شاشة الفواتير والأصناف - كون البيان مسدد','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_TASK_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_STATUS', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_AIR_PASS', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_AIR_PASS);

 --RET1 := STR.DispALERT('هل تريد التحويل إلي وحدة المعاينة والفسح','CONFIRM');

 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC

 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 ------java-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF CHECK_ICC3_CONDITIONS = 1
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_exist
 FROM dcltn_prtl_docs
 WHERE port_cd = :DECLARATIONS.port_cd
 AND dcltn_stats_isn = :DECLARATIONS.dcltn_isn;

 IF v_exist > 0
 THEN

 SELECT USER_ID_RECEIVER

 WHERE port_cd = :DECLARATIONS.port_cd
 AND dcltn_stats_isn = :DECLARATIONS.dcltn_isn;
 ELSE
 v_archv := 'false';
 END IF;

 edi_trg.database_xml_create (6,
 'PegaConsumeService.DecStages',

 :DECLARATIONS.dcltn_isn,

 7,
 :DCLTN_TYPE_CD);

 THEN

 96,

 LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK (:port_cd,

 11,

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_04360
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_04360 IS
/*
 DM_892
 Mohamed Shehata
 14-02-2021
 purpose:
 فتح شاشة بقائمة أصناف البيان الجمركى واختيار بعض أو كل الأصناف المشتبه ان بها غش تجارى
 ومن ثم ارسال طلب لوزارة التجارة لعمل تحليل لها
 */
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_DCLN_CMRC';
 RET NUMBER;
 V_LAB_CD NUMBER := 80;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DECI
 WHERE DECI.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DECI.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND NOT EXISTS
 (
 SELECT 1
 FROM smpl_items,smpl_requests
 WHERE smpl_requests.rqst_port_cd = smpl_items.rqst_port_cd
 AND smpl_requests.rqst_nmr = smpl_items.rqst_nmr
 AND smpl_requests.rqst_dt = smpl_items.rqst_dt
 AND smpl_requests.rqst_port_cd = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND smpl_requests.dcltn_isn = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND smpl_requests.lab_cd = 80
 AND smpl_items.dcltn_item_isn = DECI.ITEM_ISN
 )
 ;
 --
 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم أرسال طلب تحليل عينات لجميع أصناف البيان مسبقا','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ------
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 if not id_null(pl_id) then
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_name);
 end if;
 pl_id := create_parameter_list('LOV_DCLN_CMRC');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_LAB_CD := 80;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER,'قائمة بأصناف البيان ');
 :GLOBAL.ITEM_ISN := NULL;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_LAB_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,V_LAB_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLN_CMRC.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_04340 IS
 v_ivr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_send NUMBER;
 v_sadad_send NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :declarations.u_sadad_send IS NOT NULL THEN
 v_sadad_send := :declarations.u_sadad_send;
 :declarations.u_sadad_send := NULL;

 SELECT ivr_nbr
 INTO v_ivr_nbr
 FROM coll_orders
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND coll_ordr_nbr = :declarations.dcltn_nbr
 AND coll_ordr_dt = :declarations.dcltn_dt
 AND coll_ordr_ctgry = :declarations.dcltn_type_cd;

 IF v_sadad_send = 1 THEN
 v_send := sadad4port.send_bill (v_ivr_nbr);

 ELSIF v_sadad_send = 2 THEN
 v_send := sadad4port.send_bill (v_ivr_nbr, 1);
 END IF;

 IF v_send <= 0 THEN
 str.dispalert ('لا يمكن إرسال الفاتورة إلى سداد - لا يمكن التخزين','ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('تم إرسال المعاملة بنجاح إلى سداد برقم #'||v_ivr_nbr,'INFORMATION');
 standard.commit;
 END IF;

 END IF;
END;
