ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_03670
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_03670 IS
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(500);
 v_track_seq NUMBER;
 v_status NUMBER;
 v_to NUMBER;
 v_count NUMBER;
 ret NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
FROM TASKS
WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) AND FILLER1 IS NOT NULL;
IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = 36 THEN
v_to:=36;
ELSIF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) IN
(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM'),
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP')) AND CHK_EXP_EMP_TYPE=0 THEN
v_to:=95;
ELSIF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')
 OR (NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP')
 AND CHK_EXP_EMP_TYPE <> 0 ) THEN
v_to:=96;
ELSIF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
SELECT TO_NUMBER(filler1) INTO v_to FROM TASKS
 WHERE TASK_ID =NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0);
END IF;
LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,97,v_to,1,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret :=
 activity_db.add_activity (21,
 1,
 178,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = 36 THEN
 :RECP_FLAG := NULL;
ELSE
 :RECP_FLAG :=1;
END IF;
 COMMIT;
 LIB_USR.hours24.send_adgsts (:port_cd, :dcltn_isn, 1);
 STR.DispALERT('تمت عملية الغاء الرفض بنجاح','INFORMATION');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_03510
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_03510 IS
 V_REJECTED NUMBER:=0;
 v_track_seq NUMBER;
 v_status NUMBER;
 ret NUMBER;
 v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(500);
BEGIN
 IF :RECP_FLAG IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 IF :RECP_FLAG = 2 THEN
 V_REJECTED:=1;
 END IF;
 :RECP_FLAG := NULL;
 COMMIT;
 FORMS_DDL('UPDATE declarations SET RECP_FLAG = NULL WHERE port_cd = '||:port_cd||' AND dcltn_isn= '||:dcltn_isn );
 FORMs_ddl(' COMMIT');
 END IF;
 DELETE DCLTN_RECEIVED WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;

IF V_REJECTED = 1 THEN
LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,97,36,1,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret := activity_db.add_activity (21,
 1,
 178,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 178, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
END IF;
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 LIB_USR.hours24.send_adgsts (:port_cd, :dcltn_isn, 1);
 STR.DispALERT('تمت عملية الغاء الأستلام بنجاح','INFORMATION');

END;

v_track_seq NUMBER;
v_status NUMBER;
ret NUMBER;
v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(500);
v_INSPTR_DCLTNS NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :INSPTR_ID IS NULL THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :RECP_FLAG:=NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_INSPTR_DCLTNS
FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
WHERE port_cd = :port_cd AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn;
IF v_INSPTR_DCLTNS = 0 THEN

ELSE
 LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,96,36,6,v_track_seq,v_status);
END IF;
 ret := activity_db.add_activity (21,
 1,
 173,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 IF :GROUP_ID = 23 THEN
 DELETE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND ASSIGN_ISN = (SELECT MAX(ASSIGN_ISN) FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS WHERE PORT_CD =:PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN)
 ;
 END IF;


 COMMIT;
 STR.DispALERT('تمت عملية الغاء الإنهاء بنجاح','INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 STR.DispALERT('لا يمكن الغاء الإنهاء تم توزيع المعاملة على معاين ','ERROR');
 END IF;

END;

IS

 ------------------AHMED MOMEN 29-06-2020---------- ?????????--
 SELECT filler1

update_dept_work_flag;
 END IF;

---------------------********--------------------

 DCLTN_ISN,

Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_03350_03600 (CD VARCHAR2)IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_DCLN_SDFA';
 RET NUMBER;
 V_LAB_CD NUMBER := 15;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DECI
 WHERE DECI.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DECI.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM smpl_items, smpl_requests
 WHERE smpl_requests.rqst_port_cd = smpl_items.rqst_port_cd
 AND smpl_requests.rqst_nmr = smpl_items.rqst_nmr
 AND smpl_requests.rqst_dt = smpl_items.rqst_dt
 AND smpl_requests.rqst_port_cd = :PORT_CD
 AND smpl_requests.dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND smpl_requests.lab_cd IN (5,15)
 AND smpl_items.dcltn_item_isn = DECI.ITEM_ISN
 )
 ;

 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم أرسال طلب تحليل عينات لجميع أصناف البيان مسبقا','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 V_LAB_CD :=15 ;
 IF CD = 'CD_03350' THEN
 V_LAB_CD :=15 ;
 ELSIF CD = 'CD_03600' THEN
 V_LAB_CD :=5 ;
 END IF;


 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER,'قائمة بأصناف البيان ');

 :GLOBAL.ITEM_ISN := NULL;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'LAB_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,V_LAB_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLN_SDFA.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.ITEM_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN

 NULL;
-- :GLOBAL.ITEM_ISN;
-- :GLOBAL.ITEM_DESC;
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;


 END;

DECLARE
V_STATUS NUMBER (2);
V_APPROVAL_STATUS NUMBER (5);

BEGIN
 -- --CR-7466 mohamed nouh
 SELECT STATUS, APPROVAL_STATUS
 INTO V_STATUS, V_APPROVAL_STATUS
 FROM DCLTN_GCC_DUES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_APPROVAL_STATUS = NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب قبول أو رفض رقم الاستحقاق ','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
ELSIF V_APPROVAL_STATUS = 2 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('رقم الاستحقاق مرفوض','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
ELSIF V_STATUS <> 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('حاله رقم الاستحقاق مرفوض','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF ;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL ;
END;
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم فسح المعاملة','USR_CONFIRM_B');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 V_RET := CHK_INSTRUCTIONS;
 IF V_RET = FALSE THEN
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------سيتم فسح المعاملة----------------------------------------------
 ---تقفيل الشحن البحري والجاف والجوي---
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA') THEN
 UPDATE VSSL_BLS
 SET BL_STA_CD = 5
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY') THEN
 UPDATE VSSL_BLS
 SET BL_STA_CD = 25
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
 UPDATE BILLS
 SET BILL_STATUS = 4
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND BILL_STATUS IN(2,3)
 ;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT NVL(MAX(DGT.DGT_SEQ)+1, 1)
 INTO V_DGT_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE DGT.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 INSERT INTO DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 (PORT_CD,DCLTN_ISN,DGT_SEQ,CLRNC_DT,CLRD_QTY,CLRD_WT,CLRNC_NOTE,DGT_TYPE,DLVY_TYPE,AIR_DLVY_NBR,AIR_DLVY_DT,SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR,SEA_DLVY_NBR,SEA_DLVY_DT,SEA_ITEM_SEQ,VHCL_TRANS_NBR,VHCL_TRANS_DATE, GATE_NBR, SHIFT_ID)
 VALUES
 (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN,V_DGT_SEQ,CURR_DATE,NULL,NULL,NULL,1,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL);
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1,58, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN)THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_RLSD');
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;
 DCLTN.REMOVE_WVRS_FROM_REEXPR_DCLTN(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_TYPE_CD);
 IF AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT(:DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID) THEN
 END_INSPTR_DCLTN;
 END IF;
 --
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC
 INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 DECLARE
 --v_impr_mobile_nbr NUMBER;
 v_msg VARCHAR2 (500);
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_BUS_ID VARCHAR2(20);
 V_BUS_ID_BRNCH VARCHAR2(20);
 v_impr_mobile_nbr VARCHAR2(30);
 BEGIN
 /* SELECT mobile_no
 INTO v_impr_mobile_nbr
 FROM importers
 WHERE impr_nbr = :agent_nbr AND port_cd = :port_cd;*/
 SELECT IMPR_TYPE_CD,BUS_ID_TYPE_CD,BUS_ID,BUS_ID_BRNCH
 INTO V_IMPR_TYPE_CD,V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD,V_BUS_ID,V_BUS_ID_BRNCH
 FROM importers
 WHERE impr_nbr = :agent_nbr
 AND port_cd = :port_cd
 ;
 /* SELECT MOBILE_NO
 INTO v_impr_mobile_nbr
 FROM IMPORTER_BASIC_DATA
 WHERE IMPR_TYPE_CD = V_IMPR_TYPE_CD AND
 BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD AND
 BUS_ID = V_BUS_ID AND
 BUS_ID_BRNCH = NVL(V_BUS_ID_BRNCH,0);*/

 v_impr_mobile_nbr := IMPR.get_impr_mob_nbr (:port_cd, :impr_nbr);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 v_impr_mobile_nbr := NULL;

 v_msg :=
 ' تم الفسح الكلى الفعلى للبيان الجمركى رقم '
 || :dcltn_nbr
 || ' بتاريخ '
 || TO_CHAR(:dcltn_dt,'MI-MM-YYYY')
 || ' من نوع '
 || :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME

 || ' https://bit.ly/2ZWou1G ';
 LIB_USR.sms_message.send_sms_message (21,
 2,

 :port_cd || '|' || :dcltn_isn
 )
 ;

 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');

 ELSE

 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF ;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 ELSE
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 ELSE

 END;

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_01760 IS
 RET NUMBER;
 V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW_CHAR VARCHAR(10);
 V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW INTEGER:=0;
 V_Hij_Date_Diff_In_Days INTEGER;
BEGIN
 START_SUPPORT;
:PARAMETER.P_ALLOW_BRKER := 1;
 V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW_CHAR := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW', 999);
 IF V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW_CHAR IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW := TO_NUMBER(V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW_CHAR);
 IF V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW <> 0 THEN
 V_Hij_Date_Diff_In_Days :=HijDate.Hij_Date_Diff_In_Days(:DCLTN_DT,HijDate.Cur_Hij_Date);
 IF (V_Hij_Date_Diff_In_Days > V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW) THEN
 STR.DispALERT('مر ' || V_Hij_Date_Diff_In_Days|| ' يوم على إنشاء المعاملة .' ,'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم تحويل المعامله للمخلص - هل ترغب في إستكمال التحويل؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 77, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_01700 IS
RET NUMBER;
V_MSG_OUT VARCHAR2(200);
v_track_seq NUMBER;
v_status NUMBER;
v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(500);
RET1 NUMBER ; -- AHMED WAKEEL DM_580
RET2 NUMBER ; -- AHMED WAKEEL DM_580
V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN NUMBER := TO_NUMBER(NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN', 21), 0)); -- WAKEEL DM_580
V_PORT_TYPE NUMBER := TO_NUMBER(NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('PORT_TYPE', 999), 0)) ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
BEGIN

 INSP_CHECKS_BEFORE_TRANS(0);
 CHECK_ITEM_EXMPTN;
 CHECK_INS_REQ_CONFRMTN;
IF V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN > 0 AND V_PORT_TYPE=3 AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 RET2 := CHK_TRANSACTIONS_SELECTED(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN) ; -- START AHMED WAKEEL DM_580
 IF RET2 = 0 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('لم يتم اختيار السيارات المراد فحصها يدويا...هل تريد الاختيار ألان؟','CONFIRM'); --'--
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 hours24_services.PERCNT_20_CARS_SELECTED (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN,
 'DCLTN');
 FORMs_ddl('COMMIT');
 END IF ;
 END IF ;
END IF ; -- END AHMED WAKEEL DM_580

RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم تحويل المعامله إلي رئيس المجموعة لإنتهاء المعاينة - هل ترغب في إستكمال التحويل؟','CONFIRM'); --'--
IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 IF V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN > 0 AND V_PORT_TYPE IN (3,4) AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN -- START AHMED WAKEEL DM_580
 RET1 :=CHK_MANUAL_RSLTS(V_MSG_OUT) ;
 IF RET1 =0 AND V_MSG_OUT IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_OUT, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF ;
 END IF ; -- END AHMED WAKEEL DM_580

 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_PRICE') THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 61, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
ELSE

LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,95,96,9,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret := activity_db.add_activity (21,
 1,
 61,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_PRICE') THEN

 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STOP_NOTE := 'للتحصيل (أنتهت المعاينة)' ;
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF');
 :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;

 :DCLTN_STOP := 1;

 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;

 COMMIT;
 display_new_dcltn_queue;
 END IF;
ELSE
 TERMINATE_FUN;
END IF;
END;

:SPCL_DEPT_ACTN:=NULL;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_01224
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_01224 IS
 V_KSA_CODE NUMBER(5);
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 ALERT_MESSAGE VARCHAR2(1000);
 ALERT_RET NUMBER;
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :PARAMETER.P_UNDER_FUN := 1;
 TMPLT.DISABLE_ALL_FUNS;
 V_KSA_CODE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA');
 IF DCLTN.DCLTN_PAYED(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)= 1 THEN --1
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN --2
 IF NVL(:FINAL_CTRY_CD,V_KSA_CODE) = V_KSA_CODE THEN --3
 STR.DISPALERT(' بلد المقصد لا يمكن أن تكون السعودية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE--3
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_TRANS_VHCLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND EXIT_TRAN_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 ;
 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' تم خروج إحدى السيارات من جمرك الخروج','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 START_SUPPORT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 0;
 DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'BUS_ID_LOV';
 RET NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 4.5);
 IF (:system.mode <> 'ENTER-QUERY' ) THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'STATUS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة الدول الخليجية');
 CALL_FORM('LOV_GULF_CTRY.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 DB_JOURNAL.JOURNALING_OFF;
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END ;
 IF :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD IS NULL THEN
 DB_JOURNAL.JOURNALING_OFF;
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD = 100 THEN
 Str.DispAlert ('لا يمكن تعديل دولة المقصد الى السعودية','ERROR');
 DB_JOURNAL.JOURNALING_OFF;
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD = 113 THEN
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'لقد أدخلت دولة المقصد الكويت فى حالة الضغط على زر " نعم " سيتم ادراج جمرك الرقعى و "لا " سيتم ادراج جمرك الخفجى ';
 ALERT_RET := STR.DISPALERT(ALERT_MESSAGE,'USR_CONFIRM');
 IF ALERT_RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD :=35;
 ELSE
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD :=44;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD = 120 THEN
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD :=31;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD = 117 THEN
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD :=41;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD = 116 THEN
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD :=83;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD = 119 THEN
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD :=31;
 END IF;
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD <> 9 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 87, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 88, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD := :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD ;
 :DECLARATIONS.EXIT_PORT_CD := V_EXIT_PORT_CD;
 COMMIT;
/*
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD', TRUE);
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD';
*/
 END IF; --3
 ELSE --2
 START_SUPPORT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 0;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD', TRUE);
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD';
 END IF;--2
 ELSE --1
 --START_SUPPORT;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :NEED_PRINT :=1;
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD', TRUE);
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD';
 END IF;--1
END;
/*
 TMPLT.DISABLE_ALL_FUNS;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD', TRUE);
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD';
 -- BY SHERIFT UPON M.ABOELFTOUH 02-03-2005
 :NEED_PRINT :=1;
*/

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_01220
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_01220 IS
RET NUMBER;
V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE NUMBER;
V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR2(50);
V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
V_OLD_INSP_GROUP NUMBER;
V_RET_LFT NUMBER := 0;
V_RET NUMBER;
V_OUT_MSG VARCHAR2(100);
V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP VARCHAR2(20);
v_cnt22 number := 0 ;
BEGIN

select count(*)
into v_cnt22
from dcltn_items
where port_cd = :port_cd
and dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
and INS_RSN_CD is not null ;

 ------------------------ BY OMAR MANSOUR @ 28-01-1429 -------------------------------------------

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_RET_LFT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL(RET_TYPE,0) <> 0;

 IF V_RET_LFT <> 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن تغير نوع المعاملة - لوجود أصناف مربوطة بالمحوزات/المتروكات/المبيعات','INFORMATION');

 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_EX'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RX')) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يجب أن يكون بلد المنشأ للأصناف متوافق مع نوع البيان','INFORMATION');
 END IF;

 IF :INSPTR_ID IS NULL OR (:INSPTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1) THEN

 --BY SHERIFT 11-01-2005--
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 50, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 -- --

 :PARAMETER.P_UNDER_FUN := 1;
 TMPLT.DISABLE_ALL_FUNS;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE := :DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME := :DCLTN_TYPE_NAME;
 DCLTN_TYPE_LOV_CALL;
 IF V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE <> :DCLTN_TYPE_CD THEN
 V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP:=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('LINK_EXP_2_IMP', 21),0);
 IF(V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP >= 1)THEN

 IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD= CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')and v_cnt22 > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ربط صنف على تصفية فورية بالإدخال المؤقت','ERROR');
 :DCLTN_TYPE_CD := V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE ;
 select TYPE_NAME
 into :DCLTN_TYPE_NAME
 from DCLTN_TYPES
 where TYPE_ID = V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE ;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RX') THEN
 V_RET := TARIFF.CHECK_ALL_ITEM_INST_EXP_IRON (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN,1,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD,V_OUT_MSG);
 IF V_RET <> 0 THEN
 STR.DispAlert(' يوجد بنود محظورة لهذا النوع من البيانات ' || V_OUT_MSG ,'ERROR');
 :DCLTN_TYPE_CD := V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE ;
 :DCLTN_TYPE_NAME := V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME ;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;


--- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM @ 31/12/2005
--- NEW CODE FOR ASSIGN GROUP FOR DCLTN
 --- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM @ 28/12/2005
 IF ASSIGN_GROUP(:GROUP_ID) < 0 THEN
 IF :INSPTR_ID IS NULL THEN
 RET := ASSIGN_GROUP;
 IF RET < 0 THEN
 IF RET = -2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSE
 V_OLD_INSP_GROUP := :GROUP_ID;
 CALL_LOV_DCLTN_GROUPS;
 IF V_OLD_INSP_GROUP = :GROUP_ID THEN
 :DCLTN_TYPE_CD := V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE;
 :DCLTN_TYPE_NAME := V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME;
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,165,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_LOV := 1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن تغير نوع المعاملة - يجب حذف المعاين أولا عن طريق رئيس المجموعة','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ---
 ---
 --- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM @ 27/12/2005
 CHK_COUNTRY_WITH_DCLTN_TYPE;
 ---

 IF :DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL OR :DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_DEL_CO := 1;
 :PARAMETER.P_DEL_CO_TYPE := V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD';
 SYNCHRONIZE;

 ELSE
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 COMMIT;
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 END IF;
 -- BY SHERIFT UPON M.ABOELFTOUH 02-03-2005
 :NEED_PRINT :=1;
 --
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن تغير نوع المعاملة - يجب حذف المعاين أولا عن طريق رئيس المجموعة','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_01140

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_01140 IS
RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 CHK_IMPR_SZR_RELEASE;
RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم فك الحظر الجمركي للبيان - هل ترغب في إستكمال الفك','CONFIRM');

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_00970
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_00970 IS
RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم رفض البيان - هل ترغب في إستكمال الرفض؟','CONFIRM');
IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN


---------CR-8441 ADDED BY IBRAHIM HASSANIN 28/07/2025 FOR HANDLE MOAEN IN AIR PORT
DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM XRAY_PENDING_RESULTS
 WHERE PENDING_STAGE_CD = 9
 AND ISD_RESULT IS NULL
 AND PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN ; -- FOR REJECTION BEFORE ISD RESULT

 IF V_COUNT > 0 AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR')) AND GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,'ISD_AIR', 21) = 1 THEN
 Str.Dispalert('لا يمكن رفض البيان في نطاق الحوكمة لدى قسم الوسائل الآلية/الحية', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF ;
END ;
---------CR-8441 ADDED BY IBRAHIM HASSANIN 28/07/2025 FOR HANDLE MOAEN IN AIR PORT


 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_REF') THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 40, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;


 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_REF');
 :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;
 IF NVL(:DCLTN_STOP,0) = 1 THEN
 :DCLTN_STOP := 2 ;
 END IF;

 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;


 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR')) THEN
 UPDATE BILLS
 SET BILL_STATUS = 3
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN ;
 END IF;

 COMMIT;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.Dispalert('البيان مرفوض من قبل', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_00730
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_00730 IS
 RET NUMBER;
 MAX_SEQ_DEL NUMBER;
 X NUMBER;
v_track_seq NUMBER;
v_status NUMBER;
v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(500);
BEGIN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم تحويل المعاملة إلي المعاين - هل ترغب في إستكمال التحويل؟','CONFIRM');
IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_INSP');
 :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;

 :DCLTN_STOP := 2;

 BEGIN
 :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;

 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') THEN
-- TRANSFER_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT(2);
 TRANSFER_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT(2,MAX_SEQ_DEL);
 :DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID := NULL;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 COMMIT;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 FORMS_DDL('DELETE FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES WHERE PORT_CD='||:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD||' AND SPCL_DEPT_SEQ='||MAX_SEQ_DEL);
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END ;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') THEN
 LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,96,95,10,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret := activity_db.add_activity (21,
 1,
 64,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
standard.commit;
 ELSIF :SPCL_DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,:SPCL_DEPT_ID,95,10,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret := activity_db.add_activity (21,
 1,
 64,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
standard.commit;

 END IF;
display_new_dcltn_queue;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_00710
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_00710 IS
 RET NUMBER;
 MAX_SEQ_DEL NUMBER;
V_MSG_OUT VARCHAR2(200);
v_track_seq NUMBER;
v_status NUMBER;
v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(200);
V_SPCL_DEPT_ID NUMBER;
v_count NUMBER; -- cr8441
ISD_AIR_FLG NUMBER ; -- cr8441
BEGIN
 ISD_AIR_FLG := NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('ISD_AIR', 21), 0);
 -- cr8441
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') AND ISD_AIR_FLG = 1 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
FROM XRAY_PENDING_RESULTS XPR
WHERE PORT_CD = :port_cd AND DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_ISN AND
((IS_HAWKMA = 1 AND OPPOSITE_RESULT IS NULL ) OR (PENDING_STAGE_CD = 9 AND ISD_RESULT IS NULL))
AND BILL_NBR IS NULL;

 IF v_count = 0 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM XRAY_PENDING_RESULTS XPR WHERE PORT_CD = :port_cd
AND DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_ISN AND IS_HAWKMA = 1 AND OPPOSITE_RESULT IS NULL
AND NVL(IR_RESULT,1) = 1 AND BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL ;
 END IF ;

 IF v_count > 0 THEN

 1,
 14,

 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,

 );

 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_PRICE') AND
 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSU') AND
 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_RSTRCT') AND
 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_ISD') AND
 :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_SMPL')

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('STOP_NOTES',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('STOP_NOTES',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('STOP_NOTES',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF');

 :DCLTN_STOP := 1;

 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD',DATABASE_VALUE) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_SPE') THEN
-- TRANSFER_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT(2);

 TRANSFER_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT(2,MAX_SEQ_DEL);
 :DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID := NULL;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DECLARATIONS.STOP_NOTES';
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF');
 :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;

 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;

-- TRANSFER_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT(2);

 TRANSFER_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT(2,MAX_SEQ_DEL);

 :DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID := NULL;

 BEGIN
 COMMIT;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 FORMS_DDL('DELETE FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES WHERE PORT_CD='||:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD||' AND SPCL_DEPT_SEQ='||MAX_SEQ_DEL);
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END ;
 display_new_dcltn_queue;
 END IF;
ELSE
 TERMINATE_FUN;
END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_00705 IS
RET NUMBER;
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_DEPT_NAME VARCHAR2(100);
 V_RETREIVE_WITHOUT_REC NUMBER;
 V_USR_MGR NUMBER;
 MAX_SEQ_DEL NUMBER;

BEGIN


 V_RETREIVE_WITHOUT_REC := 0;

 IF (:GLOBAL.SEC_SND_RCV_EXIST = 1) THEN
 IF (CHK_SND_REC_STA = 1) THEN
 IF (CHECK_DCLTN_IS_RECIVE(V_PORT_CD,V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ) = 0) THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT DEPT_NAME INTO V_DEPT_NAME FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_REFS WHERE SPCL_DEPT_ID = :DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن الأسترجاع لأن البيان مستلم ب' || V_DEPT_NAME ,'INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSE
 UPDATE DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES SET
 RECIVER_USER =:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,
 TRANS_HIST_TO =SYSDATE
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND RECIVER_USER IS NULL
 AND TRANS_HIST_TO IS NULL
 AND SPCL_DEPT_ID_TO IS NOT NULL;

 V_RETREIVE_WITHOUT_REC := 1;

 END IF;
 ELSE --- القسم ليس له أستلام
 BEGIN
 SELECT SPCL_DEPT_ID INTO V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND SPCL_DEPT_ID_TO IS NOT NULL AND SPCL_DEPT_SEQ IN
 (
 SELECT MAX(SPCL_DEPT_SEQ)
 FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES
 WHERE PORT_CD=:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN
 );
 IF (V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ <> 96) THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_USR_MGR FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND (MGR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID OR DEPUTY_MGR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 IF V_USR_MGR = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن الأسترجاع لأن البيان محول من المعاين (موظف التصفية)','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 -- AHMED WAKEEL CR_3566 ICC وحدة المعاينة والفسح
 IF V_ALLOW_TRANSFER_ICC = 1 THEN
 --IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) IN (2,4,14) AND :DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID =106 AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD =7 THEN
 IF :DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID =106 AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD =7 THEN -- halsaadi (RE: ضم ميناء الملك عبدالله لقسم الفسح بعد المعاينة (icc))
 STR.DISPALERT('البيان لدي وحدة المعاينة والفسح ليس لديك صلاحية التعامل معه','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF ;
 END IF ;
 -- AHMED WAKEEL CR_3566 ICC وحدة المعاينة والفسح

 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم إسترجاع المعامله من الأوضاع الخاصة - هل ترغب في إستكمال الإسترجاع؟','CONFIRM');
IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 DECLARE
 V_SPCL_DEPT_ID NUMBER;
 v_actvy_type NUMBER;
 v_track_seq number;
 v_status number;
 ret number;
 v_msg_txt varchar2(500);
 BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') THEN
 V_SPCL_DEPT_ID := 96;
 ELSE
 V_SPCL_DEPT_ID := 95;
 END IF;

 LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,:SPCL_DEPT_ID,V_SPCL_DEPT_ID,12,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret := activity_db.add_activity (21,
 1,
 29,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
END;



 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF');
 :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;


--&&& BY NABIL AL-SALEH (EXT. : 4529) @ 27/06/2005 .
 IF :GLOBAL.SEC_SND_RCV_EXIST = 0 THEN
 INSERT_INTO_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TR;
 ELSE
 IF
V_RETREIVE_WITHOUT_REC = 0 THEN
 -- TRANSFER_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT(2);
 TRANSFER_DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT(2,MAX_SEQ_DEL);
 END IF;
 END IF;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID',REQUIRED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID2',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_NAME',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);

 :DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID := NULL;

 BEGIN
 COMMIT;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 FORMS_DDL('DELETE FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_TRANSES WHERE PORT_CD='||:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD||' AND SPCL_DEPT_SEQ='||MAX_SEQ_DEL);
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END ;

END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_00685 IS
 RET NUMBER;
 V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR NUMBER:=0;
 v_track_seq NUMBER;
 v_status NUMBER;
 v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(200);
 V_ONLINE_CNT NUMBER;
 v_count NUMBER;
BEGIN

 -- CR-5248 Anas Habshi Mohamed Shehata 16-10-2022
 -- adding setting here
 IF NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting ('FAIL_GOLDEN_5248', 21),0) = 0 THEN
 v_count := 0;
 IF :declarations.dcltn_sta_cd = 4 THEN -- فى انتظار التحصيل
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM golden_dcltn_candidate
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND candidate_status = 1
 ;
 END IF;
 IF v_count >= 1 THEN
 str.dispalert('البيان محول الياً للتحصيل,لا يمكن استرجاع المعاملة','ERROR');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 -- End CR-5248 --------------------


 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_ONLINE_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_ONLINE_PAYMENT
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL(REFUND_STATUS ,0) = 0;

 IF V_ONLINE_CNT > 0 THEN
 DCLTN_REFUND_ONLINE ( :PORT_CD ,:DCLTN_ISN) ;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم إسترجاع المعامله بدون تحصيل - هل ترغب في إستكمال الإسترجاع؟','CONFIRM');

IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN

LIB_USR.HOURS24.FILL_DCLTN_TRACK(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn,97,96,23,v_track_seq,v_status);
 ret :=
 activity_db.add_activity (21,
 1,
 18,
 :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN,
 :PORT_CD,
 :parameter.p_user_id,
 :parameter.P_WS_ID,
 v_track_seq,
 v_msg_txt
 );
 IF ret = 0 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;


 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_AFF');
 :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;
 V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR:=GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('INSPTR_AUTO_ASSIGN',CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DCLTN_SYS_ID'));
 IF (NVL(V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR,0) = 1) THEN
 BEGIN
 FOR cur IN (SELECT work_assign_level, insptr_id
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND rmv_dt IS NULL
 AND end_date IS NOT NULL)
 LOOP
 UPDATE insptr_dcltns
 SET end_date = NULL
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND rmv_dt IS NULL
 AND end_date IS NOT NULL;

 UPDATE insptr_grps
 SET work_assign_level = work_assign_level + cur.work_assign_level
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd AND grp_id=:group_id AND user_id = cur.insptr_id;
 END LOOP;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 str.dispalert
 ('هنالك خطأ في التوزيع الالي للمعاينين الرجاء الاتصال في المسانده الفنية',
 'error'
 );
 terminate_fun;
 END;
END IF;
 :DECLARATIONS.U_SADAD_SEND := 2;
 COMMIT;
 END IF;

 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_00630 IS
 RET NUMBER;

 V_CONFN_DT DATE;

 V_GULF_DUTY NUMBER := 0;

 V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW_CHAR VARCHAR(10);
 V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW INTEGER:=0;
 V_Hij_Date_Diff_In_Days INTEGER;
 V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_RET_WVR NUMBER;
 V_MSG_OUT VARCHAR2(500);
 V_INSP_RET BOOLEAN;
 V_XRAY_CHECK NUMBER;
 V_BL_PARTS_APPLIED BOOLEAN;
 V_INSP_REP NUMBER;
 V_ACTIVITY_SPCL_DEPT_ID NUMBER;
 V_CHK_XRAY_LAND NUMBER; -- BY HATEM 2/12/2006
BEGIN
V_CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
V_PAYER := DCLTN.GET_DCLTN_PAYER_NAME(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);
V_PAYER := NVL(V_PAYER, :AGNT_NAME);
 /*DEVELOPER : KAMEL ELSAYED@4145
 DATE : 12/06/2007
 MODIFICATIONS : PREVENT USER TO TREAD WITH DECLARATION IF EXPORTER IS SUSPENDED
 OR AGENT BUSSIENSE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER IS NOT VALID
 */
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')) THEN
 IF IMPR.CHK_VALID_IMPORT_AGENT(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD,:PORT_CD,:IMPR_NBR,:AGENT_NBR,V_ERR_MSG)=0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_ERR_MSG,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ---- ALAA FAWZY 15-03-2011 10-04-1432----------------------

 IF (DCLTN.IMPR_DUTY_DIFF(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN,1) = 1) THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(9,330,'ERROR');
 CALL_LOV_DUTY_DIFF;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------

 END IF;

 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 RET := DCLTN.PRE_CLRNC_ISSUE(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD, :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN, V_CALC_DT,
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, 1, V_MSG_TXT);
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');

 IF RET = 1 THEN
 IF V_MSG_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم إصدار إشعار الإستلام - هل ترغب في إستكمال الإصدار؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_2',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 -- ISSUE_CLRNC
 IF DCLTN.ISSUE_CLRNC(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD, :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, 0, 0,
 :CLRNC_NBR, :CLRNC_DT, V_MSG_TXT) = 0 THEN
 :CLRNC_NBR := NULL;
 :CLRNC_DT := NULL;
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(VAR_VALUE, 0)
 INTO V_RCV_NOTE_PRNT
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 21
 AND VAR_NAME = 'RCV_NOTE_PRNT'
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_RCV_NOTE_PRNT := 1;
 END;
 IF V_RCV_NOTE_PRNT = 1 THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_TYPE := 'PRNT_CLRNC_REP';
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 38, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 :CLRNC_NBR := NULL;
 :CLRNC_DT := NULL;
 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_TYPE := NULL;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 /* DEVELOPER : KAMEL ELSAYED
 DATE : 12/05/2007
 MODIFICATION : TO PREVENT USER FROM PRINT CLEARNCE REPORT WITHOUT CLRNC_NBR OR CLRNC_DT OR EACH OTHER
 */
 IF :CLRNC_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :CLRNC_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 COMMIT;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_TYPE := NULL;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END;
 ELSE
 :CLRNC_NBR := NULL;
 :CLRNC_DT := NULL;
 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_TYPE := NULL;

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_00570 IS
 RET NUMBER;
 VAR_SUM_DLVY NUMBER;
 VAR_SUM_ITEM NUMBER;
 V_DUTY_TYPE BOOLEAN;
 V_CONFN_DT DATE;
 V_PMT_METHOD NUMBER;
 V_CALC_DT DATE;
 V_PAYER VARCHAR2(1000);
 V_CRT_STRG BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_REVENUE_CHNGD NUMBER := 0;
 V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
 V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
 V_RET BOOLEAN;
 ACTUAL_CD NUMBER;
 V_INS_AMT NUMBER;
 V_DEF_AMT NUMBER;
 V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR2(50);
 V_OLD_INSP_GROUP NUMBER;
 V_CHK_FEES_RECALC NUMBER;
 V_DGT_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_MGR_ID VARCHAR2(200);
 V_DEPUTY_MGR_ID VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CL_VAL NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_GULF_DUTY NUMBER := 0;
 V_DCLTN_COPIES NUMBER := 1;
 V_RCV_NOTE_PRNT NUMBER := 1;
 V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW_CHAR VARCHAR(10);
 V_NO_OF_DAY_ALLOW INTEGER:=0;
 V_Hij_Date_Diff_In_Days INTEGER;
 V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_RET_WVR NUMBER;
 V_MSG_OUT VARCHAR2(500);
 V_INSP_RET BOOLEAN;
 V_XRAY_CHECK NUMBER;
 V_BL_PARTS_APPLIED BOOLEAN;
 V_INSP_REP NUMBER;
 V_ACTIVITY_SPCL_DEPT_ID NUMBER;
 V_CHK_XRAY_LAND NUMBER; -- BY HATEM 2/12/2006
 p_rqst_nmr NUMBER; -- DM-36
 p_rqst_dt DATE; -- DM-36
 V_SETT_DM_36 NUMBER; -- DM-36

BEGIN

IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 3
AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 2 AND NVL(:air_pass,0) <> 1 THEN
 chk_pay_data ; -- MAIH 15-01-2014
END IF;


--BY OMAR MANSOUR @ 25-01-1429
-- CHECK_BRKR_CRIDIT_AMT (1,:DECLARATIONS.CL_VAL);
------------------------------
V_CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
V_PAYER := DCLTN.GET_DCLTN_PAYER_NAME(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);
V_PAYER := NVL(V_PAYER, :AGNT_NAME);

 /*DEVELOPER : KAMEL ELSAYED@4145
 DATE : 12/06/2007
 MODIFICATIONS : PREVENT USER TO TREAD WITH DECLARATION IF EXPORTER IS SUSPENDED
 OR AGENT BUSSIENSE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER IS NOT VALID
*/
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')) THEN
 IF IMPR.CHK_VALID_IMPORT_AGENT(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD,:PORT_CD,:IMPR_NBR,:AGENT_NBR,V_ERR_MSG)=0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_ERR_MSG,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ---- ALAA FAWZY 15-03-2011 10-04-1432----------------------

 IF (DCLTN.IMPR_DUTY_DIFF(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN,1) = 1) THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(9,330,'ERROR');
 CALL_LOV_DUTY_DIFF;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------------
 END IF;
 IF NOT CREDIT_REQ THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 CHK_NEW_ARVD_CARGO;
 IF NVL(:air_pass,0) <> 1 THEN
 CHECK_IMPORT_CARGO(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);
 END IF;
 CHECK_AIR_MFST_REGISTRATION;
 --KAMEL ADDED BY KAMEL ELSAYED 22/5/2007
 IF CHECK_EXMTN.CHECK_EXMTN_DCLTN(:DCLTN_ISN, :PORT_CD, V_MSG_TXT) <> 1 THEN
 V_MSG_TXT := 'خطأ أثناء اختبار صحة الإعفاءات المربوطة بالأصناف' || CHR(13) || V_MSG_TXT;
 STR.DispALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 --
 --CHK_INV_ITEMS; 24/7/2006
 END IF;
 --KAMEL ADDED BY KAMEL ELSAYED 24/7/2006
 CHK_INV_ITEMS;
 --

 IF :DCLTN_NBR IS NULL THEN
/* V_RET_WVR := WAIVER.CHECK_ALL_WAIVERS(:PORT_CD, :IMPR_NBR, HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE, V_MSG_TXT);
 IF (V_RET_WVR = 1) THEN
 STR.DispALERT(V_MSG_TXT,'CONFIRM');
 END IF;

*/


 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 V_ERR_MSG := WAIVER.VALID_IMPR_WAIVERS(:PORT_CD,:IMPR_NBR,HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE);
 IF V_ERR_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DISPALERT(V_ERR_MSG || CHR(10) || 'هل تريد الأستمرار','USR_WARNING_C');
 IF RET = alert_button2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 V_ERR_MSG := WAIVER.VALID_IMPR_WAIVERS(:PORT_CD,:AGENT_NBR,HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE);
 IF V_ERR_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DISPALERT(V_ERR_MSG || CHR(10) || 'هل تريد الأستمرار','USR_WARNING_C');
 IF RET = alert_button2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم ترقيم المعامله - هل ترغب في إستكمال الترقيم؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 10, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 :DCLTN_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 IF :DCLTN_DT IS NULL THEN
 STR.DispALERT('لا يمكن ترقيم المعامله - حاول مرة أخرى!','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;


 -- DISPATCH_DCLTN;

 BEGIN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 SELECT IMPORT_NBR.NEXTVAL
 INTO :DCLTN_NBR
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSE
 SELECT EXPORT_NBR.NEXTVAL
 INTO :DCLTN_NBR
 FROM DUAL;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_AIR_PASS = 1 or (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD=2 and :brkr_port_cd is null) THEN
 :NEED_PRINT := 0;
 :PRINT_CNT :=1 ;
 :RECP_FLAG:=1;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 STR.DispALERT('لا يمكن ترقيم المعامله - حاول مرة أخرى!','ERROR');
 :DCLTN_DT := NULL;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END;

 IF :DCLTN_NBR IS NULL THEN
 STR.DispALERT('لا يمكن ترقيم المعامله - حاول مرة أخرى!','ERROR');
 :DCLTN_DT := NULL;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;


 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 POST ;
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');

 IF DCLTN.REG_TYPE_DECISION(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN,1,1) = 0 THEN
 STR.DispALERT('لا يمكن ترقيم المعامله لعدم إمكانية إنشاء سجلات الترحيل','ERROR');
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_DT := NULL;
 :DCLTN_NBR := NULL;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 GET_TIN_NBR;
 COMMIT;

/*
 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ __ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
| DEVELOPER : NIHAD KHALIL FAGEM 02/11/2008 |
| FOR ITEM LINK OPERATION |
|_ _ _ _ _ _ _ __ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _|
*/
 EXEC_LINK_OPERATION(1);
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 COMMIT;
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DispALERT('لا يمكن ترقيم المعامله - تم الترقيم من قبل!','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DispALERT('لا يمكن ترقيم المعامله - توجد سلع محمية علي المعاملة مما يتطلب وجود مخلص بخطاب ضمان !','ERROR');
 :DCLTN_DT := NULL;
 :DCLTN_NBR := NULL;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 -- DM-36 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 02/05/2021
 V_SETT_DM_36 := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('DM_36', 21),0);
 IF V_SETT_DM_36 = 1 THEN
 IF :dcltn_type_cd IN (1,2) AND NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('CREATE_SFDA_61', 21),0) = 1 THEN
 RET := DCLTN.create_rqst_for_SFDA_MEWA(:PORT_CD,:dcltn_isn,15,61,p_rqst_nmr, p_rqst_dt);
 IF RET = 1 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('تم انشاء طلب احالة لهيئة الغذاء والدواء برقم '||p_rqst_nmr,'INFORMATION');
 ELSIF RET = -1 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('يوجد خطأ عند انشاء طلب احالة لهيئة الغذاء والدواء آليا','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :dcltn_type_cd IN (1,2) AND NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('SMPL_LINK_MEWA', 21),0) = 1 THEN
 RET := DCLTN.create_rqst_for_SFDA_MEWA(:PORT_CD,:dcltn_isn,5,2,p_rqst_nmr, p_rqst_dt);
 IF RET = 1 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('تم انشاء طلب احالة لوزارة الزراعة برقم '||p_rqst_nmr,'INFORMATION');
 ELSIF RET = -1 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('يوجد خطأ عند انشاء طلب احالة لوزارة الزراعة آليا','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- END DM-36 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 02/05/2021


END;

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_00490 IS
 RET NUMBER;
 VAR_SUM_DLVY NUMBER;
 VAR_SUM_ITEM NUMBER;
 V_DUTY_TYPE BOOLEAN;
 V_CONFN_DT DATE;
 V_PMT_METHOD NUMBER;
 V_CALC_DT DATE;

 V_REVENUE_CHNGD NUMBER := 0;
 V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
 V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
 V_RET BOOLEAN;

 V_OLD_DCLTN_TYPE NUMBER;

 V_OLD_INSP_GROUP NUMBER;
 V_CHK_FEES_RECALC NUMBER;
 V_DGT_SEQ NUMBER;

 V_DEPUTY_MGR_ID VARCHAR2(200);

BEGIN
V_CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
V_PAYER := DCLTN.GET_DCLTN_PAYER_NAME(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);
V_PAYER := NVL(V_PAYER, :AGNT_NAME);

 IF NOT CHK_INSTRUCTIONS THEN

BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RX')
 THEN
 check_item_rstrctn;
-- STR.DISPALERT('البيان يحتوي علي بنود من المجموعة 162 المقيد إعادة تصديرها لا يمكن الاستمرار','ERROR');
-- RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 DECLARE
 x NUMBER := 0;
 v_count_rx NUMBER := 0;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO x
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND final_tariff_cd IN (SELECT hrmnzd_code
 FROM group_items
 WHERE grp_code = 162);

 IF NVL (x, 0) > 0
 THEN
 check_item_rstrctn;
 ELSE
 v_count_rx := chk_exception_4;

 IF NVL (v_count_rx, 0) = 0
 THEN
 check_item_rstrctn;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

CHECK_EXPORT_VHCL(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);

IF :NEED_PRINT = 0 THEN
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));

 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 IF V_REVENUE_CHNGD = 1 OR NVL(V_CL_VAL, 0) <> NVL(:DECLARATIONS.CL_VAL, 0) THEN

 :NEED_PRINT := 1;

 :DECLARATIONS.CL_VAL := V_CL_VAL;
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 COMMIT;
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 ELSIF V_REVENUE_CHNGD = -1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');

PROCEDURE exec_fun_cd_00370
IS
 ret NUMBER;
BEGIN
 --CR-7466 Mohmaed nouh strat
 DECLARE
 V_RJCT_REASON NUMBER (2);
 BEGIN

 BEGIN
 SELECT RJCT_REASON INTO V_RJCT_REASON FROM DCLTN_GCC_DUES WHERE DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_RJCT_REASON := 1 ;
 END ;

 IF :CLOSE_REASON IS NOT NULL AND V_RJCT_REASON IS NULL THEN
 :STATUS := 2;-- handling issue in JIRA NIB1-3797 -- CR-7466
 UPDATE dcltn_GCC_DUES SET RJCT_REASON = :CLOSE_REASON , STATUS = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD AND dcltn_ISN=:dcltn_ISN;
 FORMS_DDL ('commit');
 END IF ;



 IF V_RJCT_REASON IS NULL AND :CLOSE_REASON IS NULL THEN

 str.dispalert ('يجب إدخال سبب رفض رقم الاستحقاق','ERROR');
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CLOSE_REASON',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CLOSE_REASON',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CLOSE_REASON',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 GO_ITEM ('CLOSE_REASON'); -- handling issue in JIRA NIB1-3797 -- CR-7466
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF ;


 END ;
--CR-7466 Mohmaed nouh end
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_7', visible, property_true);
 ret :=
 str.dispalert
 ('سيتم إنهاء المعاملة بمعرفة الجمرك - هل ترغب في إستكمال الإنهاء',
 'CONFIRM'
 );

 IF ret = alert_button1
 THEN
 IF :parameter.p_port_type = 1
 THEN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR sdo$cur
 IS
 SELECT do_nbr, do_iss_dt, shpg_agnt_nbr
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders
 WHERE dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND port_cd = :declarations.port_cd;

 co NUMBER := 0;
 v_msg VARCHAR2 (5000) := NULL;
 v_ret NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 FOR sdo$for IN sdo$cur
 LOOP
 co := 1;
 v_msg :=
 v_msg
 || ' أذن التسليم رقم'
 || TO_CHAR (sdo$for.do_nbr)
 || ' بتاريخ '
 || TO_CHAR (sdo$for.do_iss_dt, 'MI-MM-YYYY')
 || ' لوكيل شحن '
 || TO_CHAR (sdo$for.shpg_agnt_nbr)
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13);
 v_msg :=
 v_msg
 || ' - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - '
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13);

 FOR sdi$for IN (SELECT DISTINCT mfst_type, mfst_nbr, mfst_dt,
 bl_seq
 FROM sea_dlvy_items sdi
 WHERE (sdi.port_cd =
 :declarations.port_cd
 )
 AND (sdo$for.shpg_agnt_nbr =
 sdi.shpg_agnt_nbr
 )
 AND (sdo$for.do_nbr = sdi.do_nbr)
 AND (sdo$for.do_iss_dt =
 sdi.do_iss_dt
 ))
 LOOP
 v_msg :=
 v_msg
 || TO_CHAR (co)
 || '-'
 || ' رقم المنافست'
 || '('
 || TO_CHAR (sdi$for.mfst_nbr)
 || ')'
 || ' تاريخه'
 || '('
 || TO_CHAR (sdi$for.mfst_dt, 'MI-MM-YYYY')
 || ') نوعه ';
 v_msg :=
 v_msg
 || '('
 || gnrl.get_domain_val_mean ('MFST_TYPES',
 TO_CHAR (sdi$for.mfst_type)
 )
 || ')'
 || ' رقم البوليصة'
 || '('
 || TO_CHAR (sdi$for.bl_seq)
 || ')';
 v_msg := v_msg || CHR (10) || CHR (13);
 END LOOP;

 v_msg :=
 v_msg
 || '- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - '
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13);
 co := co + 1;
 END LOOP;

 IF co > 0
 THEN
 v_msg := CHR (1000) || v_msg;
 v_ret :=
 intrface.flash_alert (v_msg,
 'INFORMATION',
 1,
 'معلومات الشحن التي سيتم فصلها',
 7.5,
 0.5,
 1,
 0.5,
 1300,
 'r255g0b0',
 12
 );
 END IF;
 END;

 DELETE FROM vssl_cntnr_inspcts
 WHERE (port_cd, mfst_type, mfst_nbr, mfst_dt, cntnr_seq) IN (
 SELECT vbi.port_cd, vbi.mfst_type, vbi.mfst_nbr,
 vbi.mfst_dt, vbi.cntnr_seq
 FROM vssl_bl_items vbi,
 sea_dlvy_items sdi,
 sea_dlvy_orders sdo,
 declarations dcltn

 AND vbi.mfst_nbr = sdi.mfst_nbr
 AND vbi.mfst_dt = sdi.mfst_dt
 AND vbi.bl_seq = sdi.bl_seq
 AND vbi.item_seq = sdi.item_seq
 AND sdi.port_cd = sdo.port_cd
 AND sdi.shpg_agnt_nbr = sdo.shpg_agnt_nbr
 AND sdi.do_nbr = sdo.do_nbr
 AND sdi.do_iss_dt = sdo.do_iss_dt
 AND sdo.port_cd = dcltn.port_cd
 AND sdo.dcltn_isn = dcltn.dcltn_isn
 AND dcltn.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn);

 CURSOR ado$cur

 co NUMBER := 0;
 v_msg VARCHAR2 (5000) := NULL;
 v_ret NUMBER;

 co := 0;

 FOR ado$for IN ado$cur
 LOOP
 IF nvl(length(v_msg),0) >4838 then
 EXIT;
 END IF;

 co := co + 1;
 v_msg :=
 SUBSTR( v_msg
 || ' أذن التسليم رقم'
 || TO_CHAR (ado$for.dlvy_nbr)
 || ' بتاريخ '
 || TO_CHAR (ado$for.dlvy_dt, 'MI-MM-YYYY')
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13),1,5000);
 v_msg :=
 SUBSTR(v_msg
 || ' - - - - - - - - - -- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - '
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13),1,5000); --
 v_msg :=
 SUBSTR(v_msg
 || TO_CHAR (co)
 || '-'
 || ' رقم المنافست'
 || '('
 || TO_CHAR (ado$for.mfst_nbr)
 || ')'
 || ' سنة المنافست '
 || '('
 || TO_CHAR (ado$for.mfst_year)
 || ') نوعه ',1,5000);
 v_msg :=
 SUBSTR(v_msg
 || '('
 || gnrl.get_domain_val_mean ('MFST_TYPES',
 TO_CHAR (ado$for.mfst_type))
 || ')',1,5000);
 v_msg :=
 SUBSTR(v_msg
 || ' نوع الشحن '
 || '('
 || gnrl.get_domain_val_mean ('SHPMT TYPE',

 )
 || ')',1,5000);

 v_msg :=
 SUBSTR(v_msg
 || '- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - '
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13),1,5000);
 END LOOP;

 IF co > 0
 THEN
 v_msg :=SUBSTR( CHR (1000) || v_msg,1,5000);
 v_ret :=
 intrface.flash_alert (v_msg,
 'INFORMATION',
 1,
 'معلومات الشحن التي سيتم فصلها',
 7.5,
 0.5,
 1,
 0.5,
 1300,
 'r255g0b0',
 12
 );

 END;

 :termn_dt := hijdate.cur_hij_date;

 SELECT dcltn_sta_desc

 FROM dcltn_status

 SELECT usr_aname

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('TERMN_DECREE_NBR', visible, property_true);

 :parameter.p_current_item := 'DECLARATIONS.TERMN_DECREE_NBR';

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_F_2100_2200_2300
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_F_2100_2200_2300 IS
 RET NUMBER;
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'TMPLT_MOD_CALL';
 V_DCLTN_COPIES NUMBER := 1;
 ACTUAL_CD NUMBER;
 V_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 v_card_cnt NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم طباعة المعامله - هل ترغب في إستكمال الطباعة؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD = 98 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 11, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 /* UPDATE DECLARATIONS SET PRINT_CNT = PRINT_CNT + 1 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 */
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT PORT_TYPE INTO V_TYPE FROM SD_PORTS WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_TYPE := NULL;
 END;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_DCLTN_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_PORT_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,V_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_DCLTN_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_REPRINT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 0);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PRIVATE_AIR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_PRIVATE_VT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_HQ_ISD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 /* Add on 2008/09/01 14:31 (Bander ) */
----------------------------------------------
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD <> 98 THEN
 IF ( (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1) AND (:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN(1,2)) THEN
/* Formatted on 2015/01/19 11:51 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_card_cnt
 FROM vhcl_cards
 WHERE vhcl_cards.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND vhcl_cards.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn ;

 IF v_card_cnt > 0 THEN
 CALL_VCARD_LOV;

 IF :GLOBAL.G_CHISIS_NO IS NOT NULL THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_ITEM_MARK', TEXT_PARAMETER, :GLOBAL.G_CHISIS_NO );
 END IF ;
 END IF;


 --str.dispalert(:GLOBAL.G_CHISIS_NO,'error');--
----------------------------------------------
 ELSIF ( (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1) AND (:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 3 ) THEN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT vt.vhcl_chassis_no
 FROM declarations d,
 dcltn_land_mnfsts dlm,
 dcltn_land_mnfst_trans dlmt,
 vhcl_transactions vt
 WHERE d.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND ( (d.port_cd = dlm.port_cd)
 AND (d.dcltn_isn = dlm.dcltn_isn)
 AND (dlm.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd)
 AND (dlm.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dlmt.dcltn_mnfst_isn)
 AND (dlmt.port_cd = vt.port_cd)
 AND (dlmt.trans_date_h = vt.trans_date_h)
 AND (dlmt.tran_seq = vt.tran_seq)
 )
 UNION
 SELECT vt.vhcl_chassis_no
 FROM declarations d, dcltn_gate_trans dgt, vhcl_transactions vt
 WHERE d.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND d.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND ( (d.port_cd = dgt.port_cd)
 AND (d.dcltn_isn = dgt.dcltn_isn)
 AND (vt.port_cd = dgt.port_cd)
 AND (vt.trans_date_h = dgt.vhcl_trans_date)
 AND (vt.tran_seq = dgt.vhcl_trans_nbr)
 AND (DGT.DGT_TYPE <> 7)
 ));
 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 CALL_VHCL_CHISIS_LOV;
 IF :GLOBAL.G_CHISIS_NO IS NOT NULL THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CHISIS_NO', TEXT_PARAMETER, :GLOBAL.G_CHISIS_NO);
 END IF;

 END IF;

 END IF;
 -- END IF;
----------------------------------------------
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND :FINAL_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN
 V_DCLTN_COPIES := COPIES_COUNT;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'COPIES', TEXT_PARAMETER, V_DCLTN_COPIES);
 END IF;

 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_2PAY') THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BANK_TXT', TEXT_PARAMETER, GET_BANK_TXT);
 END IF;

 IF CHK_DIFF_CLR THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_IMPR_DIFF_CLRNC', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 END IF;
 ACTUAL_CD := DCLTN.ENCRYPT_NUM(:DCLTN_ISN, :PRINT_CNT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_PRNT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, ACTUAL_CD);

 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOTEXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_CR_4819
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE exec_cr_4819 IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR CHECK_CUR IS
 SELECT DI.PORT_CD, DI.ITEM_ISN
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI, DCLTN_ITEM_CONFIRMS DIC
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = DIC.PORT_CD
 AND DI.ITEM_ISN = DIC.ITEM_ISN
 AND DI.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DIC.ACTION_TYPE IS NULL
 AND DCLTN.CHECK_ITEM_IMP_EXP_STATUS(DI.PORT_CD, DI.ITEM_ISN) = 1
 -- AND meet the above conditions
 ;
 V_CONFIRM NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;
 v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(2000);
 BEGIN
 FOR REC IN CHECK_CUR LOOP
 V_CONFIRM :=
 DCLTN.CONFIRM_ITEM (REC.PORT_CD,
 REC.ITEM_ISN,
 HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE,
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);

 IF V_CONFIRM = 0 THEN
 RET :=
 activity_db.add_activity (
 21,
 3,
 27,
 REC.PORT_CD || '!' || REC.ITEM_ISN,
 REC.PORT_CD,
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,
 :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID,
 v_msg_txt);
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END;
 --------------
END;

--CR-7777

 IS_MWANI_PORT BOOLEAN ;

ProgramUnit.Name: END_INSPTR_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE END_INSPTR_DCLTN IS
 H_DATE DATE;
 V_ASSIGN_ISN NUMBER;
 V_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL NUMBER;

BEGIN
 H_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;

 IF :GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL AND :INSPTR_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT ASSIGN_ISN, WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
 INTO V_ASSIGN_ISN, V_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND GRP_ID = :DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID
 AND INSPTR_ID = :DECLARATIONS.INSPTR_ID
 AND END_DATE IS NULL
 AND RMV_DT IS NULL
 ;

 UPDATE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 SET END_DATE = H_DATE
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND ASSIGN_ISN = V_ASSIGN_ISN
 ;

 UPDATE INSPTR_GRPS
 SET FINISHED_DCLTN_COUNT = FINISHED_DCLTN_COUNT + 1,
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL= WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL - V_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = :DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID
 AND USER_ID = :DECLARATIONS.INSPTR_ID
 ;
 ELSE
 UPDATE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 SET END_DATE = H_DATE
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND END_DATE IS NULL
 AND RMV_DT IS NULL
 ;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DOWN_GRADE_PRIORITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DOWN_GRADE_PRIORITY IS
RET NUMBER;
V_COUNT NUMBER;
v_prtl_exist NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_prtl_exist
FROM DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS
WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
AND PRIORITY_LEVEL <> 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
FROM TASKS
WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) AND FILLER1 IS NOT NULL;
IF v_prtl_exist = 1 OR v_count > 0 THEN
 RET:=STR.DISPALERT('هل تريد تخفيض اولوية المعاملة','CONFIRM');
 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS SET PRIORITY_LEVEL = PRIORITY_LEVEL + 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND PRIORITY_LEVEL <> 3;

 UPDATE DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 SET PRIORITY_LEVEL = PRIORITY_LEVEL + 1
 WHERE dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND TO_CHAR(DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID) IN (SELECT filler1 FROM TASKS
 WHERE TASK_ID =NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0))
 AND PRIORITY_LEVEL <> 3;
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 :GLOBAL.CANT_COLLECT_DCLTN :=1;
 STR.DISPALERT('تم تخفيض اولوية المعاملة','INFORMATION');
 display_new_dcltn_queue(0);
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISP_WAIVERS_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISP_WAIVERS_DATA IS
 V_CLRNC_DT DATE;
 CURSOR V_CUR_WVRS IS
 SELECT DISTINCT WT.ITEM_TYPE_NAME "TYPE_NAME"
 FROM WAIVERS W, WVR_ITEMS WI, WVR_TYPES WT
 WHERE W.WVR_PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND W.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND WI.WVR_PORT_CD = W.WVR_PORT_CD
 AND WI.WVR_SEQ_NBR = W.WVR_SEQ_NBR
 AND WI.ISSUED_DT = W.ISSUED_DT
 AND WI.ITEM_TYPE_CD IN (2, 6, 9, 15, 16)
-- AND WI.ITEM_STATUS <> '9'----AAAA
 AND NVL(WI.ITEM_STATUS,0) <> '9'
 AND WT.ITEM_TYPE_CD = WI.ITEM_TYPE_CD
 ;

BEGIN
 SELECT CLRNC_DT
 INTO V_CLRNC_DT
/* FROM WAIVERS
 WHERE WVR_PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN*/
 FROM WAIVERS W, WVR_ITEMS WI
 WHERE W.WVR_PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND W.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND WI.WVR_PORT_CD = W.WVR_PORT_CD
 AND WI.WVR_SEQ_NBR = W.WVR_SEQ_NBR
 AND WI.ISSUED_DT = W.ISSUED_DT
-- AND DCLTN_TYPE = 1 ---AAAA1
-- AND DCLTN_TYPE IN ( 1 , 2 ) ---AAAA2
 AND WVR_STATUS <> 0
 AND ROWNUM = 1
 ;

 IF V_CLRNC_DT IS NULL THEN
 :HAS_WAIVERS := 'بتعهدات لم تسدد';
 FOR I IN V_CUR_WVRS LOOP
 :HAS_WAIVERS := :HAS_WAIVERS||'-'||I.TYPE_NAME;
 END LOOP;

 ELSE
 :HAS_WAIVERS := 'بتعهدات مسددة';
 FOR I IN V_CUR_WVRS LOOP
 :HAS_WAIVERS := :HAS_WAIVERS||'-'||I.TYPE_NAME;
 END LOOP;

 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :HAS_WAIVERS := 'بدون تعهدات';
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISPLAY_NEW_DCLTN_QUEUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE display_new_dcltn_queue(v_prior NUMBER DEFAULT 1) IS
v_dcltn_isn NUMBER;
v_port_cd NUMBER;
BEGIN

IF :RECIEVE_AUTO = 1 THEN
:GLOBAL.DONTSHOW := 0;
lib_usr.hours24_services.get_new_dcltn_queue(:parameter.p_curr_port_cd,:dcltn_isn,:parameter.p_user_id,:parameter.p_task_id,:parameter.P_DCLTN_TYPE,v_prior,v_port_cd,v_dcltn_isn);
END IF;
 IF v_dcltn_isn IS NOT NULL AND :RECIEVE_AUTO = 1 THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN:=v_dcltn_isn;
 :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD:=v_port_cd;
 ELSE
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN :=NULL;
 :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD :=NULL;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 :global.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD;
 :global.DCLTN_ISN := :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 :GLOBAL.REFRESH_DCLTN := 1;
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM:='DCLTN_NBR';
 ELSE
 :global.DCLTN_PORT_CD := NULL;
 :global.DCLTN_ISN := NULL;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 0;
 :GLOBAL.REFRESH_DCLTN := 0;

 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISP_INSURANCE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISP_INSURANCE_DATA IS
 V_CNFRM_DT DATE;
 V_INS_REQ_PMT NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_INS_REQ_NBR NUMBER;
 V_INS_REQ_DT DATE;
BEGIN

 SELECT CONFN_DT, INS_REQ_PMT,INS_REQ_NBR ,INS_REQ_DT
 INTO V_CNFRM_DT, V_INS_REQ_PMT,V_INS_REQ_NBR ,V_INS_REQ_DT
 FROM INS_REQS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM COLL_ORDER_DTLS COD, ACCT_ITEM_DTLS AID
 WHERE COD.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COD.ACCT_SEQ = AID.ACCT_SEQ
 AND AID.AID_TYPE = 2
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;


 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 IF V_CNFRM_DT IS NULL THEN
 IF V_INS_REQ_PMT = 1 THEN
 :HAS_INSURANCE := 'مؤمن ولم يؤكد';
 ELSIF V_INS_REQ_PMT = 2 THEN
 :HAS_INSURANCE := 'مؤمن بضمان وغير مؤكد';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_INS_REQ_PMT = 1 THEN
 :HAS_INSURANCE := 'مؤمن ومؤكد';
 ELSIF V_INS_REQ_PMT = 2 THEN
 :HAS_INSURANCE := 'مؤمن بضمان ومؤكد';
 END IF;
 -- BY SHERIFT
 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM INS_REQ_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND INS_REQ_NBR = V_INS_REQ_NBR
 AND INS_REQ_DT = V_INS_REQ_DT
 AND INS_REQ_STA=1;
 IF V_COUNT=0 THEN
 :HAS_INSURANCE := :HAS_INSURANCE || ' ومنتهي';
 END IF;
 --
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :HAS_INSURANCE := 'غير مؤمن';
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :HAS_INSURANCE := 'غير مؤمن';
END;

PROCEDURE DISP_EXMPTN_DATA IS

 ELSIF V_COUNT_CONFIRM <> V_COUNT_EXMPTN THEN

 :HAS_EXMPTN := 'كل الإصناف المعفاة مؤكدة';

 ELSE

 END IF;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISP_DCLTN_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISP_DCLTN_LOV IS

 RET NUMBER;

 BEGIN

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR := :DCLTN_NBR;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD := :DCLTN_TYPE_CD;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PORT_CD);

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_TASK_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID);

/*
 IF ( (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_SEC')) AND (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2)) )THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_STA_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, 5);

*/

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN.fmx',
 no_hide,

 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 CHECK_NONE_GROUP_MGR(:GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN);

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION Disp_Available_agreement(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER,V_DATE DATE,v_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS

 CURSOR DI_CURSOR IS
 SELECT ITEM_SEQ,AGR.AGRMNT_NO,AGRMNT_DESC ,AGR.AGRMNT_TYPE,RV_MEANING,L_AM.MEMBER_ISN


,PORT_CD, FINAL_TARIFF_CD,COUNTRIES.CRTY_ARBC_NAME
,DI.CTRY_CD,ITEM_DESC


 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI
 ,AGRMNT_MEMBERS L_AM
 ,AGRMNTS AGR,CG_REF_CODES,COUNTRIES

 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DUTY_TYPE IN (1,2)
 AND EXMTN_TYPE IS NULL

 AND DI.CTRY_CD=COUNTRIES.CTRY_CD

 AND L_AM.CTRY_CD = DI.CTRY_CD

 AND
L_AM.MEMBER_STATUS <> 1
AND L_AM.AGRMNT_NO = AGR.AGRMNT_NO



AND

AGR.AGRMNT_TYPE IN (1,2)
AND V_DATE BETWEEN AGR.AGRMNT_ST_DT AND AGR.AGRMNT_EN_DT


AND (AGR.CTRY_CD = v_FINAL_CTRY_CD )
AND CG_REF_CODES.RV_DOMAIN ='AGRMNT_TYPE'
AND CG_REF_CODES.RV_LOW_VALUE=AGR.AGRMNT_TYPE

AND
(
EXISTS
(
SELECT 1 FROM AGRMNT_ITEMS
WHERE
AGRMNT_ITEMS.AGRMNT_NO = L_AM.AGRMNT_NO
AND AGRMNT_ITEMS.MEMBER_ISN = L_AM.MEMBER_ISN
AND
AGRMNT_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE = DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
AND AGRMNT_ITEMS.ITEM_STATUS <> 1
AND NVL(AGRMNT_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_FLAG,1) = 1
AND L_AM.ALL_ITEM_FLAG=3


)


OR

NOT EXISTS
(
SELECT 1 FROM AGRMNT_ITEMS
WHERE
AGRMNT_ITEMS.AGRMNT_NO = L_AM.AGRMNT_NO
AND AGRMNT_ITEMS.MEMBER_ISN = L_AM.MEMBER_ISN
AND
AGRMNT_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE = DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD


)

)
ORDER BY item_seq,AGR.AGRMNT_NO



;

 V_AGRMNT_EXIST NUMBER;


--- GROUP 204 COULD NOT BE EXCEPTED
 V_RETURN1 NUMBER;


 V_RET1 VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;
 V_MSG1 VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;


BEGIN

 V_RETURN1 :=0;

 V_RET1 := ' ' || CHR(10) ;




-- V_RET2 := 'اصناف شهادة المطابقة غير معتمدة فى دولة المنشأ ويجب عمل طلب تحليل عينات لها' || CHR(10) ;


 FOR DI IN DI_CURSOR LOOP
 V_RETURN1 :=1;
 --- لا يوجد شهادة مطابقة
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || ' مسلسل الصنف :' || DI.ITEM_SEQ || ' ' || ' البند ' || ' ' || DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD || ' ' || DI.ITEM_DESC || CHR(10) ;
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || 'رقم الاتفاقية ' || ' ' || DI.AGRMNT_NO || ' ' ;
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || 'نوعها ' || ' ' || DI.RV_MEANING || ' ' ;
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || ' ' || DI.AGRMNT_DESC || ' ' ;
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || ' الدولة ' || ' ' || DI.CRTY_ARBC_NAME || CHR(10) ;
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);


 IF (LENGTH(V_RET1) > 3900) THEN
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 ||'.....' || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 EXIT;
 END IF;

END LOOP;
 IF V_RETURN1 =1 THEN
 V_MSG1 := CHR(1000) || V_RET1;
 V_RET1 := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG1, 'INFORMATION', 1, ' يوجد اتفاقية لاعفاء الأصناف الواردة من تلك الدولة بعد توافر الشروط اللازمة للإعفاء',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 12); RETURN 1;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0 ;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISPATCH_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISPATCH_DCLTN IS
 HDATE DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM REGISTERED_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_KIND = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) = 0 THEN
 INSERT
 INTO REGISTERED_DCLTNS(PORT_CD, RGSTR_ISN, DCLTN_ISN, STATS_ISN, RGSTR_DATE, CMPLTN_DATE,
 DCLTN_KIND, DCLTN_TYPE, DCLTN_STATUS, DCLTN_DLY_ST,
 DISPATCH_FLAG, REMARKS, BASIC_BATCH_NBR, BASIC_BATCH_DT,
 DISPATCH_NBR, DISPATCH_DT)
 VALUES(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, :DCLTN_ISN, NULL, :DCLTN_DT, NULL,
 :DCLTN_TYPE_CD, 2, 2, 2,
 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
 ;
 END IF;
END;

FUNCTION DHL_BRKR_AUTO_PRINT RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_AUTO_PRINT_CHR VARCHAR2(200);
 V_AUTO_PRINT_NBR NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT VAR_VALUE
 INTO V_AUTO_PRINT_CHR
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.

 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DCLTN_SYS_ID')
--&&& END
 AND VAR_NAME = 'DHL_BRKR_AUTO_PRINT'
 ;

 V_AUTO_PRINT_NBR := TO_NUMBER(V_AUTO_PRINT_CHR);

 IF V_AUTO_PRINT_NBR = 1 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DEL_NON_PAID_DCLTN_STRGS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DEL_NON_PAID_DCLTN_STRGS(IS_COMMIT NUMBER) IS
CURSOR DCLTN_STRG_CUR IS
 SELECT *
 FROM DCLTN_STRGS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;

V_DATE DATE;
V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
BEGIN
FOR I IN DCLTN_STRG_CUR LOOP
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF NOT STRG.CHK_STRG_PAY_STAT(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, I.STRG_SEQ, I.PMNT_TYPE, V_DATE) THEN
 IF STRG.CHK_STRG_PAY_STAT(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, I.STRG_SEQ, I.PMNT_TYPE, V_DATE) = 0 THEN
--&&& END
 DELETE DCLTN_DLVY_STRGS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND STRG_SEQ = I.STRG_SEQ
 ;

 DELETE DCLTN_STRGS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND STRG_SEQ = I.STRG_SEQ
 ;
 END IF;
END LOOP;
IF IS_COMMIT = 1 THEN
 V_MSG_LEVEL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:= V_MSG_LEVEL;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DCLTN_TYPE_LOV_CALL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DCLTN_TYPE_LOV_CALL IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_DCLTN_TYPE';

 RET NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_TASK_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'أنواع البيان الجمركي');

 IF (:system.mode <> 'ENTER-QUERY' ) THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'STATUS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 END IF;

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN_TYPE.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_TYPE_CD := :GLOBAL.TYPE_ID;
 :DCLTN_TYPE_NAME := :GLOBAL.TYPE_NAME;
 END IF;


 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END DCLTN_TYPE_LOV_CALL;

ProgramUnit.Name: DCLTN_SPCL_REF_LOV_CALL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DCLTN_SPCL_REF_LOV_CALL IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_DCLTN_TYPE';
 V_24HOURS NUMBER:=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 v_dcltn_sta_cd NUMBER;
 v_dcltn_action NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 10);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'أقسام الأوضاع الخاصة');

IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = 36 THEN
 IF V_24HOURS = 1 THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_USER_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 END IF;
END IF;

 IF (:system.mode <> 'ENTER-QUERY' ) THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_STATUS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 END IF;
 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN_SPCL_REF.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) <> 36 THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.SPCL_DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_dcltn_action
 FROM CUSTOMS.DCLTN_EXPLAIN_ACTION D1, CUSTOMS.DCLTN_EXPLAIN D2
 WHERE D1.PORT_CD = D2.PORT_CD
 AND D1.EXPLAIN_SEQ = D2.EXPLAIN_SEQ
 AND D2.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DACTION_ID = 2
 AND SPCL_DEPT_ID_FROM = :GLOBAL.SPCL_DEPT_ID;
IF v_dcltn_action > 0 THEN
RET := STR.DispALERT(' تم التحويل بالفعل لهذا القسم و افاد بانهاء الاجراءات هل ترير الاستمرار','CONFIRM');
IF RET <> ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
TERMINATE_FUN;
END IF;
END IF;
 :SPCL_DEPT_ID := :GLOBAL.SPCL_DEPT_ID;
 :SPCL_DEPT_NAME := :GLOBAL.DEPT_NAME;
--MMAOUA BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.SPCL_DEPT_ID = 20 THEN
 CHECK_SMPL_REQ;
 END IF;
--MMAOUA END
 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE

IF V_24HOURS = 1 THEN

 IF :GLOBAL.LOV_DCLTN_DEPT_INSERT IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS := 7;
 :dcltn_sta_cd:=:U_DCLTN_STATUS;
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 COMMIT;
 FORMS_DDL('UPDATE declarations SET DCLTN_STA_CD = 7 WHERE port_cd = '||:port_cd||' AND dcltn_isn= '||:dcltn_isn );
 FORMs_ddl(' COMMIT');

 SELECT dcltn_sta_cd INTO v_dcltn_sta_cd
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd AND dcltn_isn=:dcltn_isn;
 IF v_dcltn_sta_cd = 7 THEN
 spc_dept_rcv_trans(:GLOBAL.LOV_DCLTN_DEPT_INSERT,'I');
 standard.commit;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF :GLOBAL.LOV_DCLTN_DEPT_delete IS NOT NULL THEN
 spc_dept_rcv_trans(:GLOBAL.LOV_DCLTN_DEPT_delete,'D');
 SELECT COUNT (*)INTO V_CNT FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF V_CNT = 0 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS := 3;
 :dcltn_sta_cd:=:U_DCLTN_STATUS;
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 FORMS_DDL('UPDATE declarations SET DCLTN_STA_CD = 3 WHERE port_cd = '||:port_cd||' AND dcltn_isn= '||:dcltn_isn );
 FORMs_ddl(' COMMIT');

 END IF;
 COMMIT;
 END IF;

END IF;



 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);

 END IF;


 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END DCLTN_SPCL_REF_LOV_CALL;

ProgramUnit.Name: DCLTN_REFUND_ONLINE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DCLTN_REFUND_ONLINE (P_PORT_CD NUMBER ,P_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER ) IS
V_ONLINE_CNT NUMBER;
RET NUMBER;
V_MSG VARCHAR2(200);
V_STATUS NUMBER;
BEGIN

 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم استرجاع المبلغ المدفوع اون لاين وسيتم انهاء البيان بمعرفة الجمرك هل تريد الاستمرار ','CONFIRM');

 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 LIB_USR.REVENUE.COLLECT_DCLTN_ONLINE_REFUND(:PORT_CD , :DCLTN_ISN ,V_MSG ,V_STATUS) ;
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG ,'INFORMATION');
 IF V_STATUS = 200 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DECLARATIONS', update_allowed, property_true);

 IF NOT activity.add_activity (21, 1, 23, TO_CHAR (:port_cd) || '!' || TO_CHAR (:dcltn_isn))
 THEN
 terminate_fun;
 END IF;

 :declarations.dcltn_sta_cd :=consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DSI_CLSD');
 :declarations.u_dcltn_status := :declarations.dcltn_sta_cd;
 :termn_dt := hijdate.cur_hij_date;
 :termn_user_id := :parameter.p_user_id;

 SELECT dcltn_sta_desc
 INTO :dcltn_sta_desc
 FROM dcltn_status
 WHERE dcltn_type_cd = :dcltn_type_cd
 AND dcltn_sta_cd = :u_dcltn_status
 AND rec_status = 1;

 SELECT usr_aname
 INTO :termn_usr_aname
 FROM sc_users
 WHERE port_cd = port_cd AND user_id = :termn_user_id;

 :TERMN_NOTE := 'بيان الكتروني سيتم استرداد المبلغ';
 :TERMN_RSN := 5 ;
:TERMN_DECREE_NBR := 1 ;
:TERMN_DECREE_DT :=hijdate.cur_hij_date;
 COMMIT;
 END IF;

 END IF ;
END;

---------------------------------------------------------------
