ProgramUnit.Name: CREATE_T2
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CREATE_T2 IS
 ----ALAA ---- 24-03-2009 ---------

 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'TMPLT_MOD_CALL';
 V_T2_RESULT NUMBER ;
 O_T2_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 O_T2_DATE DATE ;
 O_T2_SEQ NUMBER;
 O_LIST_DATE DATE ;
 O_LIST_SEQ NUMBER ;
 O_ERR_MSG_T2 VARCHAR2(100) ;
 V_Form_T2_FULLPATH VARCHAR2(300) ;

 V_Form_T2_PATH VARCHAR2(300) := 'D:\PROD\REVENUE\fmx\';
 V_Form_T2_NAME VARCHAR2(300) := 'REV43110.fmx' ;
 -----------------------------------
 V_FOUND_2T NUMBER:=0;
 V_CLOSE_SYSTEM_MSG BOOLEAN := FALSE ;
BEGIN
:GLOBAL.T2_IS_CREATED := 0 ;

 IF TO_DATE(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('T2_START_DT',24),'YYYY-MM-MI') <= HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date THEN

 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_FOUND_2T FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS
 (SELECT * FROM REV_2T WHERE PORT_CD= :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD);

 IF V_FOUND_2T>=1 THEN
 V_CLOSE_SYSTEM_MSG := TRUE;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;



 --CLCTN.INSERT_2T INSERT_2T
 V_T2_RESULT := CLCTN.INSERT_2T(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD ,
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR ,
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT ,
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD ,
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ,

 O_T2_PORT_CD ,
 O_T2_DATE ,
 O_T2_SEQ ,
 O_LIST_DATE ,
 O_LIST_SEQ ,
 O_ERR_MSG_T2
 );

 IF V_T2_RESULT <> 1 THEN -- 0 FAILS
 STR.DispALERT(O_ERR_MSG_T2,'ERROR');
 :GLOBAL.T2_IS_CREATED := 0 ;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSE -- SUCCSSES
 :GLOBAL.T2_IS_CREATED := 1 ;

 :GLOBAL.O_T2_PORT_CD := O_T2_PORT_CD ;
 :GLOBAL.O_T2_DATE := TO_CHAR(O_T2_DATE,'MI-MM-YYYY') ;
 :GLOBAL.O_T2_SEQ := O_T2_SEQ ;
 :GLOBAL.O_LIST_DATE := TO_CHAR(O_LIST_DATE ,'MI-MM-YYYY') ;
 :GLOBAL.O_LIST_SEQ := O_LIST_SEQ ;
 :GLOBAL.O_ERR_MSG_T2 := O_ERR_MSG_T2 ;

 END IF;
END IF;

 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 IF V_CLOSE_SYSTEM_MSG THEN
 Str.DispAlert('الرجاء اغلاق النظام حدث خطأ في البيان أثناء كتابة النموزج 2ت ','ERROR');
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('حدث خطأ في البيان أثناء كتابة النموزج 2ت','ERROR');
 END IF;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CREATE_SMPL_REQUEST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CREATE_SMPL_REQUEST IS
V_RQST_NBR NUMBER;
V_EXIST NUMBER;
V_LAB_CD NUMBER;
V_SMPL_NBR NUMBER;
V_RQST_DT DATE;

CURSOR S IS SELECT PORT_CD,ITEM_ISN,FINAL_TARIFF_CD
FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI
WHERE DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN AND PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
AND FINAL_TARIFF_CD IN (SELECT LAB_HRMNZD_ITEM FROM SMPL_LAB_DTLS WHERE LAB_ITEM_STATUS=1)
AND ( -- CR-4139 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 20/02/2022
 ICA_IDNT_ISN IS NULL
 AND dcltn_services.Dcltn_check_Saber(:PORT_CD, di.ITEM_ISN, 1) = 0
 AND dcltn_services.check_elctrnc_addmsion(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, 1) =0
 ) -- END CR-4139 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 20/02/2022
AND NVL(IDEN_CER_EXCEPT,0)= 0
AND EXISTS
 (SELECT 1 FROM importers
 WHERE port_cd=:PORT_CD
 AND impr_nbr=:impr_nbr
 AND IMPR_TYPE_CD NOT IN (4,2,8)
 )

AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM SMPL_ITEMS WHERE DCLTN_ITEM_ISN=ITEM_ISN);
V_ITEMS VARCHAR2(200);
RET NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN
FOR REC IN S LOOP
V_ITEMS:=V_ITEMS||REC.FINAL_TARIFF_CD||',';
END LOOP;
IF V_ITEMS IS NOT NULL THEN
RET:=STR.DISPALERT('سيتم إنشاء طلب تحليل عينات للبند '||RTRIM(V_ITEMS,','),'CONFIRM');
END IF;
IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
FOR REC IN S LOOP
BEGIN
SELECT ss.lab_cd INTO v_lab_cd
 FROM smpl_requests ss
 WHERE ss.lab_cd IN (
 SELECT s2.lab_cd
 FROM smpl_lab_dtls s2, smpl_group_item s3
 WHERE s2.lab_hrmnzd_item = s3.hrmnzd_code
 AND s3.grp_code IN (SELECT s4.grp_code
 FROM smpl_group_item s4
 WHERE s4.hrmnzd_code = rec.final_tariff_cd)
 AND lab_item_status = 1)
 AND ss.rqst_dt =
 (SELECT MIN (s1.rqst_dt)
 FROM smpl_requests s1
 WHERE s1.lab_cd IN (
 SELECT s2.lab_cd
 FROM smpl_lab_dtls s2, smpl_group_item s3
 WHERE s2.lab_hrmnzd_item = s3.hrmnzd_code
 AND s3.grp_code IN (
 SELECT s4.grp_code
 FROM smpl_group_item s4
 WHERE s4.hrmnzd_code =
 rec.final_tariff_cd)
 AND lab_item_status = 1))
 AND ROWNUM=1;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
SELECT LAB_CD INTO v_lab_cd
FROM SMPL_LAB_DTLS
WHERE LAB_HRMNZD_ITEM=REC.FINAL_TARIFF_CD AND
 LAB_ITEM_STATUS=1 AND ROWNUM=1;
END;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXIST FROM SMPL_REQUESTS
WHERE RQST_PORT_CD=:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN AND lab_cd=v_lab_cd;
IF v_exist = 0 THEN
SELECT RQST_NMR.NEXTVAL INTO V_RQST_NBR FROM DUAL;
INSERT INTO SMPL_REQUESTS(RQST_PORT_CD,RQST_NMR,RQST_DT,RQST_STATUS_CD,DCLTN_ISN,IMPR_NBR,LAB_CD,INSPCTR_NBR,DCLTN_TYPE)
VALUES(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,V_RQST_NBR,HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date,0,:DCLTN_ISN,:IMPR_NBR,V_LAB_CD,NULL,1);
ELSE
SELECT RQST_NMR INTO V_RQST_NBR FROM SMPL_REQUESTS
WHERE RQST_PORT_CD=:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN AND lab_cd=v_lab_cd;
END IF;
SELECT NVL(MAX(SMPL_NBR),0) + 1 INTO V_SMPL_NBR
FROM SMPL_ITEMS
WHERE RQST_PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
AND RQST_NMR=V_RQST_NBR AND RQST_DT=HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date;
INSERT INTO SMPL_ITEMS ( RQST_PORT_CD, RQST_NMR, RQST_DT, SMPL_NBR, SMPL_STATUS, SMPL_DESC,
PKG_CD, SMPL_QTY, SMPL_WGT, WGT_UNIT_CD, DCLTN_ITEM_ISN )
VALUES(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,V_RQST_NBR,HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date,V_SMPL_NBR,1,'عينة',
38,1,1 ,1,REC.ITEM_ISN);

END LOOP;
STANDARD.COMMIT;
STR.DISPALERT('تم إنشاء الطلب','INFORMATION');
END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE CONFIRM_EXPORT_DECLARATION
IS
 ------------------------------------------------------ANAS-----------------------------------------------------
 V_ACC_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_AMT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_SEQ NUMBER;
 CURR_DATE DATE;
 V_SEQ NUMBER;

 V_CON_IDEN NUMBER;
BEGIN
 CURR_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 IF GET_US_FORCE =1 THEN
 -----------------------AHMED MOMEN 20-08-2021 DM-259---------------
 CHK_US_FORCES_EXPORT ;
 --------------**************------------------------------------
 ELSE
 -- اختبار رسوم البيان تحت بند نظم اوراق اخرى--
 BEGIN
 SELECT ACCT_SEQ, AMT
 INTO V_ACC_SEQ, V_AMT
 FROM COLL_ORDER_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 V_ACC_SEQ := NULL;
 V_AMT := NULL;
 END;
 ----التأكد من ان البيان له مخلص فعال وله رصيد كافي في جدول الأرصدة-----

 V_CKECK_BALC_AMT := REVENUE.BALC_CHECK_AMOUNT(
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN,
 1,
 :LIC_NBR,
 :LIC_TYPE,
 :BRKR_PORT_CD,
 :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,
 NULL
 )
 ;
 --------------------------------------------------------------------
 --IF V_ACC_SEQ = 3 AND V_CKECK_BALC_AMT = 1 THEN
 IF V_CKECK_BALC_AMT = 1 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT ('سيتم خصم رسوم المعاملة من رصيد المخلص وفسحها','USR_CONFIRM_B');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 --- التأكد من عدم وجود تعليمات----
 V_RET := CHK_INSTRUCTIONS;
 IF V_RET = FALSE THEN
 --التأكد من عدم وجود اوامر قبض غير محصلة على المعاملة--
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND COLL_ORDR_STA = 1
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = 9
 ;
 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.DT_EX') OR :DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.DT_RX') THEN
 CHECK_EXPORT_VHCL (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN);
 CHECK_VHTR_XRAY_INSPECT_EXPORT (:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);
 CHECK_VHTR_COLL_ORDS_EXPORT (:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN); --BY HATEM 2007 TO CHECK IF VHTR HAS UNPAID COLL ORDER

ProgramUnit.Name: COLL_ORDER_PAYED
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION COLL_ORDER_PAYED(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND COLL_ORDR_STA = 1
 AND ((:DECLARATIONS.PMT_METHOD IN (1, 2) AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY IN (1 , 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)) OR (COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = 9))
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 ELSE
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CNFRM_PRC_APPV_4ALL_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CNFRM_PRC_APPV_4ALL_ITEMS(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) IS
 CURSOR DI_CURSOR IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, ITEM_ISN, ITEM_SEQ, DCLTN_ISN, FINAL_TARIFF_CD, PRICING_APPRV
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DI.PRICING_APPRV = 1;


BEGIN
 FOR DI IN DI_CURSOR LOOP
 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS
 SET PRICING_APPRV=3
 WHERE PORT_CD = DI.PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN = DI.ITEM_ISN;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 3, 32, DI.PORT_CD ||'!'||DI.ITEM_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
END;

 AND d1.dcltn_type_cd IN (4)
 AND D2.IDEN_GOODS_APPRV IS NULL
 AND D1.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND D1.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 ;
 IF V_CON_IDEN > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب أن يتم أتخاذ قرار بشأن مطابقة البضائع المعاد تصديرها مقارنة بالبضائع المدخلة مؤقتاً قبل الفسح','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 --
 DECLARE
 CURSOR S IS
 SELECT D3.PORT_CD,D3.ITEM_TEMP_ISN,D2.PORT_CD EXPORT_PORT_CD,D1.DCLTN_NBR,D1.DCLTN_DT,D1.DCLTN_TYPE_CD,
 D2.ITEM_SEQ,D2.NET_WT,D2.INV_QTY,D2.GROSS_WT,D3.INV_QTY INV_FIRST,D2.INV_MSR_UNIT,D3.MSR_UNIT,
 D2.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,D3.HRMNZD_CODE,D3.TEMP_EXPRY_DT,D2.CIF_COST,D2.ITEM_ISN,D4.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM declarations d1, dcltn_items d2,ITM_TMP_ALL d3,IMPORTERS D4
 WHERE d1.port_cd = d2.port_cd
 AND d1.dcltn_isn = d2.dcltn_isn
 AND d2.PORT_CD_IMPD_AT = d3.port_cd
 AND d2.DCLTN_NBR_IMPD_BY = d3.DCLTN_NBR
 AND D2.DCLTN_DT_IMPD_BY = D3.DCLTN_DT
 AND D2.DCLTN_SEQ_IMPD_BY = D3.ITEM_SEQ
 AND D1.PORT_CD = D4.PORT_CD
 AND D1.AGENT_NBR = D4.IMPR_NBR
 AND d1.dcltn_type_cd IN (4)
 AND D2.IDEN_GOODS_APPRV = 2
 AND D1.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND D1.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 ;
 OLD_SUM NUMBER;
 H_DATE DATE:= HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
 BEGIN
 FOR REC IN S LOOP
 SELECT SUM(INV_QTY)
 INTO OLD_SUM
 FROM ITM_TMP_LNK_ALL
 WHERE PORT_CD = REC.PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_TEMP_ISN = REC.ITEM_TEMP_ISN
 ;
 IF OLD_SUM+REC.INV_QTY > REC.INV_FIRST THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(REC.ITEM_SEQ||' أن المصدر الان يتجاوز ما تم استيراده من صنف رقم ','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSIF REC.INV_MSR_UNIT <> REC.MSR_UNIT THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,45,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSIF REC.FINAL_TARIFF_CD <> REC.HRMNZD_CODE THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,55,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSIF H_DATE > REC.TEMP_EXPRY_DT THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,75,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSE
 INSERT INTO ITM_TMP_LNK_ALL I
 (
 I.PORT_CD, I.ITEM_TEMP_ISN, I.EXPORT_PORT_CD,
 I.DCLTN_NBR, I.DCLTN_DT, I.DCLTN_TYPE_CD,
 I.ITEM_SEQ, I.INV_QTY, I.GROSS_WT,
 I.NET_WT,I.ACTN_DATE,I.ITEM_VALUE,I.CASH_INS_FLAG,I.ITEM_ISN,I.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 )
 VALUES
 (
 REC.PORT_CD, REC.ITEM_TEMP_ISN, REC.EXPORT_PORT_CD,
 REC.DCLTN_NBR, REC.DCLTN_DT, REC.DCLTN_TYPE_CD,
 REC.ITEM_SEQ, REC.INV_QTY, REC.GROSS_WT,
 REC.NET_WT,H_DATE,REC.CIF_COST,0,REC.ITEM_ISN,REC.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 )
 ;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END;
 COMMIT;
 ---طباعة البيان الجمركي حسب الجمرك---
 V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT',999),0);
 IF V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT <> 0 THEN
 V_PAY_PRINT := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('PAY_PRINT_DCLTN',999),0);
 IF V_PAY_PRINT = 1 THEN
 PRINT_DCLTN;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispALERT('لا يمكن الخصم والفسح بسبب وجود فواتير غير محصلة على البيان','ERROR'); --mohamed.nouh 15-11-2022 CR-5749
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispALERT('لا يمكن الخصم والفسح راجع الحاسب الألي','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_EXIST
 FROM coll_orders co, coll_order_dtls cod, acct_item_dtls aid
 WHERE (co.port_cd = cod.port_cd)
 AND (co.coll_ordr_nbr = cod.coll_ordr_nbr)
 AND (co.coll_ordr_dt = cod.coll_ordr_dt)
 AND (co.coll_ordr_ctgry = cod.coll_ordr_ctgry)
 AND (aid.acct_seq = cod.acct_seq)
 AND aid.aid_type = 1
 AND cod.amt > 0
 AND co.port_cd = :PORT_CD
 AND co.dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_ISN;

 -- STR.DISPALERT(V_EXIST,'ERROR' ) ;--\
 IF V_EXIST = 0 THEN
 ----------****------------
 -------تعديل حالة البيان الى مفسوح ومنتهي------
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DECLARATIONS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_WAIT');
 :GATE_DT := HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC
 INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1,107, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN)THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 COMMIT;
 -----------------------
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم تحويل حالة البيان إلى بيان مؤكد','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_ACC') THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_ACC');
 :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;
 ---------------------------nihad khalil fagem 7/03/2009
 IF AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT(:DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID) THEN
 END_INSPTR_DCLTN;
 END IF;
 ---------------------------nihad khalil fagem 7/03/2009
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;
 -- DISPATCH_DCLTN;
 /* -- TO BE MOVED TO RELEASING
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
 UPDATE VSSL_BLS
 SET BL_STG_CD = 5
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
 UPDATE BILLS
 SET BILL_STATUS = 4
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND BILL_STATUS IN (2, 3)
 ;
 END IF;
 */
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 32, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 :DECLARATIONS.U_SADAD_SEND := 1;
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 POST ;
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 IF DCLTN.REG_TYPE_DECISION(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN,1,1) = 0 THEN
 STR.DispALERT('لا يمكن ترقيم المعامله لعدم إمكانية إنشاء سجلات الترحيل','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 COMMIT;
 V_RET := CHK_INSTRUCTIONS;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.Dispalert('البيان مؤكد من قبل', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CNFRM_BLKLST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CNFRM_BLKLST IS
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG_LVL NUMBER;
 X NUMBER;
 v_rsk_mng NUMBER;
PROCEDURE updt_rsk(p_val NUMBER) IS
BEGIN

 FORMS_DDL('UPDATE declarations SET rsk_mng= '|| p_val ||' WHERE port_cd = '||:port_cd||' AND dcltn_isn= '||:dcltn_isn );
 FORMs_ddl(' COMMIT');
END updt_rsk ;
BEGIN

SELECT rsk_mng
INTO v_rsk_mng
FROM declarations
WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn ;

 --IF :RSK_MNG IN (1,3,11,13,33,31,32,23) THEN --


 RET :=FLASH_CLR_ALERT (
 ' الإرسالية ضمن المسار الأحمر ولا يوجد ملاحظات عليها وتستكمل بقية الإجراءات الجمركية , هل تريد الاستمرار ؟',
 'CONFIRM',
 1,
 'رسالة تأكيد',
 5.5,
 1.8,
 2.5,
 0.5,
 1300,
 'r255g255b255',
 'r255g0b0',
 1

 ) ;


 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS
 WHERE ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.ACTVY_SUB_ID = :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.SYSOBJ_ID = 21 AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.SUBJ_CODE = 1 and
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.ACTVY_TYPE = 112 AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 IF X = 0 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 112, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 V_MSG_LVL:=:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 25;


 intrface.make_block_full_operation('DECLARATIONS',TRUE,TRUE,TRUE);

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RSK_MNG',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RSK_MNG',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RSK_MNG',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);


 if v_RSK_MNG in (1,3) then
 :RSK_MNG:=2 ;
 updt_rsk(2) ;
 elsif v_RSK_MNG in (11,13,33,32,23,31) then
 :RSK_MNG:= 22 ;
 updt_rsk(22) ;
 ELSIF v_RSK_MNG IN (10,30) THEN
 :RSK_MNG:= 20 ;
 updt_rsk(20) ;
 END IF;

 COMMIT;

 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=V_MSG_LVL;

 END IF ;

 -- END IF;--

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 str.dispalert('حدث خطأ فى وظيفة التاكيد للمسار الاحمر يرجى الاتصال بقسم الحاسب الالى','error');-- TO BE CHANGED LATER
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_XRAY_LAND_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_XRAY_LAND_DATA(V_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER, V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
-- RETURN 2 MEANS V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD =2 AND THE LINK THROW DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
-- RETURN 1 MEANS V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND THE LINK THROW LAND MANFST
-- RETURN 3 MEANS V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) AND THE LINK THROW DCLTN_GATE_TRANS


V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_COUNT:=0;

 IF V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD =2 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT --VI.* ,
 FROM
 DECLARATIONS D
 ,DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 ,VHCL_INSPCTS VI
 WHERE

 (D.PORT_CD=V_CURR_PORT_CD)
 AND(D.DCLTN_ISN=V_DCLTN_ISN )

 AND (DGT.DCLTN_ISN = D.DCLTN_ISN)
 AND (DGT.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD)
 AND (DGT.PORT_CD=VI.PORT_CD)
 AND(DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE=VI.TRANS_DATE_H)
 AND(DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR=VI.TRAN_SEQ)
 AND(DGT.DGT_TYPE=4)
 ;
 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN
 RETURN(2);
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT --VI.* ,
 FROM
 DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT,
 DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM,
 DECLARATIONS D,
 VHCL_INSPCTS VI

 WHERE
 (D.PORT_CD=V_CURR_PORT_CD)
 AND(D.DCLTN_ISN=V_DCLTN_ISN )
 AND(D.PORT_CD=DLM.PORT_CD)
 AND(D.DCLTN_ISN=DLM.DCLTN_ISN)

 AND(DLM.PORT_CD=DLMT.PORT_CD )
 AND(DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN=DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN )
 AND (DLMT.PORT_CD=VI.PORT_CD )
 AND (DLMT.TRAN_SEQ=VI.TRAN_SEQ )
 AND ( DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H=VI.TRANS_DATE_H ) ;
 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN
 RETURN(1);
 END IF;
 ELSE -- CASE EXPORT & EXPORT

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT --VI.* ,
 FROM
 DECLARATIONS D
 ,DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 ,VHCL_INSPCTS VI
 WHERE

 (D.PORT_CD=V_CURR_PORT_CD)
 AND(D.DCLTN_ISN=V_DCLTN_ISN )

 AND (DGT.DCLTN_ISN = D.DCLTN_ISN)
 AND (DGT.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD)
 AND (DGT.PORT_CD=VI.PORT_CD)
 AND(DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE=VI.TRANS_DATE_H)
 AND(DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR=VI.TRAN_SEQ)
 AND(DGT.DGT_TYPE=4)
 ;
 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN
 RETURN(3);
 END IF;
 END IF ;

 RETURN(0);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_WVR_90_DAYS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2015/10/29 08:42 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
PROCEDURE chk_wvr_90_days
IS
 v_chk_upd NUMBER;
 v_chk_wvr_90_days NUMBER;
 v_bus_id_type_cd importers.bus_id_type_cd%TYPE;
 v_bus_id importers.bus_id%TYPE;
 v_bus_id_status importers.bus_id_status%TYPE;
 v_impr_type_cd importers.impr_type_cd%TYPE;
 v_impr_nbr importers.impr_nbr%TYPE;
 p_msg_txt VARCHAR2 (5000);
 h_date DATE;
 ret NUMBER;
 actv_ret BOOLEAN;
 v_count NUMBER;
 v_pay_amount NUMBER := 0;
 v_get_pay_amount NUMBER := 0;
 v_payer VARCHAR2 (200);
 v_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_coll_ordr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_coll_ordr_dt DATE;
 v_coll_ordr_ctgry NUMBER;
 v_payer_pk VARCHAR2 (200);
 v_dcltn_isn NUMBER;
 v_wvr_port_cd NUMBER (3);
 v_item_type_cd NUMBER (2);
 v_dcltn_nbr NUMBER (10);
 v_dcltn_date DATE;
 v_item_type_name VARCHAR2 (25);
 v_port_name VARCHAR2 (55);
 v_typ1 NUMBER;
 v_typ2 NUMBER;
 v_typ1_name VARCHAR2 (100);
 v_typ2_name VARCHAR2 (100);
BEGIN

 IF :declarations.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 THEN
 v_chk_wvr_90_days :=
 NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CHK_WVR_90_DAYS', 21), 0);

 IF NVL (v_chk_wvr_90_days, 0) = 1
 THEN
-----------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------
 BEGIN
 h_date := hijdate.add_hij_days (hijdate.cur_hij_date, -90);
 v_impr_nbr :=
 NVL (:declarations.impr_nbr,
 :declarations.agent_nbr);

 SELECT arbc_impr_name, bus_id_type_cd, bus_id, impr_type_cd,
 bus_id_status
 INTO v_payer, v_bus_id_type_cd, v_bus_id, v_impr_type_cd,
 v_bus_id_status
 FROM importers
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd AND impr_nbr = v_impr_nbr;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

-----------------------------------------------------------
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM wvr_items_globals
 WHERE item_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND NVL (item_status, 0) NOT IN (1, 9)
 AND bus_id_type_cd = v_bus_id_type_cd
 AND dcltn_type = 1
 AND bus_id = v_bus_id
 AND issued_dt >= TO_DATE ('01-01-1437', 'MI-MM-YYYY')
 AND item_end_dt < h_date);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) > 0
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_typ1
 FROM wvr_items_globals
 WHERE item_type_cd = 1
 AND NVL (item_status, 0) NOT IN (1, 9)
 AND bus_id_type_cd = v_bus_id_type_cd
 AND dcltn_type = 1
 AND bus_id = v_bus_id
 AND issued_dt >= TO_DATE ('01-01-1437', 'MI-MM-YYYY')
 AND item_end_dt < h_date;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_typ2
 FROM wvr_items_globals
 WHERE item_type_cd = 2
 AND NVL (item_status, 0) NOT IN (1, 9)
 AND bus_id_type_cd = v_bus_id_type_cd
 AND dcltn_type = 1
 AND bus_id = v_bus_id
 AND issued_dt >= TO_DATE ('01-01-1437', 'MI-MM-YYYY')
 AND item_end_dt < h_date;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 DECLARE
 CURSOR c1
 IS
 SELECT aa.wvr_port_cd, aa.dcltn_type, aa.dcltn_nbr,
 aa.dcltn_date
 FROM (SELECT wvr_port_cd, dcltn_type, dcltn_nbr,
 dcltn_date
 FROM wvr_items_globals
 WHERE item_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND NVL (item_status, 0) NOT IN (1, 9)
 AND bus_id_type_cd = v_bus_id_type_cd
 AND dcltn_type = 1
 AND bus_id = v_bus_id
 AND issued_dt >= TO_DATE ('01-01-1437', 'MI-MM-YYYY')
 AND item_end_dt < h_date) aa
 GROUP BY aa.wvr_port_cd,
 aa.dcltn_type,
 aa.dcltn_nbr,
 aa.dcltn_date;
 BEGIN
 FOR x IN c1
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 IF x.wvr_port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 THEN
 SELECT dcltn_isn
 INTO v_dcltn_isn
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = x.wvr_port_cd
 AND dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND dcltn_nbr = x.dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_dt = x.dcltn_date;

 v_get_pay_amount :=
 get_pay_amount (x.wvr_port_cd, v_dcltn_isn);
 ELSE
 SELECT dcltn_isn
 INTO v_dcltn_isn
 FROM declarations_cd
 WHERE port_cd = x.wvr_port_cd
 AND dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND dcltn_nbr = x.dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_dt = x.dcltn_date;

 v_get_pay_amount :=
 get_pay_amount_cd (x.wvr_port_cd, v_dcltn_isn);
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 v_get_pay_amount := NVL (v_get_pay_amount, 0) / 100;

 IF NVL (v_get_pay_amount, 0) < 500
 THEN
 v_get_pay_amount := 500;
 END IF;

 IF NVL (v_get_pay_amount, 0) > 5000
 THEN
 v_get_pay_amount := 5000;
 END IF;

 v_pay_amount :=
 NVL (v_pay_amount, 0)
 + NVL (v_get_pay_amount, 0);
 END LOOP;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_typ1, 0) > 0
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT item_type_name
 INTO v_item_type_name
 FROM wvr_types
 WHERE item_type_cd = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 v_typ1_name :=
 'عدد' || ' ' || NVL (v_typ1, 0) || ' '
 || v_item_type_name;
 END IF;

 IF NVL (v_typ2, 0) > 0
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT item_type_name
 INTO v_item_type_name
 FROM wvr_types
 WHERE item_type_cd = 2;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 v_typ2_name :=
 'عدد' || ' ' || NVL (v_typ2, 0) || ' '
 || v_item_type_name;
 END IF;

 IF LTRIM (RTRIM (v_typ1_name)) IS NOT NULL
 AND LTRIM (RTRIM (v_typ2_name)) IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 v_typ1_name :=
 LTRIM (RTRIM (v_typ1_name))
 || ' و'
 || LTRIM (RTRIM (v_typ2_name));
 ELSIF LTRIM (RTRIM (v_typ2_name)) IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 v_typ1_name := LTRIM (RTRIM (v_typ2_name));
 END IF;

 p_msg_txt :=
 'هناك تعهدات'
 || ' '
 || v_typ1_name
 || ' '
 || 'على مستورد البيان لم تسدد'
 || ' '
 || 'ومضى أكثر من 90 يوم من تاريخ إنتهاءها'
 || ' '
 || 'وسيتم فرض غرامه'
 || ' '
 || LTRIM (RTRIM (TO_CHAR (v_pay_amount, '999999999.00')))
 || ' '
 || 'ريال تحصل على البيان الحالى'
 || ' ... '
 || 'هل تريد الإستمرار ؟';
 ret := str.dispalert (p_msg_txt, 'CONFIRM');

 IF ret = alert_button1
 THEN
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO dcltn_wvr90_pnlty
 (port_cd,
 dcltn_isn, pnlty_status
 )
 VALUES (:declarations.port_cd,
 :declarations.dcltn_isn, 1
 );

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE dcltn_wvr90_pnlty
 SET pnlty_status = 1
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn;

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO dcltn_wvr90_pnlty
 (port_cd,
 dcltn_isn, pnlty_status
 )
 VALUES (:declarations.port_cd,
 :declarations.dcltn_isn, 0
 );

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE dcltn_wvr90_pnlty
 SET pnlty_status = 0

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_VALID_IMPORT_AGENT2
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*DEVELOPER : KAMEL ELSAYED@4145
 DATE : 12/06/2007
 MODIFICATIONS : PREVENT USER TO TREAD WITH DECLARATION IF EXPORTER IS SUSPENDED
 OR AGENT BUSSIENSE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER IS NOT VALID
*/
PROCEDURE CHK_VALID_IMPORT_AGENT2 IS
V_ERR_NUMBER NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')) THEN
IF :AGENT_NBR<>:IMPR_NBR THEN
IF IMPR.IMPR_SUSPENDED(:PORT_CD, :IMPR_NBR, HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE) = 1 THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 200, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
IF IMPR.IMPR_SUSPENDED(:PORT_CD, :AGENT_NBR, HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE) = 1 THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 250, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
V_ERR_NUMBER := IMPR.CHECK_IMPR_BUS_ID(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:AGENT_NBR,'A',:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD);
 IF (V_ERR_NUMBER NOT IN (0,105,115,125)) THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, V_ERR_NUMBER, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
V_ERR_NUMBER := IMPR.CHECK_IMPR_BUS_ID(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:IMPR_NBR ,'I',:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD);
 IF (V_ERR_NUMBER NOT IN (0,105,115,125)) THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, V_ERR_NUMBER, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
ELSE
IF IMPR.IMPR_SUSPENDED(:PORT_CD, :IMPR_NBR, HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE) = 1 THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, 200, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
V_ERR_NUMBER := IMPR.CHECK_IMPR_BUS_ID(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:IMPR_NBR ,'I',:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD);
 IF (V_ERR_NUMBER NOT IN (0,105,115,125)) THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21, V_ERR_NUMBER, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

END IF;
END IF;
END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_VALID_DECREE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_VALID_DECREE(V_DECREE_ISN OUT NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS


V_DECREE_STATUS NUMBER(2);
V_DECREE_TYPE NUMBER(2);
V_DECREE_PORT_CD NUMBER(3);
V_DECREE_EXPIRY_DT DATE;
V_CHECK_DT DATE;
V_VALID_DECREE BOOLEAN:=TRUE;
V_GOV_DECREE_SRCE NUMBER;
V_GOV_DECREE_MTHD NUMBER;
V_DECREE_EFF_DT DATE;
CURSOR FIRST_ROW_DECREE IS SELECT DECREE_STA_CD,DECREE_EXPRY_DT,DECREE_ISN,DECREE_PORT_CD,
 DECREE_SRCE_CD,EXMTN_MTHD_CD, DECREE_EFF_DT
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES WHERE
 DECREE_PORT_CD =:PORT_CD
 AND DECREE_TYPE = 2
 AND DECREE_SRCE_CD = 2
 AND DECREE_NBR = 7
 AND DECREE_STA_CD=2
 ORDER BY DECREE_EXPRY_DT DESC;
BEGIN

--IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE = 2
--THEN V_DECREE_TYPE := 1; -- INDUSTERIAL
--ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE IN (3,4)
--THEN
 V_DECREE_TYPE := 2; -- GOVERNOMENTAL
--END IF;


OPEN FIRST_ROW_DECREE;
 FETCH FIRST_ROW_DECREE INTO V_DECREE_STATUS, V_DECREE_EXPIRY_DT,V_DECREE_ISN,V_DECREE_PORT_CD,
 V_GOV_DECREE_SRCE,V_GOV_DECREE_MTHD , V_DECREE_EFF_DT;
 IF FIRST_ROW_DECREE%NOTFOUND THEN
 V_VALID_DECREE:= FALSE;
 END IF;
CLOSE FIRST_ROW_DECREE;
-- WHEN SHOULD THE DECREE BE EFFICTIVE?
IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL
THEN V_CHECK_DT := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT;
ELSE V_CHECK_DT := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
END IF;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
V_VALID_DECREE := TRUE; -- INITIAL VALUE

IF V_DECREE_STATUS <> 2 -- NOT EFFICTIVE
THEN
 --MESSAGE('القرار غير فعال و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا');
 --MESSAGE('القرار غير فعال و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا');
 V_VALID_DECREE := FALSE;

ELSIF HIJDATE.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_CHECK_DT, V_DECREE_EXPIRY_DT) = 1
THEN -- EXPIRED
 --MESSAGE('لقد انتهت صلاحية القرار و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا');
 --MESSAGE('لقد انتهت صلاحية القرار و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا');
 V_VALID_DECREE := FALSE;

ELSIF HIJDATE.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_CHECK_DT, V_DECREE_EFF_DT) = -1
THEN -- NOT STARTED
 --MESSAGE('لا يمكن التعامل مع القرار - تاريخ بداية السريان بعد تاريخ المعاملة');
 --MESSAGE('لا يمكن التعامل مع القرار - تاريخ بداية السريان بعد تاريخ المعاملة');
 V_VALID_DECREE := FALSE;
END IF;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RETURN V_VALID_DECREE;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN V_VALID_DECREE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_TARIF_INST_GROUP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--CHK_TARIF_INST_GROUP
--DESCRIPTION : TO CHECK IF TARIFF IS INSIDE CERTAIN GROUP OF TARIFF INSTURCTIONS OR NOT
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM
--PROGRAMMER : MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM MOHAMED
--VERSION : 2.0
--DATE : 08-06-2005
----------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION CHK_TARIF_INST_GROUP(V_HARMONIZED_TARIFF VARCHAR2,V_DCLTN_DT DATE,V_GROUP_ID NUMBER) RETURN INTEGER IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_DATE DATE;
BEGIN
 -- 1 ===> TRUE [TARIFF EXIST IN GROUP]
 -- 0 ===> FALSE [TARIFF NOT EXIST IN GROUP]
 V_DATE := V_DCLTN_DT ;
 IF V_DATE IS NULL THEN
 V_DATE :=HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 END IF;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM harmonized_tariff HT,
 group_items gro,
 tariff_groups tar,
 group_instructions ginst,
 tariff_instructions tar_inst
 WHERE ((HT.hrmnzd_code = gro.hrmnzd_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = gro.grp_code)
 AND (tar.grp_code = ginst.grp_code)
 AND (tar_inst.inst_code = ginst.inst_code)
 AND (HT.HRMNZD_CODE=V_HARMONIZED_TARIFF)
 AND (tar_inst.DECREE_STATUS=1)
 AND (V_DATE >=tar_inst.eff_date)
 AND (V_DATE <=tar_inst.expry_date)
 AND (tar_inst.INST_TYPE=V_GROUP_ID)
 );
 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_SYRIA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE chk_syria IS --MAIH --
 v_items_cnt NUMBER := 0;
 v_prhbt_items_cnt NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 IF :final_ctry_cd = 110
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_items_cnt
 FROM dcltn_items dt
 WHERE dt.port_cd = :port_cd AND dt.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn;

 IF v_items_cnt > 0
 THEN
 if :DCLTN_TYPE_CD in (1,2) then
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_prhbt_items_cnt
 FROM dcltn_items dt
 WHERE dt.port_cd = :port_cd AND dt.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn and dt.FINAL_TARIFF_CD not in (
 SELECT git.hrmnzd_code
 FROM tariff_instructions ti,
 group_instructions gin,
 tariff_groups tg,
 group_items git,
 group_countries grc,
 countries co
 WHERE git.grp_code = tg.grp_code
 AND tg.grp_code = gin.grp_code
 AND gin.inst_code = ti.inst_code
 AND tg.grp_code = grc.grp_code
 AND co.ctry_cd = grc.ctry_cd
 AND grc.ctry_cd = 110 -- سوريا --
 AND tg.grp_code = 147 AND ti.inst_code = 94 -- ممنوع استيرادها من سوريا وعليها تعليمة استثناء حظر استيراد --
 AND ti.inst_type = 12 -- بنود مستثناه من الحظر --
 ) ;

 if v_prhbt_items_cnt >0 then
 str.dispalert('لا يمكن تغيير دولة المقصد الى سوريا حيث انه هناك أصناف عليها حظر استيراد','error');
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if;

 elsif :DCLTN_TYPE_CD in (3,4,5,6) then
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_prhbt_items_cnt
 FROM dcltn_items dt
 WHERE dt.port_cd = :port_cd AND dt.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn and dt.FINAL_TARIFF_CD not in (
 SELECT git.hrmnzd_code
 FROM tariff_instructions ti,
 group_instructions gin,
 tariff_groups tg,
 group_items git,
 group_countries grc,
 countries co
 WHERE git.grp_code = tg.grp_code
 AND tg.grp_code = gin.grp_code
 AND gin.inst_code = ti.inst_code
 AND tg.grp_code = grc.grp_code
 AND co.ctry_cd = grc.ctry_cd
 AND grc.ctry_cd = 110 -- سوريا --
 AND tg.GRP_CODE = 146 AND ti.INST_CODE = 93 -- ممنوع تصديرها الى سوريا وعليها تعليمة استثناء حظر تصدير --
 AND ti.inst_type = 12 -- بنود مستثناه من الحظر --
 ) ;

 if v_prhbt_items_cnt >0 then
 str.dispalert('لا يمكن تغيير دولة المقصد الى سوريا حيث انه هناك أصناف عليها حظر تصدير','error');
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if;
 end if;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

V_SND_RCV_ACT NUMBER;
 v_prtl_exist NUMBER;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_RET_HAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_RET_HAND IS
 V_RET_REPS_PENDING NUMBER;
 V_RET_ITEMS_COUN NUMBER;
 V_RET_HAND_PEND NUMBER;
BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RET_REPS_PENDING FROM RET_REPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND STAGE_CD <> 99 AND STAGE_CD <> 97 AND STAGE_CD <> 91
 AND STATUS <> 1
 AND RET_HANDING_NBR IS NULL;

 IF V_RET_REPS_PENDING > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التحويل للتحصيل بدون إصدار محضر تسليم لمحاضر حجز البيان الجمركى','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;


 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RET_ITEMS_COUN FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DUTY_TYPE = 26;

 IF V_RET_ITEMS_COUN > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RET_HAND_PEND FROM RET_REPS , ret_handings
 WHERE ( (ret_handings.port_cd = ret_reps.port_cd)
 AND (ret_handings.ret_handing_nbr = ret_reps.ret_handing_nbr)
 AND ((ret_reps.port_cd = :PORT_CD))
 AND ((ret_reps.dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_ISN))
 AND ((ret_handings.status = 3))
 AND ((ret_reps.stage_cd <> 91))
 );

 IF V_RET_HAND_PEND > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التحويل للتحصيل بدون إعادة إصدار محضر تسليم لمحاضر حجز البيان الجمركى','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 END;



END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_RET_DCLN_ITEM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_RET_DCLN_ITEM(P_RET_TYPE NUMBER) IS
 V_CNT_ALL NUMBER;
 V_CNT_RET NUMBER;
 V_RET_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_TEXT VARCHAR2(20) ;

BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT_ALL
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN ;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT_RET
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND RET_TYPE IS NOT NULL ;

 IF (V_CNT_ALL = V_CNT_RET)OR (V_CNT_RET = 0) THEN
 RETURN ;
 ELSE
 SELECT RET_TYPE INTO V_RET_TYPE
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND RET_TYPE IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY RET_TYPE ;

 IF V_RET_TYPE = 1 THEN
 V_TEXT := 'محجوزات' ;
 ELSIF V_RET_TYPE = 2 THEN
 V_TEXT := 'متروكات' ;
 ELSIF V_RET_TYPE = 3 THEN

 V_TEXT := 'مبيعات' ;
 END IF ;

 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن تحويل البيان لوجود أصناف عليه غير مربوطة على محاضر '||V_TEXT ,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
-- STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن تحويل البيان .... يوجد خطأ في الأصناف المربوطة ','ERROR');
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,1,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_PRICING_APPRVL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_PRICING_APPRVL(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS

 CURSOR DI_CURSOR IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, ITEM_ISN, ITEM_SEQ, DCLTN_ISN, FINAL_TARIFF_CD, PRICING_APPRV
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DI.PRICING_APPRV = 1;

 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_RET VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;
 V_ITEM_ARBC_DESC VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT(*)INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DI.PRICING_APPRV = 1 ;

 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN
 V_RET := 'لا يمكن التحويل للتحصيل توجد اصناف لم يتم اعتمادها من موظف القيمة' || CHR(10) ;
 FOR DI IN DI_CURSOR LOOP
 SELECT ITEM_ARBC_DESC INTO V_ITEM_ARBC_DESC
 FROM HARMONIZED_TARIFF
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD;
 V_RET := V_RET || ' رقم الصنف :' || DI.ITEM_SEQ || ' بند الصنف ' || DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD || ' - ' || V_ITEM_ARBC_DESC || CHR(10) ;


 IF (LENGTH(V_RET) > 3900) THEN
 V_RET := V_RET ||'.....' || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 EXIT;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;
 V_MSG := CHR(1000) || V_RET;
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'INFORMATION', 1, 'الاصناف التي لم يتم اعتمادها من موظف القيمة',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 12);
 RETURN FALSE;
 ELSE
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_PRCDR_72
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- --> 10/04/2013 AHMED A-MONIM Using TRF PRCDR = 72
FUNCTION CHK_PRCDR_72(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN INTEGER IS
V_COUNT NUMBER;
V_CHK NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.PRCDR_72 > 0 AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN ( 3 , 4 ) THEN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C_DCLTN IS
 SELECT SI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD , SI.ITEM_ISN , SI.ITEM_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS SI
 WHERE SI.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND SI.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN;
 BEGIN
 FOR X IN C_DCLTN LOOP
 BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TARIFF_ITEM_RISTRICTIONS TIS
 WHERE TIS.HRMNZD_CODE = X.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND TIS.PRCDR_CODE = 72);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN V_COUNT := 0;
 END;
 IF NVL(V_COUNT,0) > 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMPL_REQUESTS SR , SMPL_ITEMS SI
 WHERE SR.RQST_PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND SR.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND SI.RQST_PORT_CD = SR.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND SI.RQST_NMR = SR.RQST_NMR
 AND SI.RQST_DT = SR.RQST_DT
 AND SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = X.ITEM_ISN
 AND SI.RESULT_CD IN(1,7));
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN V_COUNT := 0;
 END;
 IF NVL(V_COUNT,0) = 0 THEN
 V_CHK := 1;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
 END LOOP;
 IF V_CHK = 1 THEN
 RETURN(0);
 ELSE
 RETURN(1);
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN(2);
 END;
 ELSE
 RETURN(2);
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN(2);
END;
-- --< 10/04/2013 AHMED A-MONIM Using TRF PRCDR = 72

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_PENALTY_COLL_ORDER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_PENALTY_COLL_ORDER(PENALTY_NBR NUMBER , PENALTY_DATE DATE) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_COLL_ORDR_NBR NUMBER;
 V_COLL_ORDR_DT DATE;
 V_COLL_ORDR_CTGRY NUMBER;
 V_COLL_ORDR_STA NUMBER;
 V_COLL_DT DATE;
BEGIN
 -- -1 ===> EXCEPTION
 -- 0 ===> NO COLL ORDER EXIST FOR PENALTY
 -- 1 ===> THERE IS EXIST COLL ORDER FOR PENALTY BUT NOT PAID
 -- 2 ===> THERE IS EXIST COLL ORDER FOR PENALTY AND PAID

 SELECT PORT_CD , COLL_ORDR_NBR , COLL_ORDR_DT , COLL_ORDR_CTGRY , COLL_ORDR_STA , COLL_DT
 INTO V_PORT_CD , V_COLL_ORDR_NBR , V_COLL_ORDR_DT , V_COLL_ORDR_CTGRY , V_COLL_ORDR_STA , V_COLL_DT
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE COLL_ORDR_TYPE = 18 AND PAYER_PK = :PORT_CD || '!' || PENALTY_NBR || '!' || TO_CHAR(PENALTY_DATE,'MI-MM-RRRR') || '!!!' ;

 IF (V_COLL_ORDR_STA = 2 OR V_COLL_ORDR_STA = 3 OR V_COLL_ORDR_STA = 5 OR V_COLL_ORDR_STA = 6) THEN
 RETURN 2;
 ELSE
 RETURN 1;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN 0;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,5,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN -1;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_PENALTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_PENALTIES IS

 V_LIC_NBR NUMBER;
 V_LIC_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_REP_NBR NUMBER;
 V_JOB_ID NUMBER;
 V_BRKR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;

 CURSOR C_PENALTIES(P_BRKR_PORT_CD NUMBER,P_LIC_NBR NUMBER,P_LIC_TYPE NUMBER,P_REP_NBR NUMBER) IS
 SELECT PENALTY_NBR,PENALTY_DATE ,SUSPEND ---------ahmed momen ------cr-4966
 FROM PENALTIES PEN
 WHERE (
 (
 ((PEN.BRKR_PORT_CD = P_BRKR_PORT_CD) AND (PEN.LIC_NBR = P_LIC_NBR) AND (PEN.LIC_TYPE = P_LIC_TYPE)) OR
 (PEN.REP_NBR = P_REP_NBR)
 )
 AND
 (PEN.STATUS = 10)
 AND
 (PENALTY_TYPE = 10)
 );

BEGIN

 BEGIN
 SELECT LIC_NBR , LIC_TYPE , REP_NBR , BRKR_PORT_CD , JOB_ID INTO
 V_LIC_NBR , V_LIC_TYPE , V_REP_NBR , V_BRKR_PORT_CD ,V_JOB_ID FROM SC_USERS
 WHERE USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,5,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END;

 IF (V_JOB_ID = 4) THEN --- REP.
 IF ((V_BRKR_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL) AND (V_LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL) AND (V_LIC_TYPE IS NOT NULL) AND (V_REP_NBR IS NOT NULL)) THEN
 FOR REC IN C_PENALTIES(V_BRKR_PORT_CD,V_LIC_NBR,V_LIC_TYPE,V_REP_NBR) LOOP
 RET := CHK_PENALTY_COLL_ORDER(REC.PENALTY_NBR,REC.PENALTY_DATE);
 IF (RET != 2) THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,135,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,145,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF (V_JOB_ID = 3) THEN --- BROKER
 IF ((V_BRKR_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL) AND (V_LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL) AND (V_LIC_TYPE IS NOT NULL) AND (V_REP_NBR IS NULL)) THEN
 FOR REC IN C_PENALTIES(V_BRKR_PORT_CD,V_LIC_NBR,V_LIC_TYPE,-1) LOOP
 RET := CHK_PENALTY_COLL_ORDER(REC.PENALTY_NBR,REC.PENALTY_DATE);
 IF (RET != 2)
----------------AHMED MOMEN -----CR4966-------------08-05-2022------------------
 AND ( rec.SUSPEND IN (1,2,3) AND NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('SUSPEND_NO_STOP',34), 0) = 1)
 -------------------*******************-----------------
 THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,135,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,145,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,145,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

--MAIH 15-01-2014

PROCEDURE chk_pay_data
IS
 v_cnt NUMBER := 0;
 v_ret NUMBER := 0;
 v_setting VARCHAR2 (200) := '0';
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_setting
 FROM sc_port_setting
 WHERE var_name = 'INVOICE_PAYMENT_MTHD' AND var_value = '1';

 IF v_setting > 0
 THEN
 IF chk_pay_amount(:PORT_CD , :DCLTN_ISN)
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_ret
 FROM importers
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND ( (impr_nbr = :impr_nbr AND :dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2))
 OR impr_nbr = :agent_nbr AND :dcltn_type_cd IN (3, 4, 6)
 )
 AND impr_type_cd NOT IN (2, 9, 16);

 IF v_ret > 0
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM dcltn_deal_dtls
 WHERE dcltn_stats_port_cd = :port_cd AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn;

 IF NVL (:drct_clrnc, 0) = 0
 THEN
 IF v_cnt = 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert
 ('بيانات طريقة الدفع غير مدخله لا يمكن الإستمرار',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_PAY_AMOUNT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*MAIH 29-01-2014 CHECK THE MINUM AMOUNT OF PAYMENT METHOD*/

FUNCTION chk_pay_amount (p_port_cd NUMBER, p_dcltn_isn NUMBER)
 RETURN BOOLEAN
IS
 v_err_msg VARCHAR2 (100);
 v_curr_exchg NUMBER ;
 v_total_exps NUMBER;
 v_inv_curcy_cd NUMBER;
 v_total NUMBER := 0;
 v_min NUMBER := 3000;
BEGIN
 FOR cur IN (SELECT total_exps, inv_curcy_cd
 --INTO v_total_exps, v_inv_curcy_cd
 FROM dcltn_invoices
 WHERE port_cd = p_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn)
 LOOP
 --ivr_curr_exchg.curr_exchg (CUR.inv_curcy_cd, v_err_msg, v_curr_exchg);
 v_curr_exchg := REVENUE.GET_CURRENCY_RATE(cur.inv_curcy_cd,HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date ) ;
 v_curr_exchg := NVL(v_curr_exchg,1);
 v_total := v_total + (v_curr_exchg * cur.total_exps);
 END LOOP;

 IF v_total <= v_min
 THEN
 RETURN FALSE; -- PASS NOT CHECK PAYMENT METHOD
 ELSE
 RETURN TRUE; -- NOT PASS CHECK PAYMENT METHOD
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_MANUAL_RSLTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_MANUAL_RSLTS (P_MSG OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS -- AHMED WAKEEL dm_580
V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD NUMBER ;
V_FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD NUMBER ;
V_INSP_ISN NUMBER ;
V_COUNTER NUMBER := 0;
V_PORT_TYPE NUMBER ;


CURSOR CUR_DTLS(P_PORT NUMBER ,P_INSP_ISN NUMBER )
IS SELECT INSPCT_RESULT_CD,TRAN_SEQ
FROM DCLTN_INSPCT_TRANS_DTLS
WHERE
PORT_CD = P_PORT AND INSP_ISN=P_INSP_ISN ;

V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN NUMBER := NVL(TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN', 21)), 0); -- WAKEEL DIRECT CLEARANCE

BEGIN
 SELECT PORT_TYPE INTO V_PORT_TYPE FROM SD_PORTS WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD;


 IF V_PORT_TYPE = 4 AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1, 2) THEN
 RETURN 1 ;
 ELSIF V_PORT_TYPE IN (3,4) AND V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN > 0 THEN

 SELECT INSPECT_TYPE_CD,FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD,INSP_ISN
 INTO V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD,V_FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD,V_INSP_ISN
 FROM DCLTN_INSPCT_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN= :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN ;

 IF V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD <> 1 THEN
 IF V_FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD IS NULL THEN
 P_MSG :='لم يتم تسجيل نتيجة المعاينة اليدوية لهذا البيان';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSIF V_FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD <> 1 THEN
 P_MSG :='نتيجة المعاينة اليدوية غير سليمة ';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 FOR REC IN CUR_DTLS(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,V_INSP_ISN)
 LOOP
 IF REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD IS NULL THEN
 P_MSG :='لابد من اختيار نتيجة معاينة للحركة رقم '||' '||REC.TRAN_SEQ;
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 IF V_FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD = REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD THEN
 V_COUNTER :=V_COUNTER+1 ;
 END IF ;
 END IF ;
 END LOOP ;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 3 THEN
 IF V_COUNTER = 0 THEN
 P_MSG :='يوجد اختلاف بين نتيجة المعاينة للبيان ونتيجة المعاينة لحركة السيارات علي هذا البيان ...يرجي اختيار نتيجة واحدة علي الاقل لحركة السيارات مماثلة لنتيجة معاينة البيان';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF ;
 END IF ;
 RETURN 1 ;
 END IF ;
 ELSE
 RETURN 1 ;
 END IF ;
ELSE
RETURN 1 ;
END IF ;

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN -1;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_LAST_PERS_DEC_IMPR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*DEVELOPED BY :KAMEL ELSAYED
 DATE :29/04/2007
 MODIFICATION :DISPLAY MESSAGE FOR USERS OF IMMEDIATE RELEASE TO INFORM THAT
 THE NO. AND DATE OF LAST DECLARATION OR STATS_DCLTN*/
PROCEDURE CHK_LAST_PERS_DEC_IMPR IS
 V_FROM DATE ;
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_CO NUMBER;
 V_CO_ITEMS_CARD NUMBER;
 v_cnt1 NUMBER;
 V_MESSEGE VARCHAR2(1000) ;
BEGIN

 IF (:DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')) OR (:DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS')) THEN

 DECLARE

 -- V_FROM DATE ;--:= HIJDATE.ADD_HIJ_DAYS(HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date, -354);
 CURSOR CUR_DECLARATIONS IS SELECT DE.DCLTN_ISN,DE.DCLTN_NBR,DE.DCLTN_DT FROM customs.vhcl_cards vhc, customs.declarations de
 WHERE ((de.port_cd = vhc.port_cd) AND (de.dcltn_isn = vhc.dcltn_isn)AND DE.PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
 AND DE.IMPR_NBR=:IMPR_NBR
 AND DE.DCLTN_ISN <> :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DE.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN(1,2)
 AND VHC.VHCL_CARD_DT>V_FROM)
 ORDER BY DE.DCLTN_ISN DESC;

 CURSOR CUR_STATS_DCLTNS IS SELECT SD.STATS_ISN,SD.STATS_NBR,SD.STATS_DT FROM customs.vhcl_cards vhc, customs.stats_dcltns sd
 WHERE ((sd.port_cd = vhc.port_cd) AND (sd.stats_isn = vhc.stats_isn)AND SD.PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
 AND SD.IMPR_EXPR_NBR=:IMPR_NBR
 AND SD.STATS_TYPE_CD IN(11,15)
 AND VHC.VHCL_CARD_DT>V_FROM)
 ORDER BY SD.STATS_ISN DESC;

 V_DCLTN_ISN DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN%TYPE;
 V_DCLTN_NBR DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR%TYPE;
 V_DCLTN_DT DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT%TYPE;

 V_STATS_ISN STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_ISN%TYPE;
 V_STATS_NBR STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_NBR%TYPE;
 V_STATS_DT STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_DT%TYPE;
 RET NUMBER;

 BEGIN

----------
 SELECT IMPR_TYPE_CD,CTRY_CD
 INTO V_IMPR_TYPE_CD,V_CTRY_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NBR;

 IF V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 4 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO V_CO FROM CTRY_GROUP_HEADERS CGH , CTRY_GROUP_DETAILS CGD
 WHERE CGH.CTRY_GRP_NBR = CGD.CTRY_GRP_NBR AND
 CGH.CTRY_GRP_NBR = 3 AND CGH.CTRY_GRP_STATUS = 1 AND CGD.CTRY_GRP_STAT = 1 AND CGD.CTRY_CD = V_CTRY_CD;

 IF (V_CO = 0) THEN
 V_FROM := HIJDATE.ADD_HIJ_DAYS(HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date, -(354*3));
 ELSE
 RETURN ; -- PERSON FROM GULF COUNTRIES
 END IF;

 END;
 ELSE
 RETURN ;
 END IF;

----------

 :GLOBAL.ACT_LAST_DEC:=NULL;
 OPEN CUR_DECLARATIONS;
 FETCH CUR_DECLARATIONS INTO V_DCLTN_ISN,V_DCLTN_NBR,V_DCLTN_DT;
 CLOSE CUR_DECLARATIONS;

 OPEN CUR_STATS_DCLTNS;
 FETCH CUR_STATS_DCLTNS INTO V_STATS_ISN,V_STATS_NBR,V_STATS_DT;
 CLOSE CUR_STATS_DCLTNS;

 BEGIN
 V_CO_ITEMS_CARD := 0;

 SELECT NVL(SUM(inv_qty),0)--COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CO_ITEMS_CARD
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS , GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN AND
 DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD = GROUP_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE AND GRP_CODE = 76 AND DUTY_TYPE NOT IN (7,8,26);

 IF V_CO_ITEMS_CARD = 0 THEN
 RETURN ; --- NO ITEMS CONTAIN TARIFF BAND AVAILABLE TO CREATE VHCL CARDS .
 END IF;
 END;



-------------------------------------مستورد أجنبي وله بطاقة سابقة خلال الثلاث سنوات الماضية-------------------------------
 IF (V_DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL) AND V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 4 AND V_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('اخر بيان جمركى (له بطاقة جمركية) تم اصداره لهذه المستورد '||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' برقم : '||V_DCLTN_NBR ||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' وتاريخ : '|| TO_CHAR(V_DCLTN_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY')||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' ولم يمضي على ذلك 3 سنوات ,لذا لا يمكن الاستمرار','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (V_STATS_DT IS NOT NULL) AND V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 4 AND V_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('اخر بيان إحصائى (له بطاقة جمركية) تم اصداره لهذه المستورد '||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' برقم : '||V_STATS_NBR ||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' وتاريخ : '|| TO_CHAR(V_STATS_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY')||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' ولم يمضي على ذلك 3 سنوات ,لذا لا يمكن الاستمرار','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF (V_DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL) AND V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 4 AND V_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN






 SELECT COUNT(1)
 INTO v_cnt1 FROM customs.vhcl_all_chase_nbr vhc
 WHERE vhc.HQ_IMPR_NBR IN
 (SELECT imp.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM customs.declarations de, customs.importers imp
 WHERE imp.port_cd = de.port_cd
 AND imp.impr_nbr = de.impr_nbr
 AND de.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND de.impr_nbr = :impr_nbr
 AND de.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2))
 AND vhc.vhcl_card_dt > v_from;
 ------------------------------------------------------------- --

 IF (v_cnt1 >= 1) AND V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 4 AND V_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN
 str.dispalert ('يوجد لهذا المستورد بيان استيراد سيارات سابق .'||CHR (13)|| CHR (10)||
 ' ولا يسمح له استيراد أكثر من سيارة خلال 3 سنوات .','INFORMATION');
 terminate_fun;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSIF V_CO_ITEMS_CARD > 1 THEN
 str.dispalert ('البيان الحالي يوجد عليه أكثر من سيارة واحدة .'||CHR (13)|| CHR (10)||
 ' ولا يسمح له استيراد أكثر من سيارة ولمدة 3 سنوات .','INFORMATION');
 terminate_fun;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;


/* ************************************************************ */


 /* */

 BEGIN
 V_MESSEGE:=V_MESSEGE||'.'||' اسم الجمرك '||' رقم البطاقة '||' بتاريخ '||' رقم الهيكل '||CHR(13)||CHR(10) ;


 FOR C_IMP IN ( SELECT DISTINCT SD_PORTS.PORT_NAME PORT_NAME ,
 TO_CHAR(vhc.VHCL_CARD_NBR) VHCL_CARD_NBR,
 TO_CHAR(vhc.VHCL_CARD_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY') VHCL_CARD_DT,
 vhc.CHASE_NBR CHASE_NBR

 FROM customs.vhcl_all_chase_nbr vhc ,
 customs.declarations de,
 customs.importers imp,
 customs.SD_PORTS

 WHERE
 de.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND de.impr_nbr = :impr_nbr
 AND de.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)

 AND imp.port_cd = de.port_cd
 AND imp.impr_nbr = de.impr_nbr

 AND vhc.HQ_IMPR_NBR = imp.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 AND vhc.vhcl_card_dt > v_from

 AND SD_PORTS.PORT_CD=imp.PORT_CD
 ) LOOP

 v_cnt1:=v_cnt1+1;
 V_MESSEGE:=V_MESSEGE||' ( '||C_IMP.CHASE_NBR ||' ) ' ||' ( '||C_IMP.VHCL_CARD_DT ||' ) ' ||' ( '||C_IMP.VHCL_CARD_NBR||' ) ' ||' ( '||C_IMP.PORT_NAME ||' ) '||CHR(10)||CHR(13) ;

 END LOOP;

 IF (v_cnt1 >= 1) AND V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 4 AND V_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN



 str.dispalert ('يوجد لهذا المستورد بيان استيراد سيارات سابق .'||CHR (13)|| CHR (10)||
 ' ولا يسمح له استيراد أكثر من سيارة خلال 3 سنوات .','INFORMATION');

 str.dispalert (V_MESSEGE,'INFORMATION');

 terminate_fun;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;

 ELSIF V_CO_ITEMS_CARD > 1 THEN

 str.dispalert ('البيان الحالي يوجد عليه أكثر من سيارة واحدة .'||CHR (13)|| CHR (10)||
 ' ولا يسمح له استيراد أكثر من سيارة ولمدة 3 سنوات .','INFORMATION');

 terminate_fun;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;


 END;
 /* */
 /* ********************************************************************** */
 /* ******************************* END ********************************* */
 /* ********************************************************************** */





 END IF;

 END;
END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_LAST_DEC_IMPR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*DEVELOPED BY :KAMEL ELSAYED
 DATE :29/04/2007
 MODIFICATION :DISPLAY MESSAGE FOR USERS OF IMMEDIATE RELEASE TO INFORM THAT
 THE NO. AND DATE OF LAST DECLARATION OR STATS_DCLTN*/
PROCEDURE CHK_LAST_DEC_IMPR IS
 V_FROM DATE ;
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 v_cnt1 NUMBER;
BEGIN

 IF (:DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR')) THEN

 DECLARE

 -- V_FROM DATE ;--:= HIJDATE.ADD_HIJ_DAYS(HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date, -354);
 CURSOR CUR_DECLARATIONS IS SELECT DE.DCLTN_ISN,DE.DCLTN_NBR,DE.DCLTN_DT FROM customs.vhcl_cards vhc, customs.declarations de
 WHERE ((de.port_cd = vhc.port_cd) AND (de.dcltn_isn = vhc.dcltn_isn)AND DE.PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
 AND DE.IMPR_NBR=:IMPR_NBR
 AND DE.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN(1,2)
 AND VHC.VHCL_CARD_DT>V_FROM)
 ORDER BY DE.DCLTN_ISN DESC;
 CURSOR CUR_STATS_DCLTNS IS SELECT SD.STATS_ISN,SD.STATS_NBR,SD.STATS_DT FROM customs.vhcl_cards vhc, customs.stats_dcltns sd
 WHERE ((sd.port_cd = vhc.port_cd) AND (sd.stats_isn = vhc.stats_isn)AND SD.PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
 AND SD.IMPR_EXPR_NBR=:IMPR_NBR
 AND SD.STATS_TYPE_CD IN(11,15)
 AND VHC.VHCL_CARD_DT>V_FROM)
 ORDER BY SD.STATS_ISN DESC;
 V_DCLTN_ISN DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN%TYPE;
 V_DCLTN_NBR DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR%TYPE;
 V_DCLTN_DT DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT%TYPE;

 V_STATS_ISN STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_ISN%TYPE;
 V_STATS_NBR STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_NBR%TYPE;
 V_STATS_DT STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_DT%TYPE;
 RET NUMBER;

 BEGIN


----------
 SELECT IMPR_TYPE_CD,CTRY_CD

 AND IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NBR;

 V_FROM := HIJDATE.ADD_HIJ_DAYS(HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date, -354);

----------


 :GLOBAL.ACT_LAST_DEC:=NULL;

 CLOSE CUR_DECLARATIONS;

 OPEN CUR_STATS_DCLTNS;
 FETCH CUR_STATS_DCLTNS INTO V_STATS_ISN,V_STATS_NBR,V_STATS_DT;
 CLOSE CUR_STATS_DCLTNS;


 IF V_DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL AND V_STATS_DT IS NOT NULL THEN

----------------------
 IF V_DCLTN_DT>=V_STATS_DT THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('اخر بيان جمركى (له بطاقة جمركية) تم اصداره لهذه المستورد '||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||'برقم'||V_DCLTN_NBR ||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' وتاريخ '||TO_CHAR(V_DCLTN_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY')||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' هل تريد الأستمرار ؟؟؟ ','CONFIRM');
 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.ACT_LAST_DEC:=1;
 ELSIF RET = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispALERT('اخر بيان احصائى(له بطاقة جمركية) تم اصداره لهذه المستورد '||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||'برقم'||V_STATS_NBR ||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' وتاريخ '||TO_CHAR(V_STATS_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY')||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' هل تريد الأستمرار ؟؟؟ ','CONFIRM');

 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.ACT_LAST_DEC:=1;
 ELSIF RET = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
------------------------

 ELSIF V_DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL AND V_STATS_DT IS NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('اخر بيان جمركى (له بطاقة جمركية) تم اصداره لهذه المستورد '||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||'برقم'||V_DCLTN_NBR ||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' وتاريخ '||TO_CHAR(V_DCLTN_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY')||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' هل تريد الأستمرار ؟؟؟ ','CONFIRM');
 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.ACT_LAST_DEC:=1;
 ELSIF RET = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF V_DCLTN_DT IS NULL AND V_STATS_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('اخر بيان احصائى(له بطاقة جمركية) تم اصداره لهذه المستورد '||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||'برقم'||V_STATS_NBR ||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' وتاريخ '||TO_CHAR(V_STATS_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY')||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||' هل تريد الأستمرار ؟؟؟ ','CONFIRM');
 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.ACT_LAST_DEC:=1;
 ELSIF RET = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

------------------------
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT(1)
 INTO v_cnt1 FROM customs.vhcl_all_chase_nbr vhc
 WHERE vhc.HQ_IMPR_NBR IN
 (SELECT imp.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM customs.importers imp
 WHERE imp.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND imp.impr_nbr = :impr_nbr)
 AND vhc.vhcl_card_dt > v_from;
/*
SELECT imp.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM customs.declarations de, customs.importers imp
 WHERE imp.port_cd = de.port_cd
 AND imp.impr_nbr = de.impr_nbr
 AND de.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND de.impr_nbr = :impr_nbr
 AND de.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND de.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 */
 -------------------------------------------------------------
 IF (v_cnt1 >= 1) AND V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 4 THEN
 RET := str.dispalert ('يوجد لهذا المستورد بيان استيراد سيارات في جمرك آخر خلال سنة من تاريخ اليوم . هل تريد الاستمرار؟؟؟','CONFIRM');
 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.ACT_LAST_DEC:=1;
 ELSIF RET = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_INV_UNIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE chk_inv_unit IS -- MAIH 15-04-2012 لاختبار السعر الافرادى
v_msg varchar2(200) ;
v_items varchar2(200) ;
v_chk boolean := false;
begin

 v_msg :='يوجد أصناف ينقصها إدخال السعر الإفرادى ولابد من تحويلها لإدارة القيمه وهى الصنف ';

 for i in (SELECT port_cd, item_isn, item_seq, dcltn_isn, final_tariff_cd,final_tariff_dt,UNIT_INV_COST
 FROM dcltn_items DT
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND UNIT_INV_COST IS NULL
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
 FROM group_items
 WHERE hrmnzd_code = DT.final_tariff_cd AND grp_code = 106)
 ) loop
 v_chk := true;
 v_items:= i.item_seq||','||v_items ;

 end loop;


 if v_chk then
 str.dispalert(v_msg||chr(13)||chr(10)||v_items,'ERROR');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_INVST_COMP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE chk_invst_comp IS --at payment


V_COUNT NUMBER :=0 ;
V_DCN_STATUS NUMBER;
v_DCN_RSN number;
v_DCN_REASON varchar2(100) ;
BEGIN

 --STR.DISPALERT('ERROR INVST COMP 003 ','ERROR'); --

SELECT DCN_STATUS,DCN_RSN INTO V_DCN_STATUS ,v_DCN_RSN
FROM DCLTN_INVST
WHERE
PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN ;

IF V_DCN_STATUS NOT IN (2,3 ) THEN --REJECTED

 STR.DISPALERT('فى إنتظار قرار بشأن الشركة الإستثمارية ... لا يمكن الإستمرار ','ERROR');

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE ;

END IF;

IF V_DCN_STATUS = 3 THEN --REJECTED
-- by maih 28-07-2012
select rv_meaning
into v_DCN_REASON
 from CG_REF_CODES
where RV_DOMAIN = 'DCN_REASON'
and rv_low_value= v_DCN_RSN ;

-- BY NABIL ALSALEH @ 20-11-2011
 IF NOT CHECK_DCLTN_ITEMS(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RE_EXPORT')) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التحويل للتحصيل حيث ان '||v_DCN_REASON||' (إدارة القيود) ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE ;
 END IF;
END IF;

IF V_DCN_STATUS = 2 THEN --ACCEPTED

 STR.DISPALERT(' لقد تم الموافقة من إدارة القيود سوف يتم الاستمرار','INFORMATION');

 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE ;

END IF;


EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 -- STR.DISPALERT('ERROR INVST COMP ','ERROR');
NULL;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_INV_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_INV_ITEMS IS
 V_INV_CNT NUMBER;
 V_ITEM_CNT NUMBER;
 V_INV_AMT NUMBER;
 V_ITEM_AMT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_INV_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_INVOICES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 IF NVL(V_INV_CNT, 0) = 0 THEN
 Str.DispAlert('لا توجد فواتير مربوطة على المعاملة','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 SELECT SUM(ITEMS_CNT)
 INTO V_INV_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_INVOICES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_ITEM_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 IF NVL(V_ITEM_CNT, 0) = 0 THEN
 Str.DispAlert('لا توجد أصناف مربوطة على المعاملة','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 IF V_INV_CNT <> V_ITEM_CNT THEN
 Str.DispAlert('إجمالي عدد الأصناف في الفواتير لا يساوي عدد الأصناف المربوطة على المعاملة','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 --DEVELOPED BY KAMEL EL SAYED(EXT. 4145) TO PREVENT CHECKING OF THE EQUALTY OF TOTAL VALUE
 --OF ITEMS AND VALUE OF INVOICE.24/7/2006
IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX') THEN
 SELECT SUM(TOTAL_EXPS)
 INTO V_INV_AMT
 FROM DCLTN_INVOICES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 SELECT SUM(INV_COST)
 INTO V_ITEM_AMT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 IF V_INV_AMT <> V_ITEM_AMT THEN
 Str.DispAlert('إجمالي قيمة الأصناف لا يساوي إجمالي قيمة الفواتير','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_INSTRUCTIONS_SEA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION chk_instructions_sea (
 v_port_type IN NUMBER,
 v_port_cd IN NUMBER,
 v_dcltn_isn IN NUMBER,
 v_dcltn_status IN NUMBER,
 v_today IN DATE
 ) RETURN NUMBER
 IS

 have_insts NUMBER := 0;
 have_cntnr_insts NUMBER := 0;
 v_dcltn_type_cd NUMBER;
 v_dcltn_sta_cd NUMBER;
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_brkr_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_lic_nbr NUMBER;
 v_lic_type NUMBER;
 v_tariff_cd VARCHAR2 (20);
 v_agent_nbr NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;

 CURSOR dcltn_items
 IS
 SELECT port_cd, item_isn, ctry_cd, final_tariff_cd
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 ;

 -- BILLS FOR EXPORT
 CURSOR dcltn_bills
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT port_cd, bl_nbr
 FROM vssl_bls
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn;

 -- BILLS FOR IMPORT
 CURSOR dcltn_dlvy_bills
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT bills.port_cd, bills.bl_nbr
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders dlvys,
 sea_dlvy_items d_items,
 vssl_bls bills
 WHERE dlvys.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND dlvys.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND d_items.port_cd = dlvys.port_cd
 AND d_items.shpg_agnt_nbr = dlvys.shpg_agnt_nbr
 AND d_items.do_nbr = dlvys.do_nbr
 AND d_items.do_iss_dt = dlvys.do_iss_dt
 AND bills.port_cd = d_items.mfst_port_cd
 AND bills.mfst_type = d_items.mfst_type
 AND bills.mfst_nbr = d_items.mfst_nbr
 AND bills.mfst_dt = d_items.mfst_dt
 AND bills.bl_seq = d_items.bl_seq;

 -- FRPORTS FOR BILLS
 CURSOR dcltn_bill_frport
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT port_cd, ctry_cd, frgn_port_cd, frgn_port_type_cd
 FROM vssl_bls
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn;

 -- FRPORTS FOR DLVY ORDERS
 CURSOR dcltn_dlvy_bill_frport
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT bills.port_cd, bills.ctry_cd, bills.frgn_port_cd,
 bills.frgn_port_type_cd
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders dlvys,
 sea_dlvy_items d_items,
 vssl_bls bills
 WHERE dlvys.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND dlvys.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND d_items.port_cd = dlvys.port_cd
 AND d_items.shpg_agnt_nbr = dlvys.shpg_agnt_nbr
 AND d_items.do_nbr = dlvys.do_nbr
 AND d_items.do_iss_dt = dlvys.do_iss_dt
 AND bills.port_cd = d_items.mfst_port_cd
 AND bills.mfst_type = d_items.mfst_type
 AND bills.mfst_nbr = d_items.mfst_nbr
 AND bills.mfst_dt = d_items.mfst_dt
 AND bills.bl_seq = d_items.bl_seq;

 -- CNTNRS FOR BILLS
 CURSOR dcltn_bill_cntnr
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT cntnrs.port_cd, cntnrs.cntnr_mrk
 FROM vssl_bls bills,
 vssl_bl_items items,
 vssl_cntnrs cntnrs
 WHERE bills.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND bills.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND items.port_cd = bills.port_cd
 AND items.mfst_type = bills.mfst_type
 AND items.mfst_nbr = bills.mfst_nbr
 AND items.mfst_dt = bills.mfst_dt
 AND items.bl_seq = bills.bl_seq
 AND items.cntnr_seq IS NOT NULL
 AND cntnrs.port_cd = items.port_cd
 AND cntnrs.mfst_type = items.mfst_type
 AND cntnrs.mfst_nbr = items.mfst_nbr
 AND cntnrs.mfst_dt = items.mfst_dt
 AND cntnrs.cntnr_seq = items.cntnr_seq;

 -- CNTNRS FOR DLVY ORDERS
 CURSOR dcltn_dlvy_cntnr
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT cntnrs.PORT_CD,cntnrs.MFST_TYPE,cntnrs.MFST_NBR,cntnrs.MFST_DT,cntnrs.CNTNR_SEQ,cntnrs.cntnr_mrk
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders dlvys,
 sea_dlvy_items d_items,
 vssl_bl_items b_items,
 vssl_cntnrs cntnrs
 WHERE dlvys.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND dlvys.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND d_items.port_cd = dlvys.port_cd
 AND d_items.shpg_agnt_nbr = dlvys.shpg_agnt_nbr
 AND d_items.do_nbr = dlvys.do_nbr
 AND d_items.do_iss_dt = dlvys.do_iss_dt
 AND b_items.port_cd = d_items.mfst_port_cd
 AND b_items.mfst_type = d_items.mfst_type
 AND b_items.mfst_nbr = d_items.mfst_nbr
 AND b_items.mfst_dt = d_items.mfst_dt
 AND b_items.bl_seq = d_items.bl_seq
 AND b_items.item_seq = d_items.item_seq
 AND b_items.cntnr_seq IS NOT NULL
 AND cntnrs.port_cd = b_items.port_cd
 AND cntnrs.mfst_type = b_items.mfst_type
 AND cntnrs.mfst_nbr = b_items.mfst_nbr
 AND cntnrs.mfst_dt = b_items.mfst_dt
 AND cntnrs.cntnr_seq = b_items.cntnr_seq;

BEGIN

 BEGIN
 SELECT dcltn_type_cd, dcltn_sta_cd, impr_nbr, agent_nbr,
 brkr_port_cd, lic_nbr, lic_type
 INTO v_dcltn_type_cd, v_dcltn_sta_cd, v_impr_nbr, v_agent_nbr,
 v_brkr_port_cd, v_lic_nbr, v_lic_type
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN have_insts;
 END;
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF v_dcltn_status IS NOT NULL THEN
 v_dcltn_sta_cd := v_dcltn_status;
 END IF;


IF dcltn.is_import_dcltn (v_dcltn_type_cd) = 1 THEN

 -- CHECK_SEA_BILL
 FOR i IN dcltn_dlvy_bills LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 7
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_BL_NBR = i.bl_nbr
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- CHECK_FRPORT
 FOR i IN dcltn_dlvy_bill_frport LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 12
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND FP_PORT_TYPE_CD = i.frgn_port_type_cd
 AND FP_PORT_CD = i.frgn_port_cd
 AND CTRY_CD = i.ctry_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- CHECK_SEA_CNTNR
 FOR i IN dcltn_dlvy_cntnr LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 8
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_CNTNR_MRK = i.cntnr_mrk
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 insert_manual_xray_inst(i.PORT_CD,v_dcltn_isn,i.MFST_TYPE,i.MFST_nbr,i.MFST_dt,i.CNTNR_SEQ);
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- CHECK_DCLTN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 9
 AND PORT_CD = v_port_cd
 AND DCLTN_ISN = v_dcltn_isn
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- CHECK_IMPR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 1
 AND PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = V_IMPR_NBR
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- CHECK_BRKR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 6
 AND PORT_CD = v_PORT_CD
 AND BRKR_LIC_NBR = V_LIC_NBR
 AND BRKR_LIC_TYPE = V_LIC_TYPE
 AND BRKR_PORT_CD = V_BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOR i IN dcltn_items
 LOOP

 -- CHECK_CTRY
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 3
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND CTRY_CD = i.ctry_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;

 -- CHECK_TARIFF_DTLS
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 2
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = i.final_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;


 BEGIN
 IF NVL (TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('NEW_TARIFF_STAGE',999)),0) = 0
 THEN
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 8, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSIF NVL(TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('NEW_TARIFF_STAGE',999)),0) = 1
 THEN
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 12, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSE
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 12, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
 -- CHECK_MAIN_TARIFF
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 11
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = v_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;

 v_tariff_cd := SUBSTR (i.final_tariff_cd, 1, 2);

 -- CHECK_TARIFF_CHPTR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 10
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = v_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

ELSIF dcltn.is_export_dcltn (v_dcltn_type_cd) = 1 THEN

 -- BILLS FOR EXPORT
 FOR i IN dcltn_bills LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 7
 AND PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_BL_NBR = I.bl_nbr
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;


 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


 -- CHECK_FRPORT
 FOR i IN dcltn_bill_frport LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 12
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND FP_PORT_TYPE_CD = i.frgn_port_type_cd
 AND FP_PORT_CD = i.frgn_port_cd
 AND CTRY_CD = i.ctry_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 -- CHECK_SEA_CNTNR
 FOR i IN dcltn_bill_cntnr LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 8
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_CNTNR_MRK = i.cntnr_mrk
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 -- CHECK_DCLTN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS CI , DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE CI.INST_STATUS = 1
 AND CI.INST_TYPE = 9
 AND CI.PORT_CD = v_port_cd
 AND CI.DCLTN_ISN = v_dcltn_isn
 AND CI.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD
 AND CI.DCLTN_ISN = D.DCLTN_ISN
 AND CI.FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 -- CHECK_IMPR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 1
 AND PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = V_IMPR_NBR
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 -- CHECK_BRKR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 6
 AND PORT_CD = v_PORT_CD
 AND BRKR_LIC_NBR = V_LIC_NBR
 AND BRKR_LIC_TYPE = V_LIC_TYPE
 AND BRKR_PORT_CD = V_BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 FOR i IN dcltn_items
 LOOP

 -- CHECK_CTRY
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 3
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND CTRY_CD = i.ctry_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;


 -- CHECK_TARIFF_DTLS
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 2
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = i.final_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 IF NVL (TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('NEW_TARIFF_STAGE',999)),0) = 0
 THEN
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 8, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSIF NVL(TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('NEW_TARIFF_STAGE',999)),0) = 1
 THEN
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 12, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSE
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 12, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
 -- CHECK_MAIN_TARIFF
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 11
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = v_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;

 v_tariff_cd := SUBSTR (i.final_tariff_cd, 1, 2);

 -- CHECK_TARIFF_CHPTR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 10
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = v_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;



END IF;

 RETURN have_insts;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_INSTRUCTIONS_LAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION chk_instructions_land (
 v_port_type IN NUMBER,
 v_port_cd IN NUMBER,
 v_dcltn_isn IN NUMBER,

FUNCTION chk_instructions_dry (
 v_port_type IN NUMBER,
 v_port_cd IN NUMBER,
 v_dcltn_isn IN NUMBER,
 v_dcltn_status IN NUMBER,
 v_today IN DATE
 ) RETURN NUMBER
 IS

 have_insts NUMBER := 0;
 have_cntnr_insts NUMBER := 0;
 v_dcltn_type_cd NUMBER;
 v_dcltn_sta_cd NUMBER;
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_brkr_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_lic_nbr NUMBER;
 v_lic_type NUMBER;
 v_tariff_cd VARCHAR2 (20);
 v_agent_nbr NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;

 CURSOR dcltn_items
 IS
 SELECT port_cd, item_isn, ctry_cd, final_tariff_cd
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 ;

 -- BILLS FOR EXPORT
 CURSOR dcltn_bills
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT port_cd, bl_nbr
 FROM vssl_bls
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn;

 -- BILLS FOR IMPORT
 CURSOR dcltn_dlvy_bills
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT bills.port_cd, bills.bl_nbr
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders dlvys,
 sea_dlvy_items d_items,
 vssl_bls bills
 WHERE dlvys.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND dlvys.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND d_items.port_cd = dlvys.port_cd
 AND d_items.shpg_agnt_nbr = dlvys.shpg_agnt_nbr
 AND d_items.do_nbr = dlvys.do_nbr
 AND d_items.do_iss_dt = dlvys.do_iss_dt
 AND bills.port_cd = d_items.mfst_port_cd
 AND bills.mfst_type = d_items.mfst_type
 AND bills.mfst_nbr = d_items.mfst_nbr
 AND bills.mfst_dt = d_items.mfst_dt
 AND bills.bl_seq = d_items.bl_seq;

 -- FRPORTS FOR BILLS
 CURSOR dcltn_bill_frport
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT port_cd, ctry_cd, frgn_port_cd, frgn_port_type_cd
 FROM vssl_bls
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn;

 -- FRPORTS FOR DLVY ORDERS
 CURSOR dcltn_dlvy_bill_frport
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT bills.port_cd, bills.ctry_cd, bills.frgn_port_cd,
 bills.frgn_port_type_cd
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders dlvys,
 sea_dlvy_items d_items,
 vssl_bls bills
 WHERE dlvys.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND dlvys.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND d_items.port_cd = dlvys.port_cd
 AND d_items.shpg_agnt_nbr = dlvys.shpg_agnt_nbr
 AND d_items.do_nbr = dlvys.do_nbr
 AND d_items.do_iss_dt = dlvys.do_iss_dt
 AND bills.port_cd = d_items.mfst_port_cd
 AND bills.mfst_type = d_items.mfst_type
 AND bills.mfst_nbr = d_items.mfst_nbr
 AND bills.mfst_dt = d_items.mfst_dt
 AND bills.bl_seq = d_items.bl_seq;

 -- CNTNRS FOR BILLS
 CURSOR dcltn_bill_cntnr
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT cntnrs.port_cd, cntnrs.cntnr_mrk
 FROM vssl_bls bills,
 vssl_bl_items items,
 vssl_cntnrs cntnrs
 WHERE bills.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND bills.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND items.port_cd = bills.port_cd
 AND items.mfst_type = bills.mfst_type
 AND items.mfst_nbr = bills.mfst_nbr
 AND items.mfst_dt = bills.mfst_dt
 AND items.bl_seq = bills.bl_seq
 AND items.cntnr_seq IS NOT NULL
 AND cntnrs.port_cd = items.port_cd
 AND cntnrs.mfst_type = items.mfst_type
 AND cntnrs.mfst_nbr = items.mfst_nbr
 AND cntnrs.mfst_dt = items.mfst_dt
 AND cntnrs.cntnr_seq = items.cntnr_seq;

 -- CNTNRS FOR DLVY ORDERS
 CURSOR dcltn_dlvy_cntnr
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT cntnrs.port_cd, cntnrs.cntnr_mrk,cntnrs.CNTNR_SEQ
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders dlvys,
 sea_dlvy_items d_items,
 vssl_bl_items b_items,
 vssl_cntnrs cntnrs
 WHERE dlvys.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND dlvys.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND d_items.port_cd = dlvys.port_cd
 AND d_items.shpg_agnt_nbr = dlvys.shpg_agnt_nbr
 AND d_items.do_nbr = dlvys.do_nbr
 AND d_items.do_iss_dt = dlvys.do_iss_dt
 AND b_items.port_cd = d_items.mfst_port_cd
 AND b_items.mfst_type = d_items.mfst_type
 AND b_items.mfst_nbr = d_items.mfst_nbr
 AND b_items.mfst_dt = d_items.mfst_dt
 AND b_items.bl_seq = d_items.bl_seq
 AND b_items.item_seq = d_items.item_seq
 AND b_items.cntnr_seq IS NOT NULL
 AND cntnrs.port_cd = b_items.port_cd
 AND cntnrs.mfst_type = b_items.mfst_type
 AND cntnrs.mfst_nbr = b_items.mfst_nbr
 AND cntnrs.mfst_dt = b_items.mfst_dt
 AND cntnrs.cntnr_seq = b_items.cntnr_seq;

BEGIN

 BEGIN

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOR i IN dcltn_items

 -- CHECK_CTRY
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT

 THEN
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 8, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSIF NVL(TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('NEW_TARIFF_STAGE',999)),0) = 1
 THEN
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 12, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSE
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 12, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
 -- CHECK_MAIN_TARIFF
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT

 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1

 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = v_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0

ELSIF dcltn.is_export_dcltn (v_dcltn_type_cd) = 1 THEN
