 v_port_type IN NUMBER,
 v_port_cd IN NUMBER,
 v_dcltn_isn IN NUMBER,
 v_dcltn_status IN NUMBER,
 v_today IN DATE
 ) RETURN NUMBER
 IS

 have_insts NUMBER := 0;
 v_dcltn_type_cd NUMBER;
 v_dcltn_sta_cd NUMBER;
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_brkr_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_lic_nbr NUMBER;
 v_lic_type NUMBER;
 v_tariff_cd VARCHAR2 (20);
 v_agent_nbr NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;

 CURSOR dcltn_items
 IS
 SELECT port_cd, item_isn, ctry_cd, final_tariff_cd
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 ;

 -- BILLS FOR EXPORT
 CURSOR dcltn_bills
 IS
 SELECT port_cd, carr_prefix, bill_nbr
 FROM bills
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND stmt_isn = v_dcltn_isn;

 -- BILLS FOR IMPORT
 CURSOR dcltn_dlvy_bills
 IS
 SELECT port_cd, carr_prefix, bill_nbr
 FROM air_dlvy_orders
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND stmt_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND clrnc_type = 2;

 -- FRPORTS FOR BILLS
 CURSOR dcltn_bill_frport
 IS
 SELECT m.port_cd, m.load_ctry_cd, m.load_port_cd,
 m.load_port_type_cd
 FROM manifests m, bills b
 WHERE m.port_cd = b.port_cd
 AND m.mfst_nbr = b.mfst_nbr
 AND m.mfst_year = b.mfst_year
 AND b.stmt_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND b.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND m.load_port_cd IS NOT NULL;

 -- FRPORTS FOR DLVY ORDERS
 CURSOR dcltn_dlvy_bill_frport
 IS
 SELECT m.port_cd, m.load_ctry_cd, m.load_port_cd,
 m.load_port_type_cd
 FROM manifests m, air_dlvy_orders DO
 WHERE m.port_cd = DO.port_cd
 AND m.mfst_nbr = DO.mfst_nbr
 AND m.mfst_year = DO.mfst_year
 AND DO.stmt_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND DO.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND DO.clrnc_type = 2;

BEGIN

 BEGIN
 SELECT dcltn_type_cd, dcltn_sta_cd, impr_nbr, agent_nbr,
 brkr_port_cd, lic_nbr, lic_type
 INTO v_dcltn_type_cd, v_dcltn_sta_cd, v_impr_nbr, v_agent_nbr,
 v_brkr_port_cd, v_lic_nbr, v_lic_type
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN (0);
 END;
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF v_dcltn_status IS NOT NULL THEN
 v_dcltn_sta_cd := v_dcltn_status;
 END IF;


IF dcltn.is_import_dcltn (v_dcltn_type_cd) = 1 THEN

 -- CHECK_air_BILL
 FOR i IN dcltn_dlvy_bills LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 5
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND AIR_BILL_NBR = i.BILL_NBR
 AND ((AIR_CARR_PREFIX IS NULL) OR (AIR_CARR_PREFIX = i.CARR_PREFIX))
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- CHECK_FRPORT
 FOR i IN dcltn_dlvy_bill_frport LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 12
 AND PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND FP_PORT_TYPE_CD = i.load_port_type_cd
 AND FP_PORT_CD = i.load_port_cd
 AND CTRY_CD = i.load_ctry_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- CHECK_DCLTN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 9
 AND PORT_CD = v_port_cd
 AND DCLTN_ISN = v_dcltn_isn
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- CHECK_IMPR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 1
 AND PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = V_IMPR_NBR
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- CHECK_BRKR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 6
 AND PORT_CD = v_PORT_CD
 AND BRKR_LIC_NBR = V_LIC_NBR
 AND BRKR_LIC_TYPE = V_LIC_TYPE
 AND BRKR_PORT_CD = V_BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOR i IN dcltn_items
 LOOP

 -- CHECK_CTRY
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 3
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND CTRY_CD = i.ctry_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;

 -- CHECK_TARIFF_DTLS
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 2
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = i.final_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;


 BEGIN
 IF NVL (TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('NEW_TARIFF_STAGE',999)),0) = 0
 THEN
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 8, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSIF NVL(TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('NEW_TARIFF_STAGE',999)),0) = 1
 THEN
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 12, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSE
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 12, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
 -- CHECK_MAIN_TARIFF
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 11
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = v_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;

 v_tariff_cd := SUBSTR (i.final_tariff_cd, 1, 2);

 -- CHECK_TARIFF_CHPTR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 10
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = v_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (0, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

ELSIF dcltn.is_export_dcltn (v_dcltn_type_cd) = 1 THEN

 -- BILLS FOR EXPORT
 FOR i IN dcltn_bills LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 5
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND AIR_BILL_NBR = i.BILL_NBR
 AND ((AIR_CARR_PREFIX IS NULL) OR (AIR_CARR_PREFIX = i.CARR_PREFIX))
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;


 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


 -- CHECK_FRPORT
 FOR i IN dcltn_bill_frport LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 12
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND FP_PORT_TYPE_CD = i.load_port_type_cd
 AND FP_PORT_CD = i.load_port_cd
 AND CTRY_CD = i.load_ctry_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 -- CHECK_DCLTN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS CI , DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE CI.INST_STATUS = 1
 AND CI.INST_TYPE = 9
 AND CI.PORT_CD = v_port_cd
 AND CI.DCLTN_ISN = v_dcltn_isn
 AND CI.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD
 AND CI.DCLTN_ISN = D.DCLTN_ISN
 AND CI.FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 -- CHECK_IMPR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 1
 AND PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = V_IMPR_NBR
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 -- CHECK_BRKR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 6
 AND PORT_CD = v_PORT_CD
 AND BRKR_LIC_NBR = V_LIC_NBR
 AND BRKR_LIC_TYPE = V_LIC_TYPE
 AND BRKR_PORT_CD = V_BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 FOR i IN dcltn_items
 LOOP

 -- CHECK_CTRY
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 3
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND CTRY_CD = i.ctry_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;


 -- CHECK_TARIFF_DTLS
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 2
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = i.final_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 IF NVL (TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('NEW_TARIFF_STAGE',999)),0) = 0
 THEN
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 8, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSIF NVL(TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('NEW_TARIFF_STAGE',999)),0) = 1
 THEN
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 12, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 ELSE
 SELECT RPAD (v_tariff_cd, 12, '0')
 INTO v_tariff_cd
 FROM DUAL;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
 -- CHECK_MAIN_TARIFF
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 11
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = v_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;

 v_tariff_cd := SUBSTR (i.final_tariff_cd, 1, 2);

 -- CHECK_TARIFF_CHPTR
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CSTMS_INSTS
 WHERE INST_STATUS = 1
 AND INST_TYPE = 10
 AND PORT_CD = i.PORT_CD
 AND HRMNZD_CODE = v_tariff_cd
 AND FOR_EXPORT IN (1, 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 have_insts := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;



END IF;

 RETURN have_insts;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_INSTRUCTIONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_INSTRUCTIONS RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 HAVE_INSTS BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_TODAY DATE;
 V_RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_TODAY := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_RET := DCLTN.CHK_INSTRUCTIONS(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS, V_TODAY);
 IF V_RET = 1 THEN
 HAVE_INSTS := TRUE;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
-- :DCLTN_STA_CD := DCLTN.DSI_INST;
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_INST');
-- ELSIF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) THEN
 ELSIF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
-- :DCLTN_STA_CD := DCLTN.DSX_INST;
 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_INST');
 END IF;
--&&& END

 COMMIT;

 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_CD
 INTO :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 FROM DCLTN_SUSPNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ROWNUM = 1
 ORDER BY SUSPN_SEQ DESC
 ;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;

 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :U_DCLTN_STATUS
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 END IF;

 RETURN HAVE_INSTS;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_INS_REQ_MANUAL_PAY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_INS_REQ_MANUAL_PAY RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_CONFN_DT DATE;
 V_INS_REQ_PMT NUMBER;
 V_CURR_TOT_AMT NUMBER;

 V_CR_LETR_NBR NUMBER;
 V_CR_LETR_DT DATE;

 V_AMT NUMBER;
 V_SRC_PORT_AMT NUMBER;
 V_TOT_AMT NUMBER;

BEGIN

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(COD.AMT), SUM(COD.SRCE_PORT_AMT)
 INTO V_AMT, V_SRC_PORT_AMT
 FROM COLL_ORDER_DTLS COD, ACCT_ITEM_DTLS AID
 WHERE COD.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COD.ACCT_SEQ = AID.ACCT_SEQ
 AND AID.AID_TYPE = 2 -- مؤمن
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;

 V_TOT_AMT := NVL(V_AMT, 0) + NVL(V_SRC_PORT_AMT, 0);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_TOT_AMT := 0;
 END;

 IF V_TOT_AMT <= 0 THEN
 RETURN(0); -- NO INSURED AMOUNT
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT INS_REQ_PMT, CONFN_DT, CR_LETR_NBR, CR_LETR_DT
 INTO V_INS_REQ_PMT, V_CONFN_DT, V_CR_LETR_NBR, V_CR_LETR_DT
 FROM INS_REQS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد طلب ربط بالتأمين مع وجود أصناف مؤمنة - لا يمكن التحصيل يدويا','ERROR');
 RETURN (-1); -- INSURANCE REQUEST NOT EXIST
 END;

 IF V_CONFN_DT IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('طلب الربط بالتأمين غير معتمد - لا يمكن التحصيل يدويا','ERROR');
 RETURN (-1); -- INSURANCE REQUEST NOT CONFIRMED
 END IF;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF V_INS_REQ_PMT = REVENUE.INS_REQ_PMT_CL THEN
 IF V_INS_REQ_PMT = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('REVENUE.INS_REQ_PMT_CL') THEN
--&&& END

 BEGIN
 SELECT CURR_TOT_AMT
 INTO V_CURR_TOT_AMT
 FROM CREDIT_LETTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND CR_LETR_NBR = V_CR_LETR_NBR
 AND CR_LETR_DT = V_CR_LETR_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' خطاب الضمان المستخدم للمعاملة غير موجود - لا يمكن التحصيل يدويا','ERROR');
 RETURN (-1); -- CREDIT LETTER NOT EXIST
 END;

 IF V_TOT_AMT > V_CURR_TOT_AMT THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('المبلغ علي خطاب الضمان لا يغطي قيمة التأمين - لا يمكن التحصيل يدويا','ERROR');
 RETURN (-1); -- CREDITE LETTER AMOUNT DOS NOT COVER THE REQUIRED VALUE
 ELSE
 RETURN (-2); -- EXSIT INSURANCE BUT WITH CREDITE LETTER, SO CONSUME FROM THE CREDITE LETTER BUT NOT COLLECT IT
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RETURN (V_TOT_AMT);
 END IF;
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في رسوم المعاملة - لا يمكن التحصيل يدويا','ERROR');
 RETURN (-1); -- EXIST UNKNOWN ERROR
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_INSPCT_GRP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* BY SHERIFT TO FIX BUG 07-12-2004 */
PROCEDURE CHK_INSPCT_GRP IS
 V_GROUP_ID NUMBER;
 V_SHOW_OTHER_MSG BOOLEAN :=TRUE;
BEGIN
 IF (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_XRAY')) THEN
 IF :GROUP_ID IS NULL THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 SELECT GRP_ID
 INTO :GROUP_ID
 FROM INSPTR_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;


 SELECT GRP_NAME
 INTO :GROUP_ANAME
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = :GROUP_ID
 ;


 :INSPTR_ID := :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 ELSE
 SELECT GRP_ID
 INTO V_GROUP_ID
 FROM INSPTR_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;
 IF V_GROUP_ID <> :GROUP_ID THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' خطأ - لا يسمح بإتمام العملية إلا لمستخدم من نفس مجموعة البيان ','ERROR');
 V_SHOW_OTHER_MSG:=FALSE;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 IF (:INSPTR_ID IS NULL) THEN
 :INSPTR_ID := :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 BEGIN
 SELECT USR_ANAME
 INTO :DECLARATIONS.INS_ANAME
 FROM SC_USERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND USER_ID = :INSPTR_ID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 IF V_SHOW_OTHER_MSG=TRUE THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في تعريف مجموعات المعاين - يجب تعريف المعاين في مجموعات المعاينة ','ERROR');
 END IF;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_IMPR_WHITE_LIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 30/09/2018 01:30:55 م (QP5 v5.294) */
PROCEDURE CHK_IMPR_WHITE_LIST
IS
 V_EXSIT NUMBER;
 V_LIST VARCHAR2 (10);
 ret NUMBER;
 V_ITM_CNT NUMBER := 0;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(1000);
 V_OLD_IMPR NUMBER :=GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('IMPR_NBR',DATABASE_VALUE);

 FUNCTION GET_WHIT_LIST_FLG
 RETURN VARCHAR2
 IS
 V_BUS_ID VARCHAR2 (20);
 V_BUS_ID_BRNCH VARCHAR2 (20);
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_SERVICE_RESULT VARCHAR2 (1000);
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD VARCHAR2 (10);
 V_WHITE_LIST VARCHAR2 (10);
 V_SERVICE_NAME VARCHAR2(100):=NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('VAT_TIN_SERVICE', 21), 'GAZTSERVICETIN');

 BEGIN

 BEGIN
 SELECT BUS_ID,
 BUS_ID_BRNCH,
 IMPR_TYPE_CD,
 CTRY_CD,
 BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_BUS_ID,
 V_BUS_ID_BRNCH,
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD,
 V_CTRY_CD,
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF V_IMPR_TYPE_CD != 4
 THEN
 IF V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2
 THEN
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := 'BUP002';
 ELSIF V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 3
 THEN
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := 'ZS0002';
 ELSIF V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 5
 THEN
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := 'ZS0001';
 ELSIF V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 16
 THEN
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := 'ZS0003';
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT ID_TYPE_GZT, BUS_ID_NEW
 INTO V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, V_BUS_ID
 FROM IMPR_GAZT_ID
 WHERE BUS_ID = V_BUS_ID
 AND NVL (BUS_ID_BRNCH, 0) = NVL (V_BUS_ID_BRNCH, 0)
 AND IMPR_TYPE_CD = V_IMPR_TYPE_CD
 AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 AND CTRY_CD = V_CTRY_CD
 AND LST_TRAN_DT =
 (SELECT MAX (LST_TRAN_DT)
 FROM IMPR_GAZT_ID
 WHERE BUS_ID = V_BUS_ID
 AND NVL (BUS_ID_BRNCH, 0) =
 NVL (V_BUS_ID_BRNCH, 0)
 AND IMPR_TYPE_CD = V_IMPR_TYPE_CD
 AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 AND CTRY_CD = V_CTRY_CD);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 V_SERVICE_RESULT :=
 LIB_USR.zakat_SERVICE.GETZAKATTINPARAM (
 V_JAVA_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 || ':'
 || -- ??? ????????
 V_BUS_ID
 || ':'
 || -- ????? ???????
 NVL (V_BUS_ID_BRNCH, 'NULL')
 || ':'
 || -- ????? ??????
 NULL
 || ':'
 || V_CTRY_CD
 || ':'
 || -- ??????
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD
 || ':'
 || -- ??? ????????
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 || ':'
 || -- ??? ????? ???????
 :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 || ':3',
 V_SERVICE_NAME);

 SELECT SUBSTR (RESULT,INSTR (RESULT,':',1,6)+ 1,( INSTR (RESULT,':',1,7)- 1)- INSTR (RESULT,':',1,6))WHIT_LIST
 INTO V_WHITE_LIST
 FROM (SELECT V_SERVICE_RESULT || ':' RESULT
 FROM DUAL);

 RETURN NVL (V_WHITE_LIST, 'NOLIST');
 END GET_WHIT_LIST_FLG;

BEGIN
 IF V_OLD_IMPR != :DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR THEN
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2)
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_EXSIT
 FROM dcltn_vat_exmtn
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_FLG = 1
 AND item_isn IN
 (SELECT ITEM_ISN
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)
 AND VAT_EXMTN_RSN = 7;

 IF V_EXSIT > 0
 THEN
 IF :DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN (5, 9)
 THEN
 DELETE FROM dcltn_vat_exmtn
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_FLG = 1
 AND VAT_EXMTN_RSN = 7
 AND item_isn IN
 (SELECT ITEM_ISN
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD =
 :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN =
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN);
 ELSE
 V_LIST := GET_WHIT_LIST_FLG;

 FOR I
 IN (SELECT FINAL_TARIFF_CD v_HS_code
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI, dcltn_vat_exmtn DV
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = DV.PORT_CD
 AND DI.ITEM_ISN = DV.ITEM_ISN
 AND DI.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_STATS_FLG = 1
 AND VAT_EXMTN_RSN = 7)
 LOOP
 IF IMPR.Check_IMP_WHITE_LIST (I.v_HS_code, V_LIST) = 1
 THEN
 V_ITM_CNT := V_ITM_CNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_ITM_CNT != V_EXSIT
 THEN
 V_MSG :=
 ' يوجد عدد ' || V_EXSIT - V_ITM_CNT
 || ' تم اعفائها للمستورد السابق بسبب انه تابع للقائمة البيضاء ,بينما المستورد الحالي ليس لها اعفاء ';
 ret :=
 intrface.flash_alert (
 V_msg,
 'INFORMATION',
 1,
 'اسباب توقف الاجراءات ',
 7.5,
 0.5,
 1,
 0.5,
 1150,
 'r0g0b75',
 12);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;

END;

PROCEDURE CHK_IMPR_SZR_RELEASE IS

 HDATE DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;

 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM IMPORTER_SEIZURES IMPRS, IMPORTERS I

 AND I.HQ_IMPR_NBR = IMPRS.HQ_IMPR_NBR

 ;

 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
END;

FUNCTION CHK_IMPR_SZR RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 HDATE DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) THEN
IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
--&&& END
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM IMPORTER_SEIZURES IMPRS, IMPORTERS I
 WHERE SZR_STATUS = 1

 AND I.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND I.IMPR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR
 AND I.HQ_IMPR_NBR = IMPRS.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 AND TO_CHAR(IMPRS.SZR_STRT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI') <= TO_CHAR(HDATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI')
 ;

 IF V_COUNT <> 0 THEN

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 :DCLTN_STA_CD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_SZR');

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_IMPR_STATUS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2015/01/19 09:52 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
PROCEDURE chk_impr_status
IS
 v_chk_upd NUMBER;
 v_mci_chk NUMBER;
 v_retry_count NUMBER;
 v_lst_tran_dt importers.lst_tran_dt%TYPE;
 v_bus_id_type_cd importers.bus_id_type_cd%TYPE;
 v_bus_id_status importers.bus_id_status%TYPE;
 v_impr_type_cd importers.impr_type_cd%TYPE;
 v_impr_nbr importers.impr_nbr%TYPE;
 p_stop_stage NUMBER;
 p_msg_txt VARCHAR2 (500);
BEGIN

 IF :declarations.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 THEN
 v_impr_nbr := NVL (:declarations.impr_nbr, :declarations.agent_nbr);
 v_mci_chk := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('MCI_CHK', 21), 0);

 IF NVL (v_mci_chk, 0) = 1
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT bus_id_type_cd, impr_type_cd, lst_tran_dt,
 bus_id_status
 INTO v_bus_id_type_cd, v_impr_type_cd, v_lst_tran_dt,
 v_bus_id_status
 FROM importers
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd AND impr_nbr = v_impr_nbr;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_bus_id_type_cd, 0) = 2
 AND v_impr_type_cd IN (1, 3, 5, 6, 19)
 THEN
 IF TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') LIKE
 TO_CHAR (v_lst_tran_dt, 'YYYYMMDD')
 THEN
 IF NVL (v_bus_id_status, 0) = 4
 THEN
 str.disparbmsg (21, 200, 'ERROR');
 terminate_fun;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 v_chk_upd :=
 impr.get_cr_status (:declarations.port_cd,
 v_impr_nbr,
 p_stop_stage,
 p_msg_txt
 );

 IF NVL(v_chk_upd,18) = 4
 THEN
 str.disparbmsg (21, 200, 'ERROR');
 terminate_fun;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

PROCEDURE CHK_IMD_RELS_IMPR IS
 V_IMPR_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_EXPR_TYPE NUMBER;

 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR') THEN

--&&& END

--&&& END

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_IDN_CERT_OR_LAB_RQST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_IDN_CERT_OR_LAB_RQST(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS

 CURSOR DI_CURSOR IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, ITEM_ISN, ITEM_SEQ, DCLTN_ISN, FINAL_TARIFF_CD,CTRY_CD
 , DI.ICA_IDNT_ISN,IDEN_CERT_NBR,IDEN_CERT_DT,IDEN_CERT_APPRV,DI.IDEN_CER_EXCEPT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 -- CR-4139 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 20/02/2022
 AND (
 (DI.ICA_IDNT_ISN IS NULL OR DI.IDEN_CERT_NBR IS NULL)
 AND DCLTN_SERVICES.Dcltn_check_Saber(V_PORT_CD, di.ITEM_ISN, 1) =0
 AND DCLTN_SERVICES.check_elctrnc_addmsion(V_PORT_CD, V_DCLTN_ISN, 1) =0
 )
 -- END CR-4139 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 20/02/2022
 AND EXISTS
 (
 SELECT 1 FROM SMPL_LAB_DTLS,SMPL_LABS
 WHERE SMPL_LAB_DTLS.LAB_HRMNZD_ITEM = DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND SMPL_LAB_DTLS.LAB_CD=SMPL_LABS.LAB_CD
 AND SMPL_LAB_DTLS.LAB_ITEM_STATUS=1
 AND SMPL_LABS.STATUS=1


 )

 AND EXISTS
 (

 SELECT * FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE GRP_CODE= 225 AND GROUP_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE = DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 )
;


 V_SMPL_EXIST NUMBER;



 V_RETURN1 NUMBER;


 V_RET1 VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;
 V_MSG1 VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;


 V_ITEM_ARBC_DESC VARCHAR2(1000);

 v_send_lab NUMBER := 0 ;
v_GROUP_242_DATE DATE:= TO_DATE ( NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('GROUP_242_START_DATE', 5),'1441-12-04'), 'YYYY-MM-MI');
BEGIN
 IF hijdate_db.cur_hij_date > v_GROUP_242_DATE THEN -- added to 25-07-2020 for saber project

v_send_lab := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('IDN_CERT_OR_LAB', 21), 0);
IF v_send_lab =0 THEN
 RETURN 0 ;

END IF;


 V_RETURN1 :=0;
 V_RET1 := 'اصناف بدون شهادة مطابقة ويجب عمل تحليل عينات لها ' || CHR(10) ;


 FOR DI IN DI_CURSOR LOOP


 V_SMPL_EXIST :=0;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_SMPL_EXIST FROM smpl_items si
 WHERE
 si.RQST_PORT_CD=DI.PORT_CD AND si.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN=DI.ITEM_ISN;


 IF V_SMPL_EXIST =0 THEN
 V_RETURN1 :=1;

 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || ' رقم الصنف :' || DI.ITEM_SEQ || ' بند الصنف ' || DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD || ' - ' || V_ITEM_ARBC_DESC || CHR(10) ;

 IF (LENGTH(V_RET1) > 3900) THEN
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 ||'.....' || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF V_RETURN1 =1 THEN
 V_MSG1 := CHR(1000) || V_RET1;
 V_RET1 := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG1, 'INFORMATION', 1, ' الأصناف التى يجب عمل طلب تحليل عينات لها ويمكن استثناءها',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 12);
 END IF;

 IF V_RETURN1=1 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0 ;
 END IF;
---- added to 25-07-2020 for saber project
 ELSE
 RETURN 1;
 END IF; -- added to 25-07-2020 for saber project
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_GULF_IMPR_VCARDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_GULF_IMPR_VCARDS(MSG_TYPE NUMBER) IS
 V_FROM DATE ;
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_CO NUMBER;
 V_CO_ITEMS_CARD NUMBER;
 v_cnt1 NUMBER;
 V_CNT_CAR_EX NUMBER;
 V_NO_CAR NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF (:dcltn_type_cd = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DT_IR'))
 OR (:dcltn_type_cd = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DT_IS'))
 THEN
 DECLARE
 ret NUMBER;
 BEGIN
------------------------------AHMED MOMEN 01-11-2020---------

 SELECT COUNT (*)
INTO V_CNT_CAR_EX
FROM IMPR_CAR_EXCEPTION
WHERE PORT_CD =:port_cd
AND NVL(dcltn_isn,0) = :dcltn_isn
AND IMPR_NBR = :impr_nbr;

-------------------------********----------------

 SELECT impr_type_cd, ctry_cd
 INTO v_impr_type_cd, v_ctry_cd
 FROM importers
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd AND impr_nbr = :impr_nbr;

 IF v_impr_type_cd = 4 THEN

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_co
 FROM ctry_group_headers cgh, ctry_group_details cgd
 WHERE cgh.ctry_grp_nbr = cgd.ctry_grp_nbr
 AND cgh.ctry_grp_nbr = 3
 AND cgh.ctry_grp_status = 1
 AND cgd.ctry_grp_stat = 1
 AND cgd.ctry_cd = v_ctry_cd;

 IF (v_co > 0)
 THEN
 BEGIN
 v_co_items_card := 0;

 SELECT NVL(SUM(inv_qty),0)--COUNT (*)
 INTO v_co_items_card
 FROM dcltn_items, group_items
 WHERE dcltn_items.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_items.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd = group_items.hrmnzd_code
 AND grp_code = 76
 AND duty_type NOT IN (7, 8, 26);
 IF MSG_TYPE = 1 THEN
 IF v_co_items_card = 0 THEN
 RETURN;
 --- NO ITEMS CONTAIN TARIFF BAND AVAILABLE TO CREATE VHCL CARDS.
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;

 v_from := hijdate.add_hij_days (hijdate.cur_hij_date, -354);
------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT(1)
 INTO v_cnt1 FROM customs.vhcl_all_chase_nbr vhc
 WHERE vhc.HQ_IMPR_NBR IN
 (SELECT imp.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM customs.declarations de, customs.importers imp
 WHERE imp.port_cd = de.port_cd
 AND imp.impr_nbr = de.impr_nbr
 AND de.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND de.impr_nbr = :impr_nbr
 AND de.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND de.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2))
 AND vhc.vhcl_card_dt > v_from
-- --> 07/04/2013 AHMED A-MONIM Current VHCL Not include
 AND (vhc.PORT_CD,vhc.VHCL_CARD_NBR,vhc.VHCL_CARD_DT) NOT IN
 (SELECT vc.PORT_CD,vc.VHCL_CARD_NBR,vc.VHCL_CARD_DT
 FROM VHCL_CARDS VC WHERE
 vhc.PORT_CD = vc.PORT_CD AND
 vhc.VHCL_CARD_NBR = vc.VHCL_CARD_NBR AND
 vhc.VHCL_CARD_DT = vc.VHCL_CARD_DT AND
 vc.PORT_CD = :port_cd AND
 vc.DCLTN_ISN = :dcltn_isn );
-- --< 07/04/2013 AHMED A-MONIM Current VHCL Not include
-------------------------------------------------------------

 IF (v_cnt1 + v_co_items_card) > 2 THEN
 :GLOBAL.act_last_dec := NULL;
 ELSE
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RETURN; -- PERSON NOT FROM GULF COUNTRIES
 END IF;
 END;
 ELSE
 RETURN;
 END IF;

-------------------------------------مستورد خليجي وله 2 بطاقة سابقة خلال سنة ماضية-------------------------------
 IF v_impr_type_cd = 4 AND (v_ctry_cd = 100 OR v_co > 0) THEN ------MAIN

 IF MSG_TYPE = 1 AND (v_cnt1 + v_co_items_card) > 2 THEN

 ------------------AHMED MOMEN 01-011-2020-------------

IF V_CNT_CAR_EX >0 AND NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('CAR_EXCEPTION',21),0)=1 THEN

 SELECT NO_OF_CARS
INTO V_NO_CAR
FROM IMPR_CAR_EXCEPTION
WHERE PORT_CD =:port_cd
AND NVL(dcltn_isn,0) = :dcltn_isn
AND IMPR_NBR = :impr_nbr;
 str.dispalert(
' يوجد لهذا المستـــــورد استثناء على عدد '
 || V_NO_CAR
 || ' سيارات : ','INFORMATION');

 ELSE

 -----------------START OLD -----------------------
DECLARE
 v_msg VARCHAR2 (500);
 V_CLR_RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 v_msg :=
 ' المركبات المستورة خلال العام الحالي لهذا المستورد'
 || CHR (13)
 || CHR (10);
 v_msg := v_msg ||' م '
 || ' '
 ||RPAD(' الجمرك ',25,' ')
 --|| ' ' --
 ||rpad('رقم البطاقة',12,' ')
 --|| ' ' --
 ||' تاريخها '
 || CHR (13)
 || CHR (10);
 FOR v_card IN
 (SELECT ROWNUM seq, sdp.port_name, vhc.vhcl_card_nbr, vhc.vhcl_card_dt,
 vhc.chase_nbr
 FROM customs.vhcl_all_chase_nbr vhc, sd_ports sdp
 WHERE sdp.port_cd = vhc.port_cd
 AND vhc.hq_impr_nbr IN (
 SELECT imp.hq_impr_nbr
 FROM customs.declarations de, customs.importers imp
 WHERE imp.port_cd = de.port_cd
 AND imp.impr_nbr = de.impr_nbr
 AND de.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND de.impr_nbr = :impr_nbr
 AND de.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND de.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2))
 AND vhc.vhcl_card_dt > v_from)
 LOOP
 v_msg :=
 v_msg
 || ' '
 || v_card.seq
 || '- '
 || rpad(v_card.port_name,25,' ')
 -- || ' ' --
 || rpad(v_card.vhcl_card_nbr,10,' ')
 -- || ' '--
 || to_char(v_card.vhcl_card_dt,'YYYY/MM/MI')
 || CHR (13)
 || CHR (10);
 NULL;
 END LOOP;

 v_msg :=
 v_msg
 || 'عدد المركبات في البيان الحالي '
 || '('
 || v_co_items_card
 || ')'
 || CHR (13)
 || CHR (10)
 || 'لا يسمح للمستورد باستيراد اكثر من مركبتين خلال العام الواحد';

 -- str.dispalert(v_msg,'INFORMATION'); --

 V_CLR_RET :=FLASH_CLR_ALERT (v_msg,
 'INFORMATION',
 1,
 'رسالة تحذيرية',
 5.5,
 1.8,
 2.5,
 0.5,
 1300,
 'r0g0b0',
 'r200g200b200',
 5

 ) ;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 str.dispalert (' يوجد لهذا المستـــــورد '||
 v_cnt1 ||' سيارات سابقة : '||
 v_co_items_card||' سيارات على البيان الحالي : '||
 CHR (13)|| CHR (10)||
 ' ولا يسمح له استيراد أكثر من سيارتين في السنة .','INFORMATION');
END;

 terminate_fun;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;

 --------------------END OLD-------------
 END IF; ----- END NEW 1---

 ELSIF MSG_TYPE <> 1 AND (v_cnt1 + v_co_items_card) >= 2 THEN
 RET := str.dispalert ('يوجد لهذا المستورد 2 بيان استيراد سيارات. هل تريد الاستمرار؟؟؟','CONFIRM');
 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.ACT_LAST_DEC:=1;
 ELSIF RET = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
---====================================

 END IF; ------MAIN
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 END;
 END IF;



END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_GRP_158
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2014/09/03 13:56 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
-- --> 03/09/2014 AHMED A-MONIM Check Group 158 For DEB AND KAP

PROCEDURE chk_grp_158
IS
 v_count NUMBER := 0;
 v_chk NUMBER := 0;
 ret NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 IF :declarations.port_cd IN (53, 75 )
 AND :declarations.dcltn_type_cd IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM group_sd_ports
 WHERE grp_code = 158
 AND port_cd = :declarations.port_cd);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) > 0
 THEN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR c1
 IS
 SELECT final_tariff_cd
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn;

 v_count1 NUMBER := 0;
 v_count2 NUMBER := 0;
 v_exist_port NUMBER := 0;
 BEGIN
 FOR x IN c1
 LOOP
--=================================================================================
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count1
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM tariff_instructions ti,
 group_instructions gin,
 tariff_groups tg,
 group_items git
 WHERE git.grp_code = tg.grp_code
 AND tg.grp_code = gin.grp_code
 AND gin.inst_code = ti.inst_code
 AND tg.grp_code = 158
 AND ti.inst_code = 97
 AND git.hrmnzd_code = x.final_tariff_cd
 AND ti.inst_type = 12);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count1 := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_count1, 0) > 0
 THEN
 v_chk := v_chk + 1;
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count2
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM tariff_instructions ti,
 group_instructions gin,
 tariff_groups tg,
 group_items git,
 group_chapters gch
 WHERE git.grp_code = tg.grp_code
 AND tg.grp_code = gin.grp_code
 AND gch.grp_code = tg.grp_code
 AND gin.inst_code = ti.inst_code
 AND tg.grp_code = 158
 AND ti.inst_code = 97
 AND gch.chpt_code =
 SUBSTR (x.final_tariff_cd, 1, 2)
 AND gch.chpt_status = 0
 AND ti.inst_type = 12);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count2 := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_count2, 0) > 0
 THEN
 v_chk := v_chk + 1;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
--=================================================================================
 END LOOP;

 IF v_chk > 0
 THEN
 RET := str.dispalert ('يجب أن تكون المادة المصدرة جامدة وليست سائلة',
 'CONFIRM'
 );

 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 134, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 135, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 terminate_fun;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
declare
x number;
ALERT_RET number;
begin
if :port_cd = 66 and :dcltn_type_cd in (3) then
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD= :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN
 AND FINAL_TARIFF_CD = '320730000000';
if x > 0 then
 ALERT_RET := STR.DISPALERT('الصنف هو من الدهانات وزيوت محركات السيارات المعبأة في عبوات مصنعيه لا تزيد سعتها عن 25 لتر , هل تريد الإستمرار؟','USR_CONFIRM');
 IF ALERT_RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 136, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 else
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 137, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
end if;
end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_FUTURE_IMPR_DIFF_SUSPN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_FUTURE_IMPR_DIFF_SUSPN(V_DATE IN OUT DATE) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 HDATE DATE;
BEGIN
 HDATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;

 SELECT MIN(SUSPN_STRT_DT)
 INTO V_DATE
 FROM IMPR_SUSPNS
 WHERE IMPR_SUSPNS.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_SUSPNS.Impr_Nbr IN (:DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR, :DECLARATIONS.AGENT_NBR)
 AND TO_CHAR(IMPR_SUSPNS.SUSPN_STRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-MI') > TO_CHAR(HDATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI')
 AND SUSPN_RSN_CD = 1
 AND IMPR_SUSPNS.SUSPN_RLSE_DT IS NULL;

 IF V_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;


 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
END;

FUNCTION chk_express_impr (
 v_port_cd IN NUMBER,
 v_agent_nbr IN NUMBER,
 v_msg_txt OUT VARCHAR2
)
 RETURN NUMBER
IS
x NUMBER;
V_BZMS_LOW_VALUE NUMBER;
CURSOR s IS SELECT FINAL_TARIFF_CD FROM dcltn_items WHERE port_cd=:port_cd AND dcltn_isn=:dcltn_isn;
BEGIN
 --------------BZMS
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_BZMS_LOW_VALUE
 FROM BZMS_DECLARATIONS_INFO
 WHERE PORT_CD = :port_cd
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL(VALUE_LEVEL,0) = 1
 AND NVL(BZMS_DCLTN_CATEGORY,0) = 3 ;
 --------------

IF :impr_nbr IS NOT NULL AND :dcltn_type_cd IN (1,2) AND :parameter.p_port_type IN (3,4) AND V_BZMS_LOW_VALUE = 0
 THEN
FOR rec IN s LOOP
 x:=LIB_USR.hours24_services.validate_agent_tarrif (:port_cd,
 :impr_nbr,
 rec.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,
 :dcltn_type_cd,
 v_msg_txt);
IF x = 0 THEN
RETURN 0;
END IF;
END LOOP;
END IF;
RETURN 1;
END;

 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 4 AND NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('BOUND_EXP_ALLOW', 73), 0) = 1 THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_EXIST_SABEK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION chk_exist_sabek (
 p_port_cd NUMBER,
 p_dcltn_isn NUMBER,
 p_item_isn NUMBER
)
 RETURN NUMBER
IS
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_hq_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_count NUMBER;
BEGIN
--==============================================================================
 BEGIN
 SELECT impr_nbr
 INTO v_impr_nbr
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = p_port_cd AND dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn;

 SELECT hq_impr_nbr
 INTO v_hq_impr_nbr
 FROM importers
 WHERE importers.impr_nbr = v_impr_nbr AND importers.port_cd = p_port_cd;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF v_hq_impr_nbr = 445796
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT '1'
 FROM exmtn_decrees ed,
 decree_acptd_items dai,
 dcltn_items di
 WHERE dai.decree_port_cd = ed.decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn = ed.decree_isn
 AND dai.decree_port_cd = di.exmtn_decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn = di.exmtn_decree_isn
 AND dai.aplctn_port_cd = di.port_cd
 AND dai.item_seq = di.exmtn_item_seq
 AND dai.item_sub_seq = di.exmtn_item_sub_seq
 AND di.port_cd = p_port_cd
 --AND di.dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn
 AND di.item_isn = p_item_isn
 AND dai.item_sta_cd = 2
 AND ed.decree_type = 1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT '1'
 FROM exmtn_decrees_hq ed,
 decree_acptd_items_hq dai,
 dcltn_items di
 WHERE dai.decree_port_cd = ed.decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn = ed.decree_isn
 AND dai.decree_port_cd = di.exmtn_decree_port_cd
 AND dai.decree_isn = di.exmtn_decree_isn
 AND dai.aplctn_port_cd = di.port_cd
 AND dai.item_seq = di.exmtn_item_seq
 AND dai.item_sub_seq = di.exmtn_item_sub_seq
 AND di.port_cd = p_port_cd
 --AND di.dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn
 AND di.item_isn = p_item_isn
 AND dai.item_sta_cd = 2
 AND ed.decree_type = 1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) > 0
 THEN
 RETURN (1);
 ELSE
 RETURN (0);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RETURN (0);
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 RETURN (0);
END chk_exist_sabek;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_EXCPT_IMPR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- MAIH 01-04-2013 --
PROCEDURE chk_excpt_impr IS
 v_cnt NUMBER;
 v_excpt_cnt NUMBER;
 v_new_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_old_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_new_rule_isn NUMBER;
 v_old_rule_isn NUMBER;
 v_rule_type NUMBER;
 v_remained_qty NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM impr_rule_dcltns ird, dcltn_items dt
 WHERE ird.dcltn_port_cd = dt.port_cd
 AND ird.item_isn = dt.item_isn
 AND dt.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dt.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND ird.rec_status = 1;
 -- if the declaration has an item that is excepted
 IF v_cnt > 0
 THEN


 IF DCLTN.is_import_dcltn (:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 SELECT impr_nbr
 INTO v_old_impr_nbr
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn;
 v_rule_type := 1;
 v_new_impr_nbr := :impr_nbr;
 ELSIF DCLTN.is_export_dcltn (:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 SELECT AGENT_NBR
 INTO v_old_impr_nbr
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn;
 v_rule_type := 2;
 v_new_impr_nbr := :AGENT_NBR;
 END IF;




 -- loop in all items that is excepted in that declaration
 FOR i IN (SELECT dt.port_cd,dt.item_seq, dt.item_isn, dt.final_tariff_cd,
 dt.intl_qty
 FROM impr_rule_dcltns ird, dcltn_items dt
 WHERE ird.dcltn_port_cd = dt.port_cd
 AND ird.item_isn = dt.item_isn
 AND dt.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dt.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND ird.rec_status = 1)
 LOOP


 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_excpt_cnt
 FROM importers im, impr_rules ir, impr_rule_tariff_HQ irt
 WHERE im.hq_impr_nbr = ir.hq_impr_nbr
 AND ( (ir.ALL_BRNCH_FLAG = 1)
 OR (0 <
 (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM impr_rule_ports irp
 WHERE irp.rule_isn = ir.rule_isn
 AND irp.rec_status = 1
 AND irp.port_cd = :port_cd)
 )
 )
 AND ( (ir.rule_type IN (9, 10) AND v_rule_type = 1) /*import*/
 OR (ir.rule_type IN (9, 11) AND v_rule_type = 2) /*export*/
 )
 AND ir.rule_isn = irt.rule_isn
 AND irt.hrmnzd_code = i.final_tariff_cd
 AND irt.remained_qty >=i.intl_qty
 AND ir.rec_status = 1
 AND im.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND im.impr_nbr = v_new_impr_nbr;
 -- check if the new importer has an exception for the excepted item before
 IF v_excpt_cnt <= 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert (' يوجد أصناف مستثناه من المنع للمستورد القديم و لا يوجد إستثناء للصنف رقم ( '||i.item_seq || ')' || ' للمستورد الجديد او ان الكمية لا تكفى', 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 ------------- get old and new rule isn ------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT irt.rule_isn
 INTO v_new_rule_isn
 FROM importers im, impr_rules ir, impr_rule_tariff_HQ irt
 WHERE im.hq_impr_nbr = ir.hq_impr_nbr
 AND ( (ir.ALL_BRNCH_FLAG = 1)
 OR (0 <
 (SELECT COUNT (*)
 FROM impr_rule_ports irp
 WHERE irp.rule_isn = ir.rule_isn
 AND irp.rec_status = 1
 AND irp.port_cd = :port_cd)
 )
 )
 AND ( (ir.rule_type IN (9, 10) AND v_rule_type = 1
 ) /*import*/
 OR (ir.rule_type IN (9, 11) AND v_rule_type = 2
 ) /*export*/
 )
 AND ir.rule_isn = irt.rule_isn
 AND irt.hrmnzd_code = I.final_tariff_cd
 AND irt.remained_qty >=i.intl_qty
 AND ir.rec_status = 1
 AND im.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND im.impr_nbr = v_new_impr_nbr;

 SELECT RULE_ISN
 INTO v_old_rule_isn
 FROM impr_rule_dcltns
 WHERE DCLTN_PORT_CD = :port_cd
 AND item_isn = i.item_isn
 AND rec_status = 1;
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------


 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 ------------------ delete old ----------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 delete from impr_rule_dcltns
 WHERE dcltn_port_cd = :port_cd
 AND item_isn = i.item_isn;

 UPDATE impr_rule_tariff_HQ
 SET remained_qty = remained_qty + i.intl_qty
 WHERE rule_isn = v_old_rule_isn
 AND hrmnzd_code = i.final_tariff_cd;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------


 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 ------------------ inset new ------------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 INSERT INTO impr_rule_dcltns
 (rule_isn, dcltn_port_cd,
 item_isn, hrmnzd_code,
 used_qty, rec_status
 )
 VALUES (v_new_rule_isn, :port_cd,
 i.item_isn, i.final_tariff_cd,
 i.intl_qty, 1
 );

 UPDATE impr_rule_tariff_HQ
 SET remained_qty = remained_qty - i.intl_qty
 WHERE rule_isn = v_new_rule_isn
 AND hrmnzd_code = i.final_tariff_cd;
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------

 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;

end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_EMPTY_CNTNR_FOR_EXP( P_EXP_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER ) IS
CURSOR IMP_CNTNR_EMPTY IS
SELECT VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_MRK
 FROM
 CUSTOMS.VSSL_BLS,
 CUSTOMS.VSSL_BL_ITEMS,
 CUSTOMS.VSSL_CNTNRS
 WHERE ( (VSSL_BLS.PORT_CD = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.PORT_CD)
 AND (VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE)
 AND (VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_NBR)
 AND (VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_DT)
 AND (VSSL_BLS.BL_SEQ = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.BL_SEQ)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.PORT_CD = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.PORT_CD)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_NBR = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_NBR)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_DT = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_DT)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_SEQ = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ)
 AND VSSL_BLS.DCLTN_ISN = P_EXP_DCLTN_ISN
 );

V_IMP_CNTNR_MRK VARCHAR2(100);
V_CNTNR_MRK_LIST VARCHAR2(4000) ;
V_CNTNR_EMPTY BOOLEAN ;

pl_id ParamList;
pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'empty_cntnr';
RET NUMBER;
V_EXIST NUMBER := 0;
V_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
V_WIVER_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
----------------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION IS_EXCEED_180_DAY(P_CNTNR_MRK VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER
IS
 CURSOR C1 IS
 SELECT WAIVERS.ISSUED_DT
 FROM
 SEA_DLVY_ORDERS,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS,
 VSSL_CNTNRS,
 DECLARATIONS,
 WAIVERS,
 WVR_ITEMS
 WHERE ( (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.PORT_CD)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.DO_NBR)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_DT = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.DO_ISS_DT)

 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_PORT_CD)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_NBR)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_DT = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_DT)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.BL_SEQ = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.BL_SEQ)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ)

 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.PORT_CD = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.PORT_CD)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_NBR = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_NBR)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_DT = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_DT)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_SEQ = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ)

 AND (DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD)
 AND (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DCLTN_ISN)

 AND (DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD = WAIVERS.WVR_PORT_CD)
 AND (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN = WAIVERS.DCLTN_ISN)

 AND (WAIVERS.WVR_PORT_CD = WVR_ITEMS.WVR_PORT_CD)
 AND (WAIVERS.WVR_SEQ_NBR = WVR_ITEMS.WVR_SEQ_NBR)
 AND (WAIVERS.ISSUED_DT = WVR_ITEMS.ISSUED_DT)

 AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 9 -- بيان الوارد مفسوح

 AND WVR_ITEMS.CNTNR_MRK = P_CNTNR_MRK
 AND VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_MRK = P_CNTNR_MRK

 AND VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_TYPE = 1 --وارد
 AND VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_STA_CD = 1 -- الحاويه مفتحه
 AND VSSL_CNTNRS.SHPMT_TYPE_CD = 8 -- حاويه فارغه

 AND WVR_ITEMS.ITEM_TYPE_CD = 21
 AND NVL(WVR_ITEMS.ITEM_STATUS,0) <> 1
 );

V_VOCATION_DAYS NUMBER;
V_TOTAL_DAYS NUMBER;
V_ISSUED_DT DATE;
V_CURR_DATE DATE:= HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
V_MSG VARCHAR2(100);
V_180_NBR NUMBER:=0;

BEGIN
 FOR I IN C1 LOOP
 V_ISSUED_DT := I.ISSUED_DT;
 V_VOCATION_DAYS := STRG.GET_VACATION_DAYS(:PORT_CD , V_ISSUED_DT,V_CURR_DATE,V_MSG);
 V_TOTAL_DAYS := V_VOCATION_DAYS + HIJDATE.Hij_Date_Diff_In_Days(V_ISSUED_DT , V_CURR_DATE);

 IF V_TOTAL_DAYS > 180 THEN
 V_180_NBR := V_180_NBR + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_180_NBR > 0 THEN RETURN 1 ;
 ELSE RETURN 0;
 END IF;

END IS_EXCEED_180_DAY;


----------------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION IS_CNTNR_EMPY (V_CNTNR_MRK VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN
IS

V_CHK_1 NUMBER := 0;
V_CHK_2 NUMBER := 0;
V_CHK_3 NUMBER := 0;
--V_WIVER_COUNT NUMBER := 0;

BEGIN
 --- CHECK 1
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CHK_1
 FROM VSSL_CNTNRS
 WHERE MFST_TYPE = 1 --وارد
 AND CNTNR_STA_CD = 1
 AND SHPMT_TYPE_CD = 8
 AND CNTNR_MRK = V_CNTNR_MRK;


 IF V_CHK_1 > 0 THEN
 --- CHECK 2
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CHK_2
 FROM
 SEA_DLVY_ORDERS,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS,
 VSSL_CNTNRS,
 DECLARATIONS,
 WAIVERS,
 WVR_ITEMS
 WHERE ( (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.PORT_CD)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.DO_NBR)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_DT = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.DO_ISS_DT)

 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_PORT_CD)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_NBR)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_DT = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_DT)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.BL_SEQ = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.BL_SEQ)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ)

 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.PORT_CD = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.PORT_CD)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_NBR = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_NBR)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_DT = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_DT)
 AND (VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_SEQ = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ)

 AND (DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD)
 AND (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DCLTN_ISN)

 AND (DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD = WAIVERS.WVR_PORT_CD)
 AND (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN = WAIVERS.DCLTN_ISN)

 AND (WAIVERS.WVR_PORT_CD = WVR_ITEMS.WVR_PORT_CD)
 AND (WAIVERS.WVR_SEQ_NBR = WVR_ITEMS.WVR_SEQ_NBR)
 AND (WAIVERS.ISSUED_DT = WVR_ITEMS.ISSUED_DT)

 AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 9 -- بيان الوارد مفسوح

 AND WVR_ITEMS.CNTNR_MRK = V_CNTNR_MRK
 AND VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_MRK = V_CNTNR_MRK

 AND VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_TYPE = 1 --وارد
 AND VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_STA_CD = 1 -- الحاويه مفتحه
 AND VSSL_CNTNRS.SHPMT_TYPE_CD = 8 -- حاويه فارغه

 AND WVR_ITEMS.ITEM_TYPE_CD = 21
 AND NVL(WVR_ITEMS.ITEM_STATUS,0) <> 1


 )
 ;

 IF V_CHK_2 > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM WAIVERS , WVR_ITEMS
 WHERE (WAIVERS.WVR_PORT_CD = WVR_ITEMS.WVR_PORT_CD)
 AND (WAIVERS.WVR_SEQ_NBR = WVR_ITEMS.WVR_SEQ_NBR)
 AND (WAIVERS.ISSUED_DT = WVR_ITEMS.ISSUED_DT)

 AND WVR_ITEMS.CNTNR_MRK = V_CNTNR_MRK
 AND WVR_ITEMS.ITEM_TYPE_CD = 21
 AND NVL(WVR_ITEMS.ITEM_STATUS,0) <> 1 ;

 V_WIVER_COUNT := V_WIVER_COUNT + V_COUNT;

 IF V_WIVER_COUNT = 2 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد خطأ في معلومات بيانات الحاويات الوارده للبيان الصادر, حيث يوجد أكثر من تعهد على حاويه فارغه','ERROR');
 --TERMINATE_FUN ;
 END IF;
 --- CHECK 3
 V_CHK_3:= IS_EXCEED_180_DAY(V_CNTNR_MRK);
 ------- عرض رسالة ارشادية وعدم ايقاف الوظيفة DM-788
 IF V_CHK_3 > 0 AND V_EXIST = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد تعهد تجاوز مدته اكثر من 180 يوم','INFORMATION');
 V_EXIST := 1;
 V_CHK_3 := 0;
 END IF;
 ---------------------------------
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_CHK_1 > 0 AND V_CHK_2 > 0 AND V_CHK_3 = 0 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;


END IS_CNTNR_EMPY;
----------------------------------------------------------------------

BEGIN

 FOR REC IN IMP_CNTNR_EMPTY
 LOOP
 V_CNTNR_EMPTY := IS_CNTNR_EMPY(REC.CNTNR_MRK);
 IF V_CNTNR_EMPTY = TRUE THEN
 NULL;
 --V_CNTNR_MRK_LIST := V_CNTNR_MRK_LIST||''''||REC.CNTNR_MRK||''',';

 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF V_EXIST > 0 THEN

 --V_CNTNR_MRK_LIST := SUBSTR(V_CNTNR_MRK_LIST,1,LENGTH(V_CNTNR_MRK_LIST)-1);
 ---- show lov------------------------------
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, ' الحاويات الفارغة الوارده للحاويات المصدره ');


 CALL_FORM('LOV_EMPTY_CNTNR.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.AGREE = 1 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 103, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لابد من الموافقه على القائمة السابقة للأستمرار في أستكمال عمل تلك الوظيفه' ,'ERROR');
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 -------------------------------------------
 END IF;


--EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
-- STR.DISPALERT(DBMS_ERROR_TEXT,'ERROR');
 --TERMINATE_FUN ;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_DUPL_IMP_BRKR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_DUPL_IMP_BRKR IS
 V_VAR_VALUE VARCHAR2(2) := 0;
 V_CHK NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR(3000);
 V_HQ_IMPR_NBR NUMBER ;
 V_ARBC_IMPR_NAM VARCHAR2(500) ;
 V_RESPONSIBLE_NAME VARCHAR2(500) ;
 V_RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT VAR_VALUE
 INTO V_VAR_VALUE
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 9
 AND VAR_NAME = 'CHK_DPLCATE_IMP_BRKR'
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_VAR_VALUE := 0 ;
 END;

 IF V_VAR_VALUE = 1 THEN
 IF :IMPR_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 DECLARE
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_BUS_ID VARCHAR2(50);
 V_BUS_ID_BRNCH VARCHAR2(50);
 BEGIN

 SELECT IMPR_TYPE_CD,COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE,BUS_ID,BUS_ID_BRNCH
 INTO V_IMPR_TYPE_CD,V_COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE,V_BUS_ID,V_BUS_ID_BRNCH
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NBR ;

 IF V_IMPR_TYPE_CD IN (1,4) THEN

 V_CHK :=IMPR.CHECK_DUPLICATE_IMP_BRKR(:PORT_CD,1,V_IMPR_TYPE_CD,V_BUS_ID,V_COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE,V_BUS_ID,V_BUS_ID_BRNCH,V_MSG);
 IF V_CHK = 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 IF :LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 DECLARE
 V_NEW_ID_NBR VARCHAR2(30);
 BEGIN

 DECLARE
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER:=:PORT_CD;
 BEGIN
 IF :LIC_TYPE IN (2,5) THEN
 V_PORT_CD:=99;
 END IF;

 SELECT NEW_ID_NBR INTO V_NEW_ID_NBR
 FROM BRKR_MSTR
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND LIC_TYPE = :LIC_TYPE
 AND LIC_NBR = :LIC_NBR;

 END;

 V_CHK := IMPR.CHECK_DUPLICATE_IMP_BRKR(:PORT_CD,2,NULL,V_NEW_ID_NBR,NULL,NULL,NULL,V_MSG);

 IF V_CHK = 1 THEN
 V_MSG := CHR(1000) || V_MSG;
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'INFORMATION', 1, 'خطأ',7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 12);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_DUMP_CMPNY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--MMAOUA 18/06/2017
PROCEDURE CHK_DUMP_CMPNY(
 P_PORT_CD NUMBER,
 P_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER,
 P_DCLTN_DT DATE,
 P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER)
IS
 CURSOR V_INV_CUR IS
 SELECT DISTINCT DIN.INV_ISN, DIN.INV_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DIT, DCLTN_DUMP_HZS DDH, DCLTN_DUMP_PERIODS DDP, DCLTN_DUMP_CMPNYS DDC, DCLTN_INVOICES DIN
 WHERE DIT.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DIT.DCLTN_ISN = P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DIT.FINAL_TARIFF_CD = DDH.HRMNZD_CODE
 --AND DIT.FINAL_TARIFF_DT = DDH.EFF_DATE
 AND DDH.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = DDP.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ
 AND DDH.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ = DDP.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ
 AND HIJDATE_DB.to_greg(P_DCLTN_DT) BETWEEN DDP.DUMP_ST_DATE AND DDP.DUMP_END_DATE
 AND DDP.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ = DDC.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ
 AND DIT.CTRY_CD = DDC.CTRY_CD
 AND DIT.PORT_CD = DIN.PORT_CD
 AND DIT.INV_ISN = DIN.INV_ISN
 ORDER BY DIN.INV_SEQ;

 CURSOR V_DUMP_CUR (V_INV_ISN NUMBER) IS
 SELECT DDCI.DUMP_CMPNY_SEQ, DDCI.DUMP_PERIOD_SEQ, DDCI.INSPECT_USR_CODE, DDCI.INSPECT_DATE, DDCI.HGRP_APPROV_FLAG, DDCI.HGRP_APPROV_DATE
 FROM DCLTN_DUMP_CMP_INV DDCI
 WHERE DDCI.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DDCI.INV_ISN = V_INV_ISN;

 DUMP_REC V_DUMP_CUR%ROWTYPE;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_ELIGIBLE BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
 IF P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2) AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (2, 14) THEN
 FOR INV_REC IN V_INV_CUR LOOP
 BEGIN
 V_ELIGIBLE := TRUE;
 OPEN V_DUMP_CUR(INV_REC.INV_ISN);
 LOOP FETCH V_DUMP_CUR INTO DUMP_REC;
 IF V_DUMP_CUR%NOTFOUND THEN--COMPANY NOT ENTERED YET
 V_MSG_TXT := V_MSG_TXT || CHR (10) || 'لم يتم تحديد الشركة المغرقة للفاتورة رقم '|| INV_REC.INV_SEQ ;
 END IF;
 EXIT;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE V_DUMP_CUR;
 END;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 IF V_MSG_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT , 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN();
 ELSIF V_ELIGIBLE THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تحويل معاملة الإغراق لقسم القيمه لبحث قيمة الأصناف بالبيان' , 'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_DRY_ANAMALS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE chk_dry_anamals IS
v_cnt NUMBER := 0 ;
v_msg_lvl NUMBER := 0 ;
x NUMBER := 0 ;
v_msg VARCHAR2(2000) ;
V_CLR_RET NUMBER ;
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM dcltn_items di, group_items gi

IF v_cnt > 0 AND :parameter.p_task_id IN (14,4) THEN
 -- str.dispalert('تنبيه , نأمل التأكد إن كانت البضاعه تحتوى على حيوان محنط بأنه ليس كاملا','information'); --

 -- v_msg := 'يمنع استيراد المجسمات المحنطة الكاملة حسب ما ورد بالتعميم رقم 363/3/4 بتاريخ 15/6/1416 هـ ويسمح فقط بالأجزاء مثل الرؤوس والأجنحة والأطراف الواردة بالتعميم رقم 221/43/2 بتاريخ 7/4/1434 هـ' ; --
 V_MSG := 'يمنع استيراد المجسمات المحنطة الكاملة حسب ما ورد بالتعميم رقم 4/3/363 بتاريخ 1416/6/15 هـ ويسمح فقط بالأجزاء مثل الرؤوس والأجنحة والأطراف الواردة بالتعميم رقم 2/43/221 بتاريخ 1434/4/7 هـ' ;
 V_CLR_RET :=FLASH_CLR_ALERT (v_msg,
 'INFORMATION',
 1,
 'رسالة تحذيرية',
 5.5,
 1.8,
 2.5,
 0.5,
 1300,
 'r0g0b0',
 'r200g200b200',
 2

 ) ;


 IF :parameter.p_task_id = 14 THEN -- معاين
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS
 WHERE ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.ACTVY_SUB_ID = :PORT_CD||'!'||:dcltn_ISN AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.SYSOBJ_ID = 21 AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.SUBJ_CODE = 1 AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.ACTVY_TYPE = 124 AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 IF X = 0 THEN
 IF NOT activity.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 124, :port_cd||'!'||:dcltn_isn) THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :parameter.p_task_id = 4 THEN -- رئيس مجموعة
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS
 WHERE ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.ACTVY_SUB_ID = :PORT_CD||'!'||:dcltn_ISN AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.SYSOBJ_ID = 21 AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.SUBJ_CODE = 1 AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.ACTVY_TYPE = 125 AND
 ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 IF X = 0 THEN
 IF NOT activity.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 125, :port_cd||'!'||:dcltn_isn) THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF ;
 v_msg_lvl:=:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 25;
 --commit; --
 FORMS_DDL (' COMMIT');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := v_msg_lvl;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_DIFF_CLR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_DIFF_CLR RETURN BOOLEAN IS

V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_HQ_NBR NUMBER;
 H_DATE DATE;
BEGIN

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) THEN
IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
--&&& END
 H_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DIFFERENCE_CLEARANCES DC, IMPORTERS I

 AND TO_CHAR(DC.OBSRV_STRT_DATE,'YYYY-MM-MI') <= TO_CHAR(H_DATE,'YYYY-MM-MI')
 AND TO_CHAR(DC.OBSRV_END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-MI') >= TO_CHAR(H_DATE,'YYYY-MM-MI')
 ;
 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_DECLOCSTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_DecLocSts IS
V_ISD_CNTNR_COUNT NUMBER;
pl_id ParamList;
ret NUMBER;
pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'INSPTN_POSES_PARAM';
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_ISD_CNTNR_COUNT FROM DCLTN_INSPTN_POSES
 WHERE port_cd = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND dcltn_isn = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND CNTNR_LOC_STA IS NULL AND SND_RCV_STA = 1
 AND EXISTS
 (
 SELECT 1
 FROM declarations, sea_dlvy_orders ,sea_dlvy_items , vssl_bl_items , VSSL_CNTNRS ,VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS vci1
 WHERE declarations.port_cd=:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn=:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND declarations.port_cd=sea_dlvy_orders.port_cd
 AND declarations.DCLTN_ISN=sea_dlvy_orders.DCLTN_ISN
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.PORT_CD=sea_dlvy_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.SHPG_AGNT_NBR=sea_dlvy_ITEMS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.DO_NBR=sea_dlvy_ITEMS.DO_NBR
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.DO_ISS_DT=sea_dlvy_ITEMS.DO_ISS_DT
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_PORT_CD=VSSL_bl_items.PORT_CD
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE=VSSL_bl_items.MFST_TYPE
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_NBR=VSSL_bl_items.MFST_NBR
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_DT=VSSL_bl_items.MFST_DT
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.BL_SEQ=VSSL_bl_items.BL_SEQ
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ=VSSL_bl_items.ITEM_SEQ
 AND VSSL_bl_items.PORT_CD=VSSL_Cntnrs.PORT_CD
 AND VSSL_bl_items.MFST_TYPE=VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_TYPE
 AND VSSL_bl_items.MFST_NBR=VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_NBR
 AND VSSL_bl_items.MFST_DT=VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_DT
 AND VSSL_bl_items.CNTNR_SEQ=VSSL_Cntnrs.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.PORT_CD=vci1.PORT_CD
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_TYPE=vci1.MFST_TYPE
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_NBR =vci1.MFST_NBR
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_DT =vci1.MFST_DT
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.CNTNR_SEQ=vci1.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VSSL_Cntnrs.CNTNR_MRK=DCLTN_INSPTN_POSES.CNTNR_NBR
 AND ((vci1.INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1 AND vci1.INSPCT_RESULT_CD=2)
 OR (vci1.INSPCT_ACTN_CD=5 AND vci1.INSPCT_RESULT_CD=8))
 AND isd_flag=1


 ) ;



 IF V_ISD_CNTNR_COUNT =1 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_INSPTN_POSES SET CNTNR_LOC_STA=7 , SND_RCV_STA = 2
 WHERE port_cd = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND dcltn_isn = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND CNTNR_LOC_STA IS NULL AND SND_RCV_STA = 1;


 edi_trg.database_xml_create (2, 'IDEC_MSG.DecLocSts', 'DatabaseDecLocSts', 'DEC', 'DCLTN_INSPTN_POSES',:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN);

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 183, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD||'!'||:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 COMMIT;
 Str.DispAlert('تم ارسال رسالة الى شركة التفريغ بعدم جاهزية الحاوية','INFORMATION');


 ELSIF V_ISD_CNTNR_COUNT >1 THEN

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list ' || pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PORT_CD );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_TASK_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID);


 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_USER_NAME' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_JOB_ID' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_USER_TYPE' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_USER_ID' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_WS_ID' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);



 CALL_FORM('D:\PROD\CSTMS_DCLTN\fmx\DCLN4800.fmx', no_hide, no_replace, no_query_only, pl_id);

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE

 RET := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOT EXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;




 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_CERT_IE2_IE3
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_CERT_IE2_IE3 IS
 v_chk_cert_ie2_ie3 NUMBER;
 v_cert_status NUMBER := 0;
 v_chk NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 IF :declarations.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 THEN
 v_chk_cert_ie2_ie3 :=
 NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CHK_CERT_IE2_IE3', 21), 0);

 IF NVL (v_chk_cert_ie2_ie3, 0) = 1
 THEN
-----------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------
 DECLARE
 CURSOR c1
 IS
 SELECT port_cd, item_isn
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND duty_type NOT IN (8,26)
 AND final_tariff_cd IN
 (SELECT hrmnzd_code FROM group_items WHERE grp_code = 203);
 BEGIN
 v_chk := 0;
 v_cert_status := 0;

 FOR x IN c1
 LOOP
--=================================================================================
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cert_status
 FROM dcltn_cert_ie2_ie3
 WHERE port_cd = x.port_cd
 AND item_isn = x.item_isn
 AND cert_status IN (1, 3);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 v_cert_status := NVL (v_cert_status, 0);
 v_chk := NVL (v_chk, 0);

 IF NVL (v_cert_status, 0) = 0
 THEN
 v_chk := v_chk + 1;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
--=================================================================================
 END LOOP;

 IF v_chk > 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert
 ('لا يمكن التحويل للتحصيل لعدم تأكيد مواصفة التحقق من مستوى كفاءة الطاقة',
 'ERROR'
 );
 terminate_fun;
 END IF;
 END;
-----------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_AIR_SHPMT_BEFORE_CLOSE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
--UPDATE CHECK AIR SHPMT BEFORE CLOSE()
--DESCRIPTION: CHECK AIR SHPMT
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARAF HASHIM
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 20-03-2005
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/


PROCEDURE CHK_AIR_SHPMT_BEFORE_CLOSE IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 Ret NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN
 -- RET := STR.DispALERT('يوجد اذن تسليم مربوط بالمعاملة ..هل تريد فصل الاذن عن البيان؟','CONFIRM');
 --
 RET := STR.DispALERT(' سيتم فصل اذن التسليم المربوط بالمعاملة عن البيان...','INFORMATION');

 UPDATE AIR_DLVY_ORDERS SET STMT_ISN = NULL , CLRNC_TYPE = NULL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 3, :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD||'!'||:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --UPDATE BY ANAS ALHABASHI 10/06/2006 --
ELSE -- case of export dcltn

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM BILLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_COUNT>0 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT(' سيتم فصل البوليصة عن البيان...','INFORMATION');
 UPDATE BILLS
 SET STMT_ISN = NULL ,BILL_STATUS=2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN= :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 5, :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD||'!'||:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --END UPDATE BY ANAS ALHABASHI --
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_AGENT_BILL_OWNER_NAMES_SCR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION chk_agent_bill_owner_names_scr (
 v_port_cd IN NUMBER,
 v_dcltn_isn IN NUMBER,
 dcltn_type IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
 agent_nbr IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
 agent_name IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
 dcltn_kind IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N'
 )
 RETURN NUMBER
 IS
--- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. :4853) @ 30/11/2005
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- THIS FUNCTION RETURN ONE OF THE FOLLOWING :
--- 0 ===> MATCH
--- 1 ===> NOT MATCH
--- -1 ===> Exception
--- HINT : PARAMETER DCLTN_KIND HAS TWO VALUSE ['N' ===> NORMAL DECLARATION --- 'S' ===> STATS. DECLARATION]
 v_dcltn_type NUMBER;
 v_agent_nbr NUMBER;
 v_sdo_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_bill_owners_counter NUMBER;
 v_ret NUMBER;
 v_bill_owner_name VARCHAR2 (200);
 v_agent_name VARCHAR2 (200);
 v_lic_nbr NUMBER;
/*
 CURSOR C_BILL_OWNERS IS
 SELECT DISTINCT BL_OWNERS.OWNER_NAME , NVL(SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.IMPR_NBR,0) IMPR_NBR
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS, BL_OWNERS
 WHERE (
 (BL_OWNERS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_PORT_CD) AND
 (BL_OWNERS.MFST_TYPE = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_TYPE) AND
 (BL_OWNERS.MFST_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_NBR) AND
 (BL_OWNERS.MFST_DT = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_DT) AND
 (BL_OWNERS.OWNER_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.OWNER_NBR) AND
 (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD ) AND
 (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN )
 );
*/
 CURSOR c_dcltn_bill_owners
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT bl_owners.owner_name,
 NVL (sea_dlvy_orders.impr_nbr, 0) impr_nbr,
 sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_port_cd,
 sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_type,
 sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_nbr,
 sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_dt
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders, bl_owners
 WHERE ( (bl_owners.port_cd =
 sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_port_cd
 )
 AND (bl_owners.mfst_type = sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_type
 )
 AND (bl_owners.mfst_nbr = sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_nbr
 )
 AND (bl_owners.mfst_dt = sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_dt)
 AND (bl_owners.owner_nbr = sea_dlvy_orders.owner_nbr
 )
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.port_cd = v_port_cd)
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn)
 );

 CURSOR c_stat_bill_owners
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT bl_owners.owner_name,
 NVL (sea_dlvy_orders.impr_nbr, 0) impr_nbr
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders, bl_owners
 WHERE ( (bl_owners.port_cd =
 sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_port_cd
 )
 AND (bl_owners.mfst_type = sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_type
 )
 AND (bl_owners.mfst_nbr = sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_nbr
 )
 AND (bl_owners.mfst_dt = sea_dlvy_orders.mfst_dt)
 AND (bl_owners.owner_nbr = sea_dlvy_orders.owner_nbr
 )
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.port_cd = v_port_cd)
 AND (sea_dlvy_orders.stats_dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 )
 );
 BEGIN
 ----- STEP 1 : GET AGENT NAME
 IF dcltn_type IS NULL
 THEN
 BEGIN
 IF dcltn_kind = 'N'
 THEN
 SELECT importers.arbc_impr_name, declarations.dcltn_type_cd,
 declarations.agent_nbr
 INTO v_agent_name, v_dcltn_type,
 v_agent_nbr
 FROM declarations, importers
 WHERE ( (importers.port_cd = declarations.port_cd)
 AND (importers.impr_nbr = declarations.agent_nbr)
 AND (declarations.port_cd = v_port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn)
 );
 ELSE --- DCLTN_KIND = 'S'
 SELECT importers.arbc_impr_name, stats_dcltns.stats_type_cd,
 stats_dcltns.impr_expr_nbr,
 NVL (stats_dcltns.lic_nbr, 0)
 INTO v_agent_name, v_dcltn_type,
 v_agent_nbr,
 v_lic_nbr
 FROM stats_dcltns, importers
 WHERE ( (importers.port_cd = stats_dcltns.port_cd)
 AND (importers.impr_nbr = stats_dcltns.impr_expr_nbr)
 AND (stats_dcltns.port_cd = v_port_cd)
 AND (stats_dcltns.stats_isn = v_dcltn_isn)
 );
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 RETURN -1;
 END;
 ELSE
 v_dcltn_type := dcltn_type;
 v_agent_nbr := agent_nbr;
 v_agent_name := agent_name;
 END IF;

---------------

 ----- STEP 2 : GET BILL OWNERS NAME
 BEGIN
 v_bill_owners_counter := 0;

 --- LOOP TO CHK. EACH BILL OWNER NAME WITH IMPORTER NAME
 IF (dcltn_kind = 'N') THEN

 FOR rec IN c_dcltn_bill_owners LOOP
 v_bill_owners_counter := v_bill_owners_counter + 1;
 v_sdo_impr_nbr := rec.impr_nbr;

 IF v_sdo_impr_nbr = 0 THEN

 v_bill_owner_name := rec.owner_name;
 v_ret := str_db.namesmatch (v_agent_name, v_bill_owner_name);

 IF (v_ret <> 0)
 THEN
 RETURN v_ret;
 END IF;

 ELSE

 IF v_sdo_impr_nbr <> v_agent_nbr
 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 FOR rec IN c_stat_bill_owners
 LOOP
 v_bill_owners_counter := v_bill_owners_counter + 1;
 v_sdo_impr_nbr := rec.impr_nbr;

 IF v_sdo_impr_nbr = 0
 THEN
 --- WE WILL CHECK THE NAMES IN CASE IMPORTER OF SDO IS NULL.
 v_bill_owner_name := rec.owner_name;
 v_ret :=
 str_db.namesmatch (v_agent_name, v_bill_owner_name);

 IF (v_ret <> 0)
 THEN
 RETURN v_ret;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF v_sdo_impr_nbr <> v_agent_nbr
 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;

 ---

 --- CASE NO BILL OWNERS FOR DECLARATION [I.E. NO SDO]
 IF v_bill_owners_counter = 0
 THEN
 IF dcltn_kind = 'N'
 THEN
 IF v_dcltn_type = 2
 THEN --- CASE DIRECT IMPORT
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 RETURN -1;
 END IF;
 ELSE --- DCLTN_KIND = 'S'
 IF v_lic_nbr = 0
 THEN --- CASE DIRECT STATS IMPORT
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 RETURN -1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ---
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 RETURN -1;
 END;

---------------
 RETURN 0;
 END chk_agent_bill_owner_names_scr;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_WVRS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_WVRS IS
V_BUS_ID VARCHAR2(20);
V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
v_setting NUMBER:=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('DCLTN_STOP_PMT_MTHD',21),0);
V_EXIST NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXIST
FROM DCLTN_PMT_MTHD_APRV
WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
AND PRICING_ACCEPT_FLAG = 1;
IF v_setting = 1 AND V_EXIST = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT BUS_ID,BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_BUS_ID,V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN ;
 END;

DECLARE
V_MSG VARCHAR2(1000);
V_CLR_RET NUMBER;
XLINE NUMBER:=2;
CURSOR S IS SELECT PORT_NAME,WVR_SEQ_NBR,ISSUED_DT,ITEM_TYPE_NAME
FROM
wvr_items_globals wvr,sd_ports sd,WVR_TYPES WT
WHERE WVR.ITEM_TYPE_CD=WT.ITEM_TYPE_CD AND
sd.port_cd = wvr.WVR_PORT_CD AND
WVR.item_type_cd IN (15,16) AND (ITEM_STATUS=0 OR ITEM_STATUS IS NULL)
AND ITEM_CLRNC_DT IS NULL AND BUS_ID=V_BUS_ID AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD =V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
AND ITEM_END_DT < HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
BEGIN
V_MSG:='يوجد تعهدات على هذا المستورد منتهية و غير مسددة وهى كالتالى : '||CHR(10);
FOR REC IN S LOOP
XLINE:=XLINE+1;
V_MSG:=V_MSG||REC.PORT_NAME||' تعهد رقم '||REC.WVR_SEQ_NBR||' بتاريخ '||TO_CHAR(REC.ISSUED_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY')||' من نوع '||REC.ITEM_TYPE_NAME||CHR(10);
END LOOP;
V_MSG:=V_MSG||'ولابد من تحويله لقسم القيمه لإتخاذ قرار لن يتم الاستمرار فى التحصيل'||CHR(10);
IF XLINE > 2 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXIST
FROM DCLTN_PMT_MTHD_APRV
WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;
IF V_EXIST = 0 THEN
INSERT INTO DCLTN_PMT_MTHD_APRV D(D.PORT_CD, D.DCLTN_STATS_ISN, D.DCLTN_STATS_FLAG,
 D.PRICING_ACCEPT_FLAG)
VALUES(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN,1,0);
STANDARD.COMMIT;
END IF;
V_CLR_RET :=FLASH_CLR_ALERT (V_MSG ,
 'ERROR',
 1,
 'رسالة خطأ',
 5.5,
 2.2,
 2.5,
 0.5,
 1300,
 'r0g0b0',
 'r200g200b200',
 XLINE

 ) ;

TERMINATE_FUN;
END IF;
END;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_WIEGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_wieght IS
 CURSOR C1 IS
 SELECT item_seq--, dcltn_isn,GROSS_WT,NET_WT
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND dcltn_isn = :DECLARATIONS.dcltn_isn
 AND NET_WT < (GROSS_WT/2)
 ;
 --:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_BRKR') THEN
 V_ACTVTY_EXIST NUMBER;
 V_ITEM_SEQ VARCHAR2(3900);
 V_RET VARCHAR2(100);
 V_ACTVTY_TYPE NUMBER;

BEGIN
IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD in (1,2)AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_insp'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_aff') )and nvl(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('WEIGHT_LESS_THAN_50', 21),0)=1 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_insp') THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_ACTVTY_EXIST
 FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = 21
 AND SUBJ_CODE = 1
 AND ACTVY_TYPE IN(149,150)
 AND ACTVY_SUB_ID = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ||'!'||:DECLARATIONS.dcltn_isn
 ;
 END IF;

 IF (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_insp')AND V_ACTVTY_EXIST = 0 ) OR :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_aff') THEN
 FOR I IN C1 LOOP
 IF V_ITEM_SEQ IS NULL THEN
 V_ITEM_SEQ := I.ITEM_SEQ;
 ELSE
 V_ITEM_SEQ := V_ITEM_SEQ ||' , '||I.item_seq;
 END IF;
-- IF (LENGTH(V_RET) > 3900) THEN
 -- V_ITEM_SEQ := V_ITEM_SEQ || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 -- EXIT;
 -- END IF;

 END LOOP;
 IF V_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(CHR(1000) ||' الاصناف التالية الأوزان الصافيه لها أقل من 50% من الأوزان القائمه' ||' ( '||V_ITEM_SEQ ||' ) '
 ||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||'هل أنت موافق ؟',
 'WARNING',2,
 'عرض بيانات الاصناف'
 ,7.5,1.11,2.0,0.5,1300,
 'r0g0b1',4);
 IF V_RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_insp') THEN
 V_ACTVTY_TYPE := 149;
 ELSE
 V_ACTVTY_TYPE := 151;
 END IF;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, V_ACTVTY_TYPE, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_insp') THEN
 V_ACTVTY_TYPE := 150;
 ELSE
 V_ACTVTY_TYPE := 152;
 END IF;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, V_ACTVTY_TYPE, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 IF V_ACTVTY_TYPE = 152 THEN
 forms_ddl('commit');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 forms_ddl('commit');
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--CHECK_TEMP_ITEM_LETERS
--DESCRIPTION : CHECK IF THERE IS TEMP ITEM AND HAS LETER OR NOT
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 05-02-2005
----------------------------------------------------------------

PROCEDURE CHECK_TEMP_ITEM_LETER IS
 V_HAS_NO_LETER BOOLEAN:=FALSE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(200);
 V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP NUMBER;
 CURSOR V_ITEM_CUR IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, ITEM_ISN, ITEM_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- AND (DUTY_TYPE = DCLTN.DT_INS_TEMP OR NVL(TEMP_ITEM,0)=1);
 AND (DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_TEMP') OR NVL(TEMP_ITEM,0)=1);
--&&& END
BEGIN
 V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP :=GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('LINK_EXP_2_IMP',21);
 IF V_LINK_EXP_2_IMP >= 2 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- AND (DUTY_TYPE = DCLTN.DT_INS_TEMP OR NVL(TEMP_ITEM,0)=1);
 AND (DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_TEMP') OR NVL(TEMP_ITEM,0)=1);
--&&& END
 IF V_COUNT =0 THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN;
 END;

 FOR I IN V_ITEM_CUR LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEM_LETRS
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND ITEM_ISN = I.ITEM_ISN;
 IF V_COUNT=0 THEN
 V_MSG :='- يوجد صنف رقم ' || I.ITEM_SEQ || ' - مؤقت وليس له خطاب';
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_SMPL_REQ
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--MMAOUA
PROCEDURE CHECK_SMPL_REQ IS
 V_ASSD_VALUE VARCHAR2(200);
 V_ASR_VALUE VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CSRF NUMBER;
 V_SDS_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_CNT_EX NUMBER;
 V_SMPL_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_ASR_VALUE := gnrl.get_customs_setting('AUTO_SMPL_REQUEST', 5);
 IF V_ASR_VALUE = '1' THEN
 -----19092019-------
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT_EX
 FROM SMPL_DCLTN_STATS_ITEMS DT, SMPL_DCLTN_STATS MS
 WHERE DT.PORT_CD = MS.PORT_CD
 AND DT.SDS_SEQ = MS.SDS_SEQ
 AND NVL(MS.DCLTN_ISN,STATS_ISN) = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DT.SMPL_ACTION_CODE IN (5,42,30,31,32,232)
 AND EXISTS
 (SELECT 1 FROM SMPL_REQUESTS SM
 WHERE SM.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN);
 END;
 ------------
-------------CHK FOR SMPL REQ --02/07/2020---
SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_SMPL_CNT
 FROM SMPL_REQUESTS SR
 WHERE SR.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN AND SR.RQST_PORT_CD = :PORT_CD ;
------------------------------------------

 BEGIN
 SELECT CREATE_SMPL_REQUEST_FLAG, SDS_SEQ INTO V_CSRF, V_SDS_SEQ
 FROM SMPL_DCLTN_STATS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_ASSD_VALUE := gnrl.get_customs_setting('AUTO_SMPL_START_DT', 5);
 IF TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= V_ASSD_VALUE THEN
 SMPL.CREATE_SMPL_DCLTN_STATS(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_TYPE_CD);
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 SELECT SDS_SEQ INTO V_SDS_SEQ
 FROM SMPL_DCLTN_STATS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;
 V_CSRF := 0;
 END IF;
 END;
 IF V_CSRF = 0 THEN
 IF V_SMPL_CNT = 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM SMPL_DCLTN_STATS_ITEMS SDSI
 WHERE SDSI.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND SDSI.SDS_SEQ = V_SDS_SEQ
 AND SDSI.SMPL_ACTION_CODE IN (8,9,40,41,43,50,51,55,56,60,61,99,100,101,102,110,120);

 IF V_COUNT = 0 AND V_CNT_EX = 0 THEN
 str.dispalert(' لا يوجد طلب تحليل عينات، جميع الصناف مستثناة، لن يتم التحويل لقسم المختبر وتحليل العينات','error');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSIF V_COUNT > 0 AND V_CNT_EX = 0 THEN
 str.dispalert(' يجب تكوين طلب تحليل العينات الآلي قبل التحويل لقسم المختبر وتحليل العينات','error');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

/******************************************************************************************************/
-- NEW CHECK_PAY_WITHOUT_PRNT
-- DESCRIPTION: TO CHECK ON THE FLAG PAY_WITHOUT_PRNIT AND UPDATE PRINT_CNT AND NEED_PRINT
-- PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM EXT.: 4295
