PROCEDURE CHECK_PAY_WITHOUT_PRNT IS
 V_REVENUE_CHNGD NUMBER;
 V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT NUMBER;
 V_CL_VAL NUMBER;
 V_CALC_DT DATE;
 V_PAYER VARCHAR2(1000);
 V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN



 V_CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;

 V_PAYER := DCLTN.GET_DCLTN_PAYER_NAME(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--V_REVENUE_CHNGD := DUTY.CALC_DCLTN_FEES(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, V_CALC_DT, V_PAYER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, NULL, TRUE, V_CL_VAL);
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));

 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');

 V_REVENUE_CHNGD := DUTY.CALC_DCLTN_FEES(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, V_CALC_DT, V_PAYER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, NULL, 1, V_CL_VAL, V_MSG_TXT);

 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
--&&& END

 V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT',999),0);

 IF V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT = 1 THEN

 IF V_REVENUE_CHNGD >= 0 THEN

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 IF NVL(:DECLARATIONS.PRINT_CNT,0)=0 THEN

 :DECLARATIONS.PRINT_CNT :=1;

 END IF;

 IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN

 IF NOT (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (9,5) AND :DECLARATIONS.PMT_METHOD IN (1,2)) THEN


 :DECLARATIONS.NEED_PRINT :=0;
 END IF;

 ELSE

 :DECLARATIONS.NEED_PRINT :=0;
 END IF;



 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 COMMIT;
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSE --V_REVENUE_CHNGD = -1 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
--&&& END
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن حساب رسوم البيان - راجع الحاسب الآلي','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_PASS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_PASS IS
X NUMBER;
Y NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT NVL(SUM(INV_COST*REVENUE.GET_CURRENCY_RATE(INV_CURCY_CD,:DCLTN_DT)),0) INTO Y FROM DCLTN_INVOICES,DCLTN_ITEMS
WHERE DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN=DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN
AND DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD=:PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN
AND FINAL_TARIFF_CD IN (SELECT HRMNZD_CODE FROM GROUP_ITEMS WHERE GRP_CODE IN (123,150));
IF Y > 60000 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X FROM PASSENGER_TRIPS
WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN;
IF X = 0 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('لابد من إدخال نموذج الإفصاح','ERROR');
TERMINATE_FUN;
END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_NO_OF_CARRIED_CARS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_NO_OF_CARRIED_CARS IS
v_count_vcard_cars NUMBER := 0;
v_count_all_cars NUMBER := 0;
v_count_master_vhcls NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN

IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 3 AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 SELECT NVL(SUM(inv_qty),0) INTO v_count_vcard_cars FROM dcltn_items, group_items
 WHERE dcltn_items.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_items.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd = group_items.hrmnzd_code
 AND grp_code = 76
 AND duty_type NOT IN (7, 8, 26)
 ;

IF v_count_vcard_cars > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count_all_cars FROM
 (
 SELECT vt.vhcl_chassis_no
 FROM declarations d,dcltn_land_mnfsts dlm,dcltn_land_mnfst_trans dlmt,vhcl_transactions vt
 WHERE d.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND d.port_cd = dlm.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = dlm.dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dlmt.dcltn_mnfst_isn
 AND dlmt.port_cd = vt.port_cd
 AND dlmt.trans_date_h = vt.trans_date_h
 AND dlmt.tran_seq = vt.tran_seq
 UNION
 SELECT vt.vhcl_chassis_no
 FROM declarations d, dcltn_gate_trans dgt, vhcl_transactions vt
 WHERE d.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND d.port_cd = dgt.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = dgt.dcltn_isn
 AND vt.port_cd = dgt.port_cd
 AND vt.trans_date_h = dgt.vhcl_trans_date
 AND vt.tran_seq = dgt.vhcl_trans_nbr
 AND DGT.DGT_TYPE <> 7
 )
 ;


 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count_master_vhcls FROM
 (
 SELECT vt.vhcl_chassis_no
 FROM declarations d,dcltn_land_mnfsts dlm,dcltn_land_mnfst_trans dlmt,vhcl_transactions vt
 WHERE d.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND d.port_cd = dlm.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = dlm.dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dlmt.dcltn_mnfst_isn
 AND dlmt.port_cd = vt.port_cd
 AND dlmt.trans_date_h = vt.trans_date_h
 AND dlmt.tran_seq = vt.tran_seq
 AND vt.vhcl_tran_type IN (5,11)
 AND INSTR(vt.PLATE_NO,'محرك')<1

 UNION
 SELECT vt.vhcl_chassis_no
 FROM declarations d, dcltn_gate_trans dgt, vhcl_transactions vt
 WHERE d.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND d.port_cd = dgt.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = dgt.dcltn_isn
 AND vt.port_cd = dgt.port_cd
 AND vt.trans_date_h = dgt.vhcl_trans_date
 AND vt.tran_seq = dgt.vhcl_trans_nbr
 AND vt.vhcl_tran_type IN (5,11)
 AND INSTR(vt.PLATE_NO,'محرك') < 1
 AND DGT.DGT_TYPE <> 7)
 ;



 IF v_count_all_cars <> (v_count_vcard_cars + v_count_master_vhcls) THEN
 str.dispalert('يوجد سيارات غير مرتبطه مع البيان','error');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_NONE_GROUP_MGR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_NONE_GROUP_MGR(V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) IS
V_GROUP_ID NUMBER;
x NUMBER;
v_NONE_OUTOF_GRP_INSP NUMBER:=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('NONE_OUTOF_GRP_INSP',21),0);
BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF') THEN
SELECT GROUP_ID INTO V_GROUP_ID FROM DECLARATIONS
WHERE PORT_CD=:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN=V_DCLTN_ISN;
SELECT SUM(v_count) INTO x FROM
(SELECT COUNT(*) v_count FROM DCLTN_GRPS
WHERE port_cd = :parameter.p_curr_port_cd
AND GRP_ID = V_GROUP_ID AND :parameter.p_user_id IN (MGR_ID,DEPUTY_MGR_ID) AND grp_status = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS
WHERE port_cd = :parameter.p_curr_port_cd
AND GRP_ID = V_GROUP_ID AND :parameter.p_user_id IN (MANGER,DEPUTY_MGR_ID) AND status = 1
AND (
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'hh24:mi') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SFT_STIME,'hh24:mi') AND TO_CHAR(SFT_ETIME,'hh24:mi')
OR
TO_CHAR(SFT_eTIME,'hh24:mi') < TO_CHAR(SFT_sTIME,'hh24:mi')
))
;
--halsaadi added AND :parameter.p_user_id NOT LIKE 'COC%'
 IF x = 0 AND v_NONE_OUTOF_GRP_INSP = 1 AND :parameter.p_user_id NOT LIKE 'APPDEV%' AND :parameter.p_user_id NOT LIKE 'APPQA%' AND :parameter.p_user_id NOT LIKE 'COC%' THEN
 str.dispalert ('ليس لديك حق الإستعلام عن هذه البيانات',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_MILITARY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_military IS

V_MSG VARCHAR2 (1000);
RET NUMBER;

CURSOR DCLT_ITEM_CUR IS SELECT FINAL_TARIFF_CD,BUY_CTRY_CD,ROUTE_DESC,ITEM_SEQ FROM DCLTN_ITEMS WHERE
PORT_CD =:PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_ISN;
V_THERE_IS_ERROR BOOLEAN :=FALSE;
 FUNCTION IN_MIL_TAR (V_HARM VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 FOUND NUMBER;
 BEGIN


 SELECT 1 INTO FOUND FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS
 (SELECT 1 FROM GROUP_ITEMS G
 WHERE G.HRMNZD_CODE=V_HARM
 AND GRP_CODE IN (30,73,74)) ;
 RETURN 1;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN 0;
 END;


BEGIN

 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 FOR ITE_ITEMS IN DCLT_ITEM_CUR LOOP
 IF ITE_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF IN_MIL_TAR(ITE_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD)= 1 THEN
 IF ITE_ITEMS.ROUTE_DESC IS NULL OR ITE_ITEMS.BUY_CTRY_CD IS NULL THEN
 V_MSG :=V_MSG ||'الصنف رقم '||ITE_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ||CHR(10);
 IF NOT V_THERE_IS_ERROR THEN
 V_THERE_IS_ERROR:=TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;


 IF V_THERE_IS_ERROR THEN
 RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(CHR(1000)||V_MSG, 'INFORMATION', 1, 'هنالك اصناف يجب ادخال بلد الشراء ومسار الشحنة',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 12);
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_ITEM_RSTRCTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_ITEM_RSTRCTN IS
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT NUMBER := 0;
 V_ITEM_RLZ_STA NUMBER := 0;
 V_CNSMTNS_QTY NUMBER;
 V_RSTRCT BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_CNSMTNS_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_CNSMTNS_APRVD NUMBER;
 V_LTR_REQ NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_RESTRCD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
 V_INTL_ITEM_QTY NUMBER;
 V_DUM NUMBER;

 P_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_REST NUMBER;
 V_IMP_154 NUMBER;
 V_ARMCO_EXCP_REST VARCHAR2(20) := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('ARMCO_EXCP_REST',21),'01-01-1400');
 CURSOR V_ITEM_CUR IS
 SELECT FINAL_TARIFF_CD, PORT_CD, EXMTN_APRVL_DT, EXMTN_TYPE, EXMTN_DECREE_ISN,
 EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD, EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ, EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ, ITEM_ISN, INTL_QTY,
 INV_QTY, ITEM_SEQ,RST_PRH_CHK
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- AND DUTY_TYPE NOT IN (DCLTN.DT_DESTROY, DCLTN.DT_RE_EXPORT, DCLTN.DT_SEIZER, DCLTN.DT_DUTY_IN_OTHER_PORT)
 AND DUTY_TYPE NOT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DESTROY'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RE_EXPORT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_SEIZER'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DUTY_IN_OTHER_PORT'))
--&&& END
 ;

FUNCTION CHECK_TRF_ITEM_PETR(H_ITEM IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_PROH_EXIST NUMBER;
BEGIN
-- 0 ===> SUCESS : NO PROBLEM TO EXPORT FROM THE CURRENT PORT.
-- 1 ===> FAIL : PROH. TO EXPORT .

 V_PROH_EXIST := 0;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_PROH_EXIST
 FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE GROUP_ITEMS.GRP_CODE = 96
 AND GROUP_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE = H_ITEM;

 IF V_PROH_EXIST > 0 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 RETURN 0;

END CHECK_TRF_ITEM_PETR;
FUNCTION CHECK_T RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
-- 0 ===> SUCESS : NO PROBLEM TO EXPORT FROM THE CURRENT PORT.
-- 1 ===> FAIL : PROH. TO EXPORT .

 V_COUNT := 0;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM
VSSL_BLS VB,VSSL_BL_ITEMS VI
WHERE VB.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
AND VB.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
AND VB.PORT_CD = VI.PORT_CD
 AND VB.MFST_TYPE = VI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VB.MFST_NBR = VI.MFST_NBR
 AND VB.MFST_DT = VI.MFST_DT
 AND VB.BL_SEQ = VI.BL_SEQ


AND VI.PORT_CD||VI.MFST_TYPE||VI.MFST_NBR||VI.MFST_DT||VI.BL_SEQ||'-'||VI.ITEM_SEQ NOT IN
(
SELECT VI.PORT_CD||VI.MFST_TYPE||VI.MFST_NBR||VI.MFST_DT||VI.BL_SEQ||'-'||VI.ITEM_SEQ FROM
VSSL_BLS VB,VSSL_BL_ITEMS VI,BL_ITEM_ENTRIES BE,BA_OUT_ITEMS OI,BA_STRG_REQS SR
WHERE VB.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND VB.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND VB.PORT_CD = VI.PORT_CD
 AND VB.MFST_TYPE = VI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VB.MFST_NBR = VI.MFST_NBR
 AND VB.MFST_DT = VI.MFST_DT
 AND VB.BL_SEQ = VI.BL_SEQ

 AND VI.PORT_CD = BE.PORT_CD
 AND VI.MFST_TYPE = BE.MFST_TYPE
 AND VI.MFST_NBR = BE.MFST_NBR
 AND VI.MFST_DT = BE.MFST_DT
 AND VI.BL_SEQ = BE.BL_SEQ
 AND VI.ITEM_SEQ = BE.ITEM_SEQ
 AND BE.ENTRY_LOC_CD=4

 AND BE.PORT_CD = OI.PORT_CD
 AND BE.EXIT_REQ_NBR=OI.OUT_REQ_NBR
 AND BE.EXIT_REQ_DT=OI.OUT_REQ_DT
 AND BE.OUT_ITEM_SEQ=OI.OUT_ITEM_SEQ

 AND OI.PORT_CD = SR.PORT_CD
 AND OI.STRG_REQ_NBR=SR.STRG_REQ_NBR
 AND OI.STRG_REQ_DT=SR.STRG_REQ_DT

 AND SR.GOODS_ORIGIN_CD IN (1,3)
);

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 RETURN 0;

END CHECK_T;
--BY NABIL ALSALEH @ 01/11/2011
FUNCTION CHECK_TRF_ITEM_PETR_GRP_128(H_ITEM IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_PROH_EXIST NUMBER;
BEGIN
-- 0 ===> SUCESS : NO PROBLEM TO EXPORT FROM THE CURRENT PORT.
-- 1 ===> FAIL : PROH. TO EXPORT .

 V_PROH_EXIST := 0;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_PROH_EXIST
 FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE GROUP_ITEMS.GRP_CODE = 128
 AND GROUP_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE = H_ITEM;

 IF V_PROH_EXIST > 0 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 RETURN 0;

END CHECK_TRF_ITEM_PETR_GRP_128;

BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_IMP_154 FROM
GROUP_IMPRS WHERE GRP_CODE=154 AND HQ_IMPR_NBR=(SELECT HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NBR);
-- --> 10/04/2013 AHMED A-MONIM Using TRF PRCDR = 72
-------------------------------------------------------
 IF CHK_PRCDR_72(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN) = 1 THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
--------------------------------------------------------
-- --< 10/04/2013 AHMED A-MONIM Using TRF PRCDR = 72
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF ((DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) AND :FINAL_CTRY_CD = DCLTN.KSA) OR DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD)) THEN
 IF ((DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND :FINAL_CTRY_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.KSA')) OR DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1) THEN
--&&& END
 -- THIS CHECK TO ALLOW ARAMCO TO EXPORT WITHOUT RESTRCTIONS
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) AND ((:PORT_CD = 32) OR
 IF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND ((:PORT_CD = 32) OR
--&&& END
 (:PORT_CD = 42 AND :AGENT_NBR IN (3102708, 3298182, 29)) OR
 (:PORT_CD IN (17,19) AND :AGENT_NBR IN (3478856, 3058219, 88, 3287452,3101962)) OR
 (:PORT_CD = 96 AND :AGENT_NBR = 2)
 ) THEN
 RETURN; -- NO CHECK
 END IF;

FOR I IN V_ITEM_CUR LOOP

------------- ALAA FAWZY 05-05-1432 -------------
IF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1
AND DCLTN.CHECK_GRP_122(I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD ,:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN, 1, P_MSG_TXT ) = 1
THEN
 NULL ; -- NO NEED MORE ACTION
-------------------------------------------------

ELSIF CHK_HRMZ_CODE_NOT_RES(I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD)=1 AND DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
NULL;

ELSIF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND :port_cd=69 AND CHECK_TRF_ITEM_PETR(I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD) =1 THEN
NULL;

--BY NABIL ALSALEH @ 01/11/2011
ELSIF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND CHECK_TRF_ITEM_PETR_GRP_128(I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD) =1 AND PETR_TERM_SEASON_WORK(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_DT,'MM'))) THEN

NULL;

ELSIF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND CHCK_ITEM_GRP(I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,107)=1 AND I.RST_PRH_CHK =4 THEN

NULL;
ELSIF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND CHCK_ITEM_GRP(I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,154)=1
 AND TO_DATE(V_ARMCO_EXCP_REST,'MI/MM/YYYY') > HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date AND V_IMP_154 > 0 THEN

NULL;

------------ alaa fawzy 22/01/1432 28-12-2010-----------------
ELSIF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND CHCK_ITEM_GRP(I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,121)=1 AND I.RST_PRH_CHK =4 THEN

NULL;

--ELSIF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND CHECK_T=0 THEN
--NULL;

ELSE


 SELECT ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT
 INTO V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT
 FROM HARMONIZED_TARIFF
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD;

 V_LTR_REQ := 0;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
/* IF (DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = TRUE AND
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT IN (TARIFF.RSTRCT_IMPORT, TARIFF.RSTRCT_ALL)) THEN*/
 IF (DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_IMPORT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_ALL'))) THEN
--&&& END

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_LTR_REQ
 FROM TARIFF_RELEASE_PROCEDURES TRP, TARIFF_ITEM_RISTRICTIONS TIR
 WHERE TIR.HRMNZD_CODE = I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND TRP.PRCDR_CODE = TIR.PRCDR_CODE
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- AND TRP.PRCDR_TYPE IN (TARIFF.RRPT_IMPORT, TARIFF.RRPT_ALL)
 AND TRP.PRCDR_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RRPT_IMPORT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RRPT_ALL'))
--&&& END
 AND ROWNUM = 1
 ;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
/* ELSIF (DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = TRUE AND
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT IN (TARIFF.RSTRCT_EXPORT, TARIFF.RSTRCT_ALL)) THEN*/
 ELSIF (DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_EXPORT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_ALL'))) THEN
--&&& END
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_LTR_REQ
 FROM TARIFF_RELEASE_PROCEDURES TRP, TARIFF_ITEM_RISTRICTIONS TIR
 WHERE TIR.HRMNZD_CODE = I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND TRP.PRCDR_CODE = TIR.PRCDR_CODE
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- AND TRP.PRCDR_TYPE IN (TARIFF.RRPT_EXPORT, TARIFF.RRPT_ALL)
 AND TRP.PRCDR_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RRPT_EXPORT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RRPT_ALL'))
--&&& END
 AND ROWNUM = 1
 ;
 END IF;

 IF V_LTR_REQ > 0 THEN
 IF I.EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND I.EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NOT NULL AND I.EXMTN_TYPE IN (2, 3, 4) THEN
 IF I.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN IS NOT NULL AND I.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT RSTRCT_STA_CD
 INTO V_ITEM_RLZ_STA
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES
 WHERE DECREE_PORT_CD = I.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DECREE_ISN = I.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;

 V_ITEM_RLZ_STA := NVL(V_ITEM_RLZ_STA, 0);

 IF V_ITEM_RLZ_STA = 2 AND I.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND I.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT ITEM_RLS_STA
 INTO V_ITEM_RLZ_STA
 FROM DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS
 WHERE APLCTN_PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND DECREE_PORT_CD = I.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DECREE_ISN = I.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 AND ITEM_SEQ = I.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ
 AND ITEM_SUB_SEQ = I.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 V_ITEM_RLZ_STA := NVL(V_ITEM_RLZ_STA, 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_ITEM_RLZ_STA <> 1 THEN

 DECLARE
 v_count NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM rlsd_items
 WHERE (port_cd, rlsd_hdr_isn, rlsd_itm_seq) IN (
 SELECT port_cd, rlsd_hdr_isn, rlsd_itm_seq
 FROM restrcn_cnsmtns
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_item_isn = i.item_isn)
 AND NVL (customs_approve, 0) = 2;---AAA;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) > 0
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('توجد بنود مرفوضة في قرارات فسح السلع المقيدة للصنف رقم '||I.ITEM_SEQ,'ERROR');
 V_RSTRCT := TRUE;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;


 SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(APRVD), SUM(QTY)
 INTO V_CNSMTNS_COUNT, V_CNSMTNS_APRVD,V_CNSMTNS_QTY
 FROM RESTRCN_CNSMTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = I.ITEM_ISN
 ;

 SELECT SUM(INTL_ITEM_QTY)
 INTO V_INTL_ITEM_QTY
 FROM RLSD_ITEMS
 WHERE (PORT_CD, RLSD_HDR_ISN, RLSD_ITM_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT PORT_CD, RLSD_HDR_ISN, RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 FROM RESTRCN_CNSMTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = I.ITEM_ISN
 )
 AND NVL(CUSTOMS_APPROVE,0) <> 2---AAA;
 ;

 V_CNSMTNS_QTY := NVL(V_CNSMTNS_QTY, 0);
 V_CNSMTNS_APRVD := NVL(V_CNSMTNS_APRVD, 0);
 V_INTL_ITEM_QTY := NVL(V_INTL_ITEM_QTY, 0);

 IF (V_CNSMTNS_QTY <> I.INTL_QTY AND V_INTL_ITEM_QTY > 0) OR (V_CNSMTNS_QTY <> I.INV_QTY AND V_INTL_ITEM_QTY = 0) THEN
 IF V_CNSMTNS_QTY <> 0 THEN
 IF V_INTL_ITEM_QTY > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الكمية المستخدمة من قرارات فسح السلع المقيدة لا تكفي لفسح كمية الصنف بالوحدة الدولية للصنف رقم '||I.ITEM_SEQ,'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('الكمية المستخدمة من قرارات فسح السلع المقيدة لا تكفي لفسح كمية الصنف بوحدة الفاتورة للصنف رقم '||I.ITEM_SEQ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تحديد قرارات فسح السلع المقيدة للصنف رقم '||I.ITEM_SEQ,'ERROR');
 END IF;

 V_RSTRCT := TRUE;
 ELSE
 IF V_CNSMTNS_COUNT <> V_CNSMTNS_APRVD THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تأكيد فسح السلع المقيدة للصنف رقم '||I.ITEM_SEQ,'ERROR');
 V_RSTRCT := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_RSTRCT THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 FOR I IN V_ITEM_CUR LOOP

IF CHK_HRMZ_CODE_NOT_RES(I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD)=1 AND DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
NULL;
ELSE
 SELECT ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT
 INTO V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT
 FROM HARMONIZED_TARIFF
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 ;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
/* IF (DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = TRUE AND
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT IN (TARIFF.RSTRCT_IMPORT, TARIFF.RSTRCT_ALL)) OR
 (DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = TRUE AND
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT IN (TARIFF.RSTRCT_EXPORT, TARIFF.RSTRCT_ALL)) THEN*/
 IF (DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_IMPORT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_ALL'))) OR
 (DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND
 V_ITEM_RSTRCT_STAT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_EXPORT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('TARIFF.RSTRCT_ALL'))) THEN
--&&& END
 V_DCLTN_RESTRCD := TRUE;
 END IF;
END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_DCLTN_RESTRCD AND :DECLARATIONS.RSTRCD_ITEMS = 0 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DECLARATIONS.RSTRCD_ITEMS := 1;
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 COMMIT;
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 ELSIF NOT V_DCLTN_RESTRCD AND :DECLARATIONS.RSTRCD_ITEMS = 1 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DECLARATIONS.RSTRCD_ITEMS := 0;
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 COMMIT;
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_ITEM_EXMPTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_ITEM_EXMPTN IS
 V_NOT_EXMPTN BOOLEAN;

 CURSOR V_ITEM_CUR IS
 SELECT EXMTN_APRVL_DT, ITEM_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- AND DUTY_TYPE NOT IN (DCLTN.DT_DESTROY, DCLTN.DT_RE_EXPORT, DCLTN.DT_SEIZER, DCLTN.DT_DUTY_IN_OTHER_PORT)
 AND DUTY_TYPE NOT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DESTROY'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RE_EXPORT'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_SEIZER'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DUTY_IN_OTHER_PORT'))
--&&& END
 AND EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL
 ;

 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) IN(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF'))
 AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR'))
 AND :DCLTN_STA_CD = 3
 THEN
 FOR I IN V_ITEM_CUR LOOP
 IF I.EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' الصنف رقم ( '||I.ITEM_SEQ||' ) يحتاج إلى تأكيد الإعفاء','INFORMATION');
 V_NOT_EXMPTN := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_NOT_EXMPTN THEN

 RET := STR.DISPALERT('هل تريد الإستمرار في التحويل إلى رئيس المجموعة ( تأكيد الإعفاء يحتاج تحويل إلى الأوضاع الخاصة )) ','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 ELSE
 FOR I IN V_ITEM_CUR LOOP
 IF I.EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NULL AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_ISD') THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تأكيد الإعفاء للصنف رقم '||I.ITEM_SEQ,'ERROR');
 V_NOT_EXMPTN := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_NOT_EXMPTN AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_ISD') THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_INS_REQ_CONFRMTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_INS_REQ_CONFRMTN IS
 V_AMT NUMBER;
 V_SRC_PORT_AMT NUMBER;
 V_TOT_AMT NUMBER;
 V_CONFN_DT DATE;
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(COD.AMT), SUM(COD.SRCE_PORT_AMT)
 INTO V_AMT, V_SRC_PORT_AMT
 FROM COLL_ORDER_DTLS COD, ACCT_ITEM_DTLS AID
 WHERE COD.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COD.ACCT_SEQ = AID.ACCT_SEQ
 AND AID.AID_TYPE = 2 -- مؤمن
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COD.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;

 V_TOT_AMT := NVL(V_AMT, 0) + NVL(V_SRC_PORT_AMT, 0);

 IF V_TOT_AMT > 0 THEN
 IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) IN(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF'))
 AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IR'))
 AND :DCLTN_STA_CD = 3

 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT CONFN_DT
 INTO V_CONFN_DT
 FROM INS_REQS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN ;
 END;

 IF V_CONFN_DT IS NULL THEN

 RET := STR.DISPALERT('طلب الربط بالتأمين للمعاملة غير مؤكد - هل تريد الإستمرار في التحويل إلى رئيس المجموعة ( تأكيد طلب التأمين يحتاج تحويل إلى الأوضاع الخاصة )) ','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT CONFN_DT
 INTO V_CONFN_DT
 FROM INS_REQS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد طلب ربط بالتأمين للمعاملة بالرغم من وجود رسوم مؤمنة','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END;

 IF V_CONFN_DT IS NULL AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID != CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_ISD') THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('طلب الربط بالتأمين للمعاملة غير مؤكد - يجب تأكيد طلب الربط بالتأمين قبل التحصيل ','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_IMPR_WAIVER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_IMPR_WAIVER(V_PAY_TY IN VARCHAR) IS
 V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_CUR_DATE DATE;
 RET NUMBER;
 V_ACT_TY NUMBER;
BEGIN
 --------------------
 --- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM @ 15/4/2006
 --- THIS CODE CHECK BEFORE TRANSFER DECLARATION TO PAY REVENUS IF THE AGENT
 --- HAS WAIVERS NOT CLEARED AND EXPIRED AND OF TYPE (1 OR 2 OR 7)
 V_CUR_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 IF V_CUR_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_ERR_MSG := WAIVER.VALID_IMPR_WAIVERS(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD, :DECLARATIONS.AGENT_NBR,V_CUR_DATE);
 IF V_ERR_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DISPALERT(V_ERR_MSG || CHR(10) || 'هل تريد الأستمرار','USR_WARNING_C');
 IF RET = alert_button2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSE
 IF V_PAY_TY = 'B' THEN
 V_ACT_TY := 59;
 ELSE
 V_ACT_TY := 60;
 END IF;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, V_ACT_TY, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,5,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 --------------------
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_IMPR_RULS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------

--CHECK_IMPR_RULS
--DESCRIPTION : TO CHECK IMPR RULS IF EXIST OR NOT
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 15-03-2005
----------------------------------------------------------------

FUNCTION CHECK_IMPR_RULS(V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER,V_RULE_TYPE NUMBER) RETURN INTEGER IS
 V_RET NUMBER:=0;
 V_RULE_ISN NUMBER;
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD IMPORTERS.BUS_ID_TYPE_CD%TYPE;
 V_BUS_ID IMPORTERS.BUS_ID%TYPE;
 V_BUS_ID_BRNCH IMPORTERS.BUS_ID_BRNCH%TYPE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT BUS_ID_TYPE_CD,BUS_ID,BUS_ID_BRNCH
 INTO V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD,V_BUS_ID,V_BUS_ID_BRNCH
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = V_IMPR_NBR;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN V_RET;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT RULE_ISN
 INTO V_RULE_ISN
 FROM IMPR_RULES

 WHERE BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 AND BUS_ID = V_BUS_ID
 AND (ALL_BRNCH_FLAG = 1 OR BUS_ID_BRNCH = V_BUS_ID_BRNCH OR (BUS_ID_BRNCH IS NULL AND V_BUS_ID_BRNCH IS NULL))
 AND REC_STATUS =1
 AND RULE_TYPE = V_RULE_TYPE
 AND ROWNUM=1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN V_RET;
 END;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM IMPR_RULE_PORTS
 WHERE RULE_ISN = V_RULE_ISN;


 IF V_COUNT=0 THEN -- IF FOR ALL PORTS
 V_RET :=1;
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM IMPR_RULE_PORTS
 WHERE RULE_ISN = V_RULE_ISN
 AND PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND REC_STATUS=1;
 IF V_COUNT>0 THEN
 V_RET :=1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN V_RET;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_IMPORT_CARGO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_IMPORT_CARGO(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) IS
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF DCLTN.CHECK_IMPORT_CARGO(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, V_PORT_CD, V_DCLTN_ISN, V_MSG_TXT) = 0 THEN
 Str.DispAlert(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');

 IF V_MSG_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_MSG_TXT := V_MSG_TXT || ' هل تريد الاستمرار؟';
 V_RET := Str.DispAlert(V_MSG_TXT, 'USR_CONFIRM_B');
 IF V_RET = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END CHECK_IMPORT_CARGO;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_IMP_BRKR_FOR_CASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_IMP_BRKR_FOR_CASES(V_PERS_NBR NUMBER , V_PERS_TY NUMBER) IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
 V_RET NUMBER;
 V_COUNTER NUMBER;

BEGIN
 BEGIN

 IF (V_PERS_TY = 1) OR (V_PERS_TY = 2) OR (V_PERS_TY = 3) THEN -- مستورد
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CUSTOMS_CASES
 WHERE (CUSTOMS_CASES.PORT_CD,CUSTOMS_CASES.CASE_SEQ,CUSTOMS_CASES.CASE_DATE) IN
 (
 SELECT PORT_CD,CASE_SEQ,CASE_DATE
 FROM CASE_ACCUSEDS
 WHERE HQ_IMPR_NBR IN ( SELECT HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = V_PERS_NBR )
 AND CONVICTION_FLAG = 1
 UNION

 SELECT CA.PORT_CD,CA.CASE_SEQ,CA.CASE_DATE
 FROM CASE_ACCUSEDS CA,CASE_COMPROMIS CCO
 WHERE (HQ_IMPR_NBR IN ( SELECT HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = V_PERS_NBR )
 )
 AND CONVICTION_FLAG = 0
 AND CA.PORT_CD = CCO.PORT_CD
 AND CA.CASE_SEQ = CCO.CASE_SEQ
 AND CA.CASE_DATE = CCO.CASE_DATE
 AND (
 (NVL(COMP_AMOUNT,0)<> 0 AND COMP_DECREE_AMT IS NULL)
 OR
 (NVL(COMP_AMOUNT,0)= 0 AND NVL(COMP_DECREE_AMT,0) <> 0 )
 OR
 (NVL(COMP_AMOUNT,0)<> 0 AND NVL(COMP_DECREE_AMT,0) <> 0 )
 )
 );

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 IF (V_PERS_TY = 1) THEN -- مستورد
 -- STR.DISPALERT('مستورد البيان توجد عليه قضايا جمركية','INFORMATION');
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,41,'INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 IF (V_PERS_TY = 2) THEN -- شركة وسيطة
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,42,'INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,43,'INFORMATION'); -- مصدر
 END IF;
 END IF;

 CALL_LOV_IMP_BRKR_CASES(V_PERS_TY , V_PERS_NBR);

 END IF;
 END IF;

 END;
----------------------------
 V_COUNT := 0;
 BEGIN
 IF (V_PERS_TY = 4) THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM CUSTOMS_CASES


 WHERE (CUSTOMS_CASES.PORT_CD,CUSTOMS_CASES.CASE_SEQ,CUSTOMS_CASES.CASE_DATE) IN
 (
 SELECT PORT_CD,CASE_SEQ,CASE_DATE
 FROM CASE_ACCUSEDS
 WHERE (BRKR_PORT_CD = :BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND BRKR_LIC_TYPE = :LIC_TYPE
 AND BRKR_LIC_NBR = :LIC_NBR)
 AND CONVICTION_FLAG = 1
 UNION

 SELECT CA.PORT_CD,CA.CASE_SEQ,CA.CASE_DATE
 FROM CASE_ACCUSEDS CA,CASE_COMPROMIS CCO
 WHERE (BRKR_PORT_CD = :BRKR_PORT_CD
 AND BRKR_LIC_TYPE = :LIC_TYPE
 AND BRKR_LIC_NBR = :LIC_NBR)
 AND CONVICTION_FLAG = 0
 AND CA.PORT_CD = CCO.PORT_CD
 AND CA.CASE_SEQ = CCO.CASE_SEQ
 AND CA.CASE_DATE = CCO.CASE_DATE
 AND (
 (NVL(COMP_AMOUNT,0)<> 0 AND COMP_DECREE_AMT IS NULL)
 OR
 (NVL(COMP_AMOUNT,0)= 0 AND NVL(COMP_DECREE_AMT,0) <> 0 )
 OR
 (NVL(COMP_AMOUNT,0)<> 0 AND NVL(COMP_DECREE_AMT,0) <> 0 )
 )

 );
 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 -- STR.DISPALERT('المخلص لهذا البيان توجد عليه قضايا جمركية','INFORMATION');
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,44,'INFORMATION'); -- مخلص
 CALL_LOV_IMP_BRKR_CASES(4 , :LIC_NBR);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_IF_ITEM_CTRY_IS_KSA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_IF_ITEM_CTRY_IS_KSA IS
 CURSOR C1 IS
 SELECT item_seq--, dcltn_isn,GROSS_WT,NET_WT
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND dcltn_isn = :DECLARATIONS.dcltn_isn
 AND CTRY_CD = 100
 ;
 V_ACTVTY_EXIST NUMBER;
 V_ITEM_SEQ VARCHAR2(3900);
 V_RET VARCHAR2(100);
 V_ACTVTY_TYPE NUMBER;

BEGIN
IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2)AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_insp'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_aff') ) AND NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('SAUDI_ITEM_CTRY', 21),0)=1 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_insp') THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_ACTVTY_EXIST
 FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = 21
 AND SUBJ_CODE = 1
 AND ACTVY_TYPE IN(153,154)
 AND ACTVY_SUB_ID = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ||'!'||:DECLARATIONS.dcltn_isn
 ;
 END IF;

 IF (:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_insp')AND V_ACTVTY_EXIST = 0 ) OR :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_aff') THEN
 FOR I IN C1 LOOP
 IF V_ITEM_SEQ IS NULL THEN
 V_ITEM_SEQ := I.ITEM_SEQ;
 ELSE
 V_ITEM_SEQ := V_ITEM_SEQ ||' , '||I.item_seq;
 END IF;
-- IF (LENGTH(V_RET) > 3900) THEN
 -- V_ITEM_SEQ := V_ITEM_SEQ || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 -- EXIT;
 -- END IF;

 END LOOP;
 IF V_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(CHR(1000) ||' الاصناف التالية بلد منشأها هو السعودية' ||' ( '||V_ITEM_SEQ ||' ) '
 ||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||'هل أنت موافق ؟',
 'WARNING',2,
 'عرض بيانات الاصناف'
 ,7.5,1.11,2.0,0.5,1300,
 'r0g0b1',4);
 IF V_RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_insp') THEN
 V_ACTVTY_TYPE := 153;
 ELSE
 V_ACTVTY_TYPE := 155;
 END IF;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, V_ACTVTY_TYPE, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.du_insp') THEN
 V_ACTVTY_TYPE := 154;
 ELSE
 V_ACTVTY_TYPE := 156;
 END IF;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, V_ACTVTY_TYPE, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 if V_ACTVTY_TYPE = 156 THEN
 forms_ddl('COMMIT');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 forms_ddl('COMMIT');
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_IDEN_CERT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
PROCEDURE CHECK_IDEN_CERT IS
X NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X FROM DCLTN_ITEMS WHERE DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN
AND FINAL_TARIFF_CD IN (SELECT HRMNZD_CODE FROM GROUP_ITEMS WHERE GRP_CODE=99)
AND IDEN_CERT_NBR IS NULL;
IF X > 0 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('البيان يحتوى على بنود تعرفه تتبع المجموعة 99 يجب إدخال شهادات المطابقة الخاصة بها','ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;
*/
PROCEDURE CHECK_IDEN_CERT IS
CURSOR S IS SELECT PORT_CD,ITEM_ISN,FINAL_TARIFF_CD,CTRY_CD,ICA_IDNT_ISN,IDEN_CER_EXCEPT,
ITEM_SEQ,ITEM_DESC,FINAL_TARIFF_DT,INV_QTY,INV_MSR_UNIT,CIF_COST
FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
WHERE DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN AND PORT_CD=:PORT_CD;
V_VALID NUMBER;
VALID_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
LAB_EXIST_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
LAB_NOT_EXIST_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
REJECT_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
X NUMBER;
V_NOT_EXIST NUMBER;
V_LAB_EXIST NUMBER;
V_SMPL_EXIST NUMBER;
WAIVER_NOT_EXIST VARCHAR2(500);
V_CHECK_WVR NUMBER;
V_CRITRIA NUMBER:=0;
V_GROUP_181 NUMBER;
V_COUNT_DEC NUMBER;
V_ALL NUMBER;
V_BAD NUMBER;
V_TODAY DATE;
V_RANDOM NUMBER;
V_CRITRIA_TYPE NUMBER;
BEGIN
V_TODAY:=HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_ALL FROM SMPL_ITEMS S1,SMPL_REQUESTS S2
WHERE S1.RQST_PORT_CD=S2.RQST_PORT_CD AND S1.RQST_NMR=S2.RQST_NMR
AND S1.RQST_DT=S2.RQST_DT AND IMPR_NBR=:IMPR_NBR AND S1.RQST_PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
AND S1.RQST_DT>NVL(:DCLTN_DT,V_TODAY)-354;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_BAD FROM SMPL_ITEMS S1,SMPL_REQUESTS S2
WHERE S1.RQST_PORT_CD=S2.RQST_PORT_CD AND S1.RQST_NMR=S2.RQST_NMR
AND S1.RQST_DT=S2.RQST_DT AND IMPR_NBR=:IMPR_NBR AND S1.RQST_PORT_CD=:PORT_CD
AND S1.RQST_DT>NVL(:DCLTN_DT,V_TODAY)-354 AND RESULT_CD=2;
IF V_BAD / V_ALL > 0.5 THEN
V_CRITRIA:=V_CRITRIA+1;
END IF;
IF :RSK_MNG=1 THEN
V_CRITRIA:=V_CRITRIA+1;
END IF;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT_DEC FROM DECLARATIONS
WHERE IMPR_NBR=:IMPR_NBR AND PORT_CD=:PORT_CD AND DCLTN_DT>NVL(:DCLTN_DT,V_TODAY)-354;
IF V_COUNT_DEC > 50 THEN
V_CRITRIA:=V_CRITRIA+1;
END IF;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_GROUP_181 FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE IN
(SELECT FINAL_TARIFF_CD FROM DCLTN_ITEMS WHERE DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_ISN AND PORT_CD=:PORT_CD)
 AND GRP_CODE=181;
 IF V_GROUP_181 > 0 THEN
 V_CRITRIA:=V_CRITRIA+1;
 END IF;
IF V_CRITRIA = 4 THEN
V_CRITRIA_TYPE:=0;
ELSIF V_CRITRIA = 3 THEN
V_CRITRIA_TYPE:=4;
ELSIF V_CRITRIA = 2 THEN
V_CRITRIA_TYPE:=7;
ELSIF V_CRITRIA = 1 THEN
V_CRITRIA_TYPE:=10;
END IF;

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RANDOM FROM SMPL_REQUESTS
WHERE DCLTN_ISN IN (SELECT dcltn_isn FROM
(SELECT dcltn_isn FROM declarations WHERE PORT_CD=:PORT_CD AND impr_nbr=:IMPR_NBR) tt
WHERE ROWNUM < V_CRITRIA_TYPE);
FOR REC IN S LOOP
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X FROM IDEN_CER_DETAILS
WHERE TRF_GRP IN (SELECT grp_code FROM group_items WHERE HRMNZD_CODE=REC.FINAL_TARIFF_CD)
AND TRF_CNTRY=REC.CTRY_CD AND ACTIVE_FLAG=1 AND V_ACTIVE_DATE<:DCLTN_DT;
 IF X > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_VALID FROM IDEN_CER_DETAILS
 WHERE TRF_GRP IN (SELECT grp_code FROM group_items WHERE HRMNZD_CODE=REC.FINAL_TARIFF_CD)
 AND TRF_CNTRY=REC.CTRY_CD AND ACTIVE_FLAG=1 AND V_ACTIVE_DATE<:DCLTN_DT
 AND ICA_IDNT_ISN=NVL(REC.ICA_IDNT_ISN,ICA_IDNT_ISN);
 IF V_VALID=0 THEN
 VALID_MSG:=VALID_MSG||REC.FINAL_TARIFF_CD||',';
 END IF;
 IF REC.ICA_IDNT_ISN IS NOT NULL AND (V_RANDOM = 0 OR V_CRITRIA_TYPE=0) THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_SMPL_EXIST FROM SMPL_ITEMS
 WHERE RQST_PORT_CD=REC.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN=REC.ITEM_ISN;
 IF V_SMPL_EXIST = 0 THEN
 LAB_EXIST_MSG:=LAB_EXIST_MSG||REC.FINAL_TARIFF_CD||',';
 END IF;
 END IF;

 END IF;
END LOOP;
IF VALID_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
VALID_MSG:=' جهة الاصدار غير مطابقة للبند '||RTRIM(VALID_MSG,',');
STR.DISPALERT(VALID_MSG,'ERROR');
END IF;
IF LAB_EXIST_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
LAB_EXIST_MSG:=' يجب عمل طلب تحليل عينات للبند '||RTRIM(LAB_EXIST_MSG,',');
STR.DISPALERT(LAB_EXIST_MSG,'ERROR');
END IF;
IF LAB_NOT_EXIST_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
LAB_NOT_EXIST_MSG:=' يجب ادخال توجيه للاستثناء من ادارة القيود للبند '||RTRIM(LAB_NOT_EXIST_MSG,',');
STR.DISPALERT(LAB_NOT_EXIST_MSG,'ERROR');
END IF;
IF REJECT_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
REJECT_MSG:=' تم الرفض من ادارة القيود يرجي إعادة التصدير للبند '||RTRIM(REJECT_MSG,',');
STR.DISPALERT(REJECT_MSG,'ERROR');
END IF;
IF WAIVER_NOT_EXIST IS NOT NULL THEN
WAIVER_NOT_EXIST:=' يجب إنشاء تعهد عدم تكرار عدم إحضار شهادة مطابقة للبند '||RTRIM(WAIVER_NOT_EXIST,',');
STR.DISPALERT(WAIVER_NOT_EXIST,'ERROR');
END IF;
IF VALID_MSG IS NOT NULL OR LAB_EXIST_MSG IS NOT NULL
OR LAB_NOT_EXIST_MSG IS NOT NULL OR REJECT_MSG IS NOT NULL
OR WAIVER_NOT_EXIST IS NOT NULL
THEN
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_IDEN_CERT_OK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_IDEN_CERT_OK(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS

 CURSOR DI_CURSOR IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, ITEM_ISN, ITEM_SEQ, DCLTN_ISN, FINAL_TARIFF_CD,CTRY_CD
 , DI.ICA_IDNT_ISN,IDEN_CERT_NBR,IDEN_CERT_DT,IDEN_CERT_APPRV,DI.IDEN_CER_EXCEPT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DI.INV_QTY >5
 AND NVL(IDEN_CER_EXCEPT,0) = 0

 -- CR-4139 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 20/02/2022
 AND (
 (DI.ICA_IDNT_ISN IS NULL OR DI.IDEN_CERT_NBR IS NULL)
 AND DCLTN_SERVICES.Dcltn_check_Saber(V_PORT_CD, di.ITEM_ISN, 1) =0
 AND DCLTN_SERVICES.check_elctrnc_addmsion(V_PORT_CD, V_DCLTN_ISN, 1) =0
 )
 -- END CR-4139 BY MOHAMED AL-SHEERIF 20/02/2022

 AND EXISTS
 (SELECT 1 FROM importers
 WHERE port_cd=v_port_cd
 AND impr_nbr=:impr_nbr
 AND IMPR_TYPE_CD NOT IN (4,2,8)
 )
 AND EXISTS
 (
 SELECT 1 FROM SMPL_LAB_DTLS,SMPL_LABS
 WHERE SMPL_LAB_DTLS.LAB_HRMNZD_ITEM = DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND SMPL_LAB_DTLS.LAB_CD=SMPL_LABS.LAB_CD
 AND SMPL_LAB_DTLS.LAB_ITEM_STATUS=1
 AND SMPL_LABS.STATUS=1


 )




;

 V_SMPL_EXIST NUMBER;
 V_IDEN_EXIST NUMBER;
 V_GRP204_EXIST NUMBER;
--- GROUP 204 COULD NOT BE EXCEPTED
 V_RETURN1 NUMBER;
 V_RETURN2 NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_RET1 VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;
 V_MSG1 VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;
 V_RET2 VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;
 V_MSG2 VARCHAR2 (8000) := NULL;

 V_ITEM_ARBC_DESC VARCHAR2(1000);
 v_GROUP_242_DATE DATE:= TO_DATE ( NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('GROUP_242_START_DATE', 5),'1441-12-04'), 'YYYY-MM-MI');
BEGIN
IF hijdate_db.cur_hij_date > v_GROUP_242_DATE THEN -- added to 25-07-2020 for saber project
 V_RETURN1 :=0;
 V_RET1 := 'اصناف بدون شهادة مطابقة ويجب عمل تحليل عينات لها أو استثناءها ' || CHR(10) ;

 V_RETURN2 :=0;
 V_RET2 := 'اصناف بدون شهادة مطابقة ويجب عمل تحليل عينات لها و لا يمكن استثناءها ' || CHR(10) ;

-- V_RET2 := 'اصناف شهادة المطابقة غير معتمدة فى دولة المنشأ ويجب عمل طلب تحليل عينات لها' || CHR(10) ;


 FOR DI IN DI_CURSOR LOOP



 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_SMPL_EXIST FROM SMPL_ITEMS
 WHERE RQST_PORT_CD=DI.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN=DI.ITEM_ISN;


/*
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_SMPL_EXIST FROM smpl_requests sr, smpl_items si, smpl_labs sl
 WHERE sr.rqst_port_cd = si.rqst_port_cd
 AND sr.rqst_nmr = si.rqst_nmr
 AND sr.rqst_dt = si.rqst_dt
 AND sr.lab_cd = sl.lab_cd
 AND sl.lab_type = 2
 AND si.RQST_PORT_CD=DI.PORT_CD AND si.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN=DI.ITEM_ISN;

*/
IF V_SMPL_EXIST =0 THEN



 SELECT ITEM_ARBC_DESC INTO V_ITEM_ARBC_DESC
 FROM HARMONIZED_TARIFF
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE = DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD;


 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_GRP204_EXIST FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE GRP_CODE= 204 AND GROUP_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE = DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
;

 if V_PORT_CD <> 34 then
 V_GRP204_EXIST :=0; -- comment temporray until applying group 204 only in 34
 end if;

 IF V_GRP204_EXIST =0 THEN
 V_RETURN1 :=1;
 --- لا يوجد شهادة مطابقة
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 || ' رقم الصنف :' || DI.ITEM_SEQ || ' بند الصنف ' || DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD || ' - ' || V_ITEM_ARBC_DESC || CHR(10) ;

 IF (LENGTH(V_RET1) > 3900) THEN
 V_RET1 := V_RET1 ||'.....' || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 --- لا يوجد شهادة مطابقة و لا يمكن الاستثناء
 V_RETURN2 :=1;
 V_RET2 := V_RET2 || ' رقم الصنف :' || DI.ITEM_SEQ || ' بند الصنف ' || DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD || ' - ' || V_ITEM_ARBC_DESC || CHR(10) ;


 IF (LENGTH(V_RET2) > 3900) THEN
 V_RET2 := V_RET2 ||'.....' || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 EXIT;
 END IF;

 END IF;
END IF;

END LOOP;
 IF V_RETURN1 =1 THEN
 V_MSG1 := CHR(1000) || V_RET1;
 V_RET1 := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG1, 'INFORMATION', 1, ' الأصناف التى يجب عمل طلب تحليل عينات لها ويمكن استثناءها',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 12);
 END IF;

 IF V_RETURN2 =1 THEN
 V_MSG2 := CHR(1000) || V_RET2;
 V_RET2 := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG2, 'INFORMATION', 1, ' الأصناف التى يجب عمل طلب تحليل عينات لها ولا يمكن استثناءها',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 12);
 END IF;
 IF V_RETURN1=1 OR V_RETURN2=1 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0 ;
 END IF;
 ---- added to 25-07-2020 for saber project
 ELSE
 RETURN 0;
 END IF; -- added to 25-07-2020 for saber project
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EXPR_PAYMENT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_EXPR_PAYMENT IS
 V_COLL_ORDR_STA NUMBER;
 V_DTL_VAL NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COLL_ORDR_STA
 INTO V_COLL_ORDR_STA
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;

 IF V_COLL_ORDR_STA IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(AMT)+SUM(SRCE_PORT_AMT)
 INTO V_DTL_VAL
 FROM COLL_ORDER_DTLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;
 EXCEPTION

 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_DTL_VAL := 0;
 END;

 IF V_DTL_VAL > 0 AND V_COLL_ORDR_STA NOT IN (2, 3) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تسديد رسوم المعاملة في البنك قبل الفسح','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSIF NOT COLL_ORDER_PAYED(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 STR.DispALERT('توجد فواتير للمعاملة غير مسددة - يجب تسديدها أو إلغائها أولا قبل الفسح','ERROR'); -- mohamed.nouh CR-5749
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

 --&&& END

 --&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
 --ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_DRY THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY') THEN
 --&&& END
 IF VAR_SUM_BILL IS NULL THEN
 Str.DispAlert('لا توجد بوالص مربوطة على المعاملة','ERROR');
 ELSE
 IF VAR_SUM_BILL != VAR_SUM_ITEM THEN
 Str.DispAlert('مجموع أوزان الأصناف لا يساوي مجموع أوزان البوالص','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END CHECK_EXPORT_CARGO;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EXMTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--DEVELOPED BY KAMEL @4145
PACKAGE BODY CHECK_EXMTN IS
CURSOR CUR_DECLARATIONS(V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER,V_PORT_CD NUMBER) IS SELECT PORT_CD,DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT,FINAL_CTRY_CD,IMPR_NBR FROM DECLARATIONS DE WHERE DE.DCLTN_ISN=V_DCLTN_ISN AND DE.PORT_CD=V_PORT_CD;

CURSOR CUR_EXMTN_DECREES(V_EXMTN_DECREE_ISN NUMBER,V_EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD NUMBER)IS
 SELECT HQ_IMPR_NBR,DECREE_EFF_DT,DECREE_EXPRY_DT,DECREE_STA_CD,DECREE_SRCE_CD,EXMTN_MTHD_CD,EXMTN_AMT_BALC
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES EDS
 WHERE EDS.DECREE_ISN=V_EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 AND EDS.DECREE_PORT_CD=V_EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 UNION

 SELECT HQ_IMPR_NBR,DECREE_EFF_DT,DECREE_EXPRY_DT,DECREE_STA_CD,DECREE_SRCE_CD,EXMTN_MTHD_CD,EXMTN_AMT_BALC
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES_HQ EDS
 WHERE EDS.DECREE_ISN=V_EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 AND EDS.DECREE_PORT_CD=V_EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 ;

CURSOR CUR_DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS(V_DECREE_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DECREE_ISN NUMBER,V_APLCTN_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_ITEM_SEQ NUMBER,V_ITEM_SUB_SEQ NUMBER)IS
 SELECT ITEM_STA_CD,ITEM_QTY_BALC,EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC,HRMNZD_CODE,DECREE_PORT_CD,DECREE_ISN,APLCTN_PORT_CD,ITEM_SEQ,ITEM_SUB_SEQ,MSR_UNIT
 FROM DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS DAI
 WHERE DAI.DECREE_PORT_CD =V_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DAI.DECREE_ISN =V_DECREE_ISN
 AND DAI.APLCTN_PORT_CD =V_APLCTN_PORT_CD
 AND DAI.ITEM_SEQ =V_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DAI.ITEM_SUB_SEQ =V_ITEM_SUB_SEQ

 UNION
 SELECT ITEM_STA_CD,ITEM_QTY_BALC,EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC,HRMNZD_CODE,DECREE_PORT_CD,DECREE_ISN,APLCTN_PORT_CD,ITEM_SEQ,ITEM_SUB_SEQ,MSR_UNIT
 FROM DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS_HQ DAI
 WHERE DAI.DECREE_PORT_CD =V_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DAI.DECREE_ISN =V_DECREE_ISN
 AND DAI.APLCTN_PORT_CD =V_APLCTN_PORT_CD
 AND DAI.ITEM_SEQ =V_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DAI.ITEM_SUB_SEQ =V_ITEM_SUB_SEQ
 ;

--REC_DECLARATIONS CUR_DECLARATIONS%ROWTYPE;
V_DEC_PORT_CD DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD%TYPE;
V_DEC_DCLTN_ISN DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN%TYPE;
V_DEC_DCLTN_DT DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT%TYPE;
V_DEC_FINAL_CTRY_CD DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD%TYPE;
V_DEC_IMPR_NBR DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR%TYPE;
--REC_EXMTN_DECREES CUR_EXMTN_DECREES%ROWTYPE;
V_EXM_HQ_IMPR_NBR EXMTN_DECREES.HQ_IMPR_NBR%TYPE;
V_EXM_DECREE_EFF_DT EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_EFF_DT%TYPE;
V_EXM_DECREE_EXPRY_DT EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_EXPRY_DT%TYPE;
V_EXM_DECREE_STA_CD EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_STA_CD%TYPE;
V_EXM_DECREE_SRCE_CD EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_SRCE_CD%TYPE;
V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD EXMTN_DECREES.EXMTN_MTHD_CD%TYPE;
V_EXM_EXMTN_AMT_BALC EXMTN_DECREES.EXMTN_AMT_BALC%TYPE;
--REC_DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS CUR_DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS%ROWTYPE;
V_ACP_ITEM_STA_CD DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS.ITEM_STA_CD%TYPE;
V_ACP_ITEM_QTY_BALC DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS.ITEM_QTY_BALC%TYPE;
V_ACP_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS.EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC%TYPE;
V_ACP_HRMNZD_CODE DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS.HRMNZD_CODE%TYPE;
V_ACP_DECREE_PORT_CD DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS.DECREE_PORT_CD%TYPE;
V_ACP_DECREE_ISN DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS.DECREE_ISN%TYPE;
V_ACP_APLCTN_PORT_CD DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS.APLCTN_PORT_CD%TYPE;
V_ACP_ITEM_SEQ DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ%TYPE;
V_ACP_ITEM_SUB_SEQ DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS.ITEM_SUB_SEQ%TYPE;
V_ACP_MSR_UNIT DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS.MSR_UNIT%TYPE;


V_COUNT_DECREE_DTLS NUMBER;
V_HQ_IMPR_NBR IMPORTERS.HQ_IMPR_NBR%TYPE;
V_EXMTN_DECREES_DATE EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_EFF_DT%TYPE;
V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(400);
V_WHAT_QTY DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY%TYPE;
V_ITEM_EXM NUMBER;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------اتفاقيات

CURSOR CUR_AGRMNTS(V_AGRMNT_NO NUMBER)IS SELECT AGRMNT_NO,AGRMNT_TYPE,CTRY_CD,AGRMNT_ST_DT,AGRMNT_EN_DT FROM AGRMNTS A WHERE A.AGRMNT_NO=V_AGRMNT_NO;

CURSOR CUR_AGRMNT_MEMBERS(V_AGRMNT_NO NUMBER,V_MEMBER_ISN NUMBER)IS SELECT AGRMNT_NO,MEMBER_ISN,MEMBER_STATUS,ALL_ITEM_FLAG,HQ_IMPR_NBR,CTRY_CD,QULFY_NO,LICENSE_NO FROM AGRMNT_MEMBERS AM
 WHERE AM.AGRMNT_NO=V_AGRMNT_NO
 AND AM.MEMBER_ISN=V_MEMBER_ISN;
/*CURSOR CUR_AGRMNT_ITEMS(V_AGRMNT_NO NUMBER,V_MEMBER_ISN NUMBER)IS SELECT * FROM AGRMNT_ITEMS AIS
 WHERE AIS.AGRMNT_NO=V_AGRMNT_NO
 AND AIS.MEMBER_ISN=V_MEMBER_ISN;*/


--REC_AGRMNTS CUR_AGRMNTS%ROWTYPE;
V_AGRMNT_NO AGRMNTS.AGRMNT_NO%TYPE;
V_AGRMNT_TYPE AGRMNTS.AGRMNT_TYPE%TYPE;
V_AGR_CTRY_CD AGRMNTS.CTRY_CD%TYPE;
V_AGRMNT_ST_DT AGRMNTS.AGRMNT_ST_DT%TYPE;
V_AGRMNT_EN_DT AGRMNTS.AGRMNT_EN_DT%TYPE;
--REC_AGRMNT_MEMBERS CUR_AGRMNT_MEMBERS%ROWTYPE;
V_MEM_AGRMNT_NO AGRMNT_MEMBERS.AGRMNT_NO%TYPE;
V_MEMBER_ISN AGRMNT_MEMBERS.MEMBER_ISN%TYPE;
V_MEMBER_STATUS AGRMNT_MEMBERS.MEMBER_STATUS%TYPE;
V_MEM_ALL_ITEM_FLAG AGRMNT_MEMBERS.ALL_ITEM_FLAG%TYPE;
V_MEM_HQ_IMPR_NBR AGRMNT_MEMBERS.HQ_IMPR_NBR%TYPE;
V_MEM_CTRY_CD AGRMNT_MEMBERS.CTRY_CD%TYPE;
V_MEM_QULFY_NO AGRMNT_MEMBERS.QULFY_NO%TYPE;
V_MEM_LICENSE_NO AGRMNT_MEMBERS.LICENSE_NO%TYPE;
--REC_AGRMNT_ITEMS CUR_AGRMNT_ITEMS%ROWTYPE;
V_AGRMNT_MEMBERS NUMBER;
V_AGRMNT_DATE AGRMNTS.AGRMNT_ST_DT%TYPE;
V_HRMNZD_CODE NUMBER;
V_MAX_QTY AGRMNT_ITEMS.MAX_QTY%TYPE;
V_RMN_QTY AGRMNT_ITEMS.RMN_QTY%TYPE;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------الأعفاء الدبلوماسى
CURSOR CUR_DPLMTC(V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR NUMBER,V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE DATE) IS SELECT APLCTN_NBR,APLCTN_DATE,APLCTN_EXPRY_DT,TOT_EXMTN_ITEMS_COUNT,USED_ITEMS_COUNT,IMP_PORT_CD,IMP_IMPR_NBR,APLCTN_STATUS FROM DPLMTC_APLCTNS DAS
 WHERE DAS.APLCTN_NBR =V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND DAS.APLCTN_DATE=V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE;
--REC_DPLMTC CUR_DPLMTC%ROWTYPE;
V_APLCTN_NBR DPLMTC_APLCTNS.APLCTN_NBR%TYPE;
V_APLCTN_DATE DPLMTC_APLCTNS.APLCTN_DATE%TYPE;
V_APLCTN_EXPRY_DT DPLMTC_APLCTNS.APLCTN_EXPRY_DT%TYPE;
V_TOT_EXMTN_ITEMS_COUNT DPLMTC_APLCTNS.TOT_EXMTN_ITEMS_COUNT%TYPE;
V_USED_ITEMS_COUNT DPLMTC_APLCTNS.USED_ITEMS_COUNT%TYPE;
V_DPL_IMP_PORT_CD DPLMTC_APLCTNS.IMP_PORT_CD%TYPE;
V_DPL_IMP_IMPR_NBR DPLMTC_APLCTNS.IMP_IMPR_NBR%TYPE;
V_APLCTN_STATUS DPLMTC_APLCTNS.APLCTN_STATUS%TYPE;
V_DPLMTC_DATE DPLMTC_APLCTNS.APLCTN_EXPRY_DT%TYPE;
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------أعفاء دول مجلس التعاون الخليجى
CURSOR CUR_EXMTN_A(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_EXM_A_ISN NUMBER) IS SELECT PORT_CD,EXM_A_ISN,EXM_STA_CD,CTRY_CD,IMPR_NBR,EFF_DT,EXPRY_DT FROM EXMTN_A_FORMS EAF
 WHERE EAF.PORT_CD=V_PORT_CD
 AND EAF.EXM_A_ISN=V_EXM_A_ISN;
--REC_EXMTN_A CUR_EXMTN_A%ROWTYPE;
V_A_PORT_CD EXMTN_A_FORMS.PORT_CD%TYPE;
V_EXM_A_ISN EXMTN_A_FORMS.EXM_A_ISN%TYPE;
V_EXM_STA_CD EXMTN_A_FORMS.EXM_STA_CD%TYPE;
V_A_CTRY_CD EXMTN_A_FORMS.CTRY_CD%TYPE;
V_A_IMPR_NBR EXMTN_A_FORMS.IMPR_NBR%TYPE;
V_A_EFF_DT EXMTN_A_FORMS.EFF_DT%TYPE;
V_A_EXPRY_DT EXMTN_A_FORMS.EXPRY_DT%TYPE;

V_FORMS EXMTN_A_FORMS.EFF_DT%TYPE;
V_INV_NBR NUMBER;
V_COUNT_EXM_A NUMBER;
V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);
V_MSG1 VARCHAR2(2000);
--=============================================

FUNCTION CHECK_EXMTN_DCLTN(V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER,V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_MSG OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS

BEGIN
 OPEN CUR_DECLARATIONS(V_DCLTN_ISN,V_PORT_CD);
 FETCH CUR_DECLARATIONS INTO V_DEC_PORT_CD,V_DEC_DCLTN_ISN,V_DEC_DCLTN_DT,V_DEC_FINAL_CTRY_CD,V_DEC_IMPR_NBR;
 CLOSE CUR_DECLARATIONS;

 SELECT HQ_IMPR_NBR
 INTO V_HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM DECLARATIONS DCLTN, IMPORTERS IMPR
 WHERE DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN = V_DEC_DCLTN_ISN
 AND IMPR.IMPR_NBR = DCLTN.IMPR_NBR
 AND IMPR.PORT_CD = DCLTN.PORT_CD
 ;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_ITEM_EXM
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DIS
 WHERE DIS.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DIS.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DIS.EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL;

 IF V_ITEM_EXM > 0 THEN
 FOR REC_DCLTN_ITEMS IN (SELECT ITEM_ISN
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DIS
 WHERE DIS.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DIS.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DIS.EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL)
 LOOP
 IF CHECK_EXMTN_ITEM(V_PORT_CD ,REC_DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN ,V_HQ_IMPR_NBR ,V_MSG1 )=0 THEN
 V_MSG:=V_MSG1;
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;
 END IF;

 RETURN 1;
END;
--===============================================================

FUNCTION CHECK_EXMTN_ITEM(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_ITEM_ISN NUMBER ,V_HQ_IMPR_NBR NUMBER,V_MSG1 OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 V_EXMTN_TYPE DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE%TYPE;
 V_EXMTN_DECREE_ISN DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN%TYPE;
 V_EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD%TYPE;
 V_EXMTN_APRVL_DT DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_APRVL_DT%TYPE;
 V_EXMTD_CIF DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_CIF%TYPE;
 V_CIF_COST DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST%TYPE;
 V_EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ%TYPE;
 V_EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ%TYPE;
 V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD%TYPE;
 V_INTL_MSR_UNIT DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_MSR_UNIT%TYPE;
 V_INTL_QTY DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY%TYPE;
 V_INV_MSR_UNIT DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT%TYPE;
 V_INV_QTY DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY%TYPE;
 V_EXMTD_QTY DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY%TYPE;
 V_AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN DCLTN_ITEMS.AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN%TYPE;
 V_AGRMNT_NO DCLTN_ITEMS.AGRMNT_NO%TYPE;
 V_CTRY_CD DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD%TYPE;
 V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR DCLTN_ITEMS.DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR%TYPE;
 V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE DCLTN_ITEMS.DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE%TYPE;
 V_GCC_EXM_A_ISN DCLTN_ITEMS.GCC_EXM_A_ISN%TYPE;
 V_GCC_EXM_B_SEQ DCLTN_ITEMS.GCC_EXM_B_SEQ%TYPE;
 V_GCC_EXM_B_ITEM_SEQ DCLTN_ITEMS.GCC_EXM_B_ITEM_SEQ%TYPE;
 V_INV_ISN DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN%TYPE;

BEGIN
 SELECT EXMTN_TYPE,EXMTN_DECREE_ISN,EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD,EXMTN_APRVL_DT,EXMTD_CIF,CIF_COST,/*PORT_CD,*/EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ,
 EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ,FINAL_TARIFF_CD,INTL_MSR_UNIT,INTL_QTY,INV_MSR_UNIT,INV_QTY,EXMTD_QTY,AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN,
 AGRMNT_NO,CTRY_CD,DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR,DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE,GCC_EXM_A_ISN,GCC_EXM_B_SEQ,GCC_EXM_B_ITEM_SEQ,INV_ISN
 INTO
 V_EXMTN_TYPE,V_EXMTN_DECREE_ISN,V_EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD,V_EXMTN_APRVL_DT,V_EXMTD_CIF,V_CIF_COST,/*V_PORT_CD,*/V_EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ,
 V_EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ,V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD,V_INTL_MSR_UNIT,V_INTL_QTY,V_INV_MSR_UNIT,V_INV_QTY,V_EXMTD_QTY,V_AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN,
 V_AGRMNT_NO,V_CTRY_CD,V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR,V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE,V_GCC_EXM_A_ISN,V_GCC_EXM_B_SEQ,V_GCC_EXM_B_ITEM_SEQ,V_INV_ISN
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE ITEM_ISN = V_ITEM_ISN
 AND PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
;

 IF V_EXMTN_TYPE IN(2,3,4) THEN --الأعفاء بموجب قرار أعفاء

 IF V_EXMTN_DECREE_ISN IS NOT NULL AND V_EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 OPEN CUR_EXMTN_DECREES(V_EXMTN_DECREE_ISN,V_EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD);
 FETCH CUR_EXMTN_DECREES INTO V_EXM_HQ_IMPR_NBR,V_EXM_DECREE_EFF_DT,V_EXM_DECREE_EXPRY_DT,V_EXM_DECREE_STA_CD,V_EXM_DECREE_SRCE_CD,V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD,V_EXM_EXMTN_AMT_BALC;
 CLOSE CUR_EXMTN_DECREES;
 ELSE
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد قرار أعفاء مربوط على هذه الصنف';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;


 --اختبار هل رقم المستورد الموجود على قرار الأعفاء مختلف عن رقم مستورد البيان
 IF V_EXM_HQ_IMPR_NBR<>V_HQ_IMPR_NBR
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='رقم المستورد الموجود على قرار الأعفاء مختلف عن رقم مستورد البيان';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 --
 IF V_DEC_DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 V_EXMTN_DECREES_DATE:=V_DEC_DCLTN_DT;
 ELSE

 IF HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date(V_MSG_TXT) IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_EXMTN_DECREES_DATE:=HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date(V_MSG_TXT);
 ELSE
 V_MSG1:=V_MSG_TXT;
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 IF V_EXM_DECREE_EFF_DT IS NULL THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد تاريخ فاعلية لهذه القرار';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_EXM_DECREE_EXPRY_DT IS NULL THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد تاريخ أنتهاء لهذه القرار';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_EXM_DECREE_STA_CD<>2
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='قرار الأعفاء غير فعال ولا يمكن التعامل معه حالياً';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSIF HIJDATE_DB.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_EXMTN_DECREES_DATE,V_EXM_DECREE_EXPRY_DT)=1
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لقد انتهت صلاحية القرار و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSIF HIJDATE_DB.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_EXMTN_DECREES_DATE,V_EXM_DECREE_EFF_DT)=-1
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يمكن التعامل مع القرار - تاريخ بداية السريان بعد تاريخ المعاملة';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSIF V_EXMTN_TYPE=3
 THEN
 IF V_EXM_DECREE_SRCE_CD<>3
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='هذا القرار ليس من القرارات الصادرة بموجب أوامر سامية';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --
 IF V_EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NULL
 THEN
 IF V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD IN(3,4)
 THEN
 IF V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD=3
 THEN
 IF V_EXM_EXMTN_AMT_BALC<V_CIF_COST
 THEN
 IF V_EXMTD_CIF<>V_EXM_EXMTN_AMT_BALC
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لابد أن تكون الكمية على قرار الأعفاء متساوية مع الكمية المعفاة';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_EXMTD_CIF<>V_CIF_COST
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا بد أن تكون الكمية على الصنف هى الكمية المعفاة';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_EXMTD_CIF<>V_CIF_COST
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا بد أن تكون الكمية على الصنف هى الكمية المعفاة';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --EXIST DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS OR NOT
 IF V_EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL AND V_EXMTN_DECREE_ISN IS NOT NULL
 AND V_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL AND V_EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 AND V_EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ IS NOT NULL

 THEN

 OPEN CUR_DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS(V_EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD,V_EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 ,V_PORT_CD,V_EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ,V_EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ);
 FETCH CUR_DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS INTO V_ACP_ITEM_STA_CD,V_ACP_ITEM_QTY_BALC,V_ACP_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC,V_ACP_HRMNZD_CODE,V_ACP_DECREE_PORT_CD,V_ACP_DECREE_ISN,V_ACP_APLCTN_PORT_CD,V_ACP_ITEM_SEQ,V_ACP_ITEM_SUB_SEQ,V_ACP_MSR_UNIT;
 CLOSE CUR_DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS;
 --
 IF V_ACP_ITEM_STA_CD<>2
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يمكن التعامل مع بند أعفاء غير معتمد';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSIF
 (( V_EXMTN_TYPE=2 OR V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD=1 )AND V_ACP_ITEM_QTY_BALC=0)
 OR
 (( V_EXMTN_TYPE IN(3,4) AND V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD=5 )AND V_ACP_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC=0)
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يمكن التعامل مع بند اعفاء منتهي رصيده';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSIF
 ( V_EXMTN_TYPE=2 OR( V_EXMTN_TYPE IN(3,4) AND V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD IN(1,2,5)))
 THEN
 -- CHECK FOR TARIFF_CD
 IF SUBSTR(V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD,1,8) <> SUBSTR(V_ACP_HRMNZD_CODE,1,8)
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT_DECREE_DTLS FROM DECREE_ITEM_DTLS DID
 WHERE DID.DECREE_PORT_CD = V_ACP_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DID.DECREE_ISN = V_ACP_DECREE_ISN
 AND DID.APLCTN_PORT_CD = V_ACP_APLCTN_PORT_CD
 AND DID.ITEM_SEQ = V_ACP_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DID.ITEM_SUB_SEQ = V_ACP_ITEM_SUB_SEQ
 AND SUBSTR(DID.HRMNZD_CODE,1,8) = SUBSTR(V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD,1,8)
 AND DID.DTL_ITEM_STA = 2;
 IF V_COUNT_DECREE_DTLS=0
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='بند التعرفة لبند الاعفاء يختلف عن بند التعرفة لصنف البيان';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF( V_EXMTN_TYPE=2 OR( V_EXMTN_TYPE IN(3,4) AND V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD IN(1,2,5)))
 THEN
 IF V_ACP_MSR_UNIT=V_INTL_MSR_UNIT
 THEN
 V_WHAT_QTY:=V_INTL_QTY;
 ELSIF V_ACP_MSR_UNIT=V_INV_MSR_UNIT
 THEN
 V_WHAT_QTY:=V_INV_QTY;
 ELSE
 --V_WHAT_QTY:=V_INTL_QTY;
 V_MSG1:='وحدة القياس لبند الاعفاء يختلف عن وحدة القياس لصنف البيان';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --CHECK EXTM QTY
 IF V_EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NULL THEN
 IF V_EXMTN_TYPE=2 OR V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD=1
 THEN
 IF V_ACP_ITEM_QTY_BALC<V_WHAT_QTY
 THEN
 IF V_EXMTD_QTY<>V_ACP_ITEM_QTY_BALC
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لابد أن تكون الكمية المعفاة مساوية للكمية فى بند الأعفاء';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_EXMTD_QTY<>V_WHAT_QTY
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لابد أن تكون الكمية المعفاة مساوية للكمية على الصنف ';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF V_EXMTN_TYPE IN(3,4) AND V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD=5
 THEN
 IF V_ACP_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC<V_CIF_COST
 THEN
 IF V_EXMTD_CIF<>V_ACP_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا بد أن تكون القيمة المعفاة مساوية للقيمة فى بند الأعفاء';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_EXMTD_CIF<>V_CIF_COST
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا بد أن تكون القيمة المعفاة مساوية للقيمة على الصنف';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 ELSIF V_EXMTN_TYPE IN(3,4) AND V_EXM_EXMTN_MTHD_CD=2
 THEN
 IF V_EXMTD_QTY<>V_WHAT_QTY
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لابد أن تكون الكمية المعفاة مساوية للكمية على الصنف ';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد بند اعفاء على القرار المعروض بهذا المسلسل';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 ----------------------------الأعفاء بموجب الأتفاقية ------------------------------------------------

 ELSIF V_EXMTN_TYPE IN(5,7,9,10,11) THEN

 IF V_AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN IS NOT NULL AND V_AGRMNT_NO IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 OPEN CUR_AGRMNTS(V_AGRMNT_NO);
 FETCH CUR_AGRMNTS INTO V_AGRMNT_NO,V_AGRMNT_TYPE,V_AGR_CTRY_CD,V_AGRMNT_ST_DT,V_AGRMNT_EN_DT;
 CLOSE CUR_AGRMNTS;

 IF V_EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NULL THEN
 IF V_EXMTD_CIF IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF V_EXMTD_CIF>V_CIF_COST OR V_EXMTD_CIF<=0
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='خطأ في القيمة سيف المعفاه';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --------------------------------CHECK IF THERE IS AGRMNTS
 IF V_AGRMNT_NO IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF V_AGRMNT_TYPE IN(1,2)
 THEN
 IF V_AGR_CTRY_CD<>V_DEC_FINAL_CTRY_CD
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='البلد النهائي فى البيان لا يتوافق مع دولة الاتفاقية';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --DECLARATIONS OR CURRENT DATE
 IF V_DEC_DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 V_AGRMNT_DATE:=V_DEC_DCLTN_DT;
 ELSE

 IF HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date(V_MSG_TXT) IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_AGRMNT_DATE:=HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date(V_MSG_TXT);
 ELSE
 V_MSG1:=V_MSG_TXT;
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 --CHECK DATE OF AGRMNTS

 IF V_AGRMNT_ST_DT IS NULL THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 IF HIJDATE_DB.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_AGRMNT_DATE,V_AGRMNT_ST_DT)=-1
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يمكن التعامل مع الأتفاقية - تاريخ بداية السريان بعد تاريخ المعاملة';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 IF V_AGRMNT_EN_DT IS NULL THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 IF HIJDATE_DB.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_AGRMNT_DATE,V_AGRMNT_EN_DT)=1
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يمكن التعامل مع الأتفاقية - تاريخ أنتهاء السريان قبل تاريخ المعاملة';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 --------------------------------------------

 IF V_EXMTN_TYPE=5
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_AGRMNT_MEMBERS
 FROM AGRMNTS A , AGRMNT_MEMBERS AM
 WHERE A.AGRMNT_NO = V_AGRMNT_NO
 AND A.AGRMNT_TYPE = 4--مصانع خليجية
 AND A.AGRMNT_NO = AM.AGRMNT_NO
 AND AM.MEMBER_ISN = V_AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN
 AND AM.MEMBER_STATUS<> 1 ;--غير محجوب
 IF V_AGRMNT_MEMBERS=0 THEN
 --DISPLAY
 V_MSG1:='رقم العضو ليس تابع لبيانات الإتفاقية';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --DISPLAY

 ELSE
 V_MSG1:='لا توجد أتفاقية بهذه الرقم';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 --------------------------------------------------------END OF CHECK IF THERE IS AGRMNTS
 OPEN CUR_AGRMNT_MEMBERS(V_AGRMNT_NO,V_AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN);
 FETCH CUR_AGRMNT_MEMBERS INTO V_MEM_AGRMNT_NO,V_MEMBER_ISN,V_MEMBER_STATUS,V_MEM_ALL_ITEM_FLAG,V_MEM_HQ_IMPR_NBR,V_MEM_CTRY_CD,V_MEM_QULFY_NO,V_MEM_LICENSE_NO;
 CLOSE CUR_AGRMNT_MEMBERS;

 IF V_MEM_AGRMNT_NO IS NOT NULL AND V_MEMBER_ISN IS NOT NULL
 AND V_MEMBER_STATUS<>1
 --AND V_MEM_ALL_ITEM_FLAG IN (1,2)
 THEN

 IF V_AGRMNT_TYPE IN(1,2,5,6)
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_HRMNZD_CODE FROM AGRMNT_ITEMS AIS
 WHERE AIS.AGRMNT_NO=V_AGRMNT_NO
 AND AIS.MEMBER_ISN=V_AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN
 AND AIS.ITEM_STATUS<>1
 AND NVL(AIS.EXMTN_ITEM_FLAG,1)=1
 AND SUBSTR(AIS.HRMNZD_CODE,1,8) = SUBSTR(V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD,1,8);
 IF (V_HRMNZD_CODE=0 AND V_MEM_ALL_ITEM_FLAG NOT IN(1,2) ) OR
 (V_HRMNZD_CODE>0 AND V_MEM_ALL_ITEM_FLAG NOT IN(3) ) THEN
 V_MSG1:='بند التعرفة على صنف البيان مختلف عن بند التعرفة على بند الأتفاقية';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;


 IF V_AGRMNT_TYPE IN(5)
 THEN
 IF V_MEM_HQ_IMPR_NBR<>V_HQ_IMPR_NBR
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد اتفاقية شركات طيران لمستورد البيان لاعفاء الصنف المعروض';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 ------

 SELECT AIS.MAX_QTY,AIS.RMN_QTY INTO V_MAX_QTY,V_RMN_QTY FROM AGRMNT_ITEMS AIS
 WHERE AIS.AGRMNT_NO=V_AGRMNT_NO
 AND AIS.MEMBER_ISN=V_AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN
 AND AIS.ITEM_STATUS<>1
 AND NVL(AIS.EXMTN_ITEM_FLAG,1)=1
 AND SUBSTR(AIS.HRMNZD_CODE,1,8) = SUBSTR(V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD,1,8);

 IF V_EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NULL THEN
 IF V_RMN_QTY IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF V_RMN_QTY < V_INTL_QTY
 THEN
 IF V_EXMTD_QTY<> V_RMN_QTY
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='الكمية المعفاة على الصنف لا تساوى الكمية على بند الأعفاء';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_EXMTD_QTY<>V_INTL_QTY
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='الكمية المعفاة على الصنف لا تساوى كمية الصنف';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 V_MSG1:='لا توجد كمية على بند الأعفاء';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 ---=================================================================

 ELSIF V_AGRMNT_TYPE IN(6)
 THEN
 IF V_MEM_CTRY_CD<>V_CTRY_CD
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد اتفاقية خليجية للسلع النباتية مع بلد المنشأ لإعفاء الصنف المعروض';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_MEM_CTRY_CD<>V_CTRY_CD
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد اتفاقية ثنائية مع بلد المنشأ لاعفاء الصنف المعروض';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 IF V_AGRMNT_TYPE IN(1,2)
 THEN
 IF V_AGR_CTRY_CD<>V_DEC_FINAL_CTRY_CD
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='البلد النهائي فى البيان لا يتوافق مع دولة الاتفاقية';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 IF V_AGRMNT_TYPE IN(4)
 THEN
 IF V_MEM_CTRY_CD<>V_CTRY_CD
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد مصنع خليجي في بلد المنشأ لاعفاء الصنف المعروض';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 IF V_MEMBER_ISN <3112 AND V_MEM_QULFY_NO IS NULL
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='رقم التأهيل غير موجود';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 IF V_MEMBER_ISN >=3112 AND V_MEM_LICENSE_NO IS NULL
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='رقم الترخيص غير موجود';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 END IF;

 ELSE
 --FOR EACH TYPE IDENTICAL PRESS MESSAGE
 V_MSG1:='رقم العضو ليس تابع لبيانات الإتفاقية';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 V_MSG1:='لا توجد أتفاقية مربوط على هذه الصنف';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 -------------------------------------الأعفاء الدبلوماسى--------------------------------------------
 ELSIF V_EXMTN_TYPE IN(6) THEN
 IF V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR IS NOT NULL AND V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 OPEN CUR_DPLMTC(V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR,V_DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE);
 FETCH CUR_DPLMTC INTO V_APLCTN_NBR,V_APLCTN_DATE,V_APLCTN_EXPRY_DT,V_TOT_EXMTN_ITEMS_COUNT,V_USED_ITEMS_COUNT,V_DPL_IMP_PORT_CD,V_DPL_IMP_IMPR_NBR,V_APLCTN_STATUS;
 CLOSE CUR_DPLMTC;

 IF V_APLCTN_NBR IS NOT NULL AND V_APLCTN_DATE IS NOT NULL
 THEN

 --DECLARATIONS OR CURRENT DATE
 IF V_DEC_DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 V_DPLMTC_DATE:=V_DEC_DCLTN_DT;
 ELSE

 IF HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date(V_MSG_TXT) IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_DPLMTC_DATE:=HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date(V_MSG_TXT);
 ELSE
 V_MSG1:=V_MSG_TXT;
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF HIJDATE_DB.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_DPLMTC_DATE,V_APLCTN_EXPRY_DT)=1
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لقد انتهت صلاحية القرار و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NULL THEN
 IF V_TOT_EXMTN_ITEMS_COUNT<V_USED_ITEMS_COUNT
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='الأصناف المعفاة فعلياً بموجب الخطاب أكبر من عدد الأصناف المسموح بأعفاءها بموجب الخطاب';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 IF V_EXMTD_CIF IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF V_EXMTD_CIF>V_CIF_COST OR V_EXMTD_CIF<=0
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='خطأ في القيمة سيف المعفاه';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 END IF;


 IF V_DEC_PORT_CD<>V_DPL_IMP_PORT_CD OR V_DEC_IMPR_NBR<>V_DPL_IMP_IMPR_NBR
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='هذا الخطاب لا يخص مستورد بيان الاستيراد المعروض';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSIF V_APLCTN_STATUS<>4
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يمكن استخدام هذا الخطاب للاعفاء حاليا..راجع قسم الاعفاءات';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSIF V_APLCTN_STATUS=5
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يمكن استخدام هذا الخطاب حاليا..تم انهاء امكانية استخدامه';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد خطاب اعفاء دبلوماسي مسجل بهذا الرقم';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 ELSE

 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد قرار إعفاء دبلوماسي بهذا الرقم على هذا الصنف';
 RETURN 0;

 END IF;
-----------------------------------------------أعفاء دول مجلس التعاون الخليجى ---------------------------------------
 ELSIF V_EXMTN_TYPE IN(22) THEN

 IF V_GCC_EXM_A_ISN IS NOT NULL AND V_GCC_EXM_B_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 AND V_GCC_EXM_B_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 OPEN CUR_EXMTN_A(V_PORT_CD,V_GCC_EXM_A_ISN);
 FETCH CUR_EXMTN_A INTO V_A_PORT_CD,V_EXM_A_ISN,V_EXM_STA_CD,V_A_CTRY_CD,V_A_IMPR_NBR,V_A_EFF_DT,V_A_EXPRY_DT;
 CLOSE CUR_EXMTN_A;

 IF V_A_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL AND V_EXM_A_ISN IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 --CHECK
 IF V_EXM_STA_CD<>2
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='هذا الاعفاء غير فعال';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 IF V_DEC_FINAL_CTRY_CD<>V_A_CTRY_CD
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='يجب ان تكون دولة وصول البضاعة هي نفس دولة اصدار قرار الاعفاء ';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 IF V_DEC_IMPR_NBR<>V_A_IMPR_NBR
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='رقم المستورد على قرار أعفاء دول مجلس التعاون الخليجى مختلف عن رقم مستورد البيان ';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 --YOU MUST CHECK THE DATE
 --DECLARATIONS OR CURRENT DATE
 IF V_DEC_DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 V_FORMS:=V_DEC_DCLTN_DT;
 ELSE
 IF HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date(V_MSG_TXT) IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_FORMS:=HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date(V_MSG_TXT);
 ELSE
 V_MSG1:=V_MSG_TXT;
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_A_EFF_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF HIJDATE_DB.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_FORMS,V_A_EFF_DT)=-1
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يمكن التعامل مع القرار - تاريخ بداية السريان بعد تاريخ المعاملة';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_A_EXPRY_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF HIJDATE_DB.Compare_Hij_Dates(V_FORMS,V_A_EXPRY_DT)=1
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='لقد انتهت صلاحية القرار و لا يمكن التعامل معه حاليا';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 ELSE
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد قرار أعفاء دول مجلس التعاون الخليجى بهذا الرقم';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 FOR REC_EXMTN_B IN (SELECT * FROM EXMTN_B_FORMS EBF WHERE EBF.PORT_CD=V_PORT_CD
 AND EBF.EXM_A_ISN=V_GCC_EXM_A_ISN
 AND EBF.EXM_B_SEQ=V_GCC_EXM_B_SEQ )
 LOOP
 --CKECK
 IF REC_EXMTN_B.EXM_A_ISN IS NOT NULL AND REC_EXMTN_B.EXM_B_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF REC_EXMTN_B.EXM_B_STA_CD <>2
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='هذا النموذج غير فعال';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;


 FOR REC_EXMTN_B_D IN (SELECT * FROM EXMTN_B_FORM_DTLS EBFS
 WHERE EBFS.PORT_CD=V_PORT_CD
 AND EBFS.EXM_A_ISN=V_GCC_EXM_A_ISN
 AND EBFS.EXM_B_SEQ=V_GCC_EXM_B_SEQ
 AND EBFS.EXM_B_ITEM_SEQ=V_GCC_EXM_B_ITEM_SEQ)
 LOOP
 --CHECK
 IF REC_EXMTN_B_D.EXM_A_ISN IS NOT NULL AND REC_EXMTN_B_D.EXM_B_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 AND REC_EXMTN_B_D.EXM_B_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF REC_EXMTN_B_D.ITEM_STA_CD<>1
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='هذا الصنف مستخدم ومنتهي أو ملغي';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 IF REC_EXMTN_B_D.CTRY_CD<>V_CTRY_CD
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='يجب ان يكون بلد المنشأ في الصنف هو نفسه في صنف الإعفاء';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 BEGIN
 SELECT INV_NBR INTO V_INV_NBR
 FROM DCLTN_INVOICES
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND INV_ISN = V_INV_ISN;
 IF V_INV_NBR IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF REC_EXMTN_B_D.INVOICE_NBR<>V_INV_NBR
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='رقم الفاتورة في نموذج الاعفاء غير صحيح';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد رقم الفاتورة ';
 RETURN 0;
 END;
 IF SUBSTR(REC_EXMTN_B_D.HRMNZD_CODE,1,8) <> SUBSTR(V_FINAL_TARIFF_CD,1,8)
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='يجب ان يكون بند الصنف للإعفاء هو نفسه بند الصنف للبيان';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 IF REC_EXMTN_B_D.MSR_UNIT<>V_INV_MSR_UNIT
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='وحدة اعفاء الصنف غير وحدة فاتورة الصنف';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 IF REC_EXMTN_B_D.EXMTN_QTY<V_INV_QTY
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='الكمية المعفاة اقل من كمية الصنف';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT_EXM_A
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND GCC_EXM_A_ISN = V_GCC_EXM_A_ISN
 AND GCC_EXM_B_SEQ = V_GCC_EXM_B_SEQ
 AND GCC_EXM_B_ITEM_SEQ = V_GCC_EXM_B_ITEM_SEQ ;
 IF V_COUNT_EXM_A>1
 THEN
 V_MSG1:='هذا الإعفاء مستخدم من صنف آخر';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;


 ELSE
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد قرار أعفاء دول مجلس التعاون الخليجى مسجل على هذه الصنف';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد قرار أعفاء دول مجلس التعاون الخليجى مسجل على هذه الصنف';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;



 END LOOP;

 ELSE

 V_MSG1:='لا يوجد قرار أعفاء دول مجلس التعاون الخليجى مسجل على هذه الصنف';
 RETURN 0;

 END IF;

END IF;
RETURN 1;
END;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EXMTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE CHECK_EXMTN IS

FUNCTION CHECK_EXMTN_DCLTN(V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER,V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_MSG OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2;

FUNCTION CHECK_EXMTN_ITEM(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_ITEM_ISN NUMBER,V_HQ_IMPR_NBR NUMBER,V_MSG1 OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EXCHNG_DEC_NEG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_EXCHNG_DEC_NEG IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_INSP_REV NUMBER;
 V_FROM_JORDAN_TRANS NUMBER:= NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('FROM_JORDAN_TRANS',14),0);
 V_EXCHNG_DEC NUMBER:= NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('EXCHNG_DEC_NEG',21),0);
 V_COUNT_DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS NUMBER;
BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT_DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLM.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 ;

IF V_COUNT_DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM EXCHNG_DEC_NEG EDN,DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLM.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DLM.CTRY_CD = EDN.NEG_CTRY_CD
 AND DLM.FR_PORT_CD = EDN.NEG_PORT_CD
 AND DLM.FRGN_MAN_NO = EDN.NEG_DCLTN_NBR
 AND DLM.FRGN_MAN_DATE = EDN.NEG_DCLTN_DT
 AND DLM.MAN_TYPE = EDN.NEG_MAN_TYPE
 AND DLM.FR_PORT_TYPE_CD = EDN.NEG_PORT_TYPE_CD
 ;

 IF V_COUNT = 1 AND V_FROM_JORDAN_TRANS = 1 AND V_EXCHNG_DEC = 1 THEN
 SELECT INSP_REV INTO V_INSP_REV FROM EXCHNG_DEC_NEG EDN,DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLM.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DLM.CTRY_CD = EDN.NEG_CTRY_CD
 AND DLM.FR_PORT_CD = EDN.NEG_PORT_CD
 AND DLM.FRGN_MAN_NO = EDN.NEG_DCLTN_NBR
 AND DLM.FRGN_MAN_DATE = EDN.NEG_DCLTN_DT
 AND DLM.MAN_TYPE = EDN.NEG_MAN_TYPE
 AND DLM.FR_PORT_TYPE_CD = EDN.NEG_PORT_TYPE_CD
 ;

 IF NVL(V_INSP_REV,0) <> 2 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن تحويل المعاملة للتحصيل - يجب تأكيد الأطلاع على معلومات بيان الصادر من الجمرك المقابل لدولة الجوار','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DUTY_OTHER_PORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_DUTY_OTHER_PORT IS
BEGIN
-- BY NABIL ALSALEH @ 20-11-2011
 IF NOT CHECK_DCLTN_ITEMS(CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DUTY_IN_OTHER_PORT')) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التحصيل , بعض أصناف البيان مرسّم بجمرك آخر , لا بد أن تكون جميع الأصناف مرسّمه بجمرك آخر','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DCLTN_SABER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_DCLTN_SABER IS
 V_DCLTN_SABER_ITEMS NUMBER;
BEGIN


 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_DCLTN_SABER_ITEMS
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS,DCLTN_SABER_ITEMS
 WHERE DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD = DCLTN_SABER_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN = DCLTN_SABER_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 AND DCLTN_SABER_ITEMS.DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD=1
 AND DCLTN_SABER_ITEMS.ITEM_STAGE <> 4
 ;

 IF V_DCLTN_SABER_ITEMS > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التحصيل , بعض أصناف البيان يوجد عليها شهادات سابر غير مؤكده , لا بد أن تكون جميع الشهادات مؤكده','ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DCLTN_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_DCLTN_ITEMS(V_DUTY_TYPE NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
V_COUNT_ITEM NUMBER;
V_COUNT NUMBER;

BEGIN
-- BY NABIL ALSALEH @ 20-11-2011
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT_ITEM FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 ;


 IF V_DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RE_EXPORT') THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DUTY_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_RE_EXPORT'))
 ;


 IF V_COUNT_ITEM = V_COUNT THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 ELSIF V_DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DUTY_IN_OTHER_PORT') THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DUTY_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DUTY_IN_OTHER_PORT'))
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 IF V_COUNT_ITEM = V_COUNT THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DCLTN_CNTNRS_ISNSP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_DCLTN_CNTNRS_ISNSP(V_LCL_COUNT OUT NUMBER,V_MANUAL_COUNT OUT NUMBER ,V_BO_AREA_COUNT OUT NUMBER,V_DOG_COUNT OUT NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS



V_CNTNR_COUNT NUMBER;
V_TEMP_COUNT NUMBER;
V_TEMP_DOG_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_LCL_NSP_BY_DCLN_DT DATE
 := TO_DATE (
 NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('LCL_NSP_BY_DCLN_DT', 18),
 '1450-01-01'),
 'YYYY-MM-MI');
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
CURSOR c_CNTNRS
 IS

SELECT DISTINCT VSSL_CNTNRS.PORT_CD,VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_TYPE,VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_NBR,VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_DT,VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_SEQ ,VSSL_CNTNRS.SHPMT_TYPE_CD,VSSL_CNTNRS.STRG_LOC_CD

 FROM sea_dlvy_orders ,sea_dlvy_items , vssl_bl_items , VSSL_CNTNRS
 WHERE sea_dlvy_orders.port_cd = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.PORT_CD = sea_dlvy_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = sea_dlvy_ITEMS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.DO_NBR = sea_dlvy_ITEMS.DO_NBR
 AND sea_dlvy_orders.DO_ISS_DT = sea_dlvy_ITEMS.DO_ISS_DT
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_PORT_CD = VSSL_bl_items.PORT_CD
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_bl_items.MFST_TYPE
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_NBR = VSSL_bl_items.MFST_NBR
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.MFST_DT = VSSL_bl_items.MFST_DT
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.BL_SEQ = VSSL_bl_items.BL_SEQ
 AND sea_dlvy_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ = VSSL_bl_items.ITEM_SEQ
 AND VSSL_bl_items.PORT_CD = VSSL_Cntnrs.PORT_CD
 AND VSSL_bl_items.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_TYPE
 AND VSSL_bl_items.MFST_NBR = VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_NBR
 AND VSSL_bl_items.MFST_DT = VSSL_Cntnrs.MFST_DT
 AND VSSL_bl_items.CNTNR_SEQ = VSSL_Cntnrs.CNTNR_SEQ
 ;




BEGIN

V_LCL_COUNT :=0;
V_MANUAL_COUNT :=0;
V_CNTNR_COUNT:=0;
V_BO_AREA_COUNT :=0;

SELECT DCLTN_DT
 INTO V_DCLTN_DT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD =:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN ;

FOR i_rec IN c_CNTNRS LOOP

 V_CNTNR_COUNT :=V_CNTNR_COUNT +1;

 IF i_rec.SHPMT_TYPE_CD IN (2) THEN
 V_LCL_COUNT := V_LCL_COUNT +1;
 END IF;

IF NVL(i_rec.STRG_LOC_CD,0) IN (1,2) THEN
 V_BO_AREA_COUNT := V_BO_AREA_COUNT +1;
 END IF;


 V_TEMP_COUNT :=0;
IF V_DCLTN_DT >= V_LCL_NSP_BY_DCLN_DT
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_TEMP_COUNT FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = i_rec.PORT_CD AND MFST_TYPE = i_rec.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = i_rec.MFST_NBR AND MFST_DT = i_rec.MFST_DT AND CNTNR_SEQ = i_rec.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND ((INSPCT_ACTN_CD=5 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=8) OR (INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=2))
 AND (DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN OR DCLTN_ISN IS NULL);
ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_TEMP_COUNT FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = i_rec.PORT_CD AND MFST_TYPE = i_rec.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = i_rec.MFST_NBR AND MFST_DT = i_rec.MFST_DT AND CNTNR_SEQ = i_rec.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND ((INSPCT_ACTN_CD=5 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=8) OR (INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=2));


END IF ;
 IF V_TEMP_COUNT > 0 THEN
 V_MANUAL_COUNT :=V_MANUAL_COUNT +1;
 END IF;
IF V_DCLTN_DT >= V_LCL_NSP_BY_DCLN_DT
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_TEMP_DOG_COUNT FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = i_rec.PORT_CD AND MFST_TYPE = i_rec.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = i_rec.MFST_NBR AND MFST_DT = i_rec.MFST_DT AND CNTNR_SEQ = i_rec.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND NVL(ISD_FLAG,0) = 1
 AND ((INSPCT_ACTN_CD=5 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=8) OR (INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=2))
 AND (DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN OR DCLTN_ISN IS NULL);

ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_TEMP_DOG_COUNT FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = i_rec.PORT_CD AND MFST_TYPE = i_rec.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = i_rec.MFST_NBR AND MFST_DT = i_rec.MFST_DT AND CNTNR_SEQ = i_rec.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND NVL(ISD_FLAG,0) = 1
 AND ((INSPCT_ACTN_CD=5 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=8) OR (INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD=2)) ;
END IF ;

 IF V_TEMP_DOG_COUNT > 0 THEN
 V_DOG_COUNT :=V_DOG_COUNT +1;
 END IF;


END LOOP;


 RETURN(V_CNTNR_COUNT);


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_CONS_UPD_IMPR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------ BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM && EXT.: 4853 && @ 19/04/2004
FUNCTION CHECK_CONS_UPD_IMPR (V_PORT_CD IN NUMBER , V_DCLTN_ISN IN NUMBER, V_ERR_MSG OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 lnPrtCd NUMBER ;
 V_WVR_PAID NUMBER;
 Ins_Req_Pmt_Mtd NUMBER ;
 lbTstItmExist BOOLEAN ;
 CURSOR DCL_ITM_EXM IS SELECT EXMTN_TYPE , ITEM_ISN , ITEM_SEQ FROM DCLTN_ITEMS WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN ORDER BY ITEM_ISN ;
BEGIN

 BEGIN
 lbTstItmExist := FALSE ;

 ----- Check Exam
 FOR REC IN DCL_ITM_EXM LOOP
 IF REC.EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF REC.EXMTN_TYPE NOT IN (7,9,5) THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- V_ERR_MSG := STR.GetArbMsg(21,900) || REC.ITEM_SEQ ;
 V_ERR_MSG := STR_DB.GetArbMsg(21,900) || REC.ITEM_SEQ ;
--&&& END
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;

 ----- Check Restrcn Cnsmtns
 BEGIN
 SELECT PORT_CD INTO lnPrtCd FROM Restrcn_Cnsmtns WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = Rec.ITEM_ISN AND ROWNUM = 1;
 IF (lnPrtCd) IS NOT NULL THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- V_ERR_MSG := STR.GetArbMsg(21,905) || REC.ITEM_SEQ ;
 V_ERR_MSG := STR_DB.GetArbMsg(21,905) || REC.ITEM_SEQ ;
--&&& END
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 lbTstItmExist := TRUE;
 END LOOP;
 END;
 -----


 ----- Check Ins. Reqs
 BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT Ins_Req_Pmt INTO Ins_Req_Pmt_Mtd FROM INS_REQS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD ;
 IF Ins_Req_Pmt_Mtd = 2 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- V_ERR_MSG := STR.GetArbMsg(21,920) ;
 V_ERR_MSG := STR_DB.GetArbMsg(21,920) ;
--&&& END
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 -----

 ----- NEW CODE FOR CHEACK PAIDED WAIVERS
 BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT(waivers.wvr_port_cd) INTO V_WVR_PAID FROM waivers waivers, wvr_items wvr
 WHERE ( (waivers.wvr_port_cd = wvr.wvr_port_cd)
 AND (waivers.wvr_seq_nbr = wvr.wvr_seq_nbr)
 AND (waivers.issued_dt = wvr.issued_dt)
 AND (waivers.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN)
 AND (
 ( (wvr.item_type_cd IN (7)) )
 OR
 ( (wvr.item_type_cd IN (1,2)) AND (TO_CHAR(wvr.issued_dt,'RRRR-MM-MI') > '1427-02-26') )
 )
 AND (wvr.RCPT_NBR IS NOT NULL)
 );

 IF (V_WVR_PAID) > 0 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- V_ERR_MSG := STR.GetArbMsg(21,975) ;
 V_ERR_MSG := STR_DB.GetArbMsg(21,975) ;
--&&& END
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 -----

 RETURN(TRUE);
END;
