PROCEDURE CHECK_CONFIRM_TAPALE IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_TAPALE_SITTING NUMBER := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('CHECK_TAPALE', 21);
BEGIN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND V_TAPALE_SITTING = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO, SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI, VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI, VSSL_CNTNRS VC ,CNTNR_TYPES CT
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND SDO.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND SDI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD
 AND SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT
 AND VBI.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD
 AND VBI.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VBI.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR
 AND VBI.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT
 AND VBI.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ
 AND VBI.ITEM_SEQ = SDI.ITEM_SEQ
 AND VC.PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD
 AND VC.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VC.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR
 AND VC.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT
 AND VC.CNTNR_SEQ = VBI.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VC.CNTNR_TYPE_CD = CT.CNTNR_TYPE_CD
 AND VC.SHPMT_TYPE_CD IN (1, 3) -- FCL, PCL
 AND VC.TABALE_STA_CD = 1
 AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VCI
 WHERE VC.PORT_CD = VCI.PORT_CD
 AND VC.MFST_TYPE = VCI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VC.MFST_NBR = VCI.MFST_NBR
 AND VC.MFST_DT = VCI.MFST_DT
 AND VC.CNTNR_SEQ = VCI.CNTNR_SEQ
 )
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد حاوية غير مستفة مبدأيه ولم يتم تأكيدها ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_CERT_APPROVED
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--******************************************************************************************************************************************************************

--************************* mohamed habib 12-06-2010 << PROCEDURE FOR APPROVAL OF CERTIFICATION FOR ITEMS >> *******************************************************
--******************************************************************************************************************************************************************
PROCEDURE check_cert_approved IS

v_error NUMBER :=0; -- COUNT REJECTED ITEMS FROM MO3AYN
items_error VARCHAR2(200) :=' '; -- STRING HOLDING ITEM ISN FOR REJECTED ITEMS FROM MO3AYN
V_NULL NUMBER :=0; -- COUNT NOT APPROVED ITEMS AT ALL
ITEMS_NULL VARCHAR2(200):=' '; -- STRING HOLDING ITEM ISN FOR NOT APPROVED ITEMS AT ALL
V_LAB NUMBER :=0; -- COUNT NOT APPROVED YET FROM LABS
ITEMS_LAB VARCHAR2(200) :=' '; -- STRING HOLDING ITEMS ISN FOR NOT APPROVED YET FROM LABS
V_LAB_REJECT NUMBER :=0; -- COUNT REJECTED ITEMS FROM LABS
ITEMS_LAB_REJECT VARCHAR2(200) :=' '; -- STRING HOLDING ITEM ISN FOR REJECTED ITEMS FROM LABS
V_RESTRICT NUMBER :=0; -- COUNT RESTRICTED ITEMS FROM RESTRICT DEPARTMENT
ITEMS_RESTRICT VARCHAR2(200) :=' '; -- STRING HOLDING ITEM ISN FOR RESTRICTED ITEMS FROM RESTRICT DEPARTMENT
V_CTRY NUMBER :=0; -- COUNT RESTRICTED ITEMS FROM RESTRICT DEPARTMENT
CTRY_DIFFER VARCHAR2(200) :=' '; -- STRING HOLDING COUNTRIERS OF ITEMS THAT DIFFER FROM CERTIFICATION AUTHORITY
v_LAB_TRANS NUMBER :=0; --COUNT TRANSFERED TO LABS
SMPL_REQ VARCHAR2(200) :=' '; -- STRING HOLDING ITEMS WENT TO LABS WITH NO REQUEST AND APPROVED
v_SMPL_REQ NUMBER :=0; --COUNT HOLDING NUMBER OF ITEMS WENT TO LABS WITH NO REQUEST AND APPROVED


V_DUMMY NUMBER:=0;

 BEGIN


 BEGIN
--************************************************* LOOP ON EVERY ITEM WITH CERTIFICAT *****************************************************************************
 FOR t_item IN ( SELECT CTRY_CD,ICA_IDNT_ISN,ITEM_SEQ,IDEN_CERT_APPRV
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE port_cd=:DECLARATIONS.port_cd
 AND DCLTN_ISN=:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND IDEN_CERT_NBR IS NOT NULL) LOOP



-------------------------------CHECK CERT AUTH COUNTRY CODE------------------------------------

--CODE MOVED FROM VALIDATE RECORD OF DECLTN_ITEMS (2220) FOR BUSSINESS REASONS OF UPDATING
 DECLARE
 V_ERROR NUMBER ;
 BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1 INTO V_ERROR
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1
 FROM IDNTCAL_CERT_AUTHORTYES
 WHERE CTRY_CD!=t_item.CTRY_CD -- NOT THE SAME COUNTRY CODE
 AND IDNT_ISN=t_item.ICA_IDNT_ISN) ; --THE SAME AUTHORTY
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;

/*
 IF V_ERROR>0 THEN
 V_CTRY:=V_CTRY+1;
 CTRY_DIFFER:=CTRY_DIFFER||CHR(13)||' الصنف رقم '||t_item.ITEM_SEQ ;
 --STR.DISPALERT(' بلد المنشأ لجهة شهادة الصنف غير بلد المنشأ للصنف ','ERROR');
 -- RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
*/
 END;




------------------------------------------END----------------------------------------------------


---- VALUE THAT IS NULL << APPROVAL = { NULL } MEANS APPROVAL ACTION MUST BE TAKEN FROM MO3AYN >>
 IF t_item.IDEN_CERT_APPRV IS NULL THEN
 V_NULL:=V_NULL+1;
 ITEMS_NULL:=ITEMS_NULL||CHR(13)||' الصنف رقم '||t_item.ITEM_SEQ;
 END IF;



------ VALUE THAT REJECT FROM MO3AYN << APPROVAL == { 1 } MEANS REJECTED FROM MO3AYN >>
 IF t_item.IDEN_CERT_APPRV=1 THEN
 v_error:= v_error+1;
 items_error:=items_error||CHR(13)||' الصنف رقم '||t_item.ITEM_SEQ ;

 END IF;

---- VALUE THAT RESTRICTED FROM RESTRICT DEPARTMENT << APPROVAL == { 3 } MEANS REJECTED FROM RESTRICT DEPARTMENT>>
 IF t_item.IDEN_CERT_APPRV=3 THEN
 v_RESTRICT := v_RESTRICT +1;
 items_RESTRICT :=items_RESTRICT||CHR(13)||' الصنف رقم '||t_item.ITEM_SEQ ;
 END IF;



---- VALUE THAT REJECTED FROM LABS << APPROVAL == { 5 } MEANS REJECTED FROM LABS >>
 IF t_item.IDEN_CERT_APPRV=5 THEN
 v_LAB_REJECT:= v_LAB_REJECT+1;
 items_LAB_REJECT:=items_LAB_REJECT||CHR(13)||' الصنف رقم '||t_item.ITEM_SEQ;
 END IF;


---- VALUE THAT RANDOMLY 10 MUST BE CHECKED WITH LABS << APPROVAL = { 6 } MEANS APPROVAL ACTION MUST BE TAKEN FROM LABS >>
 IF t_item.IDEN_CERT_APPRV=6 THEN
 v_LAB:= v_LAB+1;
 items_LAB:=items_LAB||CHR(13)||' الصنف رقم '||t_item.ITEM_SEQ ;
 END IF;


---- VALUE THAT RANDOMLY 10 MUST BE CHECKED WITH LABS << APPROVAL = { 8 } MEANS APPROVAL ACTION MUST BE TAKEN FROM LABS >>
 IF t_item.IDEN_CERT_APPRV=8 THEN
 v_LAB_TRANS := v_LAB_TRANS +1;
 items_LAB:=items_LAB||CHR(13)||' الصنف رقم '||t_item.ITEM_SEQ ;
 END IF;

---- VALUE THAT APPROVED FROM LABS << APPROVAL = { 7 } MEANS APPROVED WITHOUT REQUEST SAMPLE >>
 IF t_item.IDEN_CERT_APPRV=7 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO V_DUMMY
 FROM SMPL_REQUESTS
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN=:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END ;



 IF V_DUMMY >0 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 v_SMPL_REQ := v_SMPL_REQ +1;
 SMPL_REQ:=SMPL_REQ||CHR(13)||' الصنف رقم '||t_item.ITEM_SEQ ;
 END IF;


 END IF;


 END LOOP;
EXCEPTION
WHEN OTHERS THEN
NULL;
END;
--*************************************************************** <<END LOOP>> ************************************************************************************


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------- << BEGIN CHECK >> ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
---------------------------------------------------------------- << REJECTED MO3AYN >> ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------- << NULL >> -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 ----------- NULL
 IF V_NULL>0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد اصناف لم يعتمد شهادة مطابقتها وعددها '||V_NULL||CHR(13)||' وهى '||ITEMS_NULL,'ERROR');

 TERMINATE_FUN;


 END IF;


 ----------- 1
 IF V_error>0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد اصناف مرفوض شهادة مطابقتها وعددها '||v_error||CHR(13)||' وهى '||items_error,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 ----------- 3
------------------------------------------------------------------ << RESTRICT DEP >> ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_RESTRICT >0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد اصناف تم رفضها من إدارة القيود وعددها '||V_RESTRICT ||CHR(13)||' وهى '||ITEMS_RESTRICT ,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

----------- 5
------------------------------------------------------------------ << REJECTED LAB >> ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_LAB_REJECT>0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد اصناف محولة لإدارة القيود وعددها '||V_LAB_REJECT||CHR(13)||' وهى '||ITEMS_LAB_REJECT,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

----------- 6
----------------------------------------------------------------- << COUNT 10 >> ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_LAB>0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد اصناف تم رفضها من المختبرات وعددها '||V_LAB||CHR(13)||' وهى '||ITEMS_LAB,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

----------- 8
----------------------------------------------------------------- << COUNT 10 >> ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF v_LAB_TRANS >0 THEN STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد اصناف محولة للمختبرات وعددها '||v_LAB_TRANS || CHR(13) ||' وهى '||ITEMS_LAB,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
/*
 --------------------------------------------------------------- << DIFFERENT CTRY >> ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_CTRY >0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد اصناف بلد المنشأ لجهة شهادة المطابقة غير بلد المنشأ للصنف '||V_CTRY ||CHR(13)||' '||CTRY_DIFFER ,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
*/
--------------------------------------------------------------- << NO SAMPLE REQ >> ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF v_SMPL_REQ >0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يوجد اصناف محولة للمعامل ولم ينشأ لها طلب تحليل عينات'||v_SMPL_REQ ||CHR(13)||' '||SMPL_REQ ,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------- << END CHECK >> -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_BRKR_CRIDIT_AMT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_BRKR_CRIDIT_AMT (P_STOP IN NUMBER, P_CL_VAL IN NUMBER) IS
 P_TODAY_H DATE;
 V_CHECK NUMBER;
 Ret NUMBER;
 OUT_CR_LETR_NBR NUMBER;
 OUT_CR_LETR_DT DATE;
 OUT_CR_LETR_TYPE NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('BRK_CRD_AMT',21),0) = 1 THEN
 IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DECLARATIONS.LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD <> (100) THEN
 P_TODAY_H := HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date;

 /* IF P_STOP = 0 THEN
 V_VAL := 1;
 ELSE
 V_VAL := P_CL_VAL;
 END IF;
*/
 V_CHECK := TRNST.GET_VALID_BRKR_CL(:LIC_TYPE,:LIC_NBR,:BRKR_PORT_CD,P_CL_VAL,P_TODAY_H,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,
 OUT_CR_LETR_NBR ,OUT_CR_LETR_DT ,OUT_CR_LETR_TYPE );

 IF V_CHECK <> 1 THEN
 IF P_STOP = 0 THEN --2
 RET:= STR.DISPALERT('تنبيه : لا يوجد لديك رصيد ضمان، ولن يتم استكمال المعاملة في حال وجود رسوم مقاصة إلا فى حال قيامك بتعلية رصيدك, هل تريد الاستمرار ','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN

 TERMINATE_FUN;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 RET:= STR.DISPALERT('تنبيه : لا يوجد لديك رصيد ضمان، ولن يتم استكمال المعاملة في حال وجود رسوم مقاصة إلا فى حال قيام المخلص بتعلية رصيده ','INFORMATION');
 END IF; --2

 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_AIR_MFST_REGISTRATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_AIR_MFST_REGISTRATION IS

 V_TERMINATE_FUNCTION BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_MFST_STATUS NUMBER;
 V_BILL_STATUS BILLS.BILL_STATUS%TYPE;
 V_BLD_PORT_CD BILLS.PORT_CD%TYPE;
 V_BLD_CARR_PREFIX BILLS.CARR_PREFIX%TYPE;
 V_BLD_BILL_NBR BILLS.BILL_NBR%TYPE;
 V_BLD_BILL_DT BILLS.BILL_DT%TYPE;

 CURSOR DCLTN_DLVYS IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, DLVY_NBR, DLVY_DT
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 ;


BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 4 AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD = DCLTN.DT_IS THEN
IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 4 AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_IS') THEN
--&&& END
 FOR I IN DCLTN_DLVYS LOOP
 SELECT NVL(MD.MFST_STATUS,0),BLD.PORT_CD,BLD.CARR_PREFIX,BLD.BILL_NBR,BLD.BILL_DT
 INTO V_MFST_STATUS,V_BLD_PORT_CD,V_BLD_CARR_PREFIX,V_BLD_BILL_NBR,V_BLD_BILL_DT
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS ADO, MFST_DTLS MD ,BILL_DTLS BLD
 WHERE ADO.PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND ADO.DLVY_NBR = I.DLVY_NBR
 AND ADO.DLVY_DT = I.DLVY_DT
 AND BLD.PORT_CD = ADO.PORT_CD
 AND BLD.CARR_PREFIX = ADO.CARR_PREFIX
 AND BLD.BILL_NBR = ADO.BILL_NBR
 AND BLD.BILL_DT = ADO.BILL_DT
 AND BLD.SHPMT_TYPE = ADO.SHPMT_TYPE
 AND BLD.MFST_NBR = ADO.MFST_NBR
 AND BLD.MFST_YEAR = ADO.MFST_YEAR
 AND BLD.MFST_TYPE = ADO.MFST_TYPE
 AND MD.PORT_CD = ADO.PORT_CD
 AND MD.MFST_NBR = ADO.MFST_NBR
 AND MD.SHPMT_TYPE= ADO.SHPMT_TYPE
 AND MD.MFST_YEAR = ADO.MFST_YEAR
 AND MD.MFST_TYPE = ADO.MFST_TYPE
 ;



 IF V_MFST_STATUS <> 4 THEN

 --DEVELOPED BY KAMEL EL SAYED IN 17/6/2006 TO RETURN BILL_STATUS TO CHECK ON BILL_STATUS RATHER THAN MFST_STATUS
 SELECT NVL(BLS.BILL_STATUS,0) INTO V_BILL_STATUS
 FROM BILLS BLS
 WHERE BLS.PORT_CD = V_BLD_PORT_CD
 AND BLS.CARR_PREFIX = V_BLD_CARR_PREFIX
 AND BLS.BILL_NBR = V_BLD_BILL_NBR
 AND BLS.BILL_DT = V_BLD_BILL_DT
 ;
 IF V_BILL_STATUS<>4 THEN
 STR.DispALERT(' لا يمكن إستكمال العملية - يجب تسجيل المانفيست أوالبوالص لإذن التسليم رقم'||I.DLVY_NBR||' بتاريخ '||TO_CHAR(I.DLVY_DT,'MI/MM/YYYY'),'ERROR');
 V_TERMINATE_FUNCTION := TRUE;
 END IF;
 --END OF ADD
 END IF;





 END LOOP;

 IF V_TERMINATE_FUNCTION THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_24H_GRP_XRY_INI
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_24H_GRP_XRY_INI IS
V_TOTAL_XRAY NUMBER;
V_SEND_INI NUMBER;
RET NUMBER;

BEGIN

IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0) = 1 THEN

 V_TOTAL_XRAY:=LIB_USR.HOURS24.vci_auto_no(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN);

 IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = 36 AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 IF V_TOTAL_XRAY = 0 AND :GROUP_ID IS NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('لم يتم أختيار مجموعة معاينه ولم يتم ايضا اختيار حاويات للأشعه - هل تريد الاستمرار ؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_TOTAL_XRAY = 0 AND :GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('لم يتم أختيار حاويات للأشعه - هل تريد الاستمرار ؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 end if;

 ELSIF V_TOTAL_XRAY > 0 AND :GROUP_ID IS NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('لم يتم أختيار مجموعة معاينه - هل تريد الاستمرار ؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY'),4) THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_SEND_INI FROM MSG_HDRS
 WHERE MSG_TYPE = 'DECINI' AND PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_ISN AND PORT_CNTRCTR_CD = :PORT_CNTRCTR_CD;
 IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = 36 AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND V_SEND_INI = 0 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم انهاء استقبال المعامله - هل شركة المناولة مطابقة للبوليصة الفعلية؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE <> 4 THEN
 SEND_DECINI_CNTNR;
 ELSE
 NULL;
 --SEND_AIR_DECINI_CNTNR;
 END IF;
 END IF;



 END IF;
END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHANGE_DCLTN_STA_INSP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHANGE_DCLTN_STA_INSP IS
V_prtl_exist NUMBER;
v_port_cntrctr_EXIST NUMBER;
V_DCLTN_RCV_EXIST NUMBER;
V_DCLTN_RCV_REJECTED_EXIST NUMBER;
V_prtl_FINALIZE_DT_exist NUMBER;
INSPTR_DCLTNS_exist NUMBER;
V_DCLTN_STA_DESC VARCHAR2(200);
V_24hours NUMBER :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0);
v_dcltn_status VARCHAR2(200);
V_ONLINE_CNT NUMBER;
V_Impr_pledge_status NUMBER; --DM815
 V_ALLOW_TRANSFER_ICC NUMBER := TO_NUMBER(NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('ALLOW_TRANSFER_ICC', 21), 0)); -- AHMED WAKEEL CR_3566 ICC وحدة المعاينة والفسح
BEGIN
IF V_24hours = 1 THEN
SELECT PRTL_NEBRAS_SERVICES.DCLTN_OUTSIDE_DEPT(:port_cd,:dcltn_isn) INTO v_dcltn_status FROM dual;
IF NVL(:RECP_FLAG,0) IN (3) THEN
 IF INSTR(:DCLTN_STA_DESC,'(مرفوضة)') = 0 THEN
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC := :DCLTN_STA_DESC ||'(مرفوضة)';
 END IF;
ELSE
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC := REPLACE(:DCLTN_STA_DESC,'(مرفوضة)','');
END IF;
IF (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 3)
 OR (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 2)
 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_prtl_exist
 FROM DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;
SELECT COUNT(FINALIZE_DT) INTO V_prtl_FINALIZE_DT_exist
 FROM DCLTN_PRTL_DOCS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_DCLTN_RCV_EXIST
 FROM DCLTN_RECEIVED
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_DCLTN_RCV_REJECTED_EXIST
 FROM DCLTN_RECEIVED
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND RECIEVE_FLAG = 4;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO INSPTR_DCLTNS_exist
FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
;

 IF V_DCLTN_RCV_EXIST = 0 THEN
 IF V_prtl_exist = 0 THEN
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'لدي المخلص بدون ارشفة';
 ELSE
 IF V_prtl_FINALIZE_DT_exist = 0 THEN
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'لدي المخلص أرشفة غير منتهية';
 ELSE --DM815
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(Impr_pledge_status,0) INTO V_Impr_pledge_status FROM DCLTN_IMPR_PLEDGE
 WHERE port_cd = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_TYPE = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN V_Impr_pledge_status := 0;
 END;
 --DM815
 IF v_Impr_pledge_status =1 AND NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('DM_815', 21), 0) = 1 AND :dcltn_dt > TO_DATE (NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CR815_IMPR_WVR_STG', 21),'1450-01-01'),'YYYY-MM-MI') THEN
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'معلق في انتظار تقديم الاقرار';
 ELSE
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'لدي الاستقبال أرشفة تحت الاعتماد';
 END IF;
 --WAKEEL MIM CR_6253
 IF v_Impr_pledge_status =9 AND NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('MIM_CERTIFICATE', 21), 0) = 1 THEN
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'معلق في انتظار تقديم خطاب صناعي';
 ELSE
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'لدي الاستقبال أرشفة تحت الاعتماد';
 END IF;

 --WAKEEL MIM CR_6253
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_DCLTN_RCV_REJECTED_EXIST = 1 THEN
 IF V_prtl_exist = 0 THEN
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'لدي المخلص مرفوضة أوراق';
 ELSE
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'لدي المخلص مرفوضة أرشفة';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF :recp_flag IS NULL THEN
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'لدي الاستقبال المعاملة مستلمة';
 ELSIF NVL(:recp_flag,0) = 1 THEN
 IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 IF INSPTR_DCLTNS_exist = 0 THEN
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'لدى مناولة منهي استقبالها';
 ELSE
 V_DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'تم توجيد المعاملة';
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
IF V_DCLTN_STA_DESC IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 3) THEN
 IF v_dcltn_status IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'تفتيش محال ل'||v_dcltn_status||'('||V_DCLTN_STA_DESC||')';
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'تفتيش'||'('||V_DCLTN_STA_DESC||')';
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 2) AND CHK_EXPORT_BOUND_DEC = 0 THEN --cr-6013
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'بالمراجعة'||'('||V_DCLTN_STA_DESC||')';
 END IF;
END IF;

 IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 4 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_ONLINE_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_ONLINE_PAYMENT
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND REFUND_STATUS = 0 ;

 IF V_ONLINE_CNT > 0 THEN
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_DESC := 'مــدفوع اون لايــن';
 END IF;
 END IF;

--WAKEEL CR_5475
 IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 9
 AND NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('ROLBCK_XPRSS_MAIL', 21), 0) = 1
 THEN
 IF DCLTN.CHK_IF_CNDTIONL_RLS_STTS(:PORT_CD ,:DCLTN_ISN) = 1 THEN
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC :='فسح مشروط معلق الرسوم' ;
 END IF ;
 END IF ;
--WAKEEL CR_5475

 -- AHMED WAKEEL CR_3566 ICC وحدة المعاينة والفسح
 IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD =7 AND :DECLARATIONS.SPCL_DEPT_ID = 106 THEN
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_DESC :='محول إلي وحدة المعاينة والفسح' ;
 IF NVL(:RECP_FLAG,0) IN (3) THEN
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC := :DCLTN_STA_DESC ||'(مرفوضة)';
 END IF;
 END IF ;
 -- AHMED WAKEEL CR_3566 ICC وحدة المعاينة والفسح

--WAKEEL CR-6601-3

 IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 3 AND NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('SUSPICION_REMOVAL', 21), 0) = 1
 THEN
 IF DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLW_ASSGIN_INSPCT(:PORT_CD ,:DCLTN_ISN,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 0 THEN
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC := :DCLTN_STA_DESC ||'(حوكمة وسائل)';
 ELSIF DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLW_ASSGIN_INSPCT_OPP(:PORT_CD ,:DCLTN_ISN,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 0 THEN
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC := :DCLTN_STA_DESC ||'(حوكمة المفتش المعاكس)';
 END IF ;
 END IF ;

--WAKEEL CR-6601-3

 -- CR-5180 Suzan Ibrahim Mohamed Shehata 18-10-2022
 -- تعديل آلية رفع المنافست للصادر الجوي
 declare
 p_code NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 set_bill_wait_status_txt(1,p_code);
 END;
--FEDEX_CR
DECLARE
V_RET NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 V_RET:= DHL_UTL.ALLW_PARTIAL_DHL_RLS (:DECLARATIONS.port_cd,:DECLARATIONS.dcltn_isn) ;
IF V_RET = 1 AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 5 THEN
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC :='مفسوح جزئيا--الشحنة تحت الاجراءات الجمركية ولا يمكن التصرف بها' ;
END IF;
END;

--FEDEX_CR

-- Wejdan ALharbi CR-9414
DECLARE
V_RET_1 NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 V_RET_1:= DCLTN_UTILITIES.CHK_PRTL_RLSD (:DECLARATIONS.port_cd,:DECLARATIONS.dcltn_isn) ;
IF V_RET_1 = 1 AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4) AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND')
AND NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting (:DECLARATIONS.port_cd, 'CR-9414', 21),0) = 1 AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 11 THEN -- Hotfix لإصلاح وصف الحالة
 :DCLTN_STA_DESC :='مفسوح جزئيا';
END IF;
END;

-- Wejdan ALharbi CR-9414

 add_payed_to_clear; -- CR-8767
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CAR_MODEL_VALIDATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CAR_MODEL_VALIDATE IS
FOUND NUMBER:=0;
V_MSG VARCHAR2(3030);
RET NUMBER;
BEGIN

IF ((TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_DT,'YYYY-MM-MI') >= '1430-03-03' AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2)) OR (:DCLTN_DT IS NULL AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2))) THEN

IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (1,2) THEN



/*
DECLARE


CURSOR CUR_HRMNZ IS SELECT FINAL_TARIFF_CD,CARS_MODEL FROM DCLTN_ITEMS WHERE
 PORT_CD =:PORT_CD
 AND
 DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_ISN ;
 THERE_IS_ITEMS_OTHER NUMBER:=0;
 NEW_CAR NUMBER:=0;
 OLD_CAR NUMBER:=0;
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN

 BEGIN
 SELECT IMPR_TYPE_CD INTO V_IMPR_TYPE_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = (SELECT IMPR_NBR
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN );
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD:=-1;
 END;

IF V_IMPR_TYPE_CD != 4 THEN
 FOR HRMNZ IN CUR_HRMNZ LOOP


 IF CAR_IN_HRMNZD_CODE (HRMNZ.FINAL_TARIFF_CD)= 0 THEN
 THERE_IS_ITEMS_OTHER:= 1;
 END IF;

 IF HRMNZ.CARS_MODEL=1 THEN
 NEW_CAR:= 1;
 END IF;

 IF HRMNZ.CARS_MODEL= 0 THEN
 OLD_CAR:= 1;
 END IF;


 END LOOP;

 IF OLD_CAR=1 AND NEW_CAR=1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لاتستطيع انشاء صنف سيارة جديدة مع صنف سيارات قديمة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;


 IF NEW_CAR=1 AND THERE_IS_ITEMS_OTHER=1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لاتستطيع انشاء صنف بضاعة مع صنف سيارة جديدة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END IF;

END;


*/




 FOR CUR IN (SELECT ROWNUM||'- الصنف'||'('||ITEM_SEQ ||')' MSG FROM DCLTN_ITEMS WHERE
 PORT_CD =:PORT_CD AND
 DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_ISN AND
 (CARS_MODEL IS NULL OR CARS_MODEL_CON_DT IS NULL) AND
 EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM GROUP_ITEMS
 WHERE HRMNZD_CODE=DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD AND GRP_CODE=76) ) LOOP


 IF LENGTH (V_MSG || CUR.MSG)<3000 THEN
 V_MSG := V_MSG || CUR.MSG||CHR(10);
 END IF;
 FOUND := FOUND +1;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND>0 THEN
 V_MSG:=' هناك اصناف لم يتم تاكيد نوع السيارات عددها '||FOUND||' :-'||CHR(10)||V_MSG;
 RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR', 1, 'هناك اصناف سيارة لم يتم تأكيدها لذا يجب تأكيدها قبل التحويل للتحصيل',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1150, 'r0g0b75', 12);
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;















 END IF;
END IF;
END;

 RET NUMBER;

 :GLOBAL.PORT_CD := NULL;

 :GLOBAL.PORT_NAME := NULL;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_POST_DB_COMMIT_PRINT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_POST_DB_COMMIT_PRINT (P_COPY IN NUMBER) IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'REP_LIST';
 ACTUAL_CD NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;

BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);

 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list ' || pl_name || ' IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_DCLTN_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_PORT_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_DCLTN_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_REPRINT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 0);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PRIVATE_AIR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_PRIVATE_VT);

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = DCLTN.DSI_2PAY THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_2PAY') THEN
--&&& END
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BANK_TXT', TEXT_PARAMETER, GET_BANK_TXT);
 END IF;

 IF CHK_DIFF_CLR THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_IMPR_DIFF_CLRNC', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 END IF;

 IF FAST_TRACK THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_FAST_TRACK', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 END IF;

 ACTUAL_CD := DCLTN.ENCRYPT_NUM(:DCLTN_ISN, :PRINT_CNT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'CG$P_P_PRNT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, ACTUAL_CD);
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOTEXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

---================
 IF P_COPY = 2 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id, 'P_COPY', TEXT_PARAMETER, 2);
 END IF;
---================
 PRINT_REPORT('CD_00360',PL_ID,0,1);

 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_LOV_RECIEVE_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_LOV_RECIEVE_DCLTN IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_CONFIRM_BAN';
 RET NUMBER;
 v_dept_id NUMBER;
BEGIN

IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = 36 THEN
v_dept_id:=36;
ELSIF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_IMM'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INSP'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP'))
 AND CHK_EXP_EMP_TYPE=0 THEN
v_dept_id:=95;
ELSIF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_AFF')
 OR (NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_EXP')
 AND CHK_EXP_EMP_TYPE <> 0 ) THEN
v_dept_id:=96;
END IF;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_USER_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DEPT_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,v_dept_id);
 CALL_FORM('LOV_RCV_DCLTN.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN:=:GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD:=:GLOBAL.PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.REFRESH_DCLTN :=1;
 :global.Exec_Query_Now := 1;
 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOT EXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 IF :dcltn_isn IS NULL AND :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID', REQUIRED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;


END;

BEGIN

-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_EXPORT', TEXT_PARAMETER,DCLTN.AUTH_IMP);

 :AGENT_NBR := :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_ITEMS_PASS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_ITEMS_PASS IS
pl_id ParamList;
ret NUMBER;
pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'ITEM_PASS_PARAM';
V_COUNTER NUMBER:=0 ;
OUT_MSG VARCHAR2(4000);
 CURSOR cITEMS IS
 SELECT DI.ITEM_DESC , NVL(DI.ORGNL_DUTY,0) + NVL(DI.SEL_TAX,0) ITEM_FEES
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN ;
 V_RET VARCHAR2(4000);
BEGIN
 IF NVL(:AIR_PASS, 0 ) <> 1 OR :DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن اضافة اصناف بعد ترقيم المعاملة للمسافر','ERROR');
 ------------------------------------------------------
 FOR REC IN cITEMS LOOP

 V_RET := V_RET || CHR(10) ||cITEMS%ROWCOUNT ||' - ' ||'الصنف : '|| REC.ITEM_DESC ||' رسومه : '||REC.ITEM_FEES ||CHR(10);
 IF (LENGTH(V_RET) > 3900) THEN
 V_RET := V_RET ||'.....' || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 EXIT;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;
 --STR.DISPALERT(OUT_MSG,'INFORMATION');
 OUT_MSG := CHR(1000) || V_RET;
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(OUT_MSG, 'INFORMATION', 1, 'أصناف البيان ورسومها',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1300, 'r255g0b0', 7);
-------------------------------------------------------------------
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list ' || pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,10309);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,'شاشة صيانة أصناف المسافرين');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

/*FUNCTION Call_Can_Item_Confirm_Pass RETURN INTEGER
IS

 dum NUMBER;
BEGIN
 dum :=DCLTN.Can_Item_Confirm_Pass (:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);
 IF dum=0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' يوجد أصناف تحتاج إلى تأكيد رئيس المجموعة ','ERROR');--'--
 END IF;

 RETURN dum;
END; /*
*/
FUNCTION Call_Can_Item_Confirm_Pass(FUN VARCHAR2) RETURN INTEGER
IS
 CURSOR C1 IS SELECT DI.ITEM_SEQ ITEM_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI,DCLTN_ITEM_CONFIRMS DIC
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = DIC.PORT_CD
 AND DI.ITEM_ISN = DIC.ITEM_ISN
 AND DI.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND DIC.ACTION_TYPE IS NULL ;

 V_TXT_DTL VARCHAR2(3000) := NULL;
 V_TXT_DTL_ALL VARCHAR2(3000) := NULL;
 V_TXT_HEDR VARCHAR2(200);
 V_FLASH_ALERT VARCHAR2(200);
 dum NUMBER;
BEGIN
 dum :=DCLTN.Can_Item_Confirm_Pass (:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);
 IF dum=0 THEN
 IF FUN IN ('CD_01730','CD_00655') THEN
 V_TXT_HEDR := ' لايمكن تحويل البيان للتحصيل كون هذه الأصناف تحتاج إلى تأكيد رئيس المجموعة ';
 ELSIF FUN IN ('INSP') THEN
 V_TXT_HEDR := ' لا يمكن تحويل البيان لرئيس المجموعة كون هذه الأصناف تحتاج إلى تأكيد ';
 ELSE
 V_TXT_HEDR := ' هذه الأصناف تحتاج إلى تأكيد رئيس المجموعة ';
 END IF;

 FOR I IN C1 LOOP
 V_TXT_DTL := 'مسلسل الصنف : '|| I.ITEM_SEQ || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 V_TXT_DTL_ALL :=V_TXT_DTL_ALL || V_TXT_DTL;
 IF (LENGTH(V_TXT_DTL_ALL) > 2950) THEN
 V_TXT_DTL_ALL := V_TXT_DTL_ALL ||'.....' || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 V_FLASH_ALERT := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_TXT_HEDR || CHR(1000)||V_TXT_DTL_ALL,'INFORMATION',2, 'رسالة توضيحية',
 5.5, 1.8, 1.5, 0.5, 1400, 'r100g0b0',10);
 END IF;
 RETURN dum;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT(V_GRP_ID NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR VARCHAR2(200);
 FUNCTION CHECK_DCLN_GROUP RETURN NUMBER IS
 RET NUMBER;
 BEGIN

 SELECT AUTO_INSP INTO RET FROM DCLTN_GRPS WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = V_GRP_ID ;
 RETURN RET ;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN 0;
 END;
BEGIN

 IF :PARAMETER.P_AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT IS NULL THEN

 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD)=1 THEN
 V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR:=GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('INSPTR_AUTO_ASSIGN',CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DCLTN_SYS_ID'));
 IF V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR IS NULL THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 IF DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD)=1 THEN
 V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR:=GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('INSP_AUTO_ASS_EXP',CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DCLTN_SYS_ID'));
 IF V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR IS NULL THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;




 IF IS_PRIVTE_AVIATION THEN
 V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR:=GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('INSP_AUTO_ASS_PVT',CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DCLTN_SYS_ID'));
 IF V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR IS NULL THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT := TO_NUMBER(V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR);

 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT = 1 THEN
 IF V_GRP_ID IS NOT NULL AND V_GRP_ID !=0 THEN
 IF CHECK_DCLN_GROUP = 0 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ASSIGN_GROUP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION ASSIGN_GROUP(V_GROUP_ID NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,V_TEST_GROUP NUMBER DEFAULT 0) RETURN NUMBER IS
--- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM @ 27/12/2005
--- TO ASSIGIN GROUP ID TO DECLARATION AUTOMATICALLY.


 V_GROUP_ID_VAL NUMBER;
 V_GROUP_ANAME_VAL VARCHAR2(100);

BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_ID , GRP_NAME INTO V_GROUP_ID_VAL , V_GROUP_ANAME_VAL FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE DCLTN_GRPS.PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND
 GRP_ID = NVL(V_GROUP_ID,GRP_ID)
 AND
 DCLTN_GRPS.GRP_STATUS = 1
 AND
 (DCLTN_GRPS.PORT_CD,DCLTN_GRPS.GRP_ID) IN (SELECT PORT_CD,GRP_ID FROM GRP_DCLTN_TYPES
 WHERE REC_STATUS = 1 AND DCLTN_TYPE_ID= :DCLTN_TYPE_CD AND NVL(PRIVATE,0) = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_PRIVATE_VT,0));


 IF V_TEST_GROUP = 0 THEN
 :GROUP_ID := V_GROUP_ID_VAL ;
 :GROUP_ANAME := V_GROUP_ANAME_VAL ;
 END IF;

 RETURN 0;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 RETURN -1;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 IF ( (:PORT_CD = 98) OR (:PORT_CD = 99) OR (:PORT_CD = 97) ) THEN
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 IF V_GROUP_ID IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(21,155,'ERROR'); --- THIS STEP CALLED FROM WHEN_CRETE_RECORD
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN -2;
 ELSE
 RETURN -2; --- THIS STEP CALLED FROM WHEN_VALIDATE_ITEM
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_IMPR_ACTIVITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJUST_IMPR_ACTIVITY
IS
 V_LEN NUMBER;
BEGIN

 SELECT LENGTH(ACTIVITY)
 INTO V_LEN
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.AGENT_NBR;

 IF V_LEN >= 991 THEN
 UPDATE IMPORTERS
 SET ACTIVITY = SUBSTR(ACTIVITY, 1, 990)
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.AGENT_NBR;

 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_PMT_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_PMT_DATA IS
 CURSOR CR_PMT IS SELECT COLL_ORDR_STA, COLL_DT, DOC_INS_NBR, DOC_INS_DT,
 BANK_CD, BANK_BRNCH_CD, RCPT_NBR, RCPT_TYPE
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ;
 CO_REC CR_PMT%ROWTYPE;
 V_ACCT_NBR NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :PMT_DATA := NULL;

 OPEN CR_PMT;
 FETCH CR_PMT INTO CO_REC;

 IF CR_PMT%FOUND THEN
 IF CO_REC.COLL_ORDR_STA = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('REVENUE.REV_COS_PAYED_BANK') THEN
 IF CO_REC.RCPT_TYPE = 2 THEN
 :PMT_DATA := 'تفويض رقم ';
 DECLARE
 V_ATM_AUTHRZTN_CD VARCHAR2(20);
 BEGIN
 SELECT ATM_AUTHRZTN_CD
 INTO V_ATM_AUTHRZTN_CD
 FROM BANK_RCPTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PORT_CD
 AND BANK_CD = CO_REC.BANK_CD
 AND BANK_BRNCH_CD = CO_REC.BANK_BRNCH_CD
 AND REV_DT = CO_REC.COLL_DT
 AND RCPT_NBR = CO_REC.RCPT_NBR
 AND RCPT_TYPE = CO_REC.RCPT_TYPE
 ;
 :PMT_DATA := :PMT_DATA || V_ATM_AUTHRZTN_CD;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ELSE
 :PMT_DATA := 'إيصال رقم ' || CO_REC.RCPT_NBR;
 END IF;
 :PMT_DATA := :PMT_DATA || ' بتاريخ ' || TO_CHAR(CO_REC.COLL_DT, 'MI-MM-YYYY');
 ELSIF CO_REC.COLL_ORDR_STA = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('REVENUE.REV_COS_PAYED_DOC_INS') THEN
 :PMT_DATA := 'ت. سندي ' || CO_REC.DOC_INS_NBR;
 :PMT_DATA := :PMT_DATA || ' بتاريخ ' || TO_CHAR(CO_REC.DOC_INS_DT, 'MI-MM-YYYY');
 :PMT_DATA := :PMT_DATA || ' في ' || TO_CHAR(CO_REC.COLL_DT, 'MI-MM-YYYY');
 ELSIF CO_REC.COLL_ORDR_STA = 7 THEN
 V_ACCT_NBR := REVENUE.GET_PMT_ACCT_NBR(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_NBR, :DCLTN_DT, :DCLTN_TYPE_CD);
 :PMT_DATA := 'محصل من حساب رقم ' || V_ACCT_NBR;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 CLOSE CR_PMT;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_FUNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_FUNS IS
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_SND_RCV_FUN_EXIST NUMBER;
 V_SND_RCV_FUN_EXIST2 NUMBER;
 V_SND_RCV_FUN_EXIST3 NUMBER;
 V_SND_RCV_FUN_EXIST4 NUMBER;
 V_ROW_COUNT NUMBER;
 HDATE DATE;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(100);
 V_TAPALE_SITTING NUMBER := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('CHECK_TAPALE', 21);
 V_SPCL_DEPT_ACTN NUMBER := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('SPCL_DEPT_ACTN',21);
 TABALE_CNT NUMBER;
 PRICING_CNT NUMBER;
 V_EXPRESS NUMBER;
 V_DCN_STATUS NUMBER;
 V_PETRO_EXMTN_FLG NUMBER;
 v_setting VARCHAR2 (200) := '0';
 V_MANUAL_CNTNR NUMBER;
 --V_GULF_DUTY NUMBER := 0;
 V_ASR_VALUE VARCHAR2(200);
 V_VHCL_TABALE_CNT NUMBER := 0;
 V_PORT_TYPE NUMBER ;

BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_setting
 FROM sc_port_setting
 WHERE var_name = 'INVOICE_PAYMENT_MTHD'
 AND var_value = '1'
 ;
 SELECT PORT_TYPE
 INTO V_PORT_TYPE
 FROM SD_PORTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 ;
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 ------------------------- MAIH 24-08-2012 ---------------------------------------------
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF :system.form_status = 'CHANGED' THEN
 IF :global.chg_status = 1 THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('يجب حفظ التغييرات او التراجع عنها قبل اختيار الوظائف','information');
 --TMPLT.DISABLE_ALL_FUNS;
 -- raise form_trigger_failure ;
 NULL;
 ELSE
 :global.chg_status := 1 ;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :global.chg_status := 0 ;
 END IF;
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF :DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- adj_add_daman_fees ; -- MAIH 06-07-2014
 ADJ_ALLOW_DOC_PMT_FLAG;
 --&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
 /*DCLTN.ADJ_DCLTN_FUNS(:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE,:DCLTN_STA_CD,:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,:PARAMETER.P_LEVEL,
 :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :PMT_METHOD);*/
 DCLTN_FN.ADJ_DCLTN_FUNS(:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE,:DCLTN_STA_CD,:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,:PARAMETER.P_LEVEL,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :PMT_METHOD);
 adj_add_daman_fees ; -- MAIH 06-07-2014
 HDATE := HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date(V_MSG_TXT);
 :PARAMETER.P_BANK_OFF := REVENUE.ALL_BANKS_OFF(TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD')), HDATE);
 :PARAMETER.P_SDAD_ACT := SADAD4PORT.IS_SADAD_APPLIED;
 IF NOT(V_TAPALE_SITTING = 1 AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND') AND :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND GET_TABALE_COUNT > 0) THEN
 TMPLT.DISABLE_FUN('CD_02680');
 TMPLT.DISABLE_FUN('CD_02700');
 END IF;
 --BILAL FOR PRICING
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO PRICING_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND PRICING_APPRV = 1
 ;
 IF PRICING_CNT = 0 THEN
 TMPLT.DISABLE_FUN('CD_02760');
 END IF;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_EXPRESS
 FROM DECLARATIONS D , IMPORTERS I
 WHERE D.PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND D.IMPR_NBR = I.IMPR_NBR
 AND I.EXPRESS_POST = '1'
 AND D.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF V_EXPRESS > 0 THEN
 NULL;
 --TMPLT.DISABLE_FUN('CD_00655');
 END IF;
 --END
 --&&& END
 /*
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(ORGNL_DUTY, 0) - NVL(EXMTD_DUTY, 0)), 0)
 INTO V_GULF_DUTY
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DUTY_TYPE IN (1,3,9,25)
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;

 IF V_GULF_DUTY <= 0 THEN
 TMPLT.DISABLE_FUN('CD_01227');
 END IF;
 */ --
 IF (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_STA_CD = 6) OR (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :DCLTN_STA_CD = 8) THEN
 --&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
 -- IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID NOT IN (DCLTN.DU_INST, DCLTN.DU_CMPTR, DCLTN.DU_MGR) THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID NOT IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INST'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_CMPTR'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_MGR')) THEN
 --&&& END
 TMPLT.DISABLE_ALL_FUNS;
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 str.dispalert('لا يمكن التعامل مع البيان - راجع الحاسب الآلي' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF :GLOBAL.SEC_SND_RCV_EXIST = 1 THEN
 IF CHK_SND_REC_STA = 1 THEN
 IF CHECK_DCLTN_IS_RECIVE(V_PORT_CD,V_SPCL_DEPT_SEQ) IN(1,-1) THEN
 V_ROW_COUNT := 1;
 V_SND_RCV_FUN_EXIST := 0;
 WHILE V_ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT LOOP

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_FUN_24HOURS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_FUN_24HOURS IS
 v_count NUMBER;
 v_from NUMBER;
 v_count_exist NUMBER;
 v_count_reject NUMBER;
 v_count_recieve NUMBER;
 v_total_xray NUMBER;
 v_do_iss_loc_cd NUMBER;
 x_cntnr NUMBER;
 v_prtl_doc_exist NUMBER;
 v_24hours NUMBER := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS', 21), 0);
 v_24hoursexp NUMBER := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURSEXP', 21), 0);
 v_dcln_r68 NUMBER;
 v_dcln_r70 NUMBER;
 V_MANUAL_CNTNR NUMBER;
 v_paths_rejected NUMBER;
V_CNT_DIST NUMBER ;
 CURSOR c_funs IS
 SELECT sys_os_file_name
 FROM sc_system_objects sso
 WHERE sso.sysobj_id
 IN
 (
 SELECT sysobj_id
 FROM sc_sysobj_role_privs ssrp, sc_user_roles sur
 WHERE ssrp.role_id = 'DCLN_R68'
 AND sys_type = 7
 AND ssrp.role_id = sur.role_id
 AND sur.user_id = :parameter.p_user_id
 AND sur.ur_active = 1
 AND ssrp.rl_sys_active = 1
 )
 ;
BEGIN
 -------------CRQ78428 START
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT_DIST
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES UR
 WHERE UR.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND UR.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UR.UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND UR.ROLE_ID = 'CNTRL_MNUL_DIST' ;

 IF V_CNT_DIST > 0 THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('CD_01190');
 ELSE
 TMPLT.DISABLE_FUN('CD_01190');
 END IF;
------------END
 -- START 0
 IF (v_24hours = 1 AND :dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)) OR (v_24hoursexp = 1 AND :dcltn_type_cd NOT IN (1, 2)) THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO v_prtl_doc_exist
 FROM dcltn_prtl_docs
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_stats_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND NVL (paper_rcv, 0) <> 1
 ;
 --
 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO v_paths_rejected FROM dcltn_prtl_doc_paths
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_stats_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND doc_status_seq <> 2
 ;
 --
 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO v_count
 FROM tasks
 WHERE task_id = NVL (:parameter.p_task_id, 0)
 AND filler1 IS NOT NULL
 ;
 --
 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO v_count_exist
 FROM dcltn_received
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 ;
 --
 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO v_count_recieve
 FROM dcltn_received
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND recieve_flag = 1
 ;
 BEGIN
 SELECT DISTINCT do_iss_loc_cd INTO v_do_iss_loc_cd
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 IF V_COUNT = 0 AND NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) <> 36 THEN
 IF NVL(:RECP_FLAG,0) <> 1 AND :INSPTR_ID IS NULL
 AND
 (
 (:DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_STA_CD IN (3,7))
 OR (:DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_STA_CD IN (2,7))
 ) THEN
 tmplt.disable_all_funs;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- START 1
 IF NVL (:recp_flag, 0) = 3 THEN
 tmplt.disable_all_funs;
 IF NVL (:parameter.p_task_id, 0) = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_AFF') AND :dcltn_sta_cd = 3 AND V_CNT_DIST > 0 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_01190');
 END IF;
 IF v_count > 0 THEN
 SELECT TO_NUMBER (filler1)
 INTO v_from
 FROM tasks
 WHERE task_id = NVL (:parameter.p_task_id, 0)
 ;
 END IF;
 IF (NVL (:parameter.p_task_id, 0) IN (consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_IMM'),consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_INSP')) AND :dcltn_sta_cd = 3)
 OR
 (
 NVL (:parameter.p_task_id, 0) = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DU_AFF') AND :dcltn_sta_cd = 15
 )
 OR
 (
 v_count > 0 AND v_from = :spcl_dept_id AND :dcltn_sta_cd = 7
 )
 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03670');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- END 1
 -- START 2
 IF NVL (:parameter.p_task_id, 0) = 36 THEN
 -- START 3
 IF :u_dcltn_status NOT IN (2,3) THEN
 tmplt.disable_all_funs;
 -- START 4
 IF v_prtl_doc_exist = 1 AND NVL (:recp_flag, 0) = 1 AND v_paths_rejected = 0 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03420'); -- استلام فعلي (أوراق) للمستندات
 END IF;
 -- END 4
 -- START 5
 IF :u_dcltn_status = 7 AND :recp_flag IS NULL AND :spcl_dept_id IS NULL THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_00690');
 END IF;
 -- END 5
 ELSE
 -- START 6
 IF :recp_flag IS NOT NULL THEN
 tmplt.disable_all_funs;
 -- START 7
 IF :recp_flag = 1 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03500'); -- إلغاء انهاء استقبال المعاملة
 END IF;
 -- END 7
 ELSE
 -- START 8
 IF v_count_exist > 0 THEN
 -- START 9
 IF v_count_recieve > 0 THEN
 tmplt.enable_all_funs;
 -- START 10
 IF :port_cntrctr_cd IS NULL THEN
 tmplt.disable_fun ('CD_03430'); -- تعديل شركة التفريغ
 END IF;
 -- END 10
 -- START 11
 IF v_do_iss_loc_cd = 2 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_01570');-- طباعة طلب التحضير والمعاينة
 END IF;
 -- END 11
 tmplt.disable_fun ('CD_03390'); -- قبول استلام المعامله
 tmplt.disable_fun ('CD_03400'); -- رفض استلام المعامله
 ELSE
 tmplt.disable_all_funs;
 IF v_paths_rejected = 0 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03390'); -- قبول استلام المعامله
 END IF;
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03400'); -- رفض استلام المعامله
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03370'); -- اعتماد وثائق البيان الجمركي
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03440'); -- استعراض وثائق البيان الجمركي
 END IF;
 -- END 9
 ELSE
 tmplt.disable_all_funs;
 -- START 12
 IF v_paths_rejected = 0 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03390');
 END IF;
 -- END 12
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03400'); -- رفض استلام المعامله
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03370'); -- اعتماد وثائق البيان الجمركي
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03440'); -- استعراض وثائق البيان الجمركي
 END IF;
 -- END 8
 tmplt.disable_fun ('CD_03500'); -- إلغاء انهاء استقبال المعاملة
 END IF;
 -- END 6
 END IF;
 -- END 3
 -- START 13
 IF v_prtl_doc_exist = 1 AND NVL (:recp_flag, 0) = 1 AND v_paths_rejected = 0 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03420'); -- استلام فعلي (أوراق) للمستندات
 END IF;
 -- END 13
 -- START 14
 IF :u_dcltn_status = 17 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03520');
 -- إرسال ومتابعة الرسائل داخل الجمرك
 END IF;
 -- END 14
 -- START 15
 IF NVL (:recp_flag, 0) IN (0, 2) AND :u_dcltn_status IN (2,3) AND v_count_exist > 0 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03510'); -- إلغاء استلام المعامله
 END IF;
 -- END 15
 END IF;
 -- END 2
 -- START 16
 IF v_count_recieve = 0 THEN
 tmplt.disable_fun ('CD_01570'); -- طباعة طلب التحضير والمعاينة
 END IF;
 -- END 16
 -- START 17
 IF :dcltn_isn IS NULL THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR', required,property_false);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('INSPTR_ID', required, property_false);
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03410'); -- استعراض المعاملات المستلمه
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03530'); -- استعراض المعاملات المستلمه
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03540'); -- استعراض المعاملات المستلمه
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03470'); -- استعراض توزيع الأقسام المختصه
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03490');
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_02830');
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_04280'); -- الاستعلام عن البيان الجمركي برقم الاستحقاق
 END IF;
 -- END 17
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_dcln_r68
 FROM sc_user_roles
 WHERE user_id = :parameter.p_user_id
 AND ur_active = 1
 AND role_id = 'DCLN_R68'
 ;
 --
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_dcln_r70
 FROM sc_user_roles
 WHERE user_id = :parameter.p_user_id
 AND ur_active = 1
 AND role_id = 'DCLN_R70'
 ;
 -- START 18
 IF v_dcln_r68 = 1 AND v_dcln_r70 = 1 AND :dcltn_isn IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_prtl_doc_exist
 FROM dcltn_prtl_docs dpd
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_stats_isn = :dcltn_isn
 ;
 -- START 19
 IF v_prtl_doc_exist > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_prtl_doc_exist
 FROM dcltn_prtl_docs dpd
 WHERE port_cd = :port_cd
 AND dcltn_stats_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND NVL (dpd.user_id_receiver, :parameter.p_user_id) = :parameter.p_user_id
 ;
 -- START 20
 IF v_prtl_doc_exist = 0 THEN
 FOR i IN c_funs LOOP
 tmplt.disable_fun (i.sys_os_file_name);
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 -- END 20
 END IF;
 -- END 19
 END IF;
 -- END 18
 V_MANUAL_CNTNR:=LIB_USR.HOURS24.vci_manual_no(:PORT_CD,:DCLTN_ISN);
 IF V_MANUAL_CNTNR > 0 THEN
 TMPLT.enable_FUN('CD_03550');
 ELSE
 TMPLT.DISable_FUN('CD_03550');
 END IF;
 --
 IF NVL (:parameter.p_task_id, 0) = 16 THEN
 IF NVL(:recp_flag,0) NOT IN (2,3) THEN
 TMPLT.enable_FUN('CD_00370');
 ELSE
 TMPLT.DISable_FUN('CD_00370');
 END IF;
 ELSE --- ayman gad 11-10-2026 CRQ78956
 TMPLT.DISable_FUN('CD_00370');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- END 0
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_ALLOW_DOC_PMT_FLAG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--ADJ_ALLOW_DOC_PMT_FLAG
--DESCRIPTION : TO CHECK IMPR RULS IF EXIST OR NOT
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 15-03-2005
----------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE ADJ_ALLOW_DOC_PMT_FLAG IS
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :PARAMETER.P_ALLOW_DOC_PMT_FLAG :=0;
 --&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
 --IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = FALSE THEN
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 0 THEN
 --&&& END
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 IF :DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR IS NULL THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 -- NEW WAY FOR ALLOWING DOC. PAYMENT
 IF CHECK_IMPR_RULS (:DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR,1)= 1 THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_ALLOW_DOC_PMT_FLAG :=1;
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 SELECT IMPR_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_IMPR_TYPE_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND IMPR_NBR = :DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR
 ;
 IF V_IMPR_TYPE_CD IN (2, 8) THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_ALLOW_DOC_PMT_FLAG :=1;
 RETURN;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_ADD_DAMAN_FEES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2014/09/10 11:12 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
PROCEDURE adj_add_daman_fees
IS
 v_cnt NUMBER;
 v_setting VARCHAR2 (20);
BEGIN
 SELECT NVL (var_value, '0')
 INTO v_setting
 FROM sc_port_setting
 WHERE UPPER (var_name) = UPPER ('daman_dcltn_fees')
 ;
 IF v_setting IN ('1', '2','4') THEN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM
 (
 SELECT 1
 FROM dcltn_items di,
 declarations d,
 sea_dlvy_orders sdo,
 sea_dlvy_items sdi,
 vssl_bl_items vbi,
 sea_goods_types sgt,
 importers im,
 group_items gi
 WHERE d.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND di.port_cd = d.port_cd
 AND di.dcltn_isn = d.dcltn_isn
 AND d.port_cd = sdo.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = sdo.dcltn_isn
 AND sdo.port_cd = sdi.port_cd
 AND sdo.shpg_agnt_nbr = sdi.shpg_agnt_nbr
 AND sdo.do_nbr = sdi.do_nbr
 AND sdo.do_iss_dt = sdi.do_iss_dt
 -- AND sdi.port_cd IN (vbi.port_cd, DECODE (vbi.port_cd, 30, 34, vbi.port_cd))
 AND sdi.mfst_port_cd = vbi.port_cd
 AND sdi.mfst_type = vbi.mfst_type
 AND sdi.mfst_nbr = vbi.mfst_nbr
 AND sdi.mfst_dt = vbi.mfst_dt
 AND sdi.bl_seq = vbi.bl_seq
 AND sdi.item_seq = vbi.item_seq
 AND vbi.gds_type_cd = sgt.gds_type_cd
 AND d.port_cd = im.port_cd
 AND d.impr_nbr = im.impr_nbr
 AND di.final_tariff_cd = gi.hrmnzd_code
 AND gi.grp_code = 76 -- vehicle
 --AND sgt.mark_req = 1 -- vehicle
 AND sgt.gds_type_cd = 1
 AND LENGTH (vbi.item_mark) >= 17
 AND im.car_agent_flag = 0
 -- not a car agent
 /*
 AND (
 (
 (vbi.item_mark)
 NOT IN
 (
 SELECT chase_nbr
 FROM vhcl_salvage_cars vsc
 )
 )
 OR ((vbi.item_mark)
 IN
 (
 SELECT chase_nbr
 FROM vhcl_salvage_cars vsc
 WHERE NVL (dcltn_isn, 0) <> :dcltn_isn
 AND (vsc.chase_status IS NULL
 OR vsc.chase_status = 1
 )
 )
 )
 )
 */
 UNION
 SELECT 1
 FROM customs.dcltn_land_mnfsts,
 customs.dcltn_land_mnfst_trans,
 customs.vhcl_transactions,
 customs.declarations,
 dcltn_items di,
 importers im,
 group_items gi
 WHERE (declarations.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND di.port_cd = declarations.port_cd
 AND di.dcltn_isn = declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND declarations.port_cd = im.port_cd
 AND declarations.impr_nbr = im.impr_nbr
 AND di.final_tariff_cd = gi.hrmnzd_code
 AND gi.grp_code = 76 -- vehicle
 --AND sgt.mark_req = 1 -- vehicle
 AND vhcl_transactions.VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD IN (1,2,3,4,5)
 AND LENGTH (vhcl_transactions.vhcl_chassis_no) >= 17
 AND im.car_agent_flag = 0
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfsts.port_cd = dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.port_cd)
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfsts.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.dcltn_mnfst_isn)
 AND (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_land_mnfsts.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_land_mnfsts.dcltn_isn)
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.port_cd = vhcl_transactions.port_cd)
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.tran_seq = vhcl_transactions.tran_seq)
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.trans_date_h = vhcl_transactions.trans_date_h)
 AND (vhcl_transactions.rec_tran_seq IS NOT NULL OR vhcl_transactions.vhcl_tran_type = 5)
 )
 /*
 AND ( ((vhcl_transactions.vhcl_chassis_no) NOT IN (
 SELECT chase_nbr
 FROM vhcl_salvage_cars vsc)
 )
 OR ((vhcl_transactions.vhcl_chassis_no) IN (
 SELECT chase_nbr
 FROM vhcl_salvage_cars vsc
 WHERE NVL (dcltn_isn, 0) <> :dcltn_isn
 -- 5893831
 AND ( vsc.chase_status IS NULL
 OR vsc.chase_status = 1

 ))
 )
 )
 */
 UNION
 SELECT 1
 FROM customs.declarations,
 customs.dcltn_items,
 customs.air_dlvy_orders,
 customs.bills,
 customs.bill_items,
 customs.importers,
 customs.group_items
 WHERE ((declarations.port_cd = :port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn)
 AND (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_items.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_items.dcltn_isn)
 AND (declarations.port_cd = air_dlvy_orders.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = air_dlvy_orders.stmt_isn)
 AND (bills.port_cd = air_dlvy_orders.port_cd)
 AND (bills.carr_prefix = air_dlvy_orders.carr_prefix)
 AND (bills.bill_nbr = air_dlvy_orders.bill_nbr)
 AND (bills.bill_dt = air_dlvy_orders.bill_dt)
 AND (bills.port_cd = bill_items.port_cd)
 AND (bills.carr_prefix = bill_items.carr_prefix)
 AND (bills.bill_nbr = bill_items.bill_nbr)
 AND (bills.bill_dt = bill_items.bill_dt)
 AND (importers.port_cd = declarations.port_cd)
 AND (importers.impr_nbr = declarations.impr_nbr)
 AND (group_items.hrmnzd_code = dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd)
 AND group_items.grp_code = 76 -- vehicle
 AND bill_items.pkg_type_cd = 28 -- vehicle
 AND LENGTH (bill_items.item_mark) >= 17
 AND importers.car_agent_flag = 0
 /*
 AND ( ((bill_items.item_mark) NOT IN (
 SELECT chase_nbr
 FROM vhcl_salvage_cars vsc)
 )
 OR ((bill_items.item_mark) IN (
 SELECT chase_nbr
 FROM vhcl_salvage_cars vsc
 WHERE NVL (dcltn_isn, 0) <> :dcltn_isn
 AND ( vsc.chase_status IS NULL
 OR vsc.chase_status = 1 -- not salvag
 ))
 )
 )
 */
 )
 UNION
 SELECT 1
 FROM customs.dcltn_gate_trans,
 customs.vhcl_transactions,
 customs.declarations,
 dcltn_items di,
 importers im,
 group_items gi
 WHERE (declarations.port_cd = :port_cd --31
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn --5893831
 AND di.port_cd = declarations.port_cd
 AND di.dcltn_isn = declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND declarations.port_cd = im.port_cd
 AND declarations.impr_nbr = im.impr_nbr
 AND di.final_tariff_cd = gi.hrmnzd_code
 AND gi.grp_code = 76 -- vehicle
 --AND sgt.mark_req = 1 -- vehicle
 AND vhcl_transactions.vhcl_ctgry_grp_cd IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
 AND LENGTH (vhcl_transactions.vhcl_chassis_no) >= 17
 AND im.car_agent_flag = 0
 AND (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_gate_trans.dcltn_isn)
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd = vhcl_transactions.port_cd)
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.vhcl_trans_nbr =vhcl_transactions.tran_seq)
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.vhcl_trans_date = vhcl_transactions.trans_date_h)
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type <> 7)
 AND (vhcl_transactions.rec_tran_seq IS NOT NULL
 OR vhcl_transactions.vhcl_tran_type = 5
 )
 /*
 AND ( ((vhcl_transactions.vhcl_chassis_no) NOT IN (
 SELECT chase_nbr
 FROM vhcl_salvage_cars vsc)
 )
 OR ((vhcl_transactions.vhcl_chassis_no) IN (
 SELECT chase_nbr
 FROM vhcl_salvage_cars vsc
 WHERE NVL (dcltn_isn, 0) <> :dcltn_isn
 -- 5893831
 AND ( vsc.chase_status IS NULL
 OR vsc.chase_status = 1

 ))
 )
 )
 */
 )
 )
 ;
 IF v_cnt > 0 THEN
 tmplt.enable_fun ('CD_03020');
 ELSE
 tmplt.disable_fun ('CD_03020');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 tmplt.disable_fun ('CD_03020');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_PAYED_TO_CLEAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE add_payed_to_clear IS
 -- CR-8767
 v_setting NUMBER;
 v_port_type NUMBER;
 v_inspect_type_cd NUMBER(2);
BEGIN
 v_setting := gnrl.get_customs_setting('KHALEG_ENHANCE_8767',21);
 IF v_setting = 1 then-- setting on
 IF :declarations.final_ctry_cd <> 100 THEN -- مقصد خليجي
 IF :declarations.dcltn_type_cd IN (1,2) THEN -- جمركي وارد
 v_port_type := gnrl.get_customs_setting('PORT_TYPE',999);
 if v_port_type = 3 then -- LAND
 IF :declarations.dcltn_sta_cd = 9 THEN -- clear
 BEGIN
 SELECT inspect_type_cd
 INTO v_inspect_type_cd
 FROM dcltn_inspct_trans
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND ROWNUM = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 v_inspect_type_cd := 1;
 END;
 IF v_inspect_type_cd = 1 THEN -- direct clearance
 IF :declarations.exit_doc_nbr IS NOT NULL THEN
 :declarations.dcltn_sta_desc := 'مفسوح ومنتهي ومسدد';
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_INSP_ACTIVITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADD_INSP_ACTIVITY IS
 V_PRINT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF NVL(:INSP_REP_PRINT_CNT,0) = 0 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 55, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD||'!'||:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 56, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD||'!'||:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :INSP_REP_PRINT_CNT := NVL(:INSP_REP_PRINT_CNT,0) + 1;
 COMMIT;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_DAMAN_FEES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2016/01/13 12:22 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
PROCEDURE add_daman_fees
IS
 ret NUMBER;
 v_ret NUMBER;
 v_cnt NUMBER;
 v_setting VARCHAR2 (20);
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM
 (
 SELECT 1
 FROM dcltn_items di,
 declarations d,
 sea_dlvy_orders sdo,
 sea_dlvy_items sdi,
 vssl_bl_items vbi,
 sea_goods_types sgt,
 importers im,
 group_items gi
 WHERE d.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND di.port_cd = d.port_cd
 AND di.dcltn_isn = d.dcltn_isn
 AND d.port_cd = sdo.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = sdo.dcltn_isn
 AND sdo.port_cd = sdi.port_cd
 AND sdo.shpg_agnt_nbr = sdi.shpg_agnt_nbr
 AND sdo.do_nbr = sdi.do_nbr
 AND sdo.do_iss_dt = sdi.do_iss_dt
 AND sdi.mfst_port_cd = vbi.port_cd
 AND sdi.mfst_type = vbi.mfst_type
 AND sdi.mfst_nbr = vbi.mfst_nbr
 AND sdi.mfst_dt = vbi.mfst_dt
 AND sdi.bl_seq = vbi.bl_seq
 AND sdi.item_seq = vbi.item_seq
 AND vbi.gds_type_cd = sgt.gds_type_cd
 AND d.port_cd = im.port_cd
 AND d.impr_nbr = im.impr_nbr
 AND di.final_tariff_cd = gi.hrmnzd_code
 AND gi.grp_code = 76
 AND sgt.gds_type_cd IN ( 1, 13 )
 AND LENGTH (vbi.item_mark) >= 17
 AND im.car_agent_flag = 0
 UNION
 SELECT 1
 FROM customs.dcltn_land_mnfsts,
 customs.dcltn_land_mnfst_trans,
 customs.vhcl_transactions,
 customs.declarations,
 dcltn_items di,
 importers im,
 group_items gi
 WHERE (declarations.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND di.port_cd = declarations.port_cd
 AND di.dcltn_isn = declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND declarations.port_cd = im.port_cd
 AND declarations.impr_nbr = im.impr_nbr
 AND di.final_tariff_cd = gi.hrmnzd_code
 AND gi.grp_code = 76
 AND vhcl_transactions.vhcl_ctgry_grp_cd IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
 AND LENGTH (vhcl_transactions.vhcl_chassis_no) >= 17
 AND im.car_agent_flag = 0
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfsts.port_cd = dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.port_cd)
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfsts.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.dcltn_mnfst_isn)
 AND (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_land_mnfsts.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_land_mnfsts.dcltn_isn)
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.port_cd = vhcl_transactions.port_cd)
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.tran_seq = vhcl_transactions.tran_seq)
 AND (dcltn_land_mnfst_trans.trans_date_h = vhcl_transactions.trans_date_h)
 AND (vhcl_transactions.rec_tran_seq IS NOT NULL OR vhcl_transactions.vhcl_tran_type = 5)
 )
 UNION
 SELECT 1
 FROM customs.declarations,
 customs.dcltn_items,
 customs.air_dlvy_orders,
 customs.bills,
 customs.bill_items,
 customs.importers,
 customs.group_items
 WHERE (declarations.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_items.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_items.dcltn_isn)
 AND (declarations.port_cd = air_dlvy_orders.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = air_dlvy_orders.stmt_isn)
 AND (bills.port_cd = air_dlvy_orders.port_cd)
 AND (bills.carr_prefix = air_dlvy_orders.carr_prefix)
 AND (bills.bill_nbr = air_dlvy_orders.bill_nbr)
 AND (bills.bill_dt = air_dlvy_orders.bill_dt)
 AND (bills.port_cd = bill_items.port_cd)
 AND (bills.carr_prefix = bill_items.carr_prefix)
 AND (bills.bill_nbr = bill_items.bill_nbr)
 AND (bills.bill_dt = bill_items.bill_dt)
 AND (importers.port_cd = declarations.port_cd)
 AND (importers.impr_nbr = declarations.impr_nbr)
 AND (group_items.hrmnzd_code =dcltn_items.final_tariff_cd)
 AND group_items.grp_code = 76
 AND bill_items.pkg_type_cd IN ( 28, 29 )
 AND LENGTH (bill_items.item_mark) >= 17
 AND importers.car_agent_flag = 0
 )
 UNION
 SELECT 1
 FROM customs.dcltn_gate_trans,
 customs.vhcl_transactions,
 customs.declarations,
 dcltn_items di,
 importers im,
 group_items gi
 WHERE (declarations.port_cd = :port_cd
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_isn
 AND di.port_cd = declarations.port_cd
 AND di.dcltn_isn = declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND declarations.port_cd = im.port_cd
 AND declarations.impr_nbr = im.impr_nbr
 AND di.final_tariff_cd = gi.hrmnzd_code
 AND gi.grp_code = 76
 AND vhcl_transactions.vhcl_ctgry_grp_cd IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
 AND LENGTH (vhcl_transactions.vhcl_chassis_no) >= 17
 AND im.car_agent_flag = 0
 AND (declarations.port_cd = dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd)
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = dcltn_gate_trans.dcltn_isn
 )
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd = vhcl_transactions.port_cd)
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.vhcl_trans_nbr = vhcl_transactions.tran_seq)
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.vhcl_trans_date = vhcl_transactions.trans_date_h)
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type <> 7)
 AND (vhcl_transactions.rec_tran_seq IS NOT NULL OR vhcl_transactions.vhcl_tran_type = 5)
 )
 )
 ;
 IF v_cnt > 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL (var_value, '0')
 INTO v_setting
 FROM sc_port_setting
 WHERE UPPER (var_name) = UPPER ('daman_dcltn_fees')
 ;
 IF v_setting IN ('1', '2', '4') THEN
 IF :parameter.p_port_type IN (1, 4) THEN
 ret := str.dispalert('هل تريد إستثناء المركبات الأثريه من شركة ضمان ؟ !','CONFIRM');
 IF ret = alert_button1 THEN
 call_daman_exptn_lov;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF v_setting IN ('1', '2') THEN
 str.dispalert('سوف يتم الإستعلام من ضمان وقد يستغرق بعض الوقت , وضبط رسوم البيان ويمكن التأكد من شاشة استعراض خلاصة الرسوم','INformation');
 v_ret := duty.calc_daman_fees (:port_cd, :dcltn_isn, 1);
 IF v_ret > 0 THEN
 str.dispalert ('تم ضبط رسوم ضمان داخل رسوم البيان','INformation');
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 ELSIF v_ret = -1 THEN
 str.dispalert('حدث خطأ , يمكن المحاولة فى وقت آخر , عند تكرار الخطأ يجب الإتصال بالدعم الفني التطبيقات','error');
 ELSIF v_ret = 0 THEN
 str.dispalert('لا يوجد رسوم لإضافتها قد يكون قد تم الإستعلام سابقا او ان السيارة غير موجودة فى ضمان ','INformation');
 END IF;
 ELSIF v_setting IN ('4') THEN
 str.dispalert('سوف يتم الاستعلام من ضمان من خلال تبادل وقد يستغرق بعض الوقت','INformation');
 duty.send_edi_daman_msg (:port_cd, :dcltn_isn);
 FORMS_DDL ('commit');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ACCEPT_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE accept_dcltn IS
 V_NOTE VARCHAR2(500);
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(500);
 v_msg_dtls VARCHAR2(4000);
 V_24HOURS NUMBER:=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0);
 V_FUN_RET NUMBER;
 p_rqst_nmr NUMBER;
 p_rqst_dt DATE;
 RET NUMBER;
 V_RET BOOLEAN;
 V_TODAY DATE;
 V_LCL_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_MANUAL_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_CNTNRS_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_BO_AREA_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_DOG_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF V_24HOURS = 1 THEN
 V_TODAY := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('CHK_INSTRUCTIONS_24',21),0) = 1 THEN
 IF LIB_USR.hours24.chk_instructions_sea(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, :DECLARATIONS.U_DCLTN_STATUS, V_TODAY,v_msg_txt,v_msg_dtls) = 1 THEN
 V_CNTNRS_COUNT:=HOURS24.CHECK_DCLTN_CNTNRS_ISNSP( :PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN,V_LCL_COUNT ,V_MANUAL_COUNT,V_BO_AREA_COUNT,V_DOG_COUNT );
 IF V_CNTNRS_COUNT > 0 AND V_LCL_COUNT=0 AND V_BO_AREA_COUNT=0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('برجاء أختيار أحد الحاويات للفحص اليدوي , ويحال عدم الأختيار سيتم أيقاف أنهاء أستقبال المعامله','INFORMATION');
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 181, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF LIB_USR.HOURS24.receive_dcltn(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,V_NOTE,1,V_MSG_TXT) = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT,'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 168, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 LIB_USR.hours24.send_adgsts (:port_cd, :dcltn_isn, 1);
 STR.DispALERT('تمت عملية الأستلام بنجاح','INFORMATION');
 IF V_24HOURS = 1 AND :dcltn_type_cd IN (1,2) THEN
 IF NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) = 36 THEN
 IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('CREATE_SFDA_61', 21),0) IN (1,2) THEN
 V_FUN_RET := DCLTN.create_rqst_for_SFDA_MEWA(:PORT_CD,:dcltn_isn,15,61,p_rqst_nmr, p_rqst_dt);
 IF V_FUN_RET = 1 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('تم انشاء طلب احالة لهيئة الغذاء والدواء برقم '||p_rqst_nmr,'INFORMATION');
 ELSIF V_FUN_RET = -1 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('يوجد خطأ عند انشاء طلب احالة لهيئة الغذاء والدواء آليا','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('SMPL_LINK_MEWA', 21),0) IN (1) THEN
 V_FUN_RET := DCLTN.create_rqst_for_SFDA_MEWA(:PORT_CD,:dcltn_isn,5,2,p_rqst_nmr, p_rqst_dt);
 IF V_FUN_RET = 1 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('تم انشاء طلب احالة لوزارة الزراعة برقم '||p_rqst_nmr,'INFORMATION');
 ELSIF V_FUN_RET = -1 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('يوجد خطأ عند انشاء طلب احالة لوزارة الزراعة آليا','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_CD_02390
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_CD_02390 IS
ret NUMBER;
BEGIN

 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 97, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS:=4;
 IF NOT CHK_INSTRUCTIONS THEN
 :U_DCLTN_STATUS:=5;
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD:=5;
 COMMIT;
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

DECLARE
 v_obj_version NUMBER;

BEGIN
 SELECT obj_version, obj_status
 INTO v_obj_version, v_obj_status
 FROM sc_sys_obj_ver
 WHERE sysobj_id = :parameter.p_module_id
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD /* Central By Nasser 20-02-2025 */ ;

 IF v_obj_version > nvl(:GLOBAL.current_ver,1)
 THEN
 IF v_obj_status IN (1, 2)
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('إصدار الشاشة الحالي ( '||nvl(:GLOBAL.current_ver,1) || ' ) قديم , من فضلك قم بالتحديث ', 'ERROR');

 IF v_obj_status = 1
 THEN
 EXIT_FORM ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(2000) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(2000) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 BEGIN
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(TIMER_ID) THEN
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER', 1, REPEAT);
 END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TIMER-EXPIRED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 THE_TIMER VARCHAR2(40) := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(TIMER_NAME);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 v_inactive_time NUMBER;
 V_msg_count NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF THE_TIMER = 'CHECKTIMEOUT' THEN
 v_inactive_time := Win_API_Session.Timeout_get_inactive_time;
 IF v_inactive_time >= 600 then
 Win_API_Session.Timeout_Delete_Timer;
 :GLOBAL.G_TIME_OUT := 1;
 BELL;
 EXIT_FORM (NO_VALIDATE);
 ELSIF v_inactive_time >= 360 then
 BELL;
 END IF;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'ON_ERROR_TIMER' THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('' , 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 END IF;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'ON_MESSAGE_TIMER' THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('' , 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'EDI_MSG' THEN
 for_edi_msg(V_msg_count);
 IF V_msg_count > 0 THEN
 BELL;BELL;BELL;BELL;
 :EDI_MSG.EDI_MSG_TXT := 'توجد رسائل بعدد '|| V_msg_count ||' مطلوب اتخاذ اجراءات عليها';
 TURN_MSG;
 end if;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'RETURN_EDI_MSG' THEN
 RETURN_MSG;
 END IF;
 WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG;
END;

DECLARE
 THE_TIMER VARCHAR2(40) := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(TIMER_NAME);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 V_REVENUE_CHNGD NUMBER;
 V_CALC_DT DATE;
 V_PAYER VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CL_VAL NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF THE_TIMER = 'AEO_LOGO_T' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.AEO_FLAG = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.AEO_FLAG:=0;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('AEO_LOGO',BACKGROUND_COLOR,'r100g0b0');
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.AEO_FLAG:=1;
 set_item_property('AEO_LOGO',BACKGROUND_COLOR,'r223g225b225');
 END IF;
 END IF;

--- By Mohamed Taha 02/10/2022 LTP
IF THE_TIMER = 'LTP_LOGO_T' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.LTP_FLAG = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.LTP_FLAG:=0;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('LTP_LOGO',BACKGROUND_COLOR,'r100g0b0');
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.LTP_FLAG:=1;
 set_item_property('LTP_LOGO',BACKGROUND_COLOR,'r223g225b225');
 END IF;
 END IF;


 IF THE_TIMER = 'PRNT_STMT' THEN
/* موجود في PRE_UPDATE TRIGGER
 V_CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_PAYER := DCLTN.GET_DCLTN_PAYER_NAME(:PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);
 V_PAYER := NVL(V_PAYER, :AGNT_NAME);

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REPRINT_RSNS',REQUIRED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REPRINT_RSN_CD',REQUIRED,PROPERTY_FALSE);


--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- V_REVENUE_CHNGD := DUTY.CALC_DCLTN_FEES(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, V_CALC_DT, V_PAYER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, :PRINT_CNT, TRUE, V_CL_VAL);
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 V_REVENUE_CHNGD := DUTY.CALC_DCLTN_FEES(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, V_CALC_DT, V_PAYER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, :PRINT_CNT, 1, V_CL_VAL, V_MSG_TXT);
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
--&&& END
 IF V_REVENUE_CHNGD = 1 OR NVL(V_CL_VAL, 0) <> NVL(:DECLARATIONS.CL_VAL, 0) THEN
 :REV_CRETN_CNT := :REV_CRETN_CNT + 1;
 :DECLARATIONS.CL_VAL := V_CL_VAL;
 END IF;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
 IF V_REVENUE_CHNGD = -1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 END IF;
--&&& END
*/
 GO_ITEM('REPRINT_RSN');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REPRINT_RSN_CD',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);

 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 END IF;

 IF THE_TIMER = 'STOP_STMT' THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_STOP_NOTE');

 IF :STOP_NOTES IS NOT NULL THEN
 :STOP_NOTES := NULL;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('STOP_NOTES',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('STOP_NOTES',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;


 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 END IF;

 IF THE_TIMER = 'HIDE_PRINT_CD' THEN
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('DECLARATIONS.PRINT_CD', TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS.PRINT_CD', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 END IF;


--HOURS24
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
FROM TASKS
WHERE TASK_ID = NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0) AND FILLER1 IS NOT NULL;

IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0) = 1 THEN
 IF THE_TIMER = 'FETCH_RECORD' THEN
 IF :RECIEVE_AUTO = 1 AND :DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN
 V_MSG_LEVEL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '25';
 display_new_dcltn_queue;
 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_ISN');
 DO_KEY('NEXT_ITEM');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := V_MSG_LEVEL;
 END IF;
 FOR_FETCH_RECORD;
 END IF;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGGN$KEY_CLRFRM */
/* Perform the key's standard functionality */
BEGIN
 clear_form;
 IF :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'CHANGED' THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGCF$PERFORM_STARTUP */
/* execute the when-new-form-instance code that was created by forms generator */
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
END;

 */
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM DECLARATIONS DE WHERE DE.PORT_CD=:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DE.DCLTN_ISN=:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN

 END IF;

 END IF;

END;

/* MAIH 2016/01/04 13:03 */
/* should work in post-database-commit trigger on DCLTN2210 forms
to check if there is messege and show it with the specified color*/

DECLARE
 v_clr VARCHAR2 (500);
 v_msg VARCHAR2 (500);
 v_clr_ret NUMBER;
 v_clr_cd VARCHAR2(500);
BEGIN
 risk_mng.get_context(v_clr ,v_msg ) ;

 IF v_msg IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF v_clr IN ('1','2') THEN
 v_clr_cd := 'r255g0b0' ;
 ELSIF v_clr IN ('3','4','5') THEN
 v_clr_cd := 'r0g255b255' ;
 ELSE
 v_clr_cd := 'r255g0b0' ;
 END IF;
 v_clr_ret :=
 flash_clr_alert (v_msg,
 'INFORMATION',
 1,
 'رسالة تحذيرية',
 5.5,
 1.8,
 2.5,
 0.5,
 1300,
 'r255g255b255',
 v_clr_cd,
 1
 );
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1,160, :PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 forms_ddl('COMMIT');

 set_context_value('rsk_mng_ctx','msg',null);
 set_context_value('rsk_mng_ctx','clr',null);
 END IF;
exception
 when others then
 null;
END;
